sentence: The property listing highlights an expansive backyard perfect for hosting outdoor summer corporate events.
sentenceZh: 該房地產刊登廣告強調其擁有寬敞的後院，非常適合舉辦夏季戶外公司活動。

tip: 文法陷阱：bacteria 是複數名詞，單數形為 bacterium。在食品衛生與餐廳檢查報告中常考。
sentence: Regular sanitation of kitchen surfaces prevents the spread of harmful bacteria in food preparation areas.
sentenceZh: 定期對廚房表面進行清潔消毒，可防止有害細菌在食物準備區域擴散。

tip: 金融會計領域必考名詞：'bad debt' 指無法收回的「呆帳、死帳」，在資產負債表討論中非常重要。
sentence: The commercial bank had to write off millions of dollars in uncollectible bad debts this quarter.
sentenceZh: 該商業銀行本季度不得不打銷數百萬美元無法收回的呆帳。

tip: 辦公室門禁與會議簽到題型必考：'swipe your badge'（刷識別證進門），'visitor badge'（訪客證）。
sentence: Employees and outside contractors must wear their security badges visibly while on the premises.
sentenceZh: 員工與外包廠商在廠區大樓內時，必須將安全識別證佩戴於明顯處。

tip: 常修飾過去分詞，如 'badly damaged during transit'（運輸途中嚴重受損），理賠情境核心字。
sentence: The delicate electronic equipment was badly damaged during ocean transport due to improper cargo securing.
sentenceZh: 由於貨物固定不當，該精密電子設備在海運過程中嚴重受損。

tip: 同義字 irritable, cranky。多益出題在員工團隊合作或客服衝突情境中，作情緒描寫之用。
sentence: Chronic exhaustion and tight deadlines made several members of the team uncharacteristically bad-tempered.
sentenceZh: 長期的疲勞與緊迫的期限使得團隊中數位同仁一反常態地變得脾氣暴躁。

tip: 環保零售政策文章中常探討 'reusable shopping bags'（環保可重複利用購物袋）的收費機制。
sentence: The grocery chain encourages shoppers to bring their own reusable bags to reduce plastic waste.
sentenceZh: 該連鎖超市鼓勵購物者自備環保袋，以減少塑膠廢棄物。

tip: 萬年不可數名詞考點！baggage 與 luggage 永遠不可加 s，不可用 a baggage，量詞需用 a piece of baggage。
sentence: Passengers can retrieve their checked bags at baggage claim carousels three and four upon landing.
sentenceZh: 降落後，乘客可於三號和四號行李轉盤處提領他們的託運行李。

collocations: bail out (保釋出獄/擺脫困境)
tip: 名詞常考 'release on bail'（保釋候審）；動詞片語 'bail out' 引申為在財務上解救面臨破產的單位。
sentence: The defendant's business partners raised the necessary funds to post bail prior to the court hearing.
sentenceZh: 被告的商業夥伴在法庭聽證會之前籌集了必要的資金以繳納保釋金。

collocations: financial bailout package (金融紓困方案)
tip: 金融經濟新聞大考點：指政府出資拯救大到不能倒（too big to fail）的銀行或航空公司的紓困案。
sentence: The struggling international carrier secured a multibillion-dollar government bailout to avoid filing for bankruptcy.
sentenceZh: 這家陷入困境的跨國航空公司獲得了數十億美元的政府紓困資金，以避免申請破產。

collocations: bait and switch (誘敵戰術/低價誘惑再推銷高價物)
tip: 商法與行銷常考詐欺術語：'bait-and-switch'（不實釣餌廣告，指廣告特價卻宣稱無貨改推高價品）。
sentence: Consumer protection authorities heavily penalized the electronics retailer for deceptive bait-and-switch advertising tactics.
sentenceZh: 消費者保護機構針對該電子產品零售商欺騙性的「釣餌宣傳」惡質行銷手法處以重罰。

collocations: bake in an oven (在烤箱中烘烤)
tip: 常考其分詞形容詞 'freshly baked bread/pastries'（現烤麵包/點心），出現在飯店早餐供應或餐飲菜單中。
sentence: The company cafeteria serves an assortment of freshly baked pastries every morning at seven.
sentenceZh: 公司員工餐廳每天早晨七點提供各式各樣新鮮現烤的西點烘焙。

collocations: experienced baker (經驗豐富的烘焙師)
tip: 在多益聽力 Part 1 中常以穿著圍裙（apron）操作烤箱（oven）的人物姿態出現；閱讀常出現在特色餐飲加盟與在地採購情境中。
sentence: The head baker inspected each batch of artisan bread to ensure it met the hotel's quality standards.
sentenceZh: 主廚烘焙師檢查了每一批手工麵包，以確保符合飯店的品質標準。

tip: 常出現在 Part 7 的商業贊助信函、促銷傳單或採購合約中，注意衍生字 bake (v.) 與 baked goods (烘焙食品)。
sentence: The downtown bakery will celebrate its grand opening by offering complimentary pastries tomorrow.
sentenceZh: 市中心的烘焙坊明天將藉由提供免費糕點來慶祝盛大開幕。

tip: 商務情境中 outstanding balance（未付清帳款）為 Part 7 帳單催款信核心考點；作動詞時常考 balance A with/against B。
sentence: Please remit payment for the remaining balance within thirty days of receiving the invoice.
sentenceZh: 請於收到發票後三十天內支付剩餘款項。

collocations: overlook from the balcony (從陽台俯瞰)
tip: 聽力 Part 1 建築物描述常見干擾項；Part 7 飯店與租賃廣告中常與 overlook the ocean/garden（俯瞰海景/花園）搭配出題。
sentence: Each executive suite features a private balcony overlooking the city skyline.
sentenceZh: 每間商務套房均設有可俯瞰城市天際線的私人陽台。

zh: 禿頭的；無裝飾的、直截了當的
tip: 商務閱讀中除了形容外表，亦可修飾言論如 bald truth/statement，意指「赤裸裸的真相/毫不留情的陳述」。
sentence: The CEO issued a bald statement acknowledging that operational expenses had exceeded projections.
sentenceZh: 執行長發表了一份直言不諱的聲明，承認營運開銷已超出預期。

tip: 易與體育用品 ball 混淆，在多益社交活動邀請函中專指盛裝出席的舞會，常與 gala、fundraiser 互換。
sentence: Tickets for the annual charity ball must be reserved at least three weeks in advance.
sentenceZh: 年度慈善舞會的門票必須至少提前三週預訂。

tip: 會議活動安排（event planning）的高頻字，聽力與閱讀常考宴會廳可容納之人數容量（capacity）。
sentence: The award ceremony will take place in the grand ballroom on the second floor.
sentenceZh: 頒獎典禮將在二樓的大宴會廳舉行。

collocations: impose a ban on (對…實施禁令)
tip: 介系詞固定搭配 on，例：impose a ban on smoking；文法題常考 ban sb from doing sth 架構。
sentence: The municipal government decided to lift the temporary ban on commercial drone flights.
sentenceZh: 市政府決定解除對商業無人機飛行的臨時禁令。

tip: 企業年會（gala dinner）節目表中常出現 live band；科技通訊題中亦可指頻寬或頻段。
sentence: The corporate gala will feature a live jazz band during the dinner service.
sentenceZh: 公司晚會將在晚宴期間安排現場爵士樂團演奏。

collocations: banish from the market (逐出市場)
tip: 商業評論中常用於抽象概念，如 banish inefficiencies（消除無效率），同義字可換為 eliminate 或 eradicate。
sentence: The restructuring plan aims to banish operational inefficiencies across all regional branches.
sentenceZh: 這項重組計畫旨在消除所有區域分部的營運無效率現象。

tip: 商務題除指金融機構外，data bank（資料庫）亦為常見衍生概念；作動詞時 bank on 代表「指望、寄望於」。
sentence: The commercial bank approved the expansion loan after reviewing the company's financial forecast.
sentenceZh: 這家商業銀行在審查該公司的財務預測後批准了擴建貸款。

tip: 現代考試中常與 bank statement（銀行對帳單）對應，亞洲試區偶爾於臨櫃辦理相關情境出現。
sentence: Customers are reminded to bring their bankbook and valid identification when applying for a mortgage.
sentenceZh: 提醒客戶在申請房貸時請攜帶存摺與有效身分證件。

tip: 常出現在零售結帳、ATM 操作指示或防詐騙通知中，概念涵蓋 debit card 與 ATM card。
sentence: You can withdraw cash surcharge-free using your bankcard at any affiliated terminal.
sentenceZh: 您可以使用您的金融卡在任何合作端點免手續費提領現金。

tip: 職稱考點。investment banker 常在企業併購（M&A）、IPO 相關新聞文章中作為主角登場。
sentence: Our personal banker recommended several conservative investment options tailored to our budget.
sentenceZh: 我們的個人理財專員推薦了幾項針對我們預算量身打造的穩健投資選擇。

tip: 注意 online banking、mobile banking 為聽力 Part 3/4 預約、轉帳問題之極高頻核心場景詞。
sentence: The adoption of mobile banking has reduced foot traffic in suburban branches significantly.
sentenceZh: 行動銀行的普及顯著減少了郊區分行的人流臨櫃量。

collocations: bankrupt a competitor (使競爭對手破產)
tip: go bankrupt 與 file for bankruptcy 常在閱讀題改寫互相代換，注意形容詞與名詞之詞性差異。
sentence: The retail chain was on the verge of going bankrupt before receiving an emergency equity injection.
sentenceZh: 該零售連鎖店在獲得緊急股權注資前夕已瀕臨破產邊緣。

collocations: file for bankruptcy (申請破產保護)
tip: 固定動詞搭配 file for bankruptcy（提出破產申請），在 Part 7 財經新聞中是絕對核心文法詞組。
sentence: Faced with insurmountable debt, the manufacturing firm decided to file for bankruptcy reorganization.
sentenceZh: 面對無法克服的債務，該製造公司決定申請破產重整。

zh: 橫幅、標語旗幟；網路橫幅廣告
tip: 在數位行銷文章中專指 banner ad / web banner；展覽場地布置情境中則指布條或展示架橫幅。
sentence: The marketing department placed a prominent banner ad on the partner website to drive traffic.
sentenceZh: 行銷部門在合作夥伴網站上放置了醒目的橫幅廣告以引導流量。

collocations: annual banquet (年終尾牙/年度宴會)
tip: 與 annual dinner、gala 互為同義替換詞。Part 7 常考餐點特殊需求（dietary restrictions）的問答題。
sentence: Please indicate any dietary restrictions when you confirm your attendance at the awards banquet.
sentenceZh: 確認出席頒獎宴會時，請註明任何飲食限制需求。

tip: 商務慣用語 raise/lower the bar（提高/降低門檻標準）極常出現在管理層會議或業界評比文章。
sentence: The new quality control protocol effectively raises the bar for all incoming suppliers.
sentenceZh: 新的品質管制協議有效地為所有新進供應商提高了標準。

collocations: scan a bar code (掃描條碼)
generate a bar code (產生條碼)
tip: 物流（logistics）與庫存盤點（inventory）情境的核心單字，常搭配動詞 scan 或 print。
sentence: Warehouse workers must scan the bar code on each carton before loading it onto the freight truck.
sentenceZh: 倉庫工人將每個紙箱裝上貨運卡車前，必須先掃描其條碼。

tip: 常出現在員工福利活動（staff social event）的通告信函中，常縮寫為 BBQ。
sentence: All staff members and their families are cordially invited to the annual company barbecue this Saturday.
sentenceZh: 誠摯邀請所有全體同仁及其家屬參加本週六舉辦的年度公司烤肉活動。

tip: 極常考片語 the bare minimum（最低限度），在預算編列或合約要求中相當常見。
sentence: The budget was trimmed down to the bare minimum required to maintain daily operations.
sentenceZh: 預算已被削減至維持日常運作所需的最低限度。

collocations: barely noticeable (幾乎不引人注目的)
barely manage to (勉強設法做到)
tip: 否定副詞文法題考點：句首倒裝（Barely had we launched the product when...）或與 hardly, scarcely 作同義替換。
sentence: The newly hired technician barely had enough time to inspect the malfunctioning conveyor belt.
sentenceZh: 新聘的技術員幾乎沒有足夠的時間去檢查故障的輸送帶。

collocations: bareness of the office (辦公室的簡陋/空曠)
tip: 源自形容詞 bare，名詞後綴 -ness，常用於辦公室尚未裝潢進駐前的空間描述。
sentence: The interior designer addressed the stark bareness of the lobby by adding lush indoor plants.
sentenceZh: 室內設計師藉由增添繁茂的室內植物，改善了大廳顯著的空曠感。

collocations: drive a hard bargain (精打細算/堅持立場)
tip: 名詞表「便宜好貨」，動詞 bargain with sb over sth。片語 drive a hard bargain 在採購談判題極常出現。
sentence: Our procurement team managed to drive a hard bargain with the primary raw material supplier.
sentenceZh: 我們的採購團隊設法與主要原物料供應商談成了一筆非常划算的交易。

tip: 在商務比喻用法中，a barren meeting/discussion 指「沒有達成共識、毫無產出的會議」，等同於 unproductive。
sentence: After three hours of barren negotiations, both delegations agreed to adjourn the meeting.
sentenceZh: 經過三個小時毫無成果的談判後，雙方代表團同意暫停會議。

collocations: barrier to entry (進入門檻/障礙)
tip: 固定介系詞搭配 to：barrier to doing sth。商業戰略中 barrier to entry（市場准入門檻）是 Part 7 閱讀核心術語。
sentence: High initial capital requirements serve as a significant barrier to entry for prospective competitors.
sentenceZh: 高額的初期資本要求成為潛在競爭對手進入市場的顯著障礙。

collocations: base A on B (將A奠基於B)
tip: 文法被動式 be based in 指「位於某地（辦公室/總部）」，be based on 指「根據某理論/數據」，為極高頻易混題型。
sentence: The consulting firm is based in Frankfurt and serves clients throughout Central Europe.
sentenceZh: 該顧問公司的總部設於法蘭克福，為整個中歐地區的客戶提供服務。

tip: 專案管理（Project Management）高頻詞，用來比對實施新政策前後的生產力或成本指標差異。
sentence: We gathered six months of energy usage data to establish an accurate baseline for our sustainability audit.
sentenceZh: 我們收集了六個月的能源使用數據，為永續稽核建立精確的基準。

collocations: storage in the basement (地下室儲藏)
tip: 辦公大樓導覽與設施維修通知中必考，常標記為 B1/B2 或 basement storage area。
sentence: Visitor parking is available on basement level two adjacent to the elevators.
sentenceZh: 訪客停車位位於地下二樓，緊鄰電梯。

tip: HR 人事招募必考 basic salary（底薪），以與 commission（佣金）或 bonus（獎金）做出對比區隔。
sentence: Proficiency in spreadsheet software is one of the basic requirements for the administrative assistant role.
sentenceZh: 精通試算表軟體是該行政助理職缺的基本要求之一。

tip: Part 3/4 聽力口語常用副詞，相當於 essentially 或 in essence，用於承接演說者的論點總結。
sentence: The board basically approved the strategic proposal, subject to minor budgetary adjustments.
sentenceZh: 董事會基本上批准了該項戰略提案，但仍須進行微幅的預算調整。

collocations: on a daily/monthly basis (每天/每月地)
on the basis of (根據/基於)
tip: 極度高頻片語 on a regular/daily/temporary basis，是 Part 5 介系詞與名詞固定搭配題的秒殺考點。
sentence: Quality audits are performed on a monthly basis to ensure compliance with international safety codes.
sentenceZh: 每個月都會定期進行品質稽核，以確保符合國際安全規範。

zh: 籃子、購物籃；一籃子商品
collocations: basket of goods (一籃子商品/消費籃)
tip: 在電商（e-commerce）情境中與 cart 互換，常指結帳前的購物清單；經濟學文章則指 basket of goods（物價一籃子貨品）。
sentence: Customers who add qualifying electronics to their online basket will receive free overnight shipping.
sentenceZh: 將符合條件的電子產品加入線上購物車的顧客，將享有免費隔日送達服務。

collocations: go to bat for (為…挺身而出/支持)
tip: 商務對話中偶爾出現俚語 go to bat for someone，意指「在主管或董事會前為某人極力辯護、背書」。
sentence: The branch manager went to bat for our team to secure funding for the research project.
sentenceZh: 分行經理為我們團隊挺身爭取，確保了這項研究專案的資金到位。

zh: 一批（生產量或處理件數）
collocations: a batch of orders (一批訂單)
tip: 工廠製造、瑕疵品召回（recall）公告的必備詞，如 the latest batch of products（最新一批產品）。
sentence: The plant manager halted the assembly line after identifying a defect in the first batch of microchips.
sentenceZh: 廠長在發現第一批晶片存在瑕疵後，立即叫停了組裝線。

tip: 飯店預約常見 private bath 或 rooms with a full bath；在工業實驗室中可指溫控槽。
sentence: All standard hotel accommodations are equipped with an en-suite private bath and complimentary toiletries.
sentenceZh: 所有標準客房均配有套房專用衛浴設備及免費盥洗用品。

collocations: bathe in sunlight (沐浴在陽光中)
tip: 注意發音尾音帶濁音 /ð/，與名詞 bath /θ/ 區別；地產文案中常形容空間採光良好（bathed in natural light）。
sentence: The top-floor conference suite is bathed in natural sunlight thanks to extensive skylights.
sentenceZh: 由於設有大面積天窗，頂樓會議套房沐浴在充足的自然採光中。

collocations: restock the bathroom (補充洗手間備品)
tip: 在美式商業空間常與 restroom 互通；在維修通告（maintenance memo）中常與 plumbing（水電管路）連動出現。
sentence: Maintenance announced that the fourth-floor bathroom will be closed for routine plumbing inspections.
sentenceZh: 維修部宣布，四樓洗手間將關閉以進行例行水管檢修。

tip: 科技產品評測題常考 battery life；商業閱讀亦考其名詞抽象用法 a battery of interviews/tests（一連串的測驗/面試）。
sentence: The new ultrabook boasts an extended battery life that supports up to fifteen hours of continuous usage.
sentenceZh: 這款新超薄筆電擁有長效電池續航力，可支援長達十五小時的持續使用。

collocations: battle for market share (爭奪市佔率)
tip: 商業新聞常借用軍事隱喻：legal battle 指侵權或合約訴訟；battle for market share 指市場競爭。
sentence: The telecommunications giant resolved its prolonged legal battle over patent infringement out of court.
sentenceZh: 這家電信巨頭在庭外和解了解決長達數年的專利侵權法律紛爭。

zh: 海灣；隔間、停機坪/裝卸區
tip: 物流倉庫題極高頻考詞 loading bay（貨物裝卸專區），需與地理概念的海灣做好語意區分。
sentence: Delivery vans are strictly prohibited from parking in the loading bay without prior clearance.
sentenceZh: 未經事先核准，嚴禁運貨車輛停放在裝卸貨物區。

tip: Part 5 核心在各類片語中的 be 動詞搭配與虛擬語氣（It is imperative that the contract be signed immediately）。
sentence: It is essential that every delegate be registered prior to entering the main auditorium.
sentenceZh: 所有代表在進入主禮堂之前都必須完成註冊手續。

collocations: walk on the beach (漫步沙灘)
tip: 旅遊觀光文案（travel brochure）常考配套活動，如 complimentary beach shuttle（免費海灘接駁車）。
sentence: The coastal conference resort offers guests direct access to an exclusive private beach.
sentenceZh: 這座濱海會議度假村為房客提供直達私人專屬海灘的通道。

collocations: make the commute bearable (讓通勤變得好過些)
tip: 源自動詞 bear（忍受）。在辦公環境滿意度調查中，反義字 unbearable（令人難以忍受的）更常成為客訴重點。
sentence: The installation of modern air conditioning made the prolonged heatwave bearable for the factory workers.
sentenceZh: 新型空調設備的安裝，讓工廠員工在漫長的熱浪中尚能忍耐。

collocations: bearer of the check (支票持票人)
bearer of good news (報佳音者)
tip: 合約與銀行匯票專有名詞：payable to the bearer 代表「見票即付持票人」，為商務金融難題考點。
sentence: According to the financial terms, the dividend coupon is payable directly to the bearer upon presentation.
sentenceZh: 根據財務條款，該股利息票一經出示即直接兌付予持票人。

collocations: have no bearing on (與…毫無關聯)
tip: 核心文法片語 have a direct bearing on...（與…有直接關係）或 have no bearing on...（與…無關），閱讀極愛考。
sentence: The external auditor noted that the minor administrative error had no bearing on the final financial audit.
sentenceZh: 外部稽核員指出，該項輕微的行政錯誤與最終的財務審計結果毫無關聯。

collocations: beat the deadline (趕在截止日前完成)
beat the competition (擊敗競爭對手)
tip: 財報最愛用：beat quarterly revenue expectations（優於季度營收預期），動詞三態為 beat - beat - beaten。
sentence: Thanks to aggressive digital marketing, our sales figures beat market expectations for the third consecutive quarter.
sentenceZh: 由於積極的數位行銷策略，我們的銷售數據連續第三個季度優於市場預期。

zh: 筋疲力竭的；被擊敗的；踩平的
collocations: off the beaten track (人跡罕至的/非主流的)
tip: 旅遊英文常考片語 off the beaten track / path，指「遠離觀光人潮的秘境」，常出現在特色旅行推廣中。
sentence: The travel agency specializes in curated tours that lead adventurous executives well off the beaten track.
sentenceZh: 該旅行社專門規劃讓喜愛冒險的企業主管深入遠離傳統常規路線的精選行程。

tip: 多益常在 Part 5 考其副詞形式 beautifully 修飾過去分詞，例如 beautifully renovated facility。
sentence: The convention center is situated along the shoreline, offering a beautiful panoramic view of the bay.
sentenceZh: 會議中心坐落於海岸線旁，享有壯麗開闊的優美海灣全景。

collocations: beautify the campus (美化廠區/園區)
tip: 詞性轉換考點：beauty (n.) -> beautify (v.) -> beautiful (adj.)。市政公關或企業社會責任（CSR）文章常出現。
sentence: The corporate headquarters launched an urban greening initiative to beautify the surrounding commercial district.
sentenceZh: 企業總部發起了一項都市綠化計畫，以美化周邊商業區。

collocations: beauty of the system (該系統的妙處/優點)
tip: 在商務對話中，the beauty of sth 常引申為「某套方案的絕妙之處或核心優點（advantage）」。
sentence: The beauty of this new automated inventory software is that it reconciles purchase discrepancies in real time.
sentenceZh: 這套新型自動化庫存軟體的妙處在於它能即時對帳並核銷採購差異。

tip: Part 5 經典秒殺文法陷阱：because 後接完整子句（S + V），because of 後接名詞或代名詞（N / V-ing）。
sentence: The board delayed the scheduled product launch because international supply chain shipping was disrupted.
sentenceZh: 董事會推遲了原定的產品發表會，因為國際供應鏈運輸中斷了。

tip: 不完全不及物動詞（連綴動詞），後接形容詞作主詞補詞，如 become effective immediately（立即生效）。
sentence: Employees will become eligible for performance bonuses after completing six months of continuous service.
sentenceZh: 員工在連續服務滿六個月後，將具備領取績效獎金的資格。

tip: 形容詞用法比動詞分詞更常考在面試禮儀或商務儀態指南，同義詞為 suitable 或 appropriate。
sentence: Candidates are strongly encouraged to wear becoming business attire during executive interviews.
sentenceZh: 強烈建議應試者在主管階層面試時穿著得體稱職的商務服裝。

tip: 出差訂房（hotel reservation confirmation）閱讀題高頻詞，常需區分 king bed、queen bed 與 twin beds。
sentence: The hotel confirmation stated that the standard room includes a king-size bed and complimentary Wi-Fi.
sentenceZh: 飯店確認單上註明標準客房包含一張特大雙人床及免費無線網路。

collocations: charming bed and breakfast (迷人的民宿)
run a bed and breakfast (經營民宿)
book a bed and breakfast (預訂民宿)
tip: 多益閱讀常縮寫為 B&B，屬於平價差旅或觀光型住宿，信函題中常與 hotel 或 guest house 進行價格比較。
sentence: Rather than staying at a conventional hotel, the visiting consultant opted for a quiet local bed and breakfast.
sentenceZh: 來訪的顧問沒有選擇入住傳統飯店，而是選擇了一家安靜的當地民宿。

collocations: bedside manner (醫生對待病人的態度)
tip: 飯店客房設施指南常見 bedside controls（床頭控制面板），醫療管理文章則常考 bedside manner。
sentence: Guests appreciate the convenience of having universal charging outlets integrated into the bedside table.
sentenceZh: 旅客非常滿意床頭櫃上整合了萬用充電插座所帶來的便利性。

tip: 主要出現在生活平衡、員工健康福祉專刊（wellness newsletter）或飯店安眠服務介紹中。
sentence: The corporate wellness seminar emphasized that a consistent bedtime routine improves daytime productivity.
sentenceZh: 企業健康講座強調，規律的就寢作息能提升白天的生產力。

tip: 接動名詞或不定詞均可（begin to do / begin doing）。時態題常搭配 scheduled to begin at + 時間。
sentence: The formal contract negotiations will begin promptly after the keynote speaker concludes his address.
sentenceZh: 正式的合約談判將在主講人演講結束後立即展開。

tip: 企業內訓（in-house training）海報常見 beginner, intermediate（中級）, advanced（高級）的分級制度。
sentence: The software workshop offers courses suitable for both absolute beginners and advanced users.
sentenceZh: 該軟體工作坊提供同時適合完全初學者與進階使用者的豐富課程。

collocations: at the beginning of (在…的開始)
tip: 片語 beginning next month / Monday 等同 starting next month，常置於句首作時間副詞修飾全句。
sentence: Beginning next quarter, all travel expense reimbursement claims must be submitted electronically.
sentenceZh: 自下個季度開始，所有的差旅報銷申請必須以電子方式提交。

collocations: act on behalf of (代表…行事)
tip: 多益必考超黃金片語：on behalf of someone（代表某人）。委託代簽文件、代發致謝信必備出題點。
sentence: Ms. Reynolds accepted the prestigious environmental leadership award on behalf of the entire research team.
sentenceZh: 雷諾茲女士代表整個研究團隊接受了這項負有盛名的環境領袖獎。

tip: 員工手冊（employee handbook）中常考規章要求：All employees are expected to behave professionally。
sentence: Representatives sent to the international symposium are reminded to behave professionally at all times.
sentenceZh: 提醒派遣至國際研討會的代表在任何時候都務必表現出專業素養。

tip: 行銷領域必考 consumer behavior（消費者行為）；人資管理必考 code of conduct/behavior（行為準則）。
sentence: The marketing department conducted an extensive study analyzing consumer behavior on e-commerce platforms.
sentenceZh: 行銷部門進行了一項廣泛的研究，分析電子商務平台上的消費者行為。

tip: 招募專欄常考 behavioral interview question（行為面試問題，要求候選人舉出過往處理衝突或專案的實例）。
sentence: Hiring managers use behavioral interview techniques to evaluate how candidates handled workplace pressure in past roles.
sentenceZh: 招募經理利用行為面試技巧來評估應徵者過去在職場中如何應對工作壓力。

tip: 專案管理萬年必考題：behind schedule（落後於進度）vs ahead of schedule（超前進度）vs on schedule（準時）。
sentence: Due to unexpected shipment delays from the supplier, construction of the branch is three weeks behind schedule.
sentenceZh: 由於供應商不可預期的出貨延誤，分部的建設工程已落後進度三週。

collocations: in the eye of the beholder (情人眼裡出西施/見仁見智)
tip: 常出現在文化、設計或藝術評論文章的成語引用：Beauty is in the eye of the beholder（美感因人而異）。
sentence: The architectural critic remarked that the functional aesthetics of the new building are truly in the eye of the beholder.
sentenceZh: 建築評論家評論道，這座新建築的功能性美學確實是見仁見智。

tip: 聽力 Part 1 或辦公室家具採購訂單描述中常作為顏色規格出現，注意拼法為 e 在 i 之前（ei）。
sentence: The administrative team chose beige ergonomic chairs to complement the modern office decor.
sentenceZh: 行政團隊挑選了米色的人體工學椅，以搭配現代化的辦公室裝潢。

tip: 超高頻商務轉折短語 for the time being（目前暫且、暫時），多益閱讀信件中極常代替 temporarily。
sentence: For the time being, all incoming inquiries should be forwarded directly to the customer service supervisor.
sentenceZh: 暫時而言，所有進線諮詢案件應直接轉交給客服主管。

tip: 在商務致歉信或人脈恭賀信中常見，例如 send belated condolences / belated birthday wishes。
sentence: Please accept our belated apologies for the delay in processing your warranty reimbursement claim.
sentenceZh: 對於延遲處理您的保固退款申請，請接受我們遲來的歉意。

collocations: contrary to popular belief (與普遍看法相反)
tip: 常用片語 contrary to popular belief（與一般常理/普遍看法相反），後面往往帶出文章的轉折新論點。
sentence: It is our core corporate belief that outstanding customer satisfaction is the foundation of long-term profitability.
sentenceZh: 卓越的顧客滿意度是長期獲利的基石，這是我們企業的核心信念。

tip: 商務書信常見 firmly believe that... 作為主管表達強烈信心之受詞子句用法。
sentence: We firmly believe that integrating artificial intelligence into our logistics will optimize delivery speeds.
sentenceZh: 我們堅信將人工智慧融入物流系統將大幅優化配送速度。

collocations: firm believer in (堅定信奉…的人)
tip: 管理階層受訪常用 I am a firm believer in sth（我深信…對團隊有益），後接名詞或動名詞。
sentence: The CEO is a firm believer in maintaining open communication channels across all corporate tiers.
sentenceZh: 執行長堅信在所有企業層級之間維持暢通的溝通管道是至關重要的。

tip: 商務口語慣用語 Does that name ring a bell?（那個名字聽起來耳熟嗎？）是聽力對話常見句型。
sentence: His name rang a bell, but I could not recall which engineering conference we had attended together.
sentenceZh: 他的名字聽起來很耳熟，但我記不得我們曾經共同出席過哪一場工程研討會。

collocations: belly of the aircraft (飛機貨艙/腹部)
tip: 在航空貨運（air freight）中，belly cargo 指的是客機機腹艙所承載的商業貨物。
sentence: The airline announced plans to expand its belly cargo capacity on transpacific commercial flights.
sentenceZh: 該航空公司宣布計畫擴大跨太平洋商業航班的機腹貨運運能。

tip: belong to 嚴禁使用被動語態（不可寫 is belonged to），此為 Part 5 必考文法陷阱。
sentence: All intellectual property developed during company hours strictly belongs to the employer.
sentenceZh: 在工作時間內研發的所有智慧財產權，均嚴格屬於雇主所有。

zh: 隨身行李、所有物、個人財產
tip: 機場廣播與大眾運輸聽力必考詞！永遠使用複數形 belongings。Do not leave your personal belongings unattended。
sentence: Passengers are reminded to take all personal belongings with them before exiting the commuter train.
sentenceZh: 提醒旅客在離開通勤列車之前，請帶走所有的個人隨身隨行物品。

tip: 常出現在資深員工榮退歡送信（retirement farewell letter）中，用來修飾備受敬重的主管或同事。
sentence: Staff gathered yesterday afternoon to bid a fond farewell to our beloved regional director upon his retirement.
sentenceZh: 全體員工昨天下午齊聚一堂，依依不捨地向我們備受敬重的區域總監榮退道別。

tip: 書信指引必備：Please refer to the table below / As outlined below（請參見下表/如下所列）。
sentence: Operating margins fell slightly below our original projection owing to steep inflation in logistics fees.
sentenceZh: 由於物流費用大幅通膨，營業利潤率略低於我們最初的預估。

collocations: fasten one's seat belt (繫好安全帶)
tighten one's belt (緊縮預算/勒緊褲帶)
tip: 工廠製造情境考 conveyor belt（輸送帶）；經濟不景氣情境考 tighten one's belt（節省開支）。
sentence: In light of declining revenue, the executive committee warned that departments would need to tighten their belts.
sentenceZh: 鑑於營收下滑，執行委員會警告各部門必須開始勒緊褲帶節省開銷。

tip: 工廠技工或研發實驗室文章中 workbench / lab bench 專指工作裝配檯。
sentence: The industrial technician left the calibrated multimeter on the central workbench after testing.
sentenceZh: 工業技術員在測試完畢後，將校準好的萬用電表留在庫存中央工作台上。

collocations: benchmark performance against (將績效與…進行基準評比)
tip: 管理階層常用詞。動詞 benchmark A against B（以B為基準來評比A）。同義詞為 standard, yardstick。
sentence: We benchmark our customer response times against the leading service providers in the software industry.
sentenceZh: 我們將自家的客戶回應時間與軟體業界頂尖的服務提供商進行基準比較。

collocations: bend the rules (通融/破例行事)
bend around the corner (在轉彎處彎曲)
tip: 商務口語常考 bend the rules（破例融通/放寬規則），常用於例外狀況之核准。
sentence: The human resources director stated clearly that the company cannot bend the rules regarding security protocols.
sentenceZh: 人力資源總監明確表示，公司絕不能在安全規範上破例放寬標準。

tip: 介系詞，常在空間方位題取代 under 或 underneath，用以描述管線或基礎設施隱藏於某物之下。
sentence: Extensive fiber-optic wiring is installed directly beneath the raised flooring of the server room.
sentenceZh: 廣泛的光纖線路直接安裝在伺服器機房的架高地板下方。

tip: 非營利組織（NPO）、藝術基金會或慈善籌款信函中的常客，同義詞為 donor 或 patron。
sentence: The museum successfully completed its gallery wing expansion thanks to an anonymous benefactor.
sentenceZh: 多虧了一位匿名贊助人的支持，該博物館順利完成了美術館側翼的擴建工程。

tip: 醫藥健康報告中 benign（良性）與 malignant（惡性）互為反義詞；商務中亦可形容溫和的市場環境。
sentence: The quarterly economic forecast noted a relatively benign inflation environment for wholesale manufacturing.
sentenceZh: 季度經濟預測指出，批發製造業目前處於相對溫和的通膨環境中。

zh: 彎曲的；下定決心的；天分
tip: 固定文法片語 be bent on doing sth（下定決心要完成某事，有時帶有不顧代價之意涵）。
sentence: The executive committee seems bent on consolidating branch operations despite staff resistance.
sentenceZh: 儘管員工有所反彈，執行委員會似乎仍下定決心要整合各分行的營運。

collocations: beside the point (無關痛癢/離題)
tip: 必考混淆陷阱！beside（在旁邊，介系詞）vs besides（此外/而且，副詞或介系詞），絕不可混為一談。
sentence: The training room is conveniently situated right beside the cafeteria on the third floor.
sentenceZh: 培訓教室位置便利，就位於三樓員工餐廳正旁邊。

tip: 作介系詞時表「包含在內的除外」（Besides A, also B）；作副詞時表「此外（In addition / Furthermore）」。
sentence: Besides offering competitive salaries, the enterprise provides comprehensive healthcare and tuition reimbursement.
sentenceZh: 除了提供具有競爭力的薪資外，該企業還提供全額醫療保險與進修學費補助。

zh: 打賭、下注；把握、最佳選擇
collocations: safe bet (穩妥的做法/有把握的選擇)
tip: 商務口語極愛考 your best bet is to...（你最好的辦法/策略就是…），常出現在 Part 3/4 的建議解答中。
sentence: If you are trying to avoid rush-hour airport traffic, your best bet is to take the express subway.
sentenceZh: 如果您想避開尖峰時段往機場的交通，最佳選擇是搭乘機場捷運快線。

collocations: betray trade secrets (洩漏商業機密)
tip: 合約法規常考洩漏協議：betraying proprietary information will result in immediate termination and legal action。
sentence: Any employee found to have betrayed proprietary client data will face civil litigation.
sentenceZh: 任何被發現洩漏客戶專有資料的員工，都將面臨民事訴訟。

tip: 名詞形式。常出現在職場道德（business ethics）與保密條款的法規宣導教材中。
sentence: Disclosing sensitive bid information to external third parties represents an unacceptable betrayal of professional ethics.
sentenceZh: 向外部第三方洩露敏感投標資訊，代表對職業道德無法接受的背叛行為。

collocations: better serve customers (更好地服務客戶)
better one's performance (精進個人表現)
tip: 作動詞表「改善、提升」（= improve）。如 to better meet client demands（為了更好地滿足顧客需求）。
sentence: The firm updated its digital platform to better serve overseas corporate clients across different time zones.
sentenceZh: 該公司更新了其數位平台，以更優質地服務跨越不同時區的海外企業客戶。

collocations: between A and B (在A與B之間)
tip: 文法規則：between 用於兩者之間（between A and B）；among 用於三者（含）以上之中。
sentence: The strategic partnership between the telecommunications provider and the retail firm will commence next month.
sentenceZh: 該電信商與零售企業之間的戰略合作關係將於下個月正式展開。

tip: 多益聽力與閱讀的高頻同義代換字！題目問 drink，文章必定寫 beverage，特別常出現在航班或會議餐飲介紹。
sentence: Complimentary light snacks and non-alcoholic beverages will be served throughout the flight.
sentenceZh: 整個飛行航程中將免費供應精緻點心及無酒精飲料。

tip: 告示牌常見 beware of...。注意文法上 beware 通常只作原型動詞或祈使句，不常使用進行式或過去式。
sentence: Corporate IT warned personnel to beware of fraudulent phishing emails disguised as internal memos.
sentenceZh: 企業資訊部門警告全體同仁當心偽裝成內部備忘錄的釣魚詐騙郵件。

collocations: beyond one's control (超出某人控制)
tip: 商務常考片語：beyond repair（壞到無法修理，等於 impossible to fix）；beyond one's budget（超出預算）。
sentence: Unfortunately, the damaged industrial printer is obsolete and considered completely beyond repair.
sentenceZh: 遺憾的是，這台損壞的工業印表機型號已過時，且被認定完全無法修復。

tip: HR 多元包容性（Diversity & Inclusion）培訓常考，強調 hiring process must be free of bias（招聘過程不可有偏見）。
sentence: Our recruitment committee conducts blind resume screenings to eliminate unconscious bias in the evaluation process.
sentenceZh: 我們的招募委員會進行匿名履歷審查，以消除評選過程中的無意識偏見。

collocations: commute by bicycle (騎自行車通勤)
tip: 常出現在綠色通勤津貼（eco-friendly commuting subsidy）或辦公大樓設施指南中。
sentence: The property management installed a secure bicycle rack near the north building entrance to encourage cycling.
sentenceZh: 物業管理處在北側大樓入口旁安裝了安全的自行車架，以鼓勵同仁騎車通勤。

collocations: bid on a contract (競標合約)
tip: 政府採購與工程發包之必考單字！submit a bid（投標）常與 tender, proposal 互相改寫。
sentence: Three reputable engineering firms have submitted a competitive bid to construct the new logistics hub.
sentenceZh: 已有三家聲譽良好的工程公司遞交了具競爭力的投標書以爭取興建新物流中心。

tip: 採購合約通常授予 the lowest qualified bidder（符合資格的最低價競標商），需注意是 bidder 而非 bidding。
sentence: The municipal contract was ultimately awarded to the lowest bidder that met all environmental specifications.
sentenceZh: 該市府採購案最終授予符合所有環境規範且報價最低的投標廠商。

collocations: bilingual candidate (具雙語能力的應試者)
bilingual customer support (雙語客服支援)
tip: 求職條件高頻字：Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is strongly preferred（精通英語及西語者尤佳）。
sentence: The international airline is recruiting bilingual flight attendants fluent in both English and Japanese.
sentenceZh: 該跨國航空公司正在招募精通英語及日語的雙語空服人員。

collocations: utility bill (水電瓦斯公用事業帳單)
tip: 商務常考動詞用法 bill sb for sth（向某人收取某筆費用/開立帳單請款），如 billed directly to your account。
sentence: The catering service will bill our corporate account directly for the luncheon expenses.
sentenceZh: 外燴服務公司將會就此次午宴費用直接向我們的企業帳戶開立請款。

collocations: digital billboard (數位戶外電子看板)
rent a billboard (租借戶外看板)
tip: 戶外行銷專有名詞（outdoor advertising）。在閱讀宣傳預算配置題中常與 social media campaigns 對比。
sentence: The company invested heavily in digital billboard displays positioned along major commuter highways.
sentenceZh: 該公司投入巨資在主要通勤高速公路沿線設立數位戶外電子看板。

collocations: multi-billion-dollar merger (數十億美元的合併案)
tip: 聽力 Part 3/4 數字陷阱！常與 million（百萬）進行聽音混淆；前面有明確數字時 billion 不加 s（two billion）。
sentence: The pharmaceutical company generated more than two billion dollars in annual revenue from its new vaccine.
sentenceZh: 該製藥公司的新型疫苗創造了超過二十億美元的年營業額。

tip: 飛機廣播常考 overhead bin（客艙上方行李架）；辦公室環保政策常考 recycling bin。
sentence: Passengers must ensure their carry-on luggage fits completely inside the overhead bin before takeoff.
sentenceZh: 起飛前，旅客必須確保隨身手提行李完全收妥於頭頂行李箱內。

collocations: bind a contract (使合約具約束力)
tip: 動詞三態 bind - bound - bound。在被動式中 be bound by the contract 表示「受該合約條款之約束」。
sentence: Upon signing the nondisclosure agreement, both parties are strictly bound to keep confidential all proprietary blueprints.
sentenceZh: 一旦簽署保密協定，雙方均受到嚴格約束，不得洩漏所有專有設計圖。

collocations: legally binding agreement (具法律約束力的協議)
non-binding letter of intent (不具約束力的意向書)
tip: 多益合約題絕對天王字：legally binding（具有法律約束力的），反義字為 non-binding（不具約束力的）。
sentence: The preliminary terms will become legally binding once the formal contract is signed by both chief executives.
sentenceZh: 一旦兩位執行長在正式合約上簽字，該初步條款即具有法律約束力。

tip: 常用於醫藥生技業（biotechnology / pharmaceuticals）的法規遵從或環境安全防護文章。
sentence: The research facility strictly complies with international guidelines for handling biological specimens.
sentenceZh: 該研究機構嚴格遵守處置生物樣本的國際規範準則。

tip: 在招募技術研發人才的職位徵聘廣告（job posting）中，常列入指定所需學位學科。
sentence: Applicants for the laboratory technician position should hold an accredited degree in biology or chemistry.
sentenceZh: 應徵該實驗室技術員職缺者，應持有經認證之生物學或化學學士學位。

tip: 人事填表常見 DOB（Date of Birth）；商業寫作中 give birth to 可引申為「催生了新技術/新產品」。
sentence: Please provide your full legal name and date of birth when setting up your corporate travel profile.
sentenceZh: 在建立您的企業差旅個人檔案時，請提供您的完整法定姓名與出生日期。

tip: 員工福利福利制度（fringe benefits）中，企業常提供 paid birthday leave（帶薪生日假）作為亮點。
sentence: As part of the renewed employee benefits package, full-time staff members are entitled to paid birthday leave.
sentenceZh: 作為更新版員工福利計畫的一部分，全職員工享有帶薪生日假的福利。

collocations: bit by bit (一步一步地/逐漸地)
tip: 商務對話中 a little bit 常作為修飾副詞以弱化語氣；科技 IT 文章則指數據傳輸單位 bit（位元）。
sentence: The project deadline was extended by a bit to accommodate unexpected delays in component procurement.
sentenceZh: 專案截止日期稍微延長了一些，以因應零件採購中意料之外的延誤。

zh: 咬、叮；緊咬、產生負面影響
collocations: grab a bite (吃點東西/簡餐)
bite the bullet (咬緊牙關應對難關)
tip: Part 3 聽力高頻口語句型：Let's grab a bite before the meeting begins（我們在開會前去隨便吃點東西吧）。
sentence: We only have thirty minutes between conference panels, so let's grab a quick bite at the nearby deli.
sentenceZh: 研討會各專題座談之間我們只有三十分鐘，那我們就在附近的熟食店隨便吃點簡餐吧。

zh: 苦的；嚴寒的；痛苦憤恨的
tip: 商務紛爭常用詞：a bitter dispute / bitter rivals（激烈的勞資或商業競爭對手），非僅指味覺之苦。
sentence: After months of bitter dispute between union leaders and management, an amicable compromise was reached.
sentenceZh: 在工會領袖與管理階層經歷數月激烈的爭執後，雙方終於達成了友好的妥協方案。

tip: 同義詞為 strange, unusual, peculiar。在閱讀文章中偶爾用於描述不可預料的市場異常或物流怪象。
sentence: A bizarre technical glitch in the accounting software caused several invoices to be processed twice.
sentenceZh: 會計軟體中一個罕見怪異的技術故障，導致了數張發票被重複入帳處理。

collocations: blame A on B (將A歸咎於B)
take the blame for (承擔…的責任)
tip: 文法陷阱大熱門！blame A for B（責備 A 人）vs blame A on B（將 A 事歸咎於 B 因素），介系詞完全不同。
sentence: The analyst blamed the company's disappointing earnings on escalating transportation expenditures.
sentenceZh: 該分析師將該公司令人失望的獲利表現歸咎於持續上漲的運輸開銷。

zh: 乏味的、清淡無味的；平淡的
tip: 餐廳評論常見 bland food（料理平淡無奇）；亦可用於商務演說指「內容平庸乏味、缺乏亮點」。
sentence: The food critic remarked that although the bistro's presentation was artistic, the pasta sauce tasted rather bland.
sentenceZh: 美食評論家評論道，儘管該小餐館的擺盤極具藝術感，但義大利麵醬汁嚐起來相當平淡乏味。

collocations: fill in the blanks (填寫空格)
tip: 多益表單填寫指南最愛考的指引：Leave the box blank if not applicable（若不適用請將該空格留白）。
sentence: Applicants should leave the secondary contact field blank if they do not have an alternate phone number.
sentenceZh: 應徵者若無備用聯絡電話，請將第二聯絡人欄位留白。

zh: 毛毯；全面的、一概而論的
tip: 商務高階用法：blanket approval / blanket policy（總括性/全面的政策），比常規的毛毯語意更具考驗性。
sentence: The senior vice president issued a blanket approval for all pre-budgeted departmental travel expenses.
sentenceZh: 資深副總裁對所有已列入預算的部門差旅費用給予了全面性的核准。

zh: 黯淡的、荒涼的、前景不樂觀的
collocations: bleak financial picture (淒慘的財務現狀)
tip: 財經新聞高頻形容詞，常與 outlook, future, forecast 搭配，同義詞為 gloomy, grim, pessimistic。
sentence: Given the persistent drop in consumer spending, economists painted a bleak outlook for the retail sector.
sentenceZh: 鑑於消費者支出的持續下滑，經濟學家對零售業的前景描繪出了一幅黯淡的畫面。

collocations: bleed cash (持續嚴重虧損現金)
bleed red ink (出現大量赤字)
tip: 商務比喻極常考 bleed cash / money，形容企業因營運不善或過度擴張而導致「資金急速失血虧損」。
sentence: Until the unprofitable regional routes are canceled, the budget carrier will continue to bleed cash.
sentenceZh: 在取消無利可圖的區域航線之前，這家廉價航空公司將會持續面臨巨額資金失血。

collocations: unique blend of skills (獨特的技能組合)
tip: 求職信（cover letter）自薦黃金詞彙：I possess a unique blend of technical and managerial skills。
sentence: The ideal project manager candidate will offer a unique blend of engineering knowledge and financial acumen.
sentenceZh: 最理想的專案經理候選人必須兼備工程專業知識與敏銳財務頭腦的獨特融合能力。

tip: 家電產品說明書（user manual）或產品瑕疵退換貨信函題的常見器具。
sentence: The catering staff replaced the broken commercial blender before preparing fresh beverages for the conference.
sentenceZh: 外燴人員在為會議準備新鮮飲品之前，更換了損壞的商用果汁機。

collocations: turn a blind eye to (視而不見)
tip: 聽力 Part 1 常見名詞複數 blinds（百葉窗，如 adjusting the blinds）；片語 turn a blind eye to（無視/姑息）。
sentence: The administrative assistant lowered the window blinds to reduce the glare on the conference display screen.
sentenceZh: 行政助理拉下了百葉窗，以減少會議顯示螢幕上的反光。

collocations: a few blocks away (幾條街之外)
tip: 方位指引題常考 three blocks away（相隔三個街區）；聽力 Part 1 常考 luggage is blocking the aisle。
sentence: The flagship retail store is situated just two blocks away from the central underground station.
sentenceZh: 這家旗艦零售門市距離中央地鐵站僅僅兩條街之遙。

tip: 廠區設施報修與維護通知常見詞，常搭配動詞 clear, remove, prevent。
sentence: Emergency facility maintenance was summoned immediately to clear a major plumbing blockage in the warehouse.
sentenceZh: 廠房緊急維修團隊立即被召回，以清除倉庫內一處嚴重的水管堵塞。

tip: 員工健康檢查（annual health screening）公告中常見 blood pressure check 與 blood sample collection。
sentence: The corporate wellness clinic will provide free blood pressure screenings for all employees tomorrow.
sentenceZh: 企業健康診所明天將為全體同仁提供免費的血壓篩檢服務。

collocations: business is blooming (生意蒸蒸日上)
tip: 商務隱喻中常形容新興產業或景氣繁盛興隆（thriving / flourishing），等同於 boom 或 prosper。
sentence: Local tourism started to bloom following the grand opening of the modern international convention center.
sentenceZh: 隨著這座現代化國際會議中心的盛大開幕，當地的觀光業開始蓬勃繁榮。

zh: 花朵；開花、發展成成功狀態
tip: 寫作或商業故事常考 blossom into a successful partnership（發展成為成功的夥伴關係）。
sentence: What started as an informal joint venture quickly blossomed into a lucrative long-term commercial alliance.
sentenceZh: 最初只是一場合資試水溫的合作，迅速發展成了獲利豐厚的長期商業聯盟。

collocations: deal a blow to (給予…重擊/挫折)
blow away the competition (徹底擊敗對手)
tip: 商業評論名詞用法極高頻：The unexpected loss of the client was a major blow to the company（造成沉重打擊）。
sentence: The sudden cancellation of the infrastructure contract dealt a severe financial blow to the construction firm.
sentenceZh: 基礎建設合約的無預警取消，對該營造公司造成了嚴重的財務打擊。

zh: 愚蠢的大錯；犯下重大過失
tip: 與普通的 mistake 相比，blunder 專指因疏忽或粗心造成嚴重後果的大錯（serious, foolish mistake）。
sentence: The accounting firm apologized for the clerical blunder that resulted in delayed salary distributions.
sentenceZh: 會計事務所針對導致薪資延遲發放的文書作業重大失誤表示歉意。

collocations: blur the line between (模糊…之間的界線)
tip: 遠距辦公（telecommuting）探討文章極常見：Telecommuting often blurs the line between work and personal life。
sentence: Working remotely from home can sometimes blur the professional boundary between personal life and office duty.
sentenceZh: 在家遠端辦公有時會模糊個人生活與工作職責之間的專業界線。

zh: 董事會、委員會；登機/車；登上
collocations: welcome on board (歡迎加入團隊)
tip: 一字多義超核心！作名詞表 board of directors（董事會）；作動詞表 boarding gate（登機門）。
sentence: The board of directors unanimously approved the proposed merger during the extraordinary annual meeting.
sentenceZh: 董事會在臨時股東年會上無異議通過了這項提議的合併案。

collocations: gather in the boardroom (在會議室集合)
tip: 大樓場地預訂或高階主管會議之高頻場景詞，常出現在 Part 3/4 聽力題之地點考題中。
sentence: Department heads are required to assemble in the executive boardroom for the quarterly strategy review.
sentenceZh: 各部門主管須在執行會議室集合，以進行季度戰略回顧會議。

zh: 擁有（引以為榮的事物）；自誇
collocations: boast state-of-the-art facilities (以擁有頂尖設施著稱)
boast an impressive track record (擁有亮眼的紀錄)
tip: 宣傳文案（promotional flyers）的最高頻動詞！主詞通常是物，例如 The newly opened resort boasts an Olympic pool。
sentence: The new research complex boasts cutting-edge laboratories equipped with the latest diagnostic technology.
sentenceZh: 這座新研究綜合大樓擁有配備最新診斷技術的頂尖尖端實驗室。

collocations: in the same boat (處境相同/同舟共濟)
tip: 商業口語慣用語 miss the boat 代表「錯失良機（miss an opportunity）」；be in the same boat 代表「面臨相同的困境」。
sentence: If our firm delays entering the renewable energy market any further, we might completely miss the boat.
sentenceZh: 如果我們公司再推遲進入再生能源市場，我們可能會徹底錯失良機。

collocations: governing body (主管機關/治理機構)
body of the email (電子郵件本文)
tip: 法規與公文情境中常指「機構團體」，如 advisory body（顧問團）、regulatory body（監管機構）。
sentence: The national aviation regulatory body issued updated security inspection protocols for all regional airports.
sentenceZh: 國家航空監管機構針對所有區域機場發布了更新後的安檢協議。

collocations: boil down to (歸結為/核心在於)
bring to a boil (煮至沸騰)
tip: 商業討論極常出現高階動詞片語 boil down to：The entire negotiation boils down to the pricing structure（這場談判歸結到底就是定價結構的問題）。
sentence: Ultimately, the strategic disagreement boils down to whether we should prioritize rapid growth over profitability.
sentenceZh: 歸根結底，這項戰略分歧的核心就在於我們是否應該將快速增長置於獲利之上。

tip: 辦公文書格式考題常見 in bold text / bold font（粗體字）；商業決策新聞中常形容 bold initiative（大膽的新倡議）。
sentence: The CEO made a bold move by reorganizing the entire sales division to focus exclusively on cloud services.
sentenceZh: 執行長採取了一項大膽的舉措，重組整個銷售部門以完全專注於雲端服務。

collocations: bomb at the box office (票房慘敗)
tip: 安全危機管理演習（emergency evacuation protocol）中偶爾涉及 bomb threat 通報應變流程。
sentence: Due to a credible bomb threat, security personnel promptly evacuated all employees from the corporate headquarters.
sentenceZh: 由於接獲可信的炸彈威脅，維安人員迅速疏散了企業總部內的所有同仁。

zh: 轟炸；大量湧向、連珠砲般質詢
collocations: bombard with questions (連珠砲似地提問)
bombarded with complaints (接獲如雪片般飛來的投訴)
bombarded with emails (被大量郵件淹沒)
tip: 客服中心（Call Center）常見客訴暴增描述：be bombarded with phone calls/complaints after system outage。
sentence: Following the sudden website disruption, the customer support helpdesk was bombarded with thousands of inquiries.
sentenceZh: 在網站無預警癱瘓之後，客戶支援服務台被成千上萬的諮詢信件徹底淹沒。

zh: 債券；公債；束縛、契約保證
tip: 投資理財必備核心字！stocks and bonds（股票與債券）為對等名詞組合；yield on bonds 指債券殖利率。
sentence: Institutional investors turned to ten-year treasury bonds as a defensive hedge against market volatility.
sentenceZh: 機構投資人轉向購買十年期國債，以作為防範市場波動的防禦性避險工具。

collocations: bone density test (骨質密度檢查)
tip: 工傷補償申請（workplace injury claim）常見報告詞彙，例如 severe bone fracture caused by a fall。
sentence: The warehouse worker filed a workers' compensation claim after suffering a bone fracture during the forklift accident.
sentenceZh: 該名倉庫工人在堆高機意外導致骨折後，提交了職災賠償申請。

tip: 人事薪酬必考單字！signing bonus（簽約加入獎金）與 performance-based bonus（績效紅利）為常見招募誘因。
sentence: Eligible software engineers were awarded an attractive signing bonus upon joining the research team.
sentenceZh: 符合資格的軟體工程師在加入該研究團隊時獲得了優渥的簽約獎金。

collocations: book a flight/room (預訂航班/客房)
tip: 多益聽讀超級霸王詞！動詞 book = reserve；fully booked = no vacancies；慣用語 by the book 代表嚴格按規定辦事。
sentence: We strongly advise delegates to book their hotel accommodations early as downtown hotels are nearly fully booked.
sentenceZh: 我們強烈建議代表們及早預訂飯店住宿，因為市中心的飯店已幾乎全數客滿。

tip: 字尾 -let 表「微小」，常與 brochure, pamphlet, manual 在閱讀題中互為同義字代換。
sentence: The human resources coordinator distributed an informational booklet detailing the employee dental benefits.
sentenceZh: 人力資源協調員分發了一本詳細介紹員工牙科福利的資訊小冊子。

tip: 聽力 Part 1 常見背景物品詞彙，複數形為 bookshelves。注意發音時的複合詞重音落在前面。
sentence: Several reference manuals and legal journals were neatly arranged on the office bookshelf.
sentenceZh: 幾本參考手冊和法律期刊整齊地排列在辦公室書架上。

tip: 在聽力 Part 1 與 Part 3 偶爾出現於校園或零售場景。常考在校園書店購買教科書（textbooks）或文具耗材（supplies）。
sentence: The campus bookstore is offering a 20 percent discount on all business administration textbooks this week.
sentenceZh: 校園書店本週針對所有企業管理教科書提供八折優惠。

zh: 繁榮；迅速增長 / 興旺
tip: 形容詞形式 booming 常出現在閱讀測驗中修飾 industry、economy 或 market，為多益高頻同義替換詞（thriving, flourishing）。
sentence: Driven by rapid technological innovations, the software industry is experiencing an unprecedented economic boom.
sentenceZh: 在快速技術創新的推動下，軟體產業正經歷前所未有的經濟繁榮。

collocations: provide a boost to (為…注入動能)
tip: 多益雙向高頻動詞，在 Part 7 常與 increase, elevate, enhance 做同義代換。注意 boost morale（提升士氣）是 HR 常考搭配。
sentence: The marketing department launched a nationwide campaign specifically designed to boost consumer confidence and brand awareness.
sentenceZh: 行銷部門發起了一場全國性的活動，旨在提升消費者信心與品牌知名度。

tip: 工廠巡視（plant inspection）或工作安全規範（safety regulations）場景中，常出現 protective steel-toed boots 作為工安必備裝備。
sentence: All personnel entering the warehouse facility are strictly required to wear steel-toed boots at all times.
sentenceZh: 所有進入倉庫設施的人員均必須隨時穿戴鋼頭安全靴。

tip: 商展（trade show/fair）必備核心單字。常考預訂展位（reserve a booth）或指派員工顧展位（man the booth）。
sentence: We need to reserve an exhibition booth near the main entrance to maximize foot traffic during the trade show.
sentenceZh: 我們需要預訂一個靠近主入口的展位，以便在商展期間最大化人流。

tip: 多益跨國商務出差題常見。注意 border control 及 cross-border trade（跨境貿易）的衍生用法。
sentence: International travelers must present a valid passport and business visa when passing through border control.
sentenceZh: 國際旅客在通過邊境管制時，必須出示有效護照及商務簽證。

zh: 界線 / 邊緣的；瀕於及格邊緣的
tip: 常形容考核或面試成績處於臨界點的人選（borderline candidate），表示需進一步評估。
sentence: The hiring committee debated for hours regarding the borderline candidate before deciding to schedule a follow-up interview.
sentenceZh: 招聘委員會就該名邊界候選人討論了數小時，最後決定安排第二輪面試。

tip: 分詞形容詞陷阱題：事物修飾用 boring，人感到無聊用 bored。正式商務場合更常以 tedious 或 monotonous 取代。
sentence: To prevent the annual shareholder meeting from becoming boring, the CEO incorporated dynamic multimedia slides.
sentenceZh: 為了避免年度股東大會變得枯燥，執行長融入了生動的多媒體投影片。

collocations: borrow money from a bank (向銀行借款)
tip: 文法混淆高頻題：borrow 意為「借入」（介系詞用 from），lend 意為「借出」（介系詞用 to），切勿混淆方向性。
sentence: The startup had to borrow funds from private equity investors to finance its research and development pipeline.
sentenceZh: 該新創公司不得不向私募股權投資者借調資金，以資助其研發項目。

collocations: report to the boss (向主管彙報)
tip: 口語常見 boss，但在多益正式閱讀考卷中，大多被 supervisor, manager, department head 取代。看到 boss 要立刻聯想到其正式同義詞。
sentence: You should submit your revised expense report to your immediate boss before the end of the fiscal quarter.
sentenceZh: 您應在財政季度結束前將修改後的報銷單提交給直屬主管。

collocations: don't bother to (不用費心去做…)
sorry to bother you (抱歉打擾你)
tip: 商務對話中常見客氣用語：Sorry to bother you, but do you have a minute? 另注意 bother to do sth. 與 bother doing sth. 皆可。
sentence: I am sorry to bother you during your lunch break, but the client needs this contract signed immediately.
sentenceZh: 很抱歉在您午休時打擾，但客戶急需簽署這份合約。

collocations: eliminate bothersome paperwork (簡化繁瑣的文書工作)
tip: 常在客服投訴信件中出現，修飾流程繁瑣（bothersome bureaucratic procedures）或系統錯誤。
sentence: The latest software patch successfully eliminated the bothersome glitch that caused unexpected system reboots.
sentenceZh: 最新的軟體更新成功消除了導致系統意外重啟的惱人漏洞。

tip: 在工廠與物流題型中，bottling line（裝瓶生產線）或 bottling plant 常見於自動化製造聽力題。
sentence: The bottling plant has increased its daily output by 15% after upgrading to high-speed automated machinery.
sentenceZh: 在升級到高速自動化機械設備後，該裝瓶廠將日產量提高了15%。

collocations: at the bottom of the page (在頁面底部)
tip: 商務最核心成語：bottom line 原指財報最後一行的「淨損益/利潤」，引申為「最關鍵的因素或底線」。必背！
sentence: Implementing energy-saving initiatives across all branches will significantly improve our company's bottom line.
sentenceZh: 在所有分公司實施節能措施將大幅改善我們公司的淨利潤。

collocations: located on Grand Boulevard (位於大林蔭大道上)
tip: 地址縮寫常考 Blvd.，常在 Part 7 的商業廣告、邀請卡或公車時刻表路線名稱中出現。
sentence: Our flagship retail store is strategically situated on Grand Boulevard, surrounded by high-end boutiques.
sentenceZh: 我們的旗艦零售店極具策略性地位於格蘭大道上，周圍環繞著高階精品店。

tip: 多益雙考點：1. 電子郵件因地址錯誤而被退回（Your email bounced back）；2. 數位行銷中的跳出率（bounce rate）。
sentence: Please double-check the recipient's address because the invitation email bounced back as undeliverable.
sentenceZh: 請仔細核對收件人的地址，因為邀請郵件已被退回並顯示無法送達。

collocations: northbound / southbound train (往北/南的列車)
be bound to do sth (必然會…)
tip: 聽力 Part 4 交通廣播（announcement）必考：The northbound train bound for Boston will depart from track 3.
sentence: Passengers holding boarding passes for the flight bound for Tokyo should proceed to Gate 12 immediately.
sentenceZh: 持有前往東京班機登機證的旅客請立即前往12號登機門。

collocations: set clear boundaries (設定明確界限)
tip: 在不動產（Real Estate）合約或管理領域常見。常指土地界線，或指專業職責界限。
sentence: A licensed surveyor was hired to determine the exact property boundaries before construction began.
sentenceZh: 在施工開始前，公司聘請了一位持照測量員來確定精確的土地產權界限。

collocations: take a bow (謝幕；鞠躬致意)
tip: 商業禮儀（cross-cultural etiquette）閱讀文章中常見，尤其提到日本等亞洲國家的商務接待禮俗時。
sentence: In traditional Japanese corporate culture, it is customary to bow respectfully when greeting international clients.
sentenceZh: 在傳統日本企業文化中，迎接國際客戶時恭敬地鞠躬是一種習俗。

tip: 在餐飲場景或員工福委會休閒活動（company social events）中出現，例如舉辦 bowling tournament。
sentence: The catering team prepared individual soup bowls for each guest attending the formal gala dinner.
sentenceZh: 外燴團隊為參加正式晚宴的每位貴賓準備了獨立的湯碗。

tip: 辦公室內部溝通題常見 suggestion box（意見箱）；倉庫物流題常見 cardboard box 或 drop box。
sentence: Management installed a suggestion box in the break room to encourage honest employee feedback.
sentenceZh: 管理層在休息室安裝了一個意見箱，以鼓勵員工提供坦誠的反饋。

collocations: box office hit (票房大賣的作品)
pick up tickets at the box office (在售票處取票)
tip: 多益藝文表演（concert, theater performance）必考。Will Call 常指在 box office 現場取預訂的票。
sentence: Pre-ordered tickets for the symphony performance may be collected at the box office one hour prior to the show.
sentenceZh: 預訂的交響樂演出門票可在演出開始前一小時在售票處領取。

collocations: call for a boycott (號召抵制)
tip: 常見於商業新聞或公關危機報導中，代表公眾因道德、環保或勞資糾紛而發起拒買行動。
sentence: Several environmental groups called for a nationwide boycott against the cosmetics brand due to its packaging waste.
sentenceZh: 由於該化妝品品牌的包裝浪費問題，數個環保團體號召全國抵制該品牌。

collocations: brace oneself for (為…做好心理準備)
brace for economic slowdown (防備經濟趨緩)
tip: 片語 brace for + 名詞，常出現在財經報導，表示企業或市場「為即將到來的衝擊或衰退預作準備」。
sentence: Retailers across the nation are bracing for a decline in consumer spending due to rising inflation.
sentenceZh: 由於通膨上升，全國各地的零售商正準備應對消費者支出的下滑。

tip: 市場調查（survey demographics）或薪資/稅務常見 tax bracket 或 income bracket。
sentence: Our new marketing campaign is specifically tailored for affluent consumers within the highest income bracket.
sentenceZh: 我們的新行銷企劃是專門針對處於最高收入級距的富裕消費者而量身定制的。

collocations: brains behind the project (專案幕後策劃者)
tip: 口語常見 pick your brain（請教意見）；人資或經濟文章中常出現 brain drain（頂尖人才外流）。
sentence: Could I take you out for coffee tomorrow so I can pick your brain about the new European market regulations?
sentenceZh: 我明天可以請你喝杯咖啡，向你請教關於歐洲新市場法規的問題嗎？

collocations: brainstorm ideas (集思廣益構思點子)
brainstorm potential solutions (共同探討可行解法)
tip: 多益會議情境核心單字！brainstorming session 是固定名詞片語，代表為新專案找尋靈感的小組會議。
sentence: The creative department will hold a two-hour brainstorming session to develop promotional themes for the upcoming product launch.
sentenceZh: 創意部門將舉行兩小時的腦力激盪會議，為即將到來的新品發表會開發宣傳主題。

tip: 租車保養（car rental inspection）或物流貨車維修題型中常出現。注意同音字 break（打破/休息）的拼字陷阱！
sentence: Fleet maintenance reported that the delivery van requires new brake pads before it can be dispatched.
sentenceZh: 車隊保修部門報告指出，該送貨箱型車在出勤前需要更換新的煞車皮。

tip: 極高頻商務字。銀行業稱為 bank branch（銀行分行），連鎖企業分店可稱為 branch。同義詞為 subsidiary 或 affiliate。
sentence: First National Bank has decided to close three downtown branches and expand its online banking infrastructure.
sentenceZh: 第一國家銀行已決定關閉三家市中心分行，並擴大其網路銀行基礎設施。

tip: 行銷大考點！名詞搭配詞必背：brand loyalty, brand recognition, build a brand。同義詞替換常考 trademark 或 label。
sentence: The rebranding strategy successfully enhanced brand awareness among millennial consumers across the region.
sentenceZh: 該品牌重塑策略成功提升了該地區千禧世代消費者對品牌的知名度。

collocations: invest in brand-new software (投資全新軟體)
tip: 強調從未使用過。在辦公室搬遷或工廠升級文章中，常與 state-of-the-art（最先進的）並列使用。
sentence: The research team was delighted to move into a brand-new facility equipped with cutting-edge laboratory instruments.
sentenceZh: 研究團隊非常高興能搬進配備尖端實驗儀器的全新設施。

collocations: brave the elements (頂著惡劣天氣前進)
tip: 商務演講中常形容領導者做出 brave decision（大膽有魄力的商業決策）。
sentence: Investing heavily in renewable energy during an economic downturn was considered a brave decision by the board.
sentenceZh: 在經濟低迷時期大舉投資再生能源被董事會認為是一個大膽而勇敢的決定。

collocations: bravely confront challenges (勇敢面對挑戰)
bravely admit mistakes (勇敢承認錯誤)
tip: 修飾動詞，在職場管理演講中常出現在成功心態的描述中。
sentence: The startup founders bravely negotiated favorable terms with venture capitalists despite fierce competition.
sentenceZh: 儘管面臨激烈競爭，這家新創公司的創始人依然勇敢地與創投公司爭取到了有利的條款。

tip: 多出現在聽力或日常對話題中，通常出現在文藝表演結束、頒獎或同事取得重大卓越成就時的口頭讚美。
sentence: After concluding her inspiring keynote address, the guest speaker received loud bravos and a standing ovation from the audience.
sentenceZh: 在發表完激勵人心的專題演講後，客座主講人贏得全場觀眾熱烈的喝采與起立鼓掌。

collocations: breach the confidentiality agreement (違反保密協議)
tip: 合約法規黃金考點！breach of contract 與 data breach（資料外洩）是閱讀測驗極高頻考點，同義詞為 violation 或 infringe upon。
sentence: Failing to deliver the custom machinery by the agreed deadline constitutes a material breach of contract.
sentenceZh: 未能於約定截止日前交付客製化機械已構成重大違約。

collocations: bread and butter (生計；主要經濟來源)
tip: 成語 bread and butter 常在商務閱讀中引申為「核心業務/基本生計」（e.g., Consulting is our bread and butter）。
sentence: Commercial maintenance contracts represent the bread and butter of our air-conditioning service company.
sentenceZh: 商業空調維護合約代表了我們空調服務公司的核心生計與主要營收來源。

collocations: breadth of experience (經驗的豐富程度/廣度)
breadth of product line (產品線的廣度)
tip: 常出現在求職推薦信或人資履歷評語中：impressive breadth of experience（令人印象深刻的豐富經歷）。
sentence: The search committee was impressed by the candidate's remarkable breadth of experience in international supply chain management.
sentenceZh: 遴選委員會對該候選人在國際供應鏈管理方面的豐富資歷廣度留下了深刻印象。

collocations: take a coffee break (喝咖啡小憩)
tip: 多益職場聽力常考 break room（員工休息室）與 take a short break。注意 break even（損益兩平）也是高頻商務片語。
sentence: Employees are encouraged to take a fifteen-minute break every four hours to prevent physical and mental fatigue.
sentenceZh: 我們鼓勵員工每工作四小時休息十五分鐘，以防止身心疲勞。

tip: 物流與包裝題型常與 fragile（易碎的）互為同義替換詞。包裹外箱常有 Handle with care: breakable 字樣。
sentence: Please ensure that all breakable ceramic goods are securely wrapped with bubble wrap before shipment.
sentenceZh: 出貨前請確保所有易碎陶瓷商品均已用氣泡紙妥善包裝。

collocations: detailed cost breakdown (詳細成本明細)
tip: 多益極高頻雙重意思：1. 機械或車輛故障（equipment breakdown）；2. 財務費用的「細目/明細表」（cost breakdown）。此題型在 Part 7 超常見！
sentence: The finance director requested a comprehensive breakdown of travel expenses before approving the departmental budget.
sentenceZh: 財務長在核准部門預算前，要求提供一份詳盡的差旅費用明細表。

tip: 飯店訂房與接待場景最常考 complimentary breakfast（免費早餐）或 continental breakfast。
sentence: The hotel reservation package includes a complimentary continental breakfast served daily from 6:30 a.m. to 10:00 a.m.
sentenceZh: 該飯店預訂套裝包含每日早上6:30至10:00供應的免費歐式早餐。

tip: 大型研討會（conference）日程表最常考 breakout session，表示大會主講後分成小組各別討論的專案單元。
sentence: Following the keynote speech, participants will divide into smaller groups for interactive breakout sessions.
sentenceZh: 在主題演講之後，與會者將分成較小的小組參加互動式分組會議。

tip: 在研發（R&D）報告或新聞發布會上極為高頻，常與 achieve 或 represent 搭配。
sentence: Scientists at the pharmaceutical lab achieved a significant breakthrough in developing a more stable vaccine formula.
sentenceZh: 該製藥實驗室的科學家在開發更穩定的疫苗配方方面取得了重大突破。

collocations: breakup fee (分手費/解約補償金)
tip: 企業併購（M&A）題型中常出現 breakup fee（合約破局補償費）或分拆子公司上市等議題。
sentence: The regulatory antitrust authority ordered the corporate breakup of the telecommunications conglomerate to promote fair competition.
sentenceZh: 反壟斷監管機構下令對該電信巨頭進行企業拆分，以促進公平競爭。

collocations: breathe fresh air (呼吸新鮮空氣)
tip: 注意拼字：動詞是 breathe（字尾有 e，發長音），名詞是 breath（無 e，發短音）。職場健檢或工安防護具必背。
sentence: Proper ventilation systems must be installed in the paint shop to ensure that technicians can breathe clean air safely.
sentenceZh: 噴漆車間必須安裝適當的通風系統，以確保技師能夠安全地呼吸乾淨空氣。

zh: 氣喘吁吁的；喘不過氣的
collocations: leave someone breathless (令某人屏息/讚嘆)
out of breath and breathless (氣喘如牛)
tip: 在商務閱讀或廣告宣傳文章中，leave the audience breathless 常用來誇讚演講精彩或景觀令人驚豔。
sentence: Climbing five flights of stairs during the fire drill left several senior executives temporarily breathless.
sentenceZh: 在消防演習期間爬了五層樓梯，使幾位高階主管暫時氣喘吁吁。

zh: 令人屏息的；壯觀驚人的
tip: 旅遊廣告與商務度假村（resort）宣傳文宣中的絕對高頻詞。同義詞有 stunning, spectacular, magnificent。
sentence: The executive conference resort offers breathtaking views of the surrounding alpine mountains from every meeting room.
sentenceZh: 這家高階商務會議度假村的每間會議室都能欣賞到周圍阿爾卑斯山脈令人屏息的壯美景色。

collocations: a breeze to use (使用起來非常簡單)
sail through as a breeze (輕易通過)
tip: 口語及軟體宣傳詞中常形容某工具「極其簡單容易」：Setting up the new accounting software was an absolute breeze.
sentence: Thanks to the intuitive user interface, migrating data to the new cloud platform was an absolute breeze.
sentenceZh: 得益於直覺的使用者介面，將資料遷移到新雲端平台是一件輕而易舉的事。

tip: 商業閱讀重中之重：brick-and-mortar 專指「實體零售/實體店家」，常與 e-commerce（電子商務）或 online shop 做對比考題！
sentence: Despite the rapid surge in online retail, the company continues to invest in its traditional brick-and-mortar stores.
sentenceZh: 儘管線上零售迅速崛起，該公司仍繼續投資其傳統的實體店面。

collocations: bridal suite (新娘套房/蜜月套房)
cater to the bride (為新娘提供服務)
tip: 飯店宴會業務（banquet department）題型常考婚禮策劃專案（wedding planning packages）。
sentence: The luxury hotel offers tailored event planning packages designed specifically for the bride and groom.
sentenceZh: 該豪華飯店提供專為新郎新娘量身打造的活動策劃套裝服務。

zh: 橋樑 / 跨越；彌合（差距）
collocations: bridge the gap (縮小差距/弭平歧見)
bridge the cultural divide (消除文化隔閡)
tip: 商務隱喻高頻詞！bridge the gap between A and B（消除兩者差距或分歧）是聽力長篇與閱讀 Part 7 常考金句。
sentence: The mentorship program was established to help bridge the gap between academic theory and corporate practice.
sentenceZh: 該導師指導計畫的設立是為了幫助弭平學術理論與企業實務之間的差距。

collocations: brief someone on sth (就某事向某人作簡報)
tip: 動詞用法是多益招牌考點！brief sb on sth（簡要向某人說明情況）。名詞 briefing（簡報會）也是高頻單字。
sentence: The project manager will brief the executive committee on the construction progress tomorrow morning.
sentenceZh: 專案經理將於明早向執行委員會簡報施工進度。

tip: 聽力 Part 1 圖片題極高頻物體！注意搭配動詞：carry, hold, open, placed beside the desk 等情境。
sentence: The attorney carried a leather briefcase containing the confidential litigation files into the courtroom.
sentenceZh: 律師提著裝有保密訴訟文件的皮質公事包走進了法庭。

zh: 明亮的；聰穎的；有前途的
tip: 形容前景時常與 promising 做替換。人資評鑑中形容優秀員工也常使用 bright, talented personnel。
sentence: With continuous double-digit revenue growth, industry analysts predict a bright future for the tech startup.
sentenceZh: 伴隨著連續兩位數的營收增長，產業分析師預測這家科技新創公司前景一片光明。

collocations: brighten up the office (使辦公室煥然一新)
brighten someone's day (使某人心情好轉)
tip: 在經濟評析中，brighten often means to improve（好轉）。例如：Employment prospects brighten as the economy recovers.
sentence: The unexpected surge in overseas orders has brightened the economic prospects of the local manufacturing sector.
sentenceZh: 海外訂單的意外激增使當地製造業的經濟前景大為好轉。

tip: 多益閱讀推薦信（letter of recommendation）高頻讚美詞，替換詞為 outstanding, exceptional, superb。
sentence: Her brilliant restructuring strategy not only saved the firm from insolvency but also doubled profit margins.
sentenceZh: 她絕妙的重組策略不僅使公司免於破產，更使利潤率翻倍。

zh: 輕快的；生意興隆的；活絡的
tip: 多益財經閱讀必背金證字！brisk sales 專指銷售非常熱絡快速，同義詞為 lively, rapid, vigorous。
sentence: Due to aggressive holiday advertising, the retailer reported brisk sales during the final quarter of the year.
sentenceZh: 由於假期大力宣傳促銷，該零售商在今年最後一季的銷售表現十分暢旺。

collocations: become brittle with age (因老化變脆)
tip: 在工廠品管（quality control）與原料測試（material testing）常考，代表材料在高低溫下容易折斷脆弱。
sentence: Quality inspectors rejected the plastic casing because extreme temperatures caused it to become dangerously brittle.
sentenceZh: 品管檢驗員退回了該批塑料外殼，因為極端溫度導致其變得異常脆弱易裂。

zh: 廣播；播送 / 電視或廣播節目
tip: 注意三態變化：broadcast - broadcast - broadcast（過去式與過去分詞不加 ed，雖加 ed 有時可見，但標準用法不變）。
sentence: The CEO's annual address to overseas branches will be broadcast live via the corporate intranet tomorrow.
sentenceZh: 執行長對海外分公司的年度致詞將於明天透過企業內部網路進行現場直播。

tip: 行銷促銷題必考單字！常與 pamphlet, booklet, flyer 做同義替換，常考在服務台索取（pick up a brochure）。
sentence: Please take a look at our travel brochure for detailed itineraries and discounted group vacation packages.
sentenceZh: 請翻閱我們的旅遊宣傳手冊，以了解詳細的行程規劃與團體優惠度假套裝。

zh: 經紀人；仲介 / 居間調停；促成
collocations: real estate broker (房地產經紀人)
broker a deal (居間促成交易)
tip: 金融與房地產情境必考。動詞 broker a compromise/agreement 指「居中協調斡旋達成協議」。
sentence: The experienced real estate broker helped us negotiate a long-term lease at an exceptionally favorable rate.
sentenceZh: 經驗豐富的房地產經紀人協助我們以極具優勢的租金協商了一份長期租約。

zh: 調停促成的；居間斡旋的（過去分詞/過去式）
collocations: brokered by an intermediary (由中間人斡旋)
tip: 過去分詞作形容詞用，修飾經由第三方仲介達成的交易或條約（brokered peace / brokered compromise）。
sentence: The government brokered a last-minute settlement between the port management and the dockworkers' union to avoid a strike.
sentenceZh: 政府在最後一刻促成了港口管理方與碼頭工會之間的和解，從而避免了罷工。

collocations: browse through the catalog (瀏覽商品型錄)
tip: 商場情境聽力常見對話：May I help you? - No, thanks, I'm just browsing.（不需要，我只是隨便看看）。
sentence: Customers are encouraged to browse through our digital merchandise catalog to discover exclusive online discounts.
sentenceZh: 我們鼓勵顧客瀏覽我們的數位商品型錄，以發掘專屬的線上優惠折扣。

collocations: compatible with all browsers (相容於所有瀏覽器)
tip: IT 系統通知與網路技術文章必考：Ensure your browser is updated to the latest version to view this webpage properly.
sentence: The updated corporate portal is fully compatible with any modern web browser across multiple operating systems.
sentenceZh: 更新後的企業入口網站完全相容於跨多種作業系統的任何現代網頁瀏覽器。

zh: 瘀青；挫傷 / 使受挫；使瘀傷
collocations: suffer cuts and bruises (蒙受割傷與挫傷)
tip: 職場工傷事故報告（incident report）中常見，常與 cuts, scrapes, sprains 並列在輕微傷害列表中。
sentence: Fortunately, the warehouse associate suffered only minor bruises after the unsecured parcel fell from the shelf.
sentenceZh: 所幸未固定的包裹從貨架掉落後，該名倉庫員工僅受到輕微瘀傷。

collocations: brush aside concerns (對顧慮不予理睬)
tip: 超高頻片語考題：brush up on your English/skills（重新複習你的英文/專業技能）。
sentence: Before departing for his overseas assignment in Frankfurt, David attended evening classes to brush up on his German.
sentenceZh: 在啟程前往法蘭克福執行海外派駐任務之前，大衛參加了夜間進修班以溫習德文。

collocations: give someone the brush-off (敷衍某人)
get the brush-off from (遭到…冷落拒絕)
tip: 顧客投訴或求職反饋中常見的非正式口語表達，指被客服或人資草率打發敷衍。
sentence: The frustrated client felt he was given the brush-off by the customer service representative after waiting on hold for an hour.
sentenceZh: 這位感到沮喪的客戶在在線等待了一小時後，覺得自己被客服代表敷衍打發了。

collocations: brutal market conditions (嚴酷的市場環境)
tip: 常修飾商業市場競爭：brutal price war（殘酷的價格戰）或 brutal competition。
sentence: The consumer electronics sector has been subject to brutal price competition over the past two quarters.
sentenceZh: 消費性電子產品產業在過去兩個季度中一直面臨著殘酷的價格競爭。

collocations: brutally honest (極度坦率不留情面的)
tip: 常見修飾副詞搭配：brutally honest feedback（毫不留情但真實的回饋）。
sentence: The external consultant was brutally honest when assessing the company’s outdated operational workflow.
sentenceZh: 外部顧問在評估該公司過時的營運流程時，給予了極為直白且毫不留情面的評價。

tip: 財經專題閱讀常考 economic bubble（經濟泡沫）與 the bubble bursts（泡沫破滅）。
sentence: Financial analysts warned that the sudden surge in commercial real estate prices may signal a speculative bubble.
sentenceZh: 金融分析師警告，商業地產價格的突然暴漲可能預示著投機泡沫的形成。

collocations: a drop in the bucket (滄海一粟；杯水車薪)
tip: 清潔保全或設施管理場景常見 mop and bucket；成語 a drop in the bucket 常考指資金相較總額只是「杯水車薪」。
sentence: The initial government grant was helpful, but industry experts described it as a mere drop in the bucket compared to total project costs.
sentenceZh: 最初的政府補助固然有所幫助，但產業專家認為與專案總成本相比不過是杯水車薪。

zh: 帶扣；鎖扣 / 扣上；屈服
collocations: buckle under pressure (在壓力下崩潰/屈服)
tip: 機上機長廣播常用 buckle up 取代 fasten your seatbelt；管理情境中 buckle under pressure 指無法承受工作壓力。
sentence: The flight attendant reminded all passengers to buckle their seat belts securely as the aircraft prepared for landing.
sentenceZh: 飛機準備降落時，空服員提醒所有乘客繫緊安全帶。

collocations: budge on the price (在價格上鬆口讓步)
tip: 商務談判（negotiation）經典片語：neither party would budge on price（雙方在價格上皆互不讓步）。
sentence: Despite extensive negotiations lasting several days, neither party was willing to budge on the proposed royalty rates.
sentenceZh: 儘管談判持續了數天，雙方皆不願意在提議的權利金費率上做出任何讓步。

zh: 預算 / 編列預算 / 廉價的
collocations: budget surplus / deficit (預算盈餘/赤字)
tip: 多益出題率前十名的核心單字！形容詞 budget airline 指廉航。注意 under/within budget（在預算內）與 exceed/over budget（超支）。
sentence: Thanks to prudent cost-control measures, the renovation of the corporate headquarters was completed well within budget.
sentenceZh: 得益於審慎的成本控制措施，企業總部的翻修工程在預算範圍內順利完工。

collocations: build customer trust (建立顧客信任)
tip: 商務英文中常作抽象比喻：build rapport（建立良好關係）、build a solid client base（建立穩固的客戶基礎）。
sentence: Our primary objective this quarter is to build strong, long-lasting partnerships with regional suppliers.
sentenceZh: 我們本季的首要目標是與區域供應商建立穩固且長久的合作夥伴關係。

tip: 聽力 Part 1 建築物描繪高頻詞；Part 7 不動產常見 building permit（施工執照）或 building maintenance。
sentence: The company has leased three entire floors in the prestigious commercial building located in the central business district.
sentenceZh: 該公司已租下了位於中央商務區的這棟頂級商業大樓中整整三個樓層。

tip: 採購必考核心！in bulk 為固定片語表示「大量地」；bulk discount 意為「大宗採購折扣（批發價折扣）」。
sentence: Hotels usually purchase linens and toiletries in bulk directly from distributors to secure substantial volume discounts.
sentenceZh: 飯店通常會直接向經銷商大批採購被單和盥洗用品，以取得大幅的大宗折扣。

tip: 可數與不可數陷阱：指「公司、商號」時為可數（open a new business）；指「商業貿易活動」時為不可數（expand our business）。
sentence: The firm has decided to expand its digital marketing business into several fast-growing Southeast Asian markets.
sentenceZh: 該公司已決定將其數位行銷業務擴展至多個快速成長的東南亞市場。

tip: 多益現代考卷傾向使用性別中立詞（gender-neutral words），如 businessperson, business executive 或 entrepreneur。
sentence: The prominent local businessman pledged to donate a portion of his company's annual profits to vocational training programs.
sentenceZh: 這位當地著名的企業家承諾將其公司年度利潤的一部分捐贈給職業培訓計畫。

tip: 形容旅遊或會計旺季時常用 peak season 或 busy season。電話英文中 The line is busy 代表忙線中。
sentence: Accountants are exceptionally busy with audits and tax filings during the first two months of each fiscal year.
sentenceZh: 在每個財政年度的前兩個月，會計師們都格外忙於審計與報稅工作。

collocations: hit the panic button (驚慌失措)
tip: 多出現在辦公室器材操作手冊（user manuals）：Press the start button after loading paper into tray 1.
sentence: To submit your job application, simply complete the required profile fields and click the confirmation button below.
sentenceZh: 若要提交您的工作申請，只需填妥必要的個人資料欄位，然後點擊下方的確認按鈕即可。

tip: 商務正式寫作常用 purchase 代替 buy。名詞用法 a good buy 表示「物美價廉的划算交易」。
sentence: Procurement specialists are currently negotiating with multiple vendors to buy raw materials at the lowest possible cost.
sentenceZh: 採購專員目前正與多家供應商洽談，以期以最低的可能成本購買原材料。

tip: 多益中除了指消費者「買主」外，在零售與百貨業中常指專業職稱「採購員」（merchandise buyer）。
sentence: The real estate agent arranged several private walkthroughs for prospective buyers interested in the suburban property.
sentenceZh: 房地產經紀人為對該郊區房產感興趣的潛在買家安排了多次私人實地看房。

tip: 聽力 Part 2 與 Part 3 差旅報銷常見：Keep the receipt for your cab fare to get reimbursed later.
sentence: Since my flight was delayed and I missed the shuttle, I had to hail a cab to make it to the client presentation on time.
sentenceZh: 由於我的班機延誤且錯過了接駁車，我不得不攔計程車以便及時趕上客戶簡報。

tip: 航空情境必考 cabin crew（機組人員）與 cabin baggage / carry-on luggage（登機手提行李）。
sentence: The flight captain instructed the cabin crew to secure all loose equipment in preparation for unexpected turbulence.
sentenceZh: 機長指示機組人員固定所有鬆動的設備，以準備應對無法預期的亂流。

tip: 原單字表誤植為 cabine，正確為 cabinet。聽力 Part 1 圖片題超高頻：A filing cabinet is next to the desk.
sentence: All confidential client tax records must be locked inside the metal filing cabinet at the end of each workday.
sentenceZh: 所有機密的客戶稅務記錄在每個工作日結束時都必須鎖入金屬檔案櫃中。

tip: IT 故障排除題型常見：Check if the network cable is securely plugged into the router port.
sentence: The IT department is upgrading the office infrastructure with high-speed fiber-optic cables to support video conferencing.
sentenceZh: 資訊部門正在使用高速光纖電纜升級辦公室基礎設施，以支援視訊會議需求。

collocations: subsidized cafeteria (有伙食補貼的餐廳)
tip: 多益職場日常對話極高頻。題目常出現同事約在 cafeteria 吃午餐或討論公司福利（subsidized meals）。
sentence: The newly renovated corporate cafeteria offers a wide variety of nutritious, subsidized lunch options for staff.
sentenceZh: 全新裝修的企業員工餐廳為員工提供各種營養豐富且享有補貼的午餐選擇。

collocations: high in caffeine (高咖啡因含量的)
tip: 茶水間或健康專題常出現 decaffeinated（去咖啡因的，常簡稱為 decaf）作為搭配延伸詞。
sentence: To improve employee wellness, the office pantry now provides several herbal and caffeine-free tea selections.
sentenceZh: 為了改善員工健康，辦公室茶水間現在提供數款草本及無咖啡因的茶包選擇。

tip: 多出現在健康保健品研發、營養食品廣告或員工健康生活專欄文章中。
sentence: The dietary study highlighted that dairy products fortified with calcium contribute significantly to overall bone density.
sentenceZh: 該飲食研究強調，添加鈣質的乳製品對增強整體骨質密度具有顯著貢獻。

tip: 片語 calculated risk（經精算評估過的風險）為多益閱讀進階常考商業詞彙。
sentence: The logistics manager calculated the estimated delivery fees based on weight, dimensions, and geographic destination.
sentenceZh: 物流經理根據重量、尺寸及地理目的地計算出預估的運費。

collocations: by my calculations (根據我的估算)
tip: 常考在財務報告驗算：Upon closer calculation, we discovered an accounting discrepancy.
sentence: According to preliminary financial calculations, outsourcing customer support will reduce our overhead by 25 percent.
sentenceZh: 根據初步的財務試算，外包客服支援將為我們減少25%的經常性開銷。

tip: 文具辦公用品（office supplies）採購清單必考單字之一。
sentence: Candidates taking the certification examination are permitted to bring an approved basic financial calculator.
sentenceZh: 參加認證考試的考生獲准攜帶經核准的基礎財務計算機。

collocations: mark on the calendar (在日曆上記下)
tip: 商務必備概念：calendar year 指 1/1 至 12/31；不同於 fiscal year（財政年度，可能從 4/1 或 7/1 開始）。
sentence: Please check your electronic calendar and confirm whether you are available to attend the quarterly strategy meeting next Friday.
sentenceZh: 請查看您的電子行事曆，並確認下週五是否有空參加季度策略會議。

collocations: professionals of this caliber (具備這種才幹的專業人士)
tip: 人資招募高頻進階詞彙！常修飾頂尖人才：We are seeking high-caliber professionals for our new executive branch.
sentence: Attracting candidates of exceptional caliber requires competitive compensation packages and comprehensive healthcare benefits.
sentenceZh: 吸引水準卓越的候選人需要極具競爭力的薪資方案以及全面的醫療福利。

zh: 打電話；召集 / 通話；電話
tip: 超高頻片語：call off (= cancel 取消)、call a meeting (= convene 召集會議)。此二片語在 Part 3 & 4 出題率極高。
sentence: The regional sales team participated in a conference call to discuss strategies for penetrating the overseas retail market.
sentenceZh: 區域業務團隊參加了電話會議，共同討論打入海外零售市場的策略。

collocations: keep the caller on hold (讓來電者在線上稍候)
tip: 電話客服（call center）情境必考。例如自動語音系統：All our representatives are busy, please stay on the line for the next available agent.
sentence: The automated answering system politely informs callers that all customer service agents are currently assisting other clients.
sentenceZh: 自動語音應答系統禮貌地通知來電者，所有客服代表目前都在協助其他客戶。

collocations: find one's true calling (找到個人真正的天職)
tip: 求職自傳、職涯演講或退休感言文章常考，表示對工作的極高熱情與使命感，同義詞為 vocation。
sentence: After working ten years in commercial banking, Maria found her true calling as a non-profit foundation director.
sentenceZh: 在商業銀行工作十年後，瑪麗亞在一家非營利基金會擔任主管，找到了自己真正的天職。

zh: 冷靜的；平靜的 / 使平靜
collocations: calm an upset customer (安撫憤怒的顧客)
calm the market (穩定市場情緒)
tip: 危機處理（crisis management）或客服應對必備動詞：Customer service staff are trained to stay calm and listen attentively.
sentence: The public relations manager remained calm and addressed the journalists' tough questions with complete composure.
sentenceZh: 公關經理保持冷靜，以極其沉著的態度回答了記者們提出的棘手問題。

tip: 聽力 Part 1 圖片常考 surveillance camera / security camera mounted on the wall/ceiling（安裝在牆壁或天花板上的監視器）。
sentence: High-definition security cameras were installed throughout the retail store to deter shoplifting and monitor register activity.
sentenceZh: 零售店內各處均安裝了高畫質監視器，以防止行竊並監控收銀機的作業情況。

tip: 人資培訓或團建活動（team building）常出現 coding boot camp（程式集訓營）或 leadership training camp。
sentence: The IT enterprise sponsored an intensive two-week training boot camp to upskill its junior software developers.
sentenceZh: 該 IT 企業贊助了一場為期兩週的密集培訓訓練營，以提升其初階軟體開發人員的技能。

zh: 宣傳活動；活動 / 發起運動
tip: 行銷廣告絕對的核心高頻字！常與動詞 launch, spearhead, roll out 連用。注意其拼字結尾為 paign 但發音為 /peɪn/。
sentence: Our agency spearheaded an aggressive multimedia campaign that boosted brand recognition by forty percent within two months.
sentenceZh: 我們機構主導了一場積極的多媒體宣傳活動，在兩個月內將品牌知名度提升了40%。

tip: 重要商務延伸：campus 不僅指大學校園，許多大型科技公司（如 Google、Apple）的總部園區亦通稱為 corporate campus。
sentence: The technology giant plans to construct a sprawling corporate campus featuring solar panels and green recreation areas.
sentenceZh: 該科技巨頭計劃建造一個佔地遼闊的企業園區，其特色為配備太陽能板及綠化休閒區。

tip: 多益聽力短對話最常考的突發狀況之一。名詞形為 cancellation，常見片語同義替換為 call off。
sentence: Due to hazardous road conditions caused by the blizzard, the keynote speaker was forced to cancel her seminar.
sentenceZh: 由於暴風雪導致路況危險，專題演講者被迫取消了她的研討會。

tip: 飯店預約或購票規定必考 cancellation policy。通常會說明：Cancellations made within 24 hours are subject to a fee.
sentence: Under our hotel’s current cancellation policy, guests who cancel at least 48 hours prior to check-in will receive a full refund.
sentenceZh: 根據我們飯店現行的取消政策，在入住前至少48小時取消的房客將獲得全額退款。

tip: 績效考核（performance review）中常考 candid appraisal / candid feedback，同義詞為 honest, frank, forthright。
sentence: During the performance review, the director gave candid feedback regarding areas where the project team needed improvement.
sentenceZh: 在績效考核期間，處長就專案團隊需要改進之處給予了坦率懇切的反饋。

tip: 人資招聘單元最核心單字！常與 applicant, interviewee, prospective employee 做同義替換。
sentence: After reviewing more than fifty resumes, the recruitment panel selected the three most qualified candidates for final interviews.
sentenceZh: 在審查了五十多份履歷後，招募小組選出了三位最合適的候選人進行最終面試。

collocations: beyond one's capability (超出某人能力範圍)
tip: 常指出廠設備或團隊的潛在處理產能。注意 capability 多指「具備執行某特殊任務的能力」，常搭配介系詞 of 或 to V。
sentence: By installing state-of-the-art robotic assembly arms, the plant significantly expanded its overall production capability.
sentenceZh: 藉由安裝最先進的機器人組裝手臂，該工廠大幅擴充了其整體生產能力。

tip: 文法必考搭配介系詞：be capable of + V-ing（有能力做…）；對比 be able to + 原形動詞。
sentence: Ms. Johnson has consistently proven herself capable of managing large-scale infrastructure projects under tight deadlines.
sentenceZh: 強生女士屢次證明自己有能力在緊迫的截止期限內管理大型基礎設施專案。

collocations: operate at full capacity (全產能運轉)
in an official capacity (以官方身份)
tip: 多益雙重核心用法：1. 工廠產能（production capacity）；2. 會議室容納人數（room capacity）；3. 身份/資格（in his capacity as CFO）。
sentence: Due to a surge in international orders, the electronics factory has been operating at full capacity for three consecutive months.
sentenceZh: 由於國際訂單激增，該電子工廠已連續三個月全產能滿載運轉。

tip: 商業財務精選核心詞。片語必背：venture capital（創投）、capital expenditure（資本支出，簡稱 CapEx）。
sentence: The biotechnology firm successfully secured twenty million dollars in venture capital to fund clinical trials.
sentenceZh: 該生物科技公司成功獲得了兩千萬美元的創投資金，以資助臨床試驗。

tip: 股票投資文章中常出現 market capitalization（簡稱 market cap，市值），例如：a mega-cap company。
sentence: Following a record quarterly revenue report, the technology corporation’s market capitalization crossed the one-trillion-dollar threshold.
sentenceZh: 在創紀錄的季度營收報告發布後，該科技公司的股票總市值跨過了一兆美元的門檻。

zh: 利用；趁機利用；使資本化
collocations: capitalize on market trends (順應並利用市場趨勢)
tip: 必考片語動詞：capitalize on (= take advantage of / exploit 充分利用機會)。多益 Part 5 & 7 常客！
sentence: Our firm intends to capitalize on the growing demand for green building materials across metropolitan areas.
sentenceZh: 我們公司打算充分利用大都會地區對綠建築材料日益增長的需求。

collocations: capture market share (贏得市場份額)
tip: 行銷商業報告必備：capture 20% of the market share（搶下20%的市場佔有率），同義替換為 secure 或 obtain。
sentence: The newly released budget smartphone is projected to capture a substantial share of the youth demographic market.
sentenceZh: 這款新發售的平價智慧型手機預計將在年輕客群市場中搶佔可觀的市佔率。

zh: 在乎；關心 / 照顧；照護
collocations: customer care (客戶關懷/售後服務)
tip: 物流外箱常印 Handle with care。此外 customer care 即 customer service（客戶服務）。
sentence: The company revamped its customer care department by introducing a 24-hour instant messaging support service.
sentenceZh: 該公司透過引進24小時即時通訊支援服務，徹底革新了其客戶關懷部門。

tip: 人資考題高頻詞：career opportunity（就業機會）、career development（職涯發展）。常出現在招募徵才網頁。
sentence: The international firm offers outstanding opportunities for professional mentorship and rapid career advancement.
sentenceZh: 這家跨國企業提供了卓越的專業導師培訓制度與快速的職涯晉升機會。

tip: 合約審閱或財務規劃常搭配 careful consideration：After careful consideration, the board approved the proposal.
sentence: After careful consideration of the environmental impact report, the municipal council approved the bridge construction project.
sentenceZh: 在審慎考量環境影響報告後，市議會批准了這座橋樑的建設專案。

tip: Part 5 文法題常考副詞修飾動詞：Review the contract carefully before signing it.
sentence: Legal counsel advised the executive committee to review the nondisclosure clause carefully before signing the agreement.
sentenceZh: 法律顧問建議執行委員會在簽署合約之前，先仔細審閱該保密條款。

zh: 貨物（尤指船隻、飛機運載的）
tip: 多益不可數名詞代表！cargo 指散裝大型貨物，不可數，不用加複數 s；可與 freight, shipment 做替換。
sentence: The freighter was unable to unload its containerized cargo until the severe harbor storm subsided.
sentenceZh: 在港口嚴重的暴風雨平息之前，該貨輪無法卸下其貨櫃貨物。

tip: 辦公室翻修（office renovation）常見：The building will be closed this weekend for carpet cleaning.
sentence: The facilities manager arranged for professional carpet cleaning services throughout the executive suites this weekend.
sentenceZh: 總務經理安排本週末為整個高階主管套房區域提供專業的地毯清潔服務。

zh: 承運人；運輸公司；電信業者
tip: 在物流題中專指貨運商（如 FedEx, DHL）；在通訊領域則指電信業者（wireless carrier）。
sentence: We switched to a different shipping carrier because our previous logistics partner suffered frequent transit delays.
sentenceZh: 我們更換了另一家貨運承運公司，因為我們之前的物流合作夥伴頻繁發生運送延誤。

tip: 零售商務高頻陷阱：We do not carry this model 代表「本店未販售/無進貨此型號」，不可只記攜帶的意思。
sentence: Our flagship electronics store does not currently carry the older model of that tablet, as it has been discontinued.
sentenceZh: 我們的旗艦電子產品店目前未進貨該款平板電腦的舊型號，因為該型號已經停產。

collocations: carry out an inspection (執行檢查)
carry out a plan (執行計畫)
tip: 多益最愛考片語動詞之一！同義替換詞為 conduct, implement, execute。極高頻出現在 Part 5, 6, 7。
sentence: A designated independent audit firm will carry out a thorough inspection of our accounting books next Monday.
sentenceZh: 一家指定的獨立審計事務所將於下週一對我們的會計帳目進行全面徹底的稽核檢查。

tip: 電商網站題型常見 add items to your online shopping cart；機場題型常見 baggage cart。
sentence: Airport terminals provide free luggage carts to assist international passengers with heavy bags.
sentenceZh: 機場航廈提供免費的行李手推車，以協助提著沉重行李的國際旅客。

tip: 倉庫收發貨常見計量單位：Ship 50 cartons of office supplies to the branch warehouse.
sentence: The warehouse crew carefully inspected each shipping carton for visible physical damage before signing the delivery slip.
sentenceZh: 倉庫工作人員在簽署交貨單之前，仔細檢查了每個運輸紙箱是否有外觀可見的損壞。

collocations: in case of emergency (萬一發生緊急情況)
tip: 介系詞片語陷阱：in case of + 名詞（萬一發生…）；in case + 子句（以防萬一）。另外 a case of goods 指「一箱貨物」。
sentence: In case of severe inclement weather, all employees are authorized to work remotely from home without prior approval.
sentenceZh: 萬一發生嚴重的惡劣天氣，所有員工均有權直接在家遠端辦公，無需事先獲得批准。

tip: 財務篇重要片語：cash flow statement（現金流量表）、petty cash（辦公室小額備用金/零用金）。
sentence: Maintaining healthy cash flow is essential for small businesses to survive seasonal drops in consumer spending.
sentenceZh: 維持健全的現金流對於小型企業度過消費者支出的淡季至關重要。

zh: 演員陣容 / 投射；投票
collocations: cast doubt on (對…投下懷疑陰影)
tip: 雙重考點：1. 劇場或電影的「全體演職人員」（cast members）；2. 股東大會「投票」（cast a ballot/vote）。
sentence: Shareholders are invited to cast their votes online regarding the proposed corporate merger before midnight.
sentenceZh: 股東受邀在午夜之前，就提議的企業合併案進行線上投票。

zh: 目錄；商品型錄 / 編入目錄
tip: 英美拼法：美式 catalog，英式 catalogue。在訂購產品（ordering merchandise）閱讀考題中極為普遍。
sentence: You can find full technical specifications for all commercial air conditioning units in our latest product catalog.
sentenceZh: 您可以在我們最新的產品型錄中找到所有商用空調機組的完整技術規格。

tip: 常出現在財務報帳與圖書庫存系統：All expenses must be categorized accurately into travel, lodging, or meals.
sentence: The digital inventory management system automatically categorizes replacement parts based on serial numbers and equipment compatibility.
sentenceZh: 數位庫存管理系統會根據序號及設備相容性自動對替換零件進行分類。

collocations: in the category of (在…範疇內)
tip: 常見於財報支出分類（expense category）或零售商品類目，形容詞為 categorical（明確的；範疇的）。
sentence: Expenditures under the promotional marketing category expanded by twenty percent during the final quarter.
sentenceZh: 宣傳行銷類別下的支出在最後一季增加了百分之二十。

collocations: cater to customer needs (迎合顧客需求)
cater an event (為活動提供外燴)
cater for a conference (為會議籌備餐飲)
tip: 多益雙重高頻考點：1. cater an event（承辦活動餐飲）；2. cater to + 名詞（迎合…的偏好或市場需求）。
sentence: Our newly launched executive dining package is specifically designed to cater to corporate banquet events.
sentenceZh: 我們新推出的高階商務餐飲套裝是專門為迎合企業宴會活動而設計的。

tip: 辦公室聚會、派對或年會（annual banquet）必考。常考詢問外燴菜單（catering menu）或報價單。
sentence: The administrative assistant contacted a reputable local catering service to supply lunch for the board meeting.
sentenceZh: 行政助理聯繫了一家信譽良好的當地外燴服務公司，為董事會會議提供午餐。

zh: 原因；事業 / 引起；導致
tip: 名詞除「原因」外，常指「崇高理念/公益事業」（e.g., support a worthy cause）。動詞常與 delay 或 disruption 搭配。
sentence: Engineers conducted a thorough technical review to identify the root cause of the power outage at the data center.
sentenceZh: 工程師進行了徹底的技術審查，以查明資料中心斷電的根本原因。

collocations: caution someone against (告誡某人不要做某事)
tip: 安全標語及高管發言高頻詞！exercise caution 意為「採取謹慎態度」，動詞 caution sb against doing sth（告誡某人切勿…）。
sentence: Factory supervisors reminded equipment operators to exercise extreme caution when handling hazardous chemical substances.
sentenceZh: 工廠主管提醒設備操作員在處理危險化學物質時務必格外小心謹慎。

collocations: take a cautious stance (採取審慎立場)
tip: 財經新聞最高頻片語之一：cautiously optimistic（審慎樂觀），常出現在 CEO 對未來營收展望的描述中。
sentence: The chief financial officer adopted a cautious approach toward international expansion given current geopolitical tensions.
sentenceZh: 鑑於目前的地緣政治緊張局勢，財務長對國際擴張採取了謹慎的做法。

zh: 中央的；核心的；最重要的
collocations: central business district (中央商業區, CBD)
play a central role (扮演核心角色)
tip: 商務地產常用 central location（交通便利的核心地段）；商業戰略常用 play a central role in...。
sentence: Customer satisfaction plays a central role in maintaining long-term profitability and sustainable brand loyalty.
sentenceZh: 顧客滿意度在維持長期獲利能力及永續品牌忠誠度方面扮演著核心角色。

collocations: turn of the century (世紀之交)
tip: 在公司歷史介紹（company history/about us）常見：With over half a century of manufacturing excellence...
sentence: The family-owned luxury watchmaker has been delivering superior craftsmanship for nearly half a century.
sentenceZh: 這家家族經營的奢華鐘錶製造商近半個世紀以來一直提供卓越非凡的精湛工藝。

tip: 公司大型活動高頻考點：ribbon-cutting ceremony（新廠/旗艦店剪綵典禮）、groundbreaking ceremony（動土典禮）。
sentence: The mayor and the company president both attended the ribbon-cutting ceremony for the new distribution warehouse.
sentenceZh: 市長與公司總裁共同出席了新物流配送中心的剪綵儀式。

collocations: under certain conditions (在特定條件下)
tip: 片語 make certain that... 等同於 make sure that...（確保…）。修飾複數名詞時意為「某些特定…」。
sentence: Please make certain that all confidential evaluation files are encrypted before transmitting them via email.
sentenceZh: 在透過電子郵件傳輸所有機密評估文件之前，請務必確保這些文件已完成加密。

tip: 在聽力 Part 2 的回應句中常單獨出現代表「好的，沒問題」或「當然」（= Of course / Absolutely / Surely）。
sentence: Adopting the proposed energy-saving measures will certainly reduce the manufacturing plant's utility expenses over time.
sentenceZh: 採取提議的節能措施，隨著時間推移必定會降低製造廠的水電公共費用。

collocations: certified public accountant (執業會計師, CPA)
