tip: 人資資格要求核心字：certified（受過認證的/持證照的）。例如：a certified financial planner（持證財務規劃師）。
sentence: The independent auditing firm certified that the multinational corporation complied fully with international financial standards.
sentenceZh: 該獨立審計事務所出具證明，證實該跨國企業完全符合國際財務會計標準。

tip: 商務最頂級高頻詞：supply chain management（供應鏈管理，簡稱 SCM），為物流及採購題必考主題。
sentence: Supply chain disruptions caused by severe container shortages have led to temporary inventory shortages nationwide.
sentenceZh: 由嚴重的貨櫃短缺引發的供應鏈中斷，已導致全國範圍內出現暫時性的庫存吃緊。

collocations: address / meet a challenge (應對挑戰)
pose a challenge to (對…構成挑戰)
tip: 形容詞形式 challenging 常在閱讀中用作 difficult 的高階正面替換詞（e.g., a challenging task）。
sentence: The new marketing team is prepared to meet the challenge of restoring brand credibility following the product recall.
sentenceZh: 新行銷團隊已準備好迎接挑戰，在產品召回事件後重建品牌信譽。

zh: 改變；更改 / 零錢；變化
tip: 多益雙考點：1. 不可數名詞指零錢（exact change 請自備零錢）；2. 日程或合約的變更（subject to change 可能會變動）。
sentence: Please note that flight departure times are subject to change without advance notice due to severe weather.
sentenceZh: 請注意，由於惡劣天氣，航班起飛時間可能會有所變動，恕不另行通知。

collocations: changeable market conditions (多變的市場行情)
tip: 形容氣候或匯率波動多變，商務上常與 unpredictable 或 volatile 做概念替換。
sentence: Because autumn weather in the coastal region is highly changeable, outdoor event organizers always arrange backup indoor tents.
sentenceZh: 由於沿海地區秋季天氣變化多端，戶外活動的主辦單位總會安排備用的室內帳篷。

collocations: chapter of an organization (機構的分會)
tip: 商務社團大考點：chapter 常指專業學會或非營利組織的「地方分會」（如 the local chapter of the Project Management Institute）。
sentence: The regional chapter of the Human Resources Association is hosting a professional networking dinner this Thursday.
sentenceZh: 人資協會的地方分會將於本週四舉辦一場專業人脈交流晚宴。

tip: 求職信必背搭配：character reference（品行推薦信/人品擔保人）。另在資訊科技中可指字元（character count）。
sentence: Applicants are required to provide two professional references and one character reference from a former employer.
sentenceZh: 應徵者需提供兩位專業推薦人以及一位來自前雇主的品行證明人。

zh: 特有的；典型的 / 特徵；特色
tip: 片語 be characteristic of 意為「是…的典型特徵」。名詞常與 feature, attribute 做同義詞替換。
sentence: Uncompromising attention to precision engineering is a defining characteristic of our automotive brand.
sentenceZh: 對精密工程毫不妥協的專注追求，是我們汽車品牌的代表性特色。

collocations: characterize the market (描繪市場特徵)
tip: 被動語態考點：be characterized by...（以…為特徵）。閱讀測驗產業分析報告極高頻出現句型！
sentence: The renewable energy market is currently characterized by intense competition and rapid technological innovation.
sentenceZh: 再生能源市場當前的顯著特點是激烈的競爭以及日新月異的技術創新。

collocations: charge an expense to an account (將費用記在某帳戶)
tip: 多益聽力與閱讀常考片語 'in charge of'（負責）以及 'free of charge'（免費）。動詞用法常考 'charge someone an amount for something'。
sentence: The hotel will not charge an additional fee for late check-out if requested in advance.
sentenceZh: 若事先提出申請，飯店不會針對延遲退房加收額外費用。

tip: 在多益 Part 7 圖表題（Graphic Questions）中頻繁出現，常需對照 organizational chart 找出職位隸屬關係或專案負責人。
sentence: According to the updated organizational chart, Ms. Vance now reports directly to the Vice President.
sentenceZh: 根據最新的組織架構圖，范斯女士現在直接向副總裁匯報。

tip: 美式拼法為 check，英式為 cheque。在人事雇用情境中，'conduct a background check'（進行背景調查）為 Part 7 招募公告之高頻考點。
sentence: Before finalizing the job offer, the human resources department will conduct a thorough background check.
sentenceZh: 在敲定錄取通知之前，人力資源部將會進行全面的背景調查。

tip: 易與 chief（首領；長官）混淆。chief 常作形容詞（主要的）或頭銜（如 CEO = Chief Executive Officer），而 chef 指餐飲業的廚師。
sentence: The executive chef revised the seasonal banquet menu to incorporate locally sourced organic produce.
sentenceZh: 行政主廚修改了當季宴會菜單，將在地採購的有機農產品納入其中。

tip: 此為英式拼法，多益聽力英澳音檔常出現此字，請注意發音與 check 相同，但在閱讀題選項中可能保持此英式拼寫。
sentence: Please ensure that the payee's name is spelled correctly before you issue the cheque.
sentenceZh: 在您開立支票之前，請確保受款人姓名拼寫正確無誤。

collocations: have no choice but to (別無選擇只能…)
a wide choice of (多樣的選擇)
tip: 重要句型 'have no choice but to + 原形動詞'（不得不；別無選擇只能做…），在文法題中常考 but 後方接不定詞 to V。
sentence: Due to ongoing supply chain disruptions, we had no choice but to switch to a local supplier.
sentenceZh: 由於供應鏈持續中斷，我們別無選擇，只能轉向與當地的供應商合作。

collocations: choose to do something (選擇做某事)
choose between A and B (在A與B之間做選擇)
tip: 不規則動詞變化：choose - chose - chosen。注意與名詞 choice 的詞性轉換題。
sentence: Clients can choose between express delivery and standard ground shipping at checkout.
sentenceZh: 客戶在結帳時可以選擇快捷快遞或標準陸運。

tip: 常用複數形式 chores，指枯燥繁瑣但必須完成的工作。在多益聽力 Part 1/2 偶爾指家務，在辦公室情境則引申為行政雜項手續。
sentence: Automating data entry has relieved the accounting team of tedious administrative chores.
sentenceZh: 資料輸入的自動化免除了會計團隊繁瑣的行政雜務。

collocations: come full circle (兜了一圈回到原點)
tip: 名詞複數 circles 常用於抽象概念，如 'business/financial circles'（商界／金融界），表示特定專業領域的群體。
sentence: The young entrepreneur has gained considerable respect within local business circles.
sentenceZh: 這位年輕的創業家在當地商界贏得了廣泛的敬重。

collocations: circumspect about the future (對未來持謹慎態度)
tip: 高階多益字彙，同義詞為 cautious, prudent。字根 circum-（周圍）+ spect（看），意即「面面俱到、謹慎小心」。
sentence: The board took a circumspect approach when assessing the cross-border merger proposal.
sentenceZh: 董事會在評估這項跨境併購提案時採取了謹慎周詳的態度。

collocations: due to circumstances beyond our control (由於不可抗力之因素)
tip: 必考倒裝句型：'Under no circumstances + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 本動詞'，表示「在任何情況下絕不…」，主句必須倒裝。
sentence: Under no circumstances should confidential customer data be shared with third parties.
sentenceZh: 在任何情況下，客戶的機密資料絕不可外洩給第三方。

collocations: circumvent security procedures (繞過安全防護程序)
tip: 常考商務法規或資訊安全語境，同義詞為 bypass, avoid。字根 circum-（周圍）+ vent（走），原意為繞道而行。
sentence: The company established a foreign subsidiary to legally circumvent restrictive trade tariffs.
sentenceZh: 該公司設立了海外子公司，以合法規避具限制性的貿易關稅。

collocations: receive a citation (收到傳票／罰單)
citation for excellence (卓越表現表揚狀)
tip: 多益考法有二：一為合約與學術報告中的「引證文獻」；二為工廠安檢稽核時所開立的「違規通知書/罰單」（同 penalty/ticket）。
sentence: The manufacturing plant received a citation from the regulatory agency for failing to maintain ventilation standards.
sentenceZh: 該製造廠因未能達到通風標準而收到了監管機構開立的違規罰單。

tip: 在企業社會責任（CSR）閱讀題材中，常出現 'good corporate citizen'（優良企業公民），指企業重視環保與社會公益。
sentence: By funding the public park restoration, Apex Global demonstrated its dedication to being a responsible corporate citizen.
sentenceZh: 透過資助公立公園的整建，頂峰全球展現了成為負責任企業公民的承諾。

collocations: proof of citizenship (公民身分證明)
tip: 出現在 HR 招募條件時，常考 'proof of citizenship or valid work permit'（國籍證明或有效工作許可證）。
sentence: All candidates invited for the final interview must provide proof of citizenship or permanent residency.
sentenceZh: 所有獲邀參加最終面試的候選人均必須提供公民身分或永久居留權之證明。

tip: 常搭配 city hall（市政廳）、city official（市政官員），多出現在市政規劃、公共工程改建的 Part 7 新聞報導中。
sentence: The city council recently approved the budget for expanding the regional light rail transit network.
sentenceZh: 市議會最近批准了擴建區域輕軌交通網路的預算案。

collocations: civic center (市政／市民活動中心)
tip: 易考複合名詞，如 'civic center'（常作為商展、音樂會或大型企業論壇之舉辦地點）。
sentence: The upcoming annual renewable energy symposium will take place at the downtown civic center.
sentenceZh: 即將登場的年度再生能源研討會將於市中心市民文教中心舉行。

collocations: file an insurance claim (申請保險理賠)
claim to do something (聲稱做某事)
tip: 在旅遊與客服情境中，'baggage claim'（行李提領處）是聽力極高頻字；在保險情境中，'file a claim'（提出理賠）是閱讀常見核心用語。
sentence: Passengers whose luggage was damaged during transit are advised to file an insurance claim immediately.
sentenceZh: 行李在運送途中受損的旅客，建議立即申請保險理賠。

collocations: clarify a point (澄清某個論點)
tip: 名詞為 clarification。多益商業書信中極常見結尾句：'If you need further clarification, please feel free to reach out.'（若需進一步說明，請隨時聯絡）。
sentence: The project manager held a brief conference call to clarify the revised delivery deadlines.
sentenceZh: 專案經理召開了簡短的電話會議，以闡明修正後的交付截止期限。

tip: 在合約閱讀題（Part 7）必考單字。同義詞包含 provision, term, stipulation。通常問題會問某個 clause 規範的具體內容。
sentence: Before signing the agreement, the legal team insisted on modifying the confidentiality clause.
sentenceZh: 在簽署合約之前，法務團隊堅持修改該保密條款。

tip: 動詞用法指「清除」或「使通過審批」（如 'clear customs' 通關）。形容詞則修飾 communication, direction, guideline 等。
sentence: The director provided clear instructions on how to handle client complaints during the seminar.
sentenceZh: 處長在研討會期間針對如何處理客戶投訴給予了明確的指示。

tip: 零售與採購情境中必考 'clearance sale'。而在國際貿易與物流情境中，'customs clearance' 則常指出口或進口時的海關放行程序。
sentence: All excess electronic inventory will be offered at substantial discounts during the end-of-year clearance sale.
sentenceZh: 所有過剩的電子庫存都將在年終清倉大拍賣期間以大幅折扣出售。

tip: 修飾動詞或過去分詞，常考搭配如 'clearly stated in the warranty'（在保固書中明確載明）。
sentence: The employee handbook clearly states that unauthorized overtime will not be compensated.
sentenceZh: 員工手冊中明確規定，未經核准的加班將不予補償。

tip: 發音注意：美式發音為 /klɜːrk/，英式發音常為 /klɑːk/。在 Part 1 圖片題常作為飯店接待人員或收銀人員的代稱。
sentence: The desk clerk handed the conference attendee an informational packet containing the itinerary.
sentenceZh: 櫃檯接待員將一份內含行程表的大會資料袋遞給了與會者。

collocations: retain existing clients (留住既有客戶)
tip: 區分：customer 多指在商店購買一般商品之顧客；client 則專指接受律師、會計師、諮詢顧問等「專業服務」的委託人。
sentence: Our primary objective this quarter is to expand our client base across the Asia-Pacific region.
sentenceZh: 我們本季的主要目標是拓展亞太地區的委託客戶群。

collocations: current business climate (當前商業環境)
tip: 除了指自然天氣氣候外，多益高頻考其比喻義，尤其是 'economic/financial climate'（經濟局勢／投資環境）。
sentence: In the current economic climate, investors are hesitant to back large capital development projects.
sentenceZh: 在當前的經濟形勢下，投資人對資助大型資本開發專案持保留態度。

tip: 在多益商業圖表題中，常用來表示數據上升，等同於 rise, soar, surge, increase。注意 b 不發音。
sentence: Domestic sales figures began to climb steadily following the nationwide marketing campaign.
sentenceZh: 在全國行銷活動展開後，國內銷售數據開始穩步攀升。

collocations: clip a document (將文件夾在一起)
tip: 可作動詞亦可作名詞。名詞 'paper clip'（迴紋針）常出現在 Part 1 辦公室桌面描述題；作動詞時常考 'clip together'。
sentence: Please clip the receipts to the travel reimbursement form before submitting it to finance.
sentenceZh: 在向財務部提交出差報銷單前，請先將收據夾在表格上。

collocations: around the clock (全天候；日以繼夜)
clock in / clock out (打卡上班／打卡下班)
tip: 極常考動詞片語：clock in（上班打卡）、clock out（下班打卡）。亦常考副詞片語 'around the clock'（24小時不間斷）。
sentence: Support technicians worked around the clock to restore the server after the unexpected outage.
sentenceZh: 伺服器意外當機後，支援技術人員日以繼夜地工作以恢復系統運作。

zh: 教練；經濟艙 / v. 指導
tip: 旅遊商務考點：'coach class' 指一般機票的「經濟艙」（= economy class）。HR 管理情境則指對員工一對一的指導與輔導。
sentence: Company travel policy mandates that all employees fly coach for flights under six hours.
sentenceZh: 公司差旅政策規定，飛行時間在六小時以下的航班，全體員工均須搭乘經濟艙。

tip: 行銷與心理學文章偶考，常與 consumer behavior（消費者行為）一同出現，衍生形容詞 cognitive（認知的）更為常見。
sentence: Effective advertising campaigns strive to enhance brand cognition among target consumers.
sentenceZh: 有效的廣告宣傳活動致力於提升目標消費者對品牌的認知度。

tip: 反義詞為 incoherent（語無倫次的）。常修飾 presentation, strategy, proposal，強調邏輯嚴謹、前後一致。
sentence: The marketing director presented a coherent strategy for launching the new software suite globally.
sentenceZh: 行銷總監針對在全球推出新軟體套裝提出了一套條理分明且連貫的策略。

zh: 具凝聚力的；緊密結合的
collocations: cohesive team (具高度凝聚力的團隊)
cohesive corporate culture (具凝聚力的企業文化)
tip: 名詞形式為 cohesion（凝聚力）。多益團隊合作（teamwork）與企業文化考題中極佳的褒義形容詞。
sentence: The recent team-building workshop helped transform the department into a far more cohesive unit.
sentenceZh: 最近舉辦的團隊凝聚工作坊，幫助該部門轉變成一個更具向心力的團隊。

zh: 硬幣 / v. 創造(新詞)
collocations: coin a term (創造一個新名詞)
tip: 作動詞時常考 'coin a phrase / term'，意為「創造新說法／術語」。在 Part 7 關於科技與商業趨勢文章中經常出現此動詞用法。
sentence: The technology analyst is widely credited with having coined the buzzword during his keynote address.
sentenceZh: 這位科技分析師在發表主題演講時創造了這個流行語，因而廣受認可。

collocations: coincidence of events (事件同時發生)
tip: 形容詞為 coincidental（巧合的）。'by coincidence' 等同於 'by chance' 或 'accidentally'。
sentence: By pure coincidence, our regional sales conference scheduled its event at the exact same venue as our competitor.
sentenceZh: 純屬巧合，我們的區域銷售大會與競爭對手排定在同一個場地舉行活動。

collocations: collaborate on a project (在專案上通力合作)
tip: 文法重點：人稱搭配 with（與誰合作），事物搭配 on（在…方面合作）。切勿使用 collaborate to somebody。
sentence: Our engineering department will collaborate closely with external designers to develop the user interface.
sentenceZh: 我們的工程部門將與外部設計師密切合作，共同開發使用者介面。

tip: 片語 'in collaboration with' 為介系詞片語高頻考點，等同於 'in partnership with'。
sentence: The documentary film was produced in collaboration with several international environmental organizations.
sentenceZh: 該紀錄片是與數個國際環保組織攜手合作製作而成的。

collocations: pledge as collateral (質押作為抵押品)
tip: 銀行貸款、金融風控情境核心字。申請企業貸款時常用 'use property as collateral'（用資產作為抵押）。
sentence: The bank required the startup founder to pledge company assets as collateral to secure the expansion loan.
sentenceZh: 銀行要求該新創公司創辦人質押公司資產作為抵押，以取得擴張所需的貸款。

tip: 同義詞為 coworker, associate, peer。多益聽力 Part 3/4 談話背景常設定為兩位 colleagues 之間的業務對話。
sentence: Mr. Dupont was warmly congratulated by his colleagues upon receiving the quarterly sales achievement award.
sentenceZh: 杜邦先生在榮獲季度銷售成就獎時，受到了同事們的熱烈祝賀。

collocations: collect an order (提領訂單貨物)
tip: 英式商務英文常以 'collect an item' 代替 'pick up an item'（取貨）。此外亦常考 'collect overdue payments'（催收逾期款項）。
sentence: Customers will receive an automated text message when their orders are ready to collect from the store.
sentenceZh: 當顧客的訂購商品可至門市提領時，將會收到系統自動發送的簡訊通知。

zh: 值得收藏的 / n. 收藏品
tip: 字尾 -ible 表示「具備…性質的」。名詞化時可作可數名詞，指古董、郵票、限量公仔等收藏物件。
sentence: The vintage mechanical watches featured in the auction are highly prized collectibles.
sentenceZh: 拍賣會上亮相的古董機械錶皆是價值極高的珍貴收藏品。

tip: 在時尚零售業考題中，collection 常指「新一季推出的系列服飾」；在財會題型中，'accounts collection' 則指帳款催收。
sentence: The fashion retailer unveiled its sustainable summer apparel collection at the trade expo.
sentenceZh: 該時尚零售商在商貿博覽會上發表了其永續夏季服飾系列。

tip: 在招募徵才廣告（Job Posting）中常考學歷要求，如 'a college degree in accounting or related field'（會計或相關科系大學學歷）。
sentence: Recruiters visited the local college campus yesterday to scout top talent for the annual summer internship program.
sentenceZh: 招募人員昨天造訪了當地的大學校園，為一年一度的暑期實習計畫挖掘頂尖人才。

tip: 常接介系詞 with。名詞形式為 collision。在航運與物流行程延誤公告中，偶爾提及交通事故引起的阻礙。
sentence: Delivery schedules were disrupted this morning when a cargo truck collided with a safety barrier on the highway.
sentenceZh: 今天早晨因一輛貨車在公路上撞擊安全護欄，導致配送行程受到延宕。

tip: 片語 'in combination with' 常出現在產品宣傳文宣中，強調兩項特質或服務相輔相成。
sentence: The hotel offers a winning combination of affordable luxury and state-of-the-art conference facilities.
sentenceZh: 該飯店兼具平價奢華與最先進會議設施的致勝組合。

collocations: combine A with B (將A與B結合)
tip: 常見動詞搭配 'combine A with B'。在多益中常考整合各部門資源以提高生產效率的敘述。
sentence: By combining our research capabilities with their distribution network, we can dominate the market.
sentenceZh: 透過將我們的研發實力與他們的通路網絡相結合，我們必能稱霸市場。

collocations: come to an agreement (達成協議)
tip: 'First-come, first-served'（依抵達先後順序，額滿為止）是多益活動公告、員工培訓報名必考的成語片語。
sentence: Registration for the leadership seminar is on a first-come, first-served basis due to limited seating.
sentenceZh: 由於座位有限，領導力研討會的報名採先到先得制。

collocations: come across as professional (給人專業的印象)
come across an error (偶然發現錯誤)
come across new findings (偶然碰見新發現)
tip: 片語考點：一為「偶然發現/遇見」（= encounter, run into）；二為「給人某種印象或傳達清楚」（如 He came across well in the interview）。
sentence: While auditing the quarterly ledgers, the accountant came across several minor clerical discrepancies.
sentenceZh: 在稽核季度總帳時，會計師偶然發現了幾處細微的文書出入。

zh: 慰問；安撫 / n. 舒適；安慰
collocations: take comfort in (從…中感到寬慰)
tip: 在航空與飯店業服務說明中，名詞 comfort 經常與 luxury 或 convenience 連用，強調旅客體驗。
sentence: The newly refurbished business class cabins are meticulously engineered to maximize passenger comfort.
sentenceZh: 重新裝潢的商務艙經過精心設計，旨在大幅提升乘客的舒適度。

collocations: feel comfortable with (對…感到安心自在)
tip: 注意副詞為 comfortably。在工作面試中常詢問應試者 'Are you comfortable with domestic travel?'（您能接受國內出差嗎？）。
sentence: Please let the branch manager know if you do not feel comfortable handling large cash transactions.
sentenceZh: 若您對於經手大筆現金交易感到不太自在，請讓分行經理知道。

tip: 現在分詞轉形容詞，修飾事物；修飾人的情緒感受則使用 comforted（感到寬慰的）。
sentence: It was comforting to hear that the projected budget shortfall had been resolved before the deadline.
sentenceZh: 聽到預期預算不足的問題已在截止日前獲得解決，著實令人寬慰。

zh: 命令；博得；精通 / n. 掌控；指令
collocations: command high prices (開出高價／享有高價)
have an excellent command of English (精通英語)
tip: 在 HR 職缺要求中，'have a good/excellent command of a language'（精通某種語言）是極高頻的滿分句型。
sentence: Candidates applying for the regional director position must demonstrate an excellent command of written and spoken French.
sentenceZh: 應徵區域總監職位的候選人必須展現出優異的法語聽說讀寫能力。

zh: 評論；意見 / v. 發表意見
collocations: comment on something (對某事發表評論)
decline to comment (拒絕發表評論)
tip: 作動詞時為不及物動詞，必須搭配介系詞 on（comment on...）。公關發言人常說 'declined to comment'（不予置評）。
sentence: The corporate spokesperson declined to comment on rumors concerning the upcoming management shake-up.
sentenceZh: 公司發言人拒絕對有關即將進行的管理層人事變動的傳聞發表評論。

zh: 評論；現場解說；實況報導
tip: 與 comment（單條意見/評語）不同，commentary 指「連續性的解說、系統性的專業評論分析」或語音導覽的語音介紹。
sentence: The financial analyst offered insightful commentary on the impact of changing interest rates during the interview.
sentenceZh: 金融分析師在受訪時針對利率調整帶來的影響提供了深入精闢的評析。

tip: 'Chamber of Commerce'（商會）常出現在 Part 7 商務研討會贊助商或主辦單位名冊中，為核心專有名詞。
sentence: The local Chamber of Commerce will host an annual networking dinner for small enterprise owners next Friday.
sentenceZh: 當地商會將於下週五為小型企業主舉辦年度聯誼晚宴。

zh: 商業的 / n. 電視或廣播廣告
tip: 作名詞時，commercial 特指電視或廣播的廣告短片；紙媒或網路上的平面廣告則多稱 advertisement/ad。
sentence: The marketing agency produced a 30-second television commercial to announce the product redesign.
sentenceZh: 該行銷代理商製作了一支30秒的電視廣告，以宣傳產品的改版新造型。

zh: 佣金；委員會 / v. 委任；委託製作
collocations: work on commission (按業績抽成工作)
commission a study (委託進行一項研究)
tip: 在薪資結構考題中，常見 'base salary plus commission'（底薪加抽成）。作動詞時常考委託藝術家、顧問機構製作某作品或研究。
sentence: Real estate agents earn a substantial commission on each luxury residential property they sell.
sentenceZh: 房地產經紀人每售出一棟豪華住宅物業，即可獲得一筆可觀的佣金。

collocations: commit resources to (將資源投入於)
commit oneself to doing (致力於做某事)
tip: 片語考點：'commit oneself to + V-ing/N'（致力於…），此處 to 為介系詞，後面必須接名詞或動名詞。
sentence: The board has decided to commit additional financial resources to upgrading our cybersecurity infrastructure.
sentenceZh: 董事會已決定投入額外財務資源，以升級我們的網路資訊安全基礎設施。

collocations: demonstrate a commitment to (展現對…的投入承諾)
make a long-term commitment (做出長期承諾)
prior commitments (既有行程／先前的約定)
tip: 社交與差旅信件中常考：'Due to a prior commitment, I will be unable to attend...'（由於先前已有安排，我無法出席…）。
sentence: Apex Energy has repeatedly demonstrated its commitment to reducing carbon emissions across all operations.
sentenceZh: 頂峰能源多次展現其在全營運環節減少碳排放的堅定承諾。

collocations: be committed to doing something (致力於做某事)
tip: 文法陷阱大熱門：'be committed to + N/V-ing'，to 是介系詞，後方絕不可接原形動詞！同義片語為 dedicated to, devoted to。
sentence: Our customer support team is firmly committed to resolving all client grievances within twenty-four hours.
sentenceZh: 我們的客戶支援團隊堅定致力於在24小時內解決所有客戶的申訴問題。

collocations: valuable commodity (有價值的資源／商品)
tip: 通常指石油、穀物、貴金屬等未經加工的大宗物資；在一般語境中也可引申指非常寶貴的日常必備事物（如 Time is a valuable commodity）。
sentence: Fluctuations in the global price of crude oil directly impacted shipping charges across commodity markets.
sentenceZh: 全球原油價格的波動直接影響了大宗商品市場的航運費用。

collocations: have something in common (有共同之處)
tip: 'It is common practice for someone to do something'（某人做某事是常見慣例）為多益閱讀常見描述商業習慣的句型。
sentence: It is common practice within the consulting industry to conduct preliminary interviews via videoconference.
sentenceZh: 在顧問產業中，透過視訊會議進行初步面試是極為普遍的慣例。

tip: 複數 communications 常指「通訊系統」或公關傳訊部門（Communications Department）。作溝通行為時多為不可數名詞。
sentence: Effective internal communication is essential for maintaining high staff morale during organizational transitions.
sentenceZh: 在組織轉型期間，有效的內部溝通對於維持高昂的員工士氣至關重要。

zh: 通勤 / n. 通勤路程
tip: 常考搭配介系詞：commute to work / commute from home to the office。名詞通常修飾路程，如 'a 30-minute commute'。
sentence: Many office employees prefer working remotely because it eliminates the daily commute during peak traffic hours.
sentenceZh: 許多辦公室員工偏好遠距工作，因為這免去了尖峰塞車時段的每日通勤之苦。

tip: 在市政交通、地鐵公車延誤通告中極常見，如 'commuter train'（通勤列車）或向 commuters 致歉延誤。
sentence: The municipal transit agency issued an alert warning commuters of unexpected rail delays on the blue line.
sentenceZh: 市府大眾捷運局發出警報，提醒通勤族藍線鐵路發生非預期的班次延誤。

collocations: in the company of (在…的陪同下)
tip: 除了指商業公司外，當不可數名詞時指「陪伴」，如 'enjoy one's company'。形容人際情境考點多注意此不可數用法。
sentence: The European telecommunications giant recently acquired a small software startup as its subsidiary company.
sentenceZh: 這家電信巨擘最近收購了一家小型軟體新創公司作為其子公司。

tip: 副詞修飾形容詞，同義詞為 relatively。常在財務報告中比較本期與上期的營運成本或利潤。
sentence: Thanks to our strategic supplier contracts, our manufacturing costs remained comparatively low this quarter.
sentenceZh: 得益於我們的策略性供應商合約，我們本季的製造成本相對維持在較低水準。

collocations: compare A with/to B (將A與B比較)
tip: 文法分詞片語超常考：'Compared with/to last year, sales have doubled.'（與去年相比，銷售量翻了一番）。
sentence: When you compare this software suite to its competitors, its intuitive dashboard clearly stands out.
sentenceZh: 當你將這套軟體套裝與競爭對手相比時，其直覺的操作面板顯得格外突出。

tip: 介系詞片語 'in comparison with/to' 在 Part 5 介系詞考題經常出現，意思等同於 compared with。
sentence: In comparison with the previous fiscal cycle, marketing expenditures decreased by nearly fifteen percent.
sentenceZh: 與前一個會計週期相比，行銷支出減少了近百分之十五。

tip: 固定介系詞搭配：be compatible with。在辦公室 IT 系統升級公告中，常檢測現有硬體或舊軟體是否與新系統相容。
sentence: The IT department verified that the newly installed accounting software is fully compatible with our database.
sentenceZh: 資訊部門已證實，新安裝的會計軟體與我們的資料庫完全相容。

collocations: compel someone to do something (強迫某人做某事)
tip: 句型為 compel + O + to V；其現在分詞轉形容詞 compelling 亦極常考，意為「極具說服力的；令人著迷的」（如 compelling reason）。
sentence: Rising utility and material overhead compelled the factory management to raise wholesale product prices.
sentenceZh: 水電與原料間接成本的上升，迫使工廠管理層調高了產品批發價。

collocations: compensate someone for something (為某事賠償某人)
tip: 及物用法表示支付酬勞給某人；不及物用法常接 for，即 'compensate for'（彌補…的損失或缺陷）。
sentence: The airline promised to compensate affected travelers for expenses incurred due to the overnight delay.
sentenceZh: 航空公司承諾將補償受影響旅客因隔夜延誤而產生的額外開銷。

tip: 在多益招募文章中，'compensation' 通常涵蓋薪水、獎金與津貼，常與 benefits（保險、年假等福利）合稱為 'compensation and benefits'。
sentence: The executive search committee offered a highly competitive compensation package to attract the prospective CEO.
sentenceZh: 高階主管遴選委員會開出了極具競爭力的整體薪酬方案，以吸引有潛力的執行長人選。

collocations: compete for market share (爭奪市場份額)
compete in the global market (在國際市場上競爭)
tip: 常考介系詞：與誰競爭用 compete with/against；為了爭奪何物用 compete for。
sentence: Domestic producers must innovate continually if they wish to compete effectively against imported goods.
sentenceZh: 國內製造商若想有效與進口商品競爭，就必須不斷進行創新。

tip: 名詞形式為 competence（能力；勝任力）。常出現在求職推薦信（Recommendation Letter）中讚揚候選人的專業實力。
sentence: The supervisor praised Ms. Garcia as a highly competent analyst who consistently exceeds expectations.
sentenceZh: 主管稱讚加西亞女士是一位極有能力的分析師，工作表現始終超越預期。

collocations: face stiff competition (面臨嚴峻的競爭)
tip: 不可數時指「競爭抽象概念」；也可作為集合名詞表示「競爭同業／對手」（如 'The competition is lowering prices'）。
sentence: Due to fierce competition in the smartphone sector, profit margins have narrowed significantly.
sentenceZh: 由於智慧型手機領域的激烈競爭，利潤率已大幅縮水。

zh: 競爭激烈的；具競爭優勢的
tip: 商務廣告高頻搭配：'competitive pricing'（物美價廉的價格）；人事徵才高頻搭配：'competitive salary'（優渥且具市場競爭力的薪資）。
sentence: Offering flexible work arrangements gives our firm a distinct competitive edge in recruiting top software developers.
sentenceZh: 提供彈性的工作安排，使我們公司在招募頂尖軟體開發人員時具備顯著的競爭優勢。

tip: 指具體的人或競爭公司，為可數名詞。常考同義字 rival。
sentence: To remain ahead of our closest competitor, we plan to accelerate our research and development timeline.
sentenceZh: 為了保持領先我們的主要競爭對手，我們計畫加速研發時程。

collocations: complain of a delay (投訴延誤問題)
complain to management (向管理層投訴)
tip: 不及物動詞，投訴某事必加 about 或 of；向某人投訴必加 to。切勿直接接受詞 complain something。
sentence: Several guests complained about the air conditioning system not functioning properly in the conference hall.
sentenceZh: 數名與會貴賓抱怨會議廳的空調系統無法正常運作。

collocations: file / lodge a complaint (提出投訴)
handle client complaints (處理客戶投訴)
tip: 動詞與名詞的辨析是 Part 5 文法題最愛考的陷阱之一。注意 complaint 是可數名詞（a complaint / complaints）。搭配動詞必記 lodge/file。
sentence: The hotel receptionist assisted the dissatisfied traveler in filing an official written complaint.
sentenceZh: 飯店接待人員協助這位不滿的旅客填寫正式的書面申訴表。

zh: 完成；填寫 / a. 完整的；完全的
collocations: complete a questionnaire / form (填寫問卷／表格)
tip: 作動詞時常考 'complete a form'（填妥表格，= fill out）。作形容詞時常修飾 set, overhaul, renovation，指全面、整套的。
sentence: Please complete the attached registration form and return it to the coordinator by Friday afternoon.
sentenceZh: 請填妥隨附的報名表格，並在週五下午前將其回傳給協調專員。

tip: 高頻固定句型：'upon/on completion of + N'（在某事完成之後立即…），在專案進度追蹤信件中極其常見。
sentence: Upon completion of the safety inspection, the factory supervisor will issue an official operating permit.
sentenceZh: 在安全檢查完成後，工廠主管將會簽發正式的營運許可證。

zh: 複雜的 / n. 綜合設施；園區
collocations: sports/office complex (體育園區／辦公綜合大樓)
tip: 形容詞等同於 complicated；名詞常考 'office complex'（辦公大樓群）或 'apartment complex'（公寓住宅社區）。
sentence: The logistics multinational recently opened a distribution center inside the new port industrial complex.
sentenceZh: 這家跨國物流公司最近在新建的港口工業園區內開設了一座物流中心。

collocations: fully compliant with (完全符合…法規的)
compliant with safety standards (符合安全標準)
tip: 文法重點：'be compliant with + regulations/standards'，固定搭配 with。形容詞字尾 -iant 表具備該狀態。
sentence: All production equipment must be inspected biannually to ensure it is compliant with national emissions laws.
sentenceZh: 所有生產設備必須每半年檢查一次，以確保完全符合國家排碳法規。

collocations: complicate the process (使程序變得複雜)
tip: 多益常考其被動語態或分詞形式 complicated。主動用法常帶有負面干擾意味。
sentence: The unexpected resignation of our lead software architect will severely complicate the product launch.
sentenceZh: 我們首席軟體架構師的意外辭職，將使這項產品的上市計畫嚴重複雜化。

tip: 同義詞為 complex, intricate。常形容手續繁瑣（procedures）或系統介面不易使用。
sentence: Customers expressed frustration over the complicated rebate application procedures on the website.
sentenceZh: 顧客對於網站上繁瑣的退款申請流程表示感到沮喪。

zh: 讚美；敬意 / v. 稱讚
collocations: compliments of someone (由某人免費贈送)
pay someone a compliment (讚美某人)
tip: 極常考易混淆字：compliment（讚美；禮物）vs complement（補充；互補物）。片語 'compliments of...' 常指店家招待免費提供！
sentence: Guests staying in executive suites receive a complimentary bottle of sparkling wine, compliments of the manager.
sentenceZh: 入住行政套房的貴賓可獲贈一瓶氣泡酒，此為經理個人致贈的免費招待。

collocations: comply with safety standards (遵循安全標準)
tip: 多益文法必殺考點：不及物動詞，百分之百接 with！'comply with' = 'conform to' = 'abide by' = 'adhere to'。
sentence: All contractors are strictly required to comply with workplace occupational health and safety guidelines.
sentenceZh: 所有承包商均被嚴格要求遵守工作場所的職業安全與健康準則。

collocations: key component (關鍵要素／主要零件)
tip: 工廠製造情境必背詞，同義詞為 part, module。在商業企劃中亦可指抽象概念的「要素」。
sentence: The assembly line was temporarily halted because a shipment of critical microchip components was delayed.
sentenceZh: 由於一批關鍵的晶片零件貨品延誤，裝配線被迫暫時停工。

collocations: compose an email / a memo (撰寫電子郵件／備忘錄)
tip: 重要被動文法：'be composed of' 等同於 'consist of' 或 'be made up of'（由…組成）。在辦公情境指撰寫信件稿件。
sentence: The newly established advisory committee is composed of six industry veterans and two academic scholars.
sentenceZh: 新成立的諮詢委員會由六位業界資深人士與兩位學者組成。

tip: 在多益人力資源或製造業檢驗報告中，常指「組成結構」或材料的「配方成分」。
sentence: The annual corporate report detailed significant changes in the demographic composition of our executive leadership.
sentenceZh: 年度公司報告詳細說明了我們高階領導層人口結構組成的重大轉變。

collocations: keep / maintain one's composure (保持鎮定)
lose one's composure (失去冷靜；慌亂)
tip: 在危機處理、客戶投訴溝通或公關發言情境中常考搭配動詞 maintain 或 regain。
sentence: Despite being confronted with harsh criticism from shareholders, the CEO maintained her composure throughout the meeting.
sentenceZh: 儘管面臨股東嚴厲的批評，執行長在整個會議期間依然保持從容鎮定。

collocations: comprehend the gravity (意識到事情的嚴重性)
tip: 名詞形式為 comprehension。常考副詞搭配 'fully comprehend'（全面理解），通常用於複雜條款、操作手冊的理解。
sentence: Employees should read the policy carefully to fully comprehend the implications of the new confidentiality agreement.
sentenceZh: 員工應仔細閱讀政策，以充分理解新保密協議所涉及的權利義務。

collocations: comprehensive guide / manual (詳盡的指南／手冊)
tip: 多益 Part 5 極高頻必考形容詞！易與 comprehensible（可理解的）混淆。comprehensive 意為 inclusive, thorough（全面的、詳盡的）。
sentence: The marketing firm provided a comprehensive analysis of emerging consumer habits in the retail market.
sentenceZh: 該行銷公司提供了針對零售市場新興消費者習慣的全面詳盡分析。

collocations: comprise several modules (包含數個模組)
comprise over 50 percent (佔了百分之五十以上)
tip: 主動語態可直接接受詞：'The committee comprises ten members'；亦常見被動語態 'is comprised of'（文法等同于 is composed of）。
sentence: The new training curriculum comprises six interactive instructional modules designed for entry-level sales reps.
sentenceZh: 這套新培訓課程包含六個為初階業務代表設計的互動式教學模組。

zh: 妥協；折衷；危及 / n. 妥協
collocations: acceptable compromise (可接受的折衷方案)
tip: 雙重考法：作名詞常考 'reach a compromise'（達成妥協）；作動詞時除了妥協外，極常考「危及；損害」（= undermine/jeopardize），如 compromise data security。
sentence: After hours of intense negotiation, both parties finally reached a compromise regarding patent licensing fees.
sentenceZh: 經過數小時的激烈談判，雙方最終就專利授權費用達成了折衷協議。

collocations: compute the total cost (計算總成本)
tip: 多益財會或資訊情境字，同義詞為 calculate。其名詞為 computation，形容詞為 computational。
sentence: The payroll system automatically computes monthly overtime bonuses based on logged timesheet hours.
sentenceZh: 薪資系統會根據工時表上記錄的時數，自動核算每月的加班津貼。

tip: 反義詞為 reveal, disclose。在商業法規、道德合規（ethics）題目中，常考 'conceal defects'（隱瞞瑕疵）。
sentence: The supplier was heavily penalized for attempting to conceal structural defects in the delivered machinery.
sentenceZh: 該供應商因企圖隱匿所交付機械設備中的結構性瑕疵而遭到重罰。

collocations: conceive an idea / a plan (構想出點子／計畫)
conceive of a solution (設想出解決方案)
tip: 名詞形式為 concept（概念）或 conception。在產品開發或行銷宣傳情境中，常形容新創意的孕育誕生。
sentence: The award-winning advertising campaign was originally conceived by a junior graphic designer.
sentenceZh: 這個獲獎的廣告行銷宣傳企劃，最初是由一名初階平面設計師所構想出來的。

collocations: concentrate on doing something (專注於做某事)
tip: 文法重點：必搭配介系詞 on！'concentrate on' 等同於 'focus on'。名詞為 concentration。
sentence: By outsourcing routine payroll tasks, human resources staff can concentrate on talent development initiatives.
sentenceZh: 透過外包例行性的計薪作業，人力資源部人員便能專注於人才培育計畫。

tip: 高科技與研發題型中常考 'proof of concept'（概念驗證，縮寫 PoC），確認新技術可行性。
sentence: The engineering team presented a fascinating proof of concept for the solar-powered delivery drone.
sentenceZh: 工程團隊針對太陽能物流無人機展示了一項令人驚艷的概念驗證成果。

zh: 涉及；使擔憂 / n. 擔憂；關心的事
collocations: voice concerns about (表達對…的擔憂)
be of concern to (為…所關切)
tip: 搭配動詞考點：'express/voice/raise concerns'（表達擔憂）。形容詞常考 'concerned about'（對…感到擔憂）。
sentence: Several factory workers voiced concerns regarding the insufficient ventilation system in the chemical storage room.
sentenceZh: 幾位工廠作業員對化學品儲藏室內通風設備不足一事表達了疑慮。

collocations: inquiries concerning the order (有關該訂單的詢問)
regulations concerning safety (關於安全的規定)
feedback concerning the software (關於軟體的反饋)
tip: 詞性陷阱題！concerning 在多益是「介系詞」，等同於 about, regarding, respecting。後方直接接名詞！
sentence: If you have any further questions concerning the updated travel reimbursement guidelines, please consult accounting.
sentenceZh: 若您對更新後的差旅報銷準則有任何疑問，請洽詢會計部。

collocations: conclude with a Q&A session (以問答環節作結)
tip: 有雙重重要考法：一為「結束」（會議、簡報等），常搭配 with；二為商務合約的「正式締結；敲定」（= finalize a contract）。
sentence: Dr. Aris concluded her keynote presentation with an interactive question-and-answer session.
sentenceZh: 阿里斯博士以一場互動式的問答環節結束了她的主題演講。

collocations: bring to a conclusion (使圓滿結束)
tip: 在演講與書信中常作為轉折語 'In conclusion,...'；在決策討論中常考 'reach / arrive at a conclusion'。
sentence: After reviewing the trial data, the investigative panel arrived at the conclusion that the device was safe.
sentenceZh: 在審視臨床試驗數據後，調查小組得出了該設備安全無虞的結論。

zh: 具體的；實質的 / n. 混凝土
tip: 反義字為 abstract（抽象的）。多益商業提案文章中常強調需要 'concrete plans/measures'（具體可行的計畫／措施）。
sentence: The consulting firm urged our executive committee to adopt concrete measures to curb operational expenses.
sentenceZh: 該顧問公司督促我們的執行委員會採取具體措施，以抑制營運支出。

collocations: concur with someone (贊同某人的觀點)
tip: 正式商業用字，同義於 agree。接人或意見用 with（concur with），接名詞子句接 that。注意字尾重複 r 加 ed（concurred）。
sentence: All members of the audit committee fully concurred with the recommendations outlined in the financial report.
sentenceZh: 審計委員會的全體成員完全贊同財務報告中所列出的各項建議。

zh: 條件；狀況；氣候/工作環境
collocations: in pristine / excellent condition (處於完好／極佳的狀態)
tip: 合約必背片語：'terms and conditions'（條款與約定細則）。描述物品或二手車況時常考 'in good condition'。
sentence: Please review the terms and conditions carefully before activating your monthly software subscription.
sentenceZh: 在啟用每月軟體訂閱服務之前，請仔細審閱各項條款與約定細則。

collocations: conduct a survey (進行問卷調查)
tip: 多益 Part 5 超高頻及物動詞！常考搭配的名詞受詞：survey, inquiry, inspection, research, interview, study。
sentence: The quality assurance team will conduct a thorough inspection of the manufacturing plant next Monday.
sentenceZh: 品保團隊將於下週一對製造工廠進行全面的實地檢查。

collocations: conference room / hall (會議室／大會廳)
tip: 與 meeting 相比，conference 規模通常較大且正式，常維持數天。考題常涉及報名（register for）、議程（schedule）及場地安排。
sentence: Keynote speakers from around the world have been invited to address the annual technology conference.
sentenceZh: 來自世界各地的主題演講貴賓已獲邀在年度科技研討會上發表演說。

collocations: confuse A with B (把A與B混淆)
confuse the customer (使顧客感到困惑)
tip: 情緒動詞用法：confusing（令人困惑的，修飾事物說明或介面），confused（感到困惑的，修飾人）。
sentence: The ambiguous phrasing on the return policy leaflet served only to confuse retail shoppers.
sentenceZh: 退換貨政策傳單上模稜兩可的措辭只會讓零售門市的顧客感到困惑。

collocations: in order to prevent confusion (為了防止混淆)
tip: 常考商務公告的目的子句：'To avoid any potential confusion, please note that...'（為避免造成混淆，請注意…）。
sentence: Clear signage was posted throughout the convention center to avoid any confusion among participants.
sentenceZh: 整個會議中心張貼了清晰的指示標誌，以避免與會者產生任何混淆。

tip: 多益常考複合形容詞！例如 'cost-conscious consumers'（具成本意識／精打細算的消費者）、'environmentally conscious'（重視環保的）。
sentence: Cost-conscious managers are continually seeking creative ways to trim unnecessary travel expenses.
sentenceZh: 具成本意識的經理人不斷尋求創新的方法來縮減不必要的出差開銷。

collocations: consciously make an effort (有意識地做出努力)
tip: 副詞修飾動詞，表示深思熟慮後、刻意自覺地做出的行為（deliberately）。
sentence: The design team consciously chose recyclable packaging materials to appeal to eco-friendly buyers.
sentenceZh: 設計團隊有意識地選擇可回收的包裝材料，以吸引注重環保的買家。

collocations: raise environmental consciousness (提升環保意識)
tip: 在企業行銷或企業社會責任文章中，常與 raise/increase 連用，指「喚起群眾對某議題的公眾意識」。
sentence: The public relations campaign aimed to raise public consciousness regarding renewable energy alternatives.
sentenceZh: 該公關宣傳活動旨在提高大眾對替代性再生能源的意識。

collocations: for three consecutive years (連續三年)
consecutive quarters of growth (連續數季成長)
tip: 多益 Part 5/7 超高頻副詞與形容詞出題點！'for the third consecutive month/quarter'（連續第三個月／季）。同義字為 successive。
sentence: The regional distributor reported record earnings for the fourth consecutive fiscal quarter.
sentenceZh: 該區域經銷商公布其財報連續第四個會計季度創下獲利新高。

tip: 轉折副詞考點，等同於 therefore, as a result。在 Part 6 句子插入題或上下文邏輯填空題中極為常見。
sentence: Severe winter blizzards shut down regional airports; consequently, many conference attendees arrived late.
sentenceZh: 嚴重的冬季暴風雪迫使區域機場關閉；因此，許多與會者都遲到了。

zh: 保守的；穩健的 / n. 保守派人士
collocations: conservative investment approach (穩健保守的投資方式)
tip: 商務預算編列必考搭配：'conservative estimate'（保守估計），指不誇大、謹慎評估數字。
sentence: According to a conservative estimate, adopting automated billing will save the agency ten thousand dollars annually.
sentenceZh: 根據保守估計，採用自動計費系統每年將為該機構省下一萬美元。

tip: 與 preserve 辨析：conserve 著重於「節約、有節制地使用有限資源」；preserve 著重於「維護原貌免於損壞或消失」。
sentence: Employees are kindly reminded to turn off office workstations at night to help conserve electricity.
sentenceZh: 請員工在夜間隨手關閉辦公室工作站電源，以協助節約用電。

collocations: consider someone for a position (考慮拔擢某人擔任某職務)
tip: 文法重點大魔王：consider 後方若接動詞，必須使用「動名詞 V-ing」，絕不可接 to V！(e.g., consider relocating)。
sentence: The telecommunications firm is seriously considering relocating its headquarters to an overseas hub.
sentenceZh: 該電信公司正認真考慮將其總部遷移至海外營運中心。

collocations: for a small consideration (換取少量報酬)
tip: 片語 'take something into consideration'（將某事納入考量）在決策聽力與閱讀中幾乎必出。合約法中 consideration 亦可指「對價／酬金」。
sentence: The hiring panel will take previous overseas leadership experience into active consideration during evaluation.
sentenceZh: 招募遴選委員會在評估時，會將過往的海外領導經驗積極列入考量。

collocations: considering the circumstances (考慮到當前情況)
well done considering (就情況而論表現不錯)
tip: 可作介系詞（後接名詞）或連接詞（接 that 子句），意思等同於 'in view of' 或 'given'。
sentence: Considering the prevailing economic uncertainties, the firm’s third-quarter revenue growth was remarkably strong.
sentenceZh: 考慮到普遍存在的經濟不確定性，該公司第三季度的營收增長可說是相當強勁。

collocations: largely consist of (大部分由…構成)
tip: 必考文法陷阱：'consist of' 是不及物動詞，【絕無被動語態】！不可寫作 is consisted of，必須寫為 consists of（= is composed of）。
sentence: The newly assembled task force consists of ten seasoned specialists from diverse business units.
sentenceZh: 新組成的專案小組由十位來自不同業務部門的資深專家組成。

collocations: consistency in quality (品質的一致性)
tip: 品管（Quality Control）情境常考字，強調生產製造或客服標準必須維持 consistency（始終如一的標準）。
sentence: Maintaining strict consistency in brand messaging across all digital media platforms is our top marketing goal.
sentenceZh: 在所有數位媒體平台上保持品牌宣傳訊息的高度一致性，是我們的首要行銷目標。

tip: 介系詞搭配：'be consistent with'（與…一致／吻合）。反義字為 inconsistent。
sentence: The auditor verified that our accounting practices are entirely consistent with international financial standards.
sentenceZh: 稽核員證實我們的會計作業完全符合國際財務報告準則。

collocations: consistently rank first (始終高居第一)
consistently exceed targets (持續超越目標)
tip: 多益 Part 5 超高頻正確答案副詞！常用來修飾 high quality, outperform, deliver, exceed，強調長期穩定的卓越表現。
sentence: The customer care team has consistently delivered outstanding service ratings throughout the past fiscal year.
sentenceZh: 客戶關懷團隊在過去的整個會計年度中，始終維持著優異的服務滿意度評分。

collocations: constant stream of visitors (絡繹不絕的訪客)
tip: 與 continuous 類似，但更偏重於「無休止的、恆久不變的」。名詞形式亦可指常數。
sentence: Project success depends on constant communication between site engineers and off-site project managers.
sentenceZh: 專案的成功取決於現場工程師與辦公室專案經理之間不間斷的良好溝通。

collocations: feel constrained to (感到受約束不得不)
be constrained by budget (受預算限制)
tip: 常以被動語態出現：'be constrained by'（受到…的限制或約束），同義詞為 restrict, limit。
sentence: Research and development initiatives were severely constrained by the recent corporate budget reductions.
sentenceZh: 研發計畫受到近來公司預算縮減的嚴重限制。

collocations: financial constraints (財務拮据／資金約束)
tip: 多益聽力 Part 3/4 及閱讀中極高頻出現的片語：'budget constraints'（預算限制）與 'time constraints'（時間緊迫）。
sentence: Due to strict budget constraints, the marketing division had to cancel its scheduled televised promotional series.
sentenceZh: 由於嚴格的預算限制，行銷部門不得不取消原定的電視系列促銷活動。

tip: 介系詞必考：'under construction'（施工中）。在交通改道、新辦公大樓落成的題材中是不可或缺的字眼。
sentence: The main highway exit will remain closed while the overpass undergoes extensive construction work.
sentenceZh: 在陸橋進行大規模施工期間，主要高速公路出口將持續保持封閉。

tip: 辨析：consultant 指「顧問個人」（可數人稱名詞），而 consultancy 指「顧問諮詢公司」或「諮詢業務本身」。
sentence: The logistics corporation engaged an international management consultancy to optimize its warehousing network.
sentenceZh: 該物流企業聘請了一家國際管理顧問公司，以優化其倉儲網絡。

tip: 人稱名詞考點。動詞為 consult（諮詢；查閱，注意 consult someone 不加 with；但與某人商量可用 consult with someone）。
sentence: The firm retained an outside environmental consultant to assess the ecological impact of the expansion.
sentenceZh: 該公司聘請了一位外部環境顧問，以評估擴建工程對生態所造成的影響。

tip: 除了指吃喝之外，商務上指對電力、燃料或時間、資金的消耗。衍生名詞有 consumer（消費者）與 consumption（消耗量）。
sentence: The modern server architecture is engineered to consume up to thirty percent less electric power.
sentenceZh: 現代化的伺服器架構經過精心設計，能減少多達百分之三十的電能消耗。

tip: 財經新聞常考指標：'consumer confidence index'（消費者信心指數）；客訴保護法規為 'consumer protection act'。
sentence: Surveys indicate that consumer confidence has rebounded following consecutive months of stable employment growth.
sentenceZh: 調查顯示，隨著就業連續數月維持穩定增長，消費者信心指數已呈現回升。

tip: 常考複合名詞，如 'fuel consumption'（油耗）。在倡導綠色辦公室的文章中，常提及降低紙張或電能的 consumption。
sentence: Upgrading to energy-efficient LED light fixtures drastically reduced our office power consumption.
sentenceZh: 升級至節能的LED燈具大幅降低了我們辦公室的電力消耗量。

zh: 聯絡；人脈 / v. 聯絡
tip: 動詞用法：及物動詞，直接接人（'contact us'），切勿多加 with！名詞用法常考 'point of contact'（業務聯絡窗口）。
sentence: Please do not hesitate to contact our technical department if you experience connectivity interruptions.
sentenceZh: 若您遇到連線中斷問題，請隨時與我們的技術部門聯絡。

collocations: contain confidential information (包含機密資訊)
contain the damage (控制損害擴大)
tip: 常考雙重含意：一為「包含；內含」（信件、包裹內）；二為商業營運上的「抑制；控制」（= keep under control），如 contain expenses。
sentence: Management has introduced stringent operating protocols in an effort to contain rising overhead expenditures.
sentenceZh: 管理層推出了嚴格的作業規範，以努力抑制不斷攀升的經常性開銷。

zh: 當代的；同時代的 / n. 同時代的人
tip: 同義詞為 modern, current。常用於形容建築設計風格、辦公環境規劃或當代商業管理趨勢。
sentence: The newly remodeled corporate headquarters blends classic architecture with modern, contemporary design.
sentenceZh: 重新整修後的公司總部將古典建築風格與新穎的當代設計完美融為一體。

zh: 內容；滿意 / a. 滿足的
tip: 發音與詞性考點：名詞 content 重音在第一音節；形容詞 content 重音在第二音節，接介系詞 with（be content with = satisfied with）。
sentence: Please refer to the table of contents at the beginning of the training manual for chapter listings.
sentenceZh: 請參閱培訓手冊開頭處的目錄，以查看各章節清單。

zh: 比賽；競賽 / v. 爭奪；對…質疑
collocations: contest a decision (對決定提出異議)
tip: 名詞常出現在宣傳促銷活動，如抽獎或標語徵選。作動詞時重音移至第二音節，意為「爭辯、質疑決定」（如 contest a fine 質疑罰鍰）。
sentence: Submissions for the annual corporate photography contest must be uploaded by midnight tomorrow.
sentenceZh: 年度企業攝影大賽的參賽作品必須在明天午夜之前完成上傳。

zh: 語境；上下文；背景背景環境
collocations: in the context of (在…的背景下)
tip: 常用介系詞片語 'in the context of'，多益閱讀文意理解題中常考根據 context 判斷某單字在文章中的確切意涵。
sentence: The CEO stated that the restructuring plan must be viewed in the context of recent market deregulation.
sentenceZh: 執行長表示，必須在近期市場法規鬆綁的背景脈絡下來審視此項重組計畫。

collocations: continue to do / doing (繼續做某事)
continue as planned (按原定計畫繼續)
tip: continue 後方接不定詞（to V）或動名詞（V-ing）皆可，意思大致相同。反義字為 discontinue（中止；停產）。
sentence: Despite supply disruptions, the manufacturing line will continue to operate at near-peak capacity.
sentenceZh: 儘管供應出現中斷，製造裝配線仍將繼續以接近峰值的產能維持運轉。

collocations: business continuity plan (業務持續運作計畫)
continuity of service (服務的延續性)
tip: 危機管理高頻名詞片語：'business continuity plan'（業務持續營運計畫，BCP），指遇到災害時維持業務運作的預案。
sentence: The primary objective of the disaster recovery drill is to guarantee business continuity during a crisis.
sentenceZh: 災難復原演練的首要目標，是確保在危機期間各項業務能夠持續不中斷運作。

tip: 精實生產與企業管理極高頻片語：'continuous improvement'（持續改善流程）。辨析：continual 是斷斷續續頻繁發生，continuous 則是中間無停歇的連續。
sentence: Our manufacturing division is dedicated to continuous improvement through regular quality feedback loops.
sentenceZh: 我們的製造部門致力於透過定期的品質反饋機制來實現持續改善。

zh: 合約；契約 / v. 簽約；收縮
tip: 合約情境大考點：'award a contract to...'（將合約批給…）、'breach of contract'（違約）。動詞除了簽約外，亦可指「收縮、萎縮」（The market contracted）。
sentence: The municipal authority officially awarded the subway tunnel construction contract to a local engineering consortium.
sentenceZh: 市府當局正式將地鐵隧道興建合約授予了當地的工程財團聯盟。

tip: 人稱名詞。在工程裝修或委外專案中經常出現；人事上 'independent contractor' 指無勞雇從屬關係的自雇外包者。
sentence: The property management group hired a licensed electrical contractor to upgrade the central wiring system.
sentenceZh: 物業管理集團聘請了一家持牌電氣承包商來全面升級中央電路系統。

zh: 相反的；對立的 / n. 相反
collocations: to the contrary (相反的證明／言論)
tip: 介系詞必考：'contrary to + N'（與…相反）。在閱讀中常作為反襯論點的轉折用語，如 'contrary to popular belief'。
sentence: Contrary to initial market predictions, demand for high-end luxury goods surged throughout the fourth quarter.
sentenceZh: 與最初的市場預測恰恰相反，高階奢侈品的需求在整個第四季度大幅激增。

zh: 控制；掌管 / n. 控制；支配權
tip: 極常考複合名詞：'quality control'（品管，簡稱 QC）、'inventory control'（庫存管理）。
sentence: Our newly implemented quality control measures have reduced final product defect rates by forty percent.
sentenceZh: 我們新推行的品質控管措施已使最終產品的瑕疵率降低了百分之四十。

collocations: controlling stake / interest (控股權；主導股權)
tip: 商務併購（M&A）高頻財經詞彙：'controlling interest / controlling stake'，指持股比例足以掌握公司決策控制權。
sentence: The investment conglomerate recently acquired a controlling stake in the renewable energy startup.
sentenceZh: 該投資財團最近收購了這家再生能源新創公司的多數控股股權。

collocations: at your earliest convenience (在您方便時儘速)
for the convenience of (為了…的便利)
tip: 商務書信客套結尾必考神句：'Please reply at your earliest convenience.'（請於您方便時儘早回覆）。
sentence: Please review the attached contract revisions and return the signed copy at your earliest convenience.
sentenceZh: 請審閱隨附的合約修訂內容，並請在您方便時儘速將簽署本回傳。

collocations: at your earliest convenient time (在您最方便的時候)
convenient access to (方便前往/取得)
tip: 極常考文法句型！注意 convenient 的主詞通常為「事物」或用虛主詞「It is convenient for sb to V」，絕不能說 'I am convenient.'。
sentence: The new branch office is situated in a convenient location with easy access to public transportation.
sentenceZh: 新分公司位於交通便利的地點，可輕鬆搭乘大眾運輸工具。

tip: 在聽力測驗 Part 4 常見 convention center 作為場景。注意與 conference 的區別：convention 規模通常較大且常伴隨展覽或選舉活動。
sentence: Over two thousand delegates are expected to attend the annual marketing convention next month.
sentenceZh: 預計下個月將有兩千多名代表參加年度行銷大會。

collocations: conventional wisdom (一般看法；傳統智慧)
tip: 常與 innovative（創新的）或 alternative（替代的）在閱讀測驗中形成對比，表示傳統或陳舊的模式。
sentence: The startup decided to abandon conventional marketing strategies in favor of viral social media campaigns.
sentenceZh: 該新創公司決定放棄傳統行銷策略，轉而採用社群媒體病毒式行銷。

tip: 聽力測驗 Part 3 的題目指示語總是出現 'Questions ... refer to the following conversation'，指兩人或三人之間的對話。
sentence: I had a brief conversation with the client regarding the revised project timeline.
sentenceZh: 我與客戶就修訂後的專案時程進行了簡短的交談。

collocations: convey sincere gratitude (表達由衷感謝)
tip: 多益書信中極常出現於首尾段，同義詞為 express 或 communicate。例：'Please convey my gratitude to your team.'。
sentence: The director asked me to convey her appreciation to everyone who contributed to the seminar.
sentenceZh: 主管請我向每位協助籌辦研討會的同仁傳達她的感謝。

tip: 在商務情境中多表「堅信；確信」（同義詞 belief），在法律情境下則指「定罪」；常考搭配介系詞 of 或 that 子句。
sentence: She argued her proposal with such conviction that the executive board unanimously approved it.
sentenceZh: 她無比堅定地為自己的提案辯護，使執行董事會全票通過該案。

collocations: convince sb of sth (使某人確信某事)
convince sb to V (說服某人去做…)
tip: 易混淆句型：convince sb to V（說服某人做）與 persuade sb to V 相同；但 convince 不能直接接 that 子句，後面必須先受詞，即 convince sb that...
sentence: The sales team managed to convince the client to renew the maintenance contract for another year.
sentenceZh: 銷售團隊成功說服該客戶續約維護合約一年。

collocations: appreciate your cooperation (感謝您的合作)
tip: 多益各類公告與客戶信件常見結尾金句：'Thank you for your cooperation.'（感謝您的配合）。動詞為 cooperate（常接 with sb / on sth）。
sentence: The successful merger was achieved through close cooperation between the legal and financial departments.
sentenceZh: 這次成功的合併是透過法律部門與財務部門之間的密切合作實現的。

collocations: coordinate an event (籌劃/協調活動)
tip: 常考職稱名詞 coordinator（協調員、主辦人），在閱讀徵人啟事（Job Posting）中是高頻核心職位要求之一。
sentence: Ms. Lin will coordinate the international logistics for the upcoming product rollout.
sentenceZh: 林小姐將負責協調即將推出的新產品國際物流事宜。

collocations: cope with the heavy workload (應付繁重的工作量)
tip: 固定搭配介系詞 with，不可受詞直接接名詞。同義詞為 handle, deal with, manage。
sentence: Additional temporary staff were hired to cope with the surge in customer orders during the holiday season.
sentenceZh: 公司僱用了額外的臨時員工，以應對節慶期間激增的客戶訂單。

zh: 影印；複印；複本；一本/一份
collocations: make a copy of (影印一份)
tip: 多益常考 hard copy（紙本書面複本，對照 electronic copy / digital copy）及書籍雜誌的一本（a copy of the report）。
sentence: Please ensure that you keep a hard copy of the signed contract for your personal records.
sentenceZh: 請務必保留一份已簽署合約的紙本複本，以供個人留底。

tip: Part 7 正式商務邀請函（Invitation）最核心副詞：'You are cordially invited to attend...'，必背送分句型。
sentence: You are cordially invited to attend the annual charity gala held at the Grand Hotel.
sentenceZh: 誠摯邀請您出席於圓山大飯店舉行的年度慈善晚會。

collocations: around the corner (在轉角處；即將來臨)
corner office (角落辦公室；象徵高階職位)
tip: 商務文化中 'corner office' 往往象徵高階主管的位置；在聽力地圖題中常作為參照點（on the corner of A Street and B Avenue）。
sentence: The pharmacy is conveniently located on the corner of Elm Street and Fifth Avenue.
sentenceZh: 該藥局位於榆樹街與第五大道轉角處，交通十分便利。

tip: 辨析：corporate 是形容詞（企業的），corporation 是名詞（公司、企業）。常與 executive, policy, strategy 連用。
sentence: The CEO announced a major overhaul of the corporate travel policy to reduce overall operational expenses.
sentenceZh: 執行長宣布重大改革差旅政策，以降低整體營運支出。

tip: 在 Part 6/7 商務信件中，若帳單有誤常出現此字：'We have corrected the error on your bill.'。同義詞 rectify, amend。
sentence: The billing department quickly issued a corrected invoice after discovering the duplicate charge.
sentenceZh: 帳務部門在發現重複收費後，迅速開立了一份更正後的發票。

zh: 腐敗的；貪污的；使墮落；損壞(檔案)
tip: 在科技情境下，corrupt 常用於形容檔案毀損（corrupted files）；在法務或商業道德情境則表貪腐賄賂。
sentence: The IT team worked tirelessly to recover the database after several critical files became corrupt.
sentenceZh: 在數個關鍵檔案受損後，資訊團隊全力搶修以恢復資料庫。

tip: 常出現在企業法規遵循（Compliance）及商業新聞閱讀文章中，同義字為 bribery（受賄）或 fraud（詐欺）。
sentence: The multinational corporation strictly enforces its anti-corruption policies across all foreign subsidiaries.
sentenceZh: 這家跨國公司在所有海外子公司嚴格執行其反貪腐政策。

collocations: at all costs (不惜一切代價)
tip: 動詞三態同形（cost-cost-cost）。注意名詞複數 costs 常指營運產生的各項支出（expenses）。cost-effective 表示「具成本效益的」。
sentence: Implementing the new automated software is expected to lower manufacturing costs significantly.
sentenceZh: 導入新型自動化軟體預計將大幅降低製造成本。

collocations: council member (市議員；委員會成員)
tip: 易混淆字三部曲：council（委員會、市議會）、counsel（法律顧問；諮商）、counselor（顧問、諮商師），外型極近務必分辨。
sentence: The city council approved the zoning permit for the new commercial shopping plaza.
sentenceZh: 市議會核准了新商業購物廣場的分區使用許可。

collocations: counsel sb on sth (就某事給予某人建議)
tip: 商務常考 legal counsel（法律顧問），此時 counsel 為不可數名詞或指職位；動詞用法為 counsel sb on/about sth。
sentence: Before signing the acquisition agreement, the CEO consulted with the firm's legal counsel.
sentenceZh: 在簽署收購協議之前，執行長諮詢了該公司的法律顧問。

tip: 聽力常見 checkout counter（結帳櫃檯）、reception counter（接待處）。商務閱讀常考 run counter to（違背、與…相悖）。
sentence: Passengers must present their boarding passes and passports at the check-in counter.
sentenceZh: 旅客必須在報到櫃檯出示登機證與護照。

tip: 在多益聽力中，'a couple of' 常用來代替 'two' 或 'a few'，答案選項常做數字替換考點。
sentence: The technician said the system upgrade would take a couple of hours to complete.
sentenceZh: 技術人員表示系統升級需要幾個小時才能完成。

collocations: redeem a coupon (兌換/使用優惠券)
tip: 超高頻搭配動詞是 redeem（兌換優惠券）及 expire（過期）。例：'Coupons cannot be combined with other offers.'。
sentence: Customers can redeem this 20% discount coupon on their next purchase online.
sentenceZh: 顧客可以在下次線上購物時兌換此八折優惠券。

collocations: send via courier (透過快遞寄送)
tip: 常與 express mail, delivery service 互換。如果合約或急件需要送達，多益文本首選就是 courier service。
sentence: The confidential audit documents were delivered directly to the client via courier.
sentenceZh: 機密審計文件已透過快遞直接送達客戶手中。

collocations: in the course of (在…期間/過程中)
tip: 一字多義：1. 訓練課程（training course）；2. 過程（in the course of time）；3. 正式餐飲中的「一道菜」（three-course meal）。
sentence: All new hires are required to complete a safety training course within their first month of employment.
sentenceZh: 所有新進員工都必須在到職的第一個月內完成安全培訓課程。

collocations: take sb to court (控告某人)
tip: 商務法律合約常考 dispute resolution（爭議解決條款），常包含 settle disputes out of court（庭外和解）。
sentence: Both companies agreed to an out-of-court settlement to avoid an expensive and lengthy legal battle.
sentenceZh: 兩家公司同意庭外和解，以避免耗時費資的官司訴訟。

collocations: treat customers courteously (禮貌對待顧客)
tip: 形容詞為 courteous（有禮貌的），名詞為 courtesy。在客服評價文章中是正面高評價關鍵詞。
sentence: The front desk staff always greets guests promptly and courteously.
sentenceZh: 櫃檯接待人員總是迅速且客氣有禮地向客人打招呼。

collocations: as a courtesy to (基於對…的禮貌/優待)
tip: 常考複合名詞：courtesy shuttle / courtesy bus（飯店或機場的免費接駁車），或 courtesy of（由…贊助提供）。
sentence: The airport hotel provides a complimentary courtesy shuttle that runs every thirty minutes.
sentenceZh: 該機場飯店提供每三十分鐘一班的免費禮賓接駁車。

zh: 涵蓋；代班；報導；保險；封面
tip: 多益一字多義代表！常考義：1. 代班（cover for sb）；2. 支付/包含（The fee covers lunch）；3. 保險涵蓋。
sentence: Could you please cover my shift tomorrow afternoon while I attend a doctor's appointment?
sentenceZh: 明天下午我要去看醫生，你能幫我代班嗎？

tip: 若在保險情境必指「承保範圍」（insurance coverage）；若在新聞公關情境則指「媒體報導」（press/media coverage）。
sentence: The health insurance policy provides comprehensive medical coverage for employees and their dependents.
sentenceZh: 該健保方案為員工及其家屬提供全面的醫療保障。

collocations: crack under pressure (在壓力下崩潰)
tip: 工廠品管（QC）或房屋檢驗情境中常見，表示瑕疵或安全隱患。例：inspect the wall for cracks。
sentence: The maintenance engineer identified a minor crack in the turbine casing during the routine inspection.
sentenceZh: 維修工程師在例行檢查中發現渦輪機外殼有一處微小裂紋。

collocations: craft a strategy (精心策劃策略)
tip: 動詞常指「精心製作、推敲設計」（同義詞 carefully create/formulate），例如 craft a proposal / craft an email。
sentence: The marketing department spent weeks crafting a compelling message for the upcoming launch.
sentenceZh: 行銷部門花了數週時間為即將推出的發布會精心設計了一套引人入勝的宣傳訊息。

zh: 精心製作的；手工打造的
tip: 在廣告與產品型錄（Catalog）常作為修飾詞，強調商品的高品質、手工與專業度。
sentence: Each piece of furniture in the boutique hotel is expertly crafted from sustainable materials.
sentenceZh: 這家精品飯店內的每件家具都是採用環保永續材質由專家精心打造而成。

tip: 常出現在聽力 Part 1 建築工地（construction site）圖片題中，例：'A crane is lifting building materials.'。
sentence: A heavy-duty crane was brought in to hoist the steel beams into place atop the skyscraper.
sentenceZh: 一輛重型起重機被調來將鋼樑吊升至摩天大樓頂部定位。

tip: 辦公室情境中九成指電腦硬體或軟體當機（'The server crashed this morning.'），同義片語 break down。
sentence: Remember to save your progress frequently so you don't lose data if the software crashes.
sentenceZh: 請記得隨時儲存進度，這樣若軟體當機才不會遺失資料。

collocations: create job opportunities (創造工作機會)
tip: 常用於商務網站操作（create an account）以及行銷效益評估（create awareness 建立品牌知名度）。
sentence: The new manufacturing plant is expected to create hundreds of jobs for the local community.
sentenceZh: 這座新製造廠預計將為當地社區創造數百個就業機會。

collocations: the creation of a new division (新部門的成立)
tip: 商務報告中常出現 'job creation'（創造就業機會）或指公司的創新作品。
sentence: The chef's latest culinary creation has received glowing reviews from prestigious food critics.
sentenceZh: 主廚最新的料理創作獲得了知名美食評論家的一致好評。

tip: 履歷表（Resume）與徵人廣告中的高頻關鍵字，常搭配 solutions（creative solutions 創新解決方案）。
sentence: We are seeking a creative graphic designer to lead our brand redesign project.
sentenceZh: 我們正在尋找一位有創意的平面設計師來主導我們的品牌重塑專案。

tip: 搭配動詞考點：foster / encourage / stifle creativity（培養/鼓勵/扼殺創造力）。
sentence: The open-plan office layout was designed specifically to foster collaboration and creativity among engineers.
sentenceZh: 開放式辦公室格局是專為促進工程師之間的協作與創造力而設計的。

collocations: creature of habit (守舊/生活極有規律的人)
tip: 片語 'a creature of habit' 偶爾出現在多益聽力日常會話中，指作息固定、習慣不易改變的人。
sentence: Being a creature of habit, Mr. Davis always arrives at his desk promptly at 8:00 AM with a cup of black coffee.
sentenceZh: 身為一個生活規律的人，戴維斯先生總是準時在早上八點帶著一杯黑咖啡坐在辦公桌前。

zh: 證書；憑據；資格資歷 (常用複數)
collocations: check one's credentials (查核資格資歷)
tip: 在人力資源（HR）徵才情境極高頻，通常以複數形 credentials 出現，指學位證書、執照或資歷證明。
sentence: The recruitment committee was deeply impressed by the applicant's outstanding academic and professional credentials.
sentenceZh: 招募委員會對該應徵者卓越的學歷與專業資歷留下了深刻印象。

tip: 易混淆字：credible（可信的）vs. creditable（值得稱讚的）vs. credulous（輕信的、易受騙的）。多益常考 credible source。
sentence: The analyst based her financial forecast solely on data obtained from highly credible sources.
sentenceZh: 該分析師完全依據來自高度可靠來源的數據做出財務預測。

zh: 信用；學分；讚揚；歸功於；存入金額
collocations: give credit to sb (歸功於某人)
credit A to B (把A歸功於B / 將金額A存入B帳戶)
tip: 多益關鍵考點：'credit A with B' 或被動 'A is credited with B'（某人因…而備受讚譽）。作動詞亦有入帳之意。
sentence: The company's rapid turnaround was credited to the newly appointed CEO's aggressive restructuring plan.
sentenceZh: 該公司的迅速扭虧為盈，歸功於新任執行長積極的重組計劃。

collocations: meet with creditors (與債權人會面)
pay off creditors (清償債權人債務)
tip: 對比字：creditor（借錢給別人的人，債權人）vs. debtor（欠錢的人，債務人）。破產重組文章必考。
sentence: The bankrupt retail chain reached an agreement with its major creditors to restructure its outstanding debt.
sentenceZh: 這家破產的連鎖零售商與其主要債權人達成協議，以重組其未清償的債務。

tip: 聽力航空情境極常出現 flight crew 或 cabin crew（空服員）；工地情境則常出現 maintenance/construction crew。
sentence: The flight crew kindly requested that all passengers remain seated while the plane was taxiing.
sentenceZh: 機組人員親切地要求所有乘客在飛機滑行期間保持就座。

tip: 多益較常涉及白領犯罪（white-collar crime）或網路犯罪（cybercrime），常搭配動詞 commit（犯下）。
sentence: The bank invested millions in cybersecurity software to prevent cyber crimes and protect user data.
sentenceZh: 該銀行投資數百萬引進資安軟體，以防範網路犯罪並保護使用者數據。

tip: 常考搭配詞 criminal record（犯罪紀錄，求職背景調查常用）及 criminal charges（刑事起訴）。
sentence: The former executive faces multiple criminal charges for his involvement in the insider trading scandal.
sentenceZh: 這名前高階主管因涉入內線交易醜聞而面臨多項刑事指控。

tip: 不規則複數變化：單數 crisis，複數 crises（發音為 /kracesi:z/）。常考搭配 crisis management（危機處理）。
sentence: The PR agency specialize in crisis management to help corporations protect their public reputation.
sentenceZh: 該公關公司專精於危機管理，協助企業保護其公眾聲譽。

tip: 文法陷阱：criterion 是單數，複數是 criteria。多益測驗中九成以上都以複數 criteria 出現，但動詞要注意單複數配合。
sentence: Cost-effectiveness was the primary criterion used to evaluate vendor proposals for the contract.
sentenceZh: 成本效益是評估各廠商合約提案時所採用的首要標準。

tip: 易混淆家族：critic（評論家，人）、criticism（批評，不可數名詞）、critical（批判的/關鍵的，形）、criticize（批評，動）。
sentence: A favorable review from the renowned theater critic boosted ticket sales for the new musical.
sentenceZh: 知名戲劇評論家的正面評價帶動了該新音樂劇的門票銷售。

zh: 關鍵的；至關重要的；批判的
collocations: play a critical role (扮演關鍵角色)
tip: 商務閱讀中最常考「至關重要的」（同義詞 crucial, vital, essential），常接介系詞 to 或 for。
sentence: Effective communication between team leaders is critical to the timely completion of the project.
sentenceZh: 團隊領導者之間的有效溝通對於專案的如期完成至關重要。

collocations: criticize sb for sth (因某事批評某人)
tip: 句型為 criticize + 人/物 + for + 原因。英式拼法為 criticise。
sentence: The airline was heavily criticized by travelers for failing to notify passengers of flight cancellations in advance.
sentenceZh: 該航空公司因未事先通知旅客航班取消而遭到旅客嚴厲批評。

tip: 在農業商業新聞中指農作物；在辦公軟體情境中作動詞，指裁切圖片大小（crop an image）。
sentence: Unfavorable weather conditions this summer significantly reduced the region's wheat crop.
sentenceZh: 今年夏天惡劣的天候條件大幅減少了該地區的小麥收成。

tip: 聽力 Part 1 常見行人過馬路：'Pedestrians are crossing the street.'。商務上也常考 cross-training（交叉培訓）。
sentence: Be sure to look both ways before you cross the busy intersection outside the convention hall.
sentenceZh: 在穿過會議廳外繁忙的十字路口之前，請務必先看清兩邊來車。

collocations: draw a large crowd (吸引大批人潮)
stand out from the crowd (脫穎而出)
tip: 活動報導常見 'draw a huge crowd'（吸引大批觀眾/人潮）。片語 stand out from the crowd 表示在眾多競爭者中脫穎而出。
sentence: The annual technology expo drew a record-breaking crowd of over fifty thousand attendees.
sentenceZh: 年度科技博覽會吸引了創紀錄的逾五萬名參觀人潮。

tip: 常接介系詞 with，如 'The airport terminal was crowded with holiday travelers.'。也可形容行程滿檔。
sentence: The downtown showroom was so crowded with eager shoppers that security had to restrict entry.
sentenceZh: 市中心的展售間擠滿了熱切的購物者，以致於警衛不得不限制入場人數。

collocations: play a crucial role in (在…扮演極關鍵角色)
tip: 形容詞同義替換常客：crucial = vital = critical = indispensable。常出現在閱讀結論段以加強語氣。
sentence: Securing additional financing is crucial to the expansion of our logistics network across Asia.
sentenceZh: 取得額外融資對於我們在全亞洲擴張物流網絡至關重要。

zh: 遊輪巡遊；漫遊；乘船遊覽
collocations: take a cruise (搭乘郵輪度假)
tip: 在聽力觀光旅遊廣告或 Part 7 旅遊行程表（Itinerary）高頻出現，常見 'dinner cruise along the river'。
sentence: The executive committee decided to hold their celebratory dinner aboard an evening harbor cruise.
sentenceZh: 執行委員會決定在晚間的港灣遊輪上舉行慶祝晚宴。

tip: 不可數名詞。常搭配地域形容詞，如 Italian cuisine、authentic Thai cuisine（道地泰國菜）。
sentence: The newly opened downtown bistro is renowned for serving authentic French cuisine.
sentenceZh: 新開幕的市中心小餐館以供應道地的法國料理聞名。

tip: 聽力 Part 1 辦公室茶水間（break room）圖片題常見物品，注意發音為 /ˈkʌb.əd/，字母 p 不發音！
sentence: Extra coffee mugs and tea bags are stored in the upper cupboard in the staff break room.
sentenceZh: 額外的咖啡馬克杯和茶包存放在員工茶水間上方的櫥櫃裡。

collocations: cure for a problem (問題的解決之道)
tip: 作為名詞時常接介系詞 for（a cure for ...）。注意在商務延伸比喻中可指「弊端或問題的解決辦法」。
sentence: Medical researchers are conducting clinical trials to find a cure for the rare respiratory disorder.
sentenceZh: 醫學研究人員正在進行臨床試驗，以尋找這種罕見呼吸道疾病的療法。

collocations: curious to know/see (很想知道/看看)
tip: 固定用法：be curious about sth。名詞為 curiosity（好奇心），常見片語 out of curiosity。
sentence: Prospective clients were curious about how the new automated software could improve workplace productivity.
sentenceZh: 潛在客戶對這款新型自動化軟體將如何提高工作生產力感到非常好奇。

tip: 多益出差報銷及跨國採購必備詞彙。海外出差情境常出現 currency exchange booth（外幣兌換處）。
sentence: Due to fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates, overseas shipping fees may vary monthly.
sentenceZh: 由於外幣匯率的波動，海外運費每個月可能會有所變動。

zh: 目前的；現行的；水流；潮流
collocations: current economic climate (目前的經濟局勢)
under current regulations (在現行法規下)
tip: 多益常考副詞 currently（目前，與現在進行式或現在式連用）。current events 指時事。
sentence: Under current company policy, employees are permitted to work remotely up to two days a week.
sentenceZh: 根據公司現行政策，員工每週最多可在家遠距辦公兩天。

tip: 商務閱讀常以動詞引申出現：'cushion the blow/impact'（緩和打擊/衝擊）。名詞也可指應急預備金。
sentence: The government subsidies helped cushion the financial impact of the economic downturn on small businesses.
sentenceZh: 政府補助有助於減緩經濟衰退對小型企業造成的財務衝擊。

tip: 注意單複數差異極大：custom 作形容詞為「訂製的」（= customized）；名詞為習俗。若加 s 的 customs 則為「海關」。
sentence: The agency specializes in providing custom website design tailored to the client's brand identity.
sentenceZh: 該機構專門依據客戶的品牌形象提供客製化的網站設計。

tip: 多益聽力閱讀超高頻！比較：customer 多指一般零售消費者，client 多指尋求專業服務（律師、會計師、顧問）的委託人。
sentence: Customer satisfaction surveys are reviewed weekly by management to identify service bottlenecks.
sentenceZh: 管理層每週都會審查顧客滿意度調查，以找出服務瓶頸。

tip: 常以過去分詞作形容詞用：customized products/services（客製化的產品/服務），英式拼為 customise。
sentence: Our software allows users to customize their dashboard according to their daily workflow needs.
sentenceZh: 我們的軟體允許使用者根據日常工作流程需求自訂儀表板。

tip: 恆為複數名詞！常考片語 'go through customs' 或 'clear customs'（通關），進出境時填寫 customs declaration。
sentence: All international travelers must present their passports and declaration slips when passing through customs.
sentenceZh: 所有國際旅客通過海關時，均須出示護照與申報單。

tip: 由片語動詞 cut back 演變而來的複合名詞。通常與預算（budget）或人力（staff）縮減連用。
sentence: Due to unexpected revenue shortfalls, the university announced severe budget cutbacks across all departments.
sentenceZh: 由於意外的稅收短缺，該大學宣布全面削減各系所的預算。

collocations: product life cycle (產品生命週期)
tip: 商務會計高頻詞：billing cycle（計費週期），在電子郵件帳單通知中經常可見。
sentence: Invoices are automatically generated and sent to clients at the beginning of each billing cycle.
sentenceZh: 發票會在每個出帳週期開始時自動生成並發送給客戶。

tip: 多益最愛同義置換片語：on a daily basis = every day / daily。注意它可作形容詞、副詞及名詞（日報）。
sentence: Supervisors conduct daily inspections to ensure that factory safety regulations are strictly obeyed.
sentenceZh: 主管人員每天進行檢查，以確保工廠安全法規得到嚴格遵守。

tip: 當「損害、破壞」時為不可數名詞！但若加上複數 damages，則專指法律上的「損害賠償金」（seek damages）。
sentence: The courier company agreed to compensate the client for the damage caused during transit.
sentenceZh: 快遞公司同意賠償客戶在運輸過程中造成的損壞。

collocations: in danger of (處於…的危險中)
tip: 常考片語：be in danger of extinction/bankruptcy（面臨絕種/破產的危險）。工安告示標語常出現 Danger: High Voltage。
sentence: Without an immediate cash infusion, the struggling retail chain is in serious danger of bankruptcy.
sentenceZh: 若無立即的資金挹注，這家陷入困境的連鎖零售店將面臨嚴重的破產危機。

tip: 常與 hazardous 或 risky 進行同義詞替換。工廠工安標誌及勞工安全規章中常客。
sentence: Employees handling dangerous chemicals are strictly required to wear full protective gear at all times.
sentenceZh: 處理危險化學品的員工在任何時候都必須嚴格穿戴全套防護裝備。

tip: 可作助動詞（後接原形動詞，否定為 dare not）或一般動詞（dare to V）。口語常考 'I dare say'（我想、很可能）。
sentence: Few established retailers dared to challenge the tech giant's dominance in the e-commerce market.
sentenceZh: 鮮少有老牌零售商敢於挑戰這家科技巨頭在電子商務市場上的主導地位。

tip: 商務新聞中形容企業的大膽擴張或策略變革，同義詞 bold, adventurous。
sentence: The CEO made a daring move by shifting the company's entire focus toward artificial intelligence solutions.
sentenceZh: 執行長採取了大膽的舉動，將公司的整體業務重心轉向人工智慧解決方案。

tip: 文法上 data 原為複數（單數 datum），但在現代商務美語中通常作不可數名詞，接單數動詞（The data shows...）。
sentence: The marketing team collected valuable consumer data during the nationwide product trial.
sentenceZh: 行銷團隊在全國產品試用活動期間收集了寶貴的消費者數據。

tip: IT與客戶管理必考詞。常搭配動詞 access, update, maintain, search。
sentence: All customer contact details are securely stored and encrypted in our centralized database.
sentenceZh: 所有客戶聯絡資料均安全儲存並加密於我們的中央資料庫中。

zh: 黎明；拂曉；破曉；開始明白
collocations: at the crack of dawn (一大清早)
dawn of a new era (新時代的曙光)
dawn on sb (某人突然明白)
tip: 片語動詞 'dawn on sb' 表示「某人恍然大悟」：'It finally dawned on him that...'。
sentence: It suddenly dawned on the manager that the accounting discrepancies were caused by a software glitch.
sentenceZh: 經理突然意識到，會計帳目出錯是由軟體故障所引起的。

collocations: call it a day (今天到此為止；收工)
tip: 多益超高頻片語：'within 3 to 5 business days'（三到五個工作天內，business days = working days）。
sentence: Your online order will be shipped within two business days after payment confirmation.
sentenceZh: 您的線上訂單將在付款確認後的兩個工作日內寄出。

collocations: daylight saving time (日光節約時間)
tip: 多益歐美跨國視訊會議情境中常提及 'daylight saving time'（日光節約時間/夏令時間），提醒換算時差。
sentence: Construction crews took full advantage of the daylight hours to finish repairing the roadway.
sentenceZh: 施工隊充分利用白天時段，以完成道路搶修工程。

zh: 日期；約會；註明日期；追溯
tip: 合約與信件中極常出現 'to date'（迄今為止 = up to now），以及 'effective date'（生效日期）。
sentence: Please check the expiration date printed on the packaging before using the product.
sentenceZh: 在使用產品之前，請先檢查印在包裝上的有效期限。

collocations: daytime phone number (日間聯絡電話)
tip: 在線上填寫訂購單或註冊表格時，常看到 'daytime phone number'（日間聯絡電話）。
sentence: Please provide a daytime telephone number where you can be reached regarding your shipment.
sentenceZh: 請提供白天可聯絡到您的電話號碼，以方便告知您的貨運情況。

tip: 形容詞 dazzling（令人眼花繚亂的、燦爛奪目的）常用來形容展覽、新品發表或亮眼的財務業績。
sentence: The tech company managed to dazzle investors with a live demonstration of its cutting-edge smartphone.
sentenceZh: 這家科技公司現場實機展示其尖端智慧型手機，令投資人驚豔不已。

collocations: meet a deadline (趕上截止期限)
miss a deadline (錯過截止期限)
tip: 多益考過上千次的魔王級必備詞！四大黃金動詞搭配：meet / miss / set / extend a deadline。
sentence: Our development team worked overtime throughout the weekend to meet the client's tight deadline.
sentenceZh: 我們的研發團隊整個週末都在加班，以趕上客戶緊迫的截止期限。

collocations: close a deal (達成協議/做成生意)
a great deal of (大量的 + 不可數名詞)
tip: 文法重點：'a great deal of + 不可數名詞'。片語 deal with = handle / address / cope with（處理問題）。
sentence: The sales representative worked hard for months to finally close a multi-million dollar deal with the vendor.
sentenceZh: 業務代表辛苦了數個月，終於與該供應商達成了一筆數百萬美元的交易。

tip: 閱讀常見 'authorized dealer'（授權經銷商），通常享有保固維修資格，為合約常客。
sentence: To ensure that your vehicle warranty remains valid, purchase replacement parts only from authorized dealers.
sentenceZh: 為確保您的車輛保固維持有效，請僅向授權經銷商購買更換零件。

zh: 商業往來；交易；行為 (常用複數)
collocations: have dealings with (與…有業務往來)
tip: 通常使用複數形 dealings，表公司之間的商務合作或往來紀錄。例：ethical dealings（合乎商業道德的交易）。
sentence: Our firm is widely respected for its transparency and fair dealings with subcontractors.
sentenceZh: 我們公司因與分包商之間的高度透明與公平交易而備受推崇。

collocations: dean's list (書卷獎優秀學生名單)
tip: 多益校園徵才（Campus Recruitment）或學術機構文章中常見，多指大學學院院長（Dean of the Business School）。
sentence: The dean of the engineering department announced a substantial grant for renewable energy research.
sentenceZh: 工程學院院長宣布了一筆用於再生能源研究的巨額補助金。

collocations: cost sb dear (讓某人付出沉重代價)
tip: 在正式信函中做抬頭稱呼。此外在英式英文商業文章中，dear 也可當「昂貴的」（expensive）使用。
sentence: Dear Valued Customer, thank you for choosing our banking services for your financial needs.
sentenceZh: 親貴的顧客：感謝您選擇本行的金融服務來滿足您的財務需求。

collocations: a debatable point (有爭議的論點)
tip: 同義片語為 open to debate 或 questionable。閱讀中常修飾策略的成效或數據推估是否正確。
sentence: Whether the new advertising campaign actually boosted store traffic remains highly debatable.
sentenceZh: 這波新的廣告宣傳是否真正帶動了店面人流，仍極具爭議。

tip: 搭配動詞：hold a debate, spark/trigger a debate。常接介系詞 over 或 on。
sentence: The proposed revisions to the company retirement plan sparked a heated debate among union representatives.
sentenceZh: 針對公司退休金計畫的修訂提議在工會代表之間引發了激烈的爭辯。

tip: 會計雙核心：debit（借方；扣款）vs. credit（貸方；入帳）。debit card 是指存款有多少刷多少的簽帳卡。
sentence: The monthly gym membership fee will be automatically debited from your checking account.
sentenceZh: 每月的健身房會員費將自動從您的支票帳戶中扣除。

collocations: pay off a debt (清償債務)
tip: 注意發音！字母 b 不發音，唸 /det/。同義片語 get into debt（陷入負債）、clear/settle one's debt（還清債務）。
sentence: Through prudent cost management, the manufacturing firm managed to pay off all its long-term debt early.
sentenceZh: 透過審慎的成本管理，該製造公司得以提前清償所有長期債務。

collocations: debut album/product (首發專輯/初亮相產品)
tip: 注意發音，法語借詞，結尾 t 不發音，唸作 /ˈdeɪ.bju/。新品上市在報紙文章中常稱作其 market debut。
sentence: The automotive brand's first fully electric SUV made its international debut at the Geneva Motor Show.
sentenceZh: 該汽車品牌的第一款純電動休旅車在日內瓦車展上首次國際亮相。

collocations: over the past decade (過去十年來)
tip: 多益聽力與閱讀常考時態搭配：'Over the past decade, sales have doubled.'，句中必定使用現在完成式！
sentence: Over the past decade, the software firm has grown from a humble startup into a Fortune 500 company.
sentenceZh: 在過去十年間，這家軟體公司已從小規模的新創公司成長為財星五百大企業。

collocations: upon the decease of (在…過世後)
tip: 常出現在遺產繼承、人壽保險合約或法律文件中。最常見其過去分詞轉名詞用法 'the deceased'（死者）。
sentence: According to the life insurance contract, the benefits are payable immediately upon the decease of the policyholder.
sentenceZh: 根據人壽保險合約，保險金於保戶過世後立即支付。

collocations: obtain by deceit (藉由詐欺獲取)
guilty of deceit (犯有欺詐行為)
tip: 不可數名詞，指欺瞞的行徑。商業道德或訴訟案件常客，同義詞 deception, dishonesty。
sentence: The rogue trader was dismissed immediately after company auditors uncovered a deliberate act of deceit.
sentenceZh: 在公司稽核員揭發了一起蓄意的欺詐行為後，該違規交易員隨即被解雇。

zh: 騙人的；不誠實的；虛偽的
tip: 多益消費者保護法或法務法規文章中，常用 deceitful practices 指稱不實宣傳或詐欺業務行為。
sentence: The trade commission fined the retailer heavily for engaging in deceitful advertising practices.
sentenceZh: 公平交易委員會因該零售商從事虛偽不實的廣告行為而對其處以巨額罰款。

collocations: deceive sb into V-ing (騙某人去做…)
tip: 固定句型：deceive sb into doing sth（騙某人做某事）。名詞形式為 deception 或 deceit。
sentence: The investment firm attempted to deceive regulators by falsifying its quarterly revenue reports.
sentenceZh: 該投資公司企圖藉由偽造季度營收報告來矇騙監管機構。

tip: 反義詞 accelerate（加速）。商務財經版常拿來形容經濟成長趨緩（economic growth decelerates）或通膨減速。
sentence: Economic analysts noted that consumer spending began to decelerate during the third quarter.
sentenceZh: 經濟分析師指出，消費者支出在第三季已開始放緩。

tip: 財經新聞高頻名詞，反義字為 acceleration。常與 slowdown 替換使用。
sentence: The latest central bank report pointed to a gradual deceleration of economic expansion over the coming year.
sentenceZh: 央行最新報告指出，未來一年經濟擴張將逐漸放緩。

zh: 體面的；正派的；相當不錯的
collocations: decent working conditions (良好的工作條件)
tip: 在招聘廣告或求職評價中，'decent salary/benefits' 指符合期望、相當令人滿意的待遇。
sentence: The tech firm offers a decent compensation package alongside flexible working hours to attract top developers.
sentenceZh: 該科技公司提供優厚的薪酬方案及彈性工時，以吸引頂尖開發人才。

collocations: decide on sth (決定選某事物)
tip: 注意搭配介系詞：decide to + 原形動詞；decide on + 名詞（選定某事）；decide against + V-ing（決定不做）。
sentence: The committee ultimately decided against adopting the proposed scheduling changes for field workers.
sentenceZh: 委員會最終決定不採用針對外勤人員排班修改的提案。

tip: 辦公室情境中常指「解讀難懂的文字或模糊的手寫字跡」（decipher illegible notes）。
sentence: The administrative assistant struggled to decipher the client's handwritten instructions on the contract.
sentenceZh: 行政助理費了很大的勁才辨認出合約上客戶手寫的指示。

collocations: reach a decision (達成共識/做出決策)
tip: 動詞搭配考點：make a decision 或 reach / arrive at a decision（達成決定）。形容詞 decisive（果斷的）。
sentence: After three hours of continuous deliberation, the board of directors finally reached a decision regarding the merger.
sentenceZh: 經過三個小時不間斷的審議，董事會終於就合併案做出了決定。

collocations: take decisive action (採取果斷行動)
tip: 在主管績效考核中常用詞：decisive leadership。對事物則指「具決定性的」，如 decisive role/factor。
sentence: Management took decisive action to recall the defective merchandise and minimize damage to the brand.
sentenceZh: 管理層採取果斷行動召回有瑕疵的商品，將品牌傷害降到最低。

zh: 甲板；平台；簡報投影片(slide deck)
tip: 在郵輪/航空情境指甲板或駕駛艙；在現代商務創投簡報中，'slide deck' 或 'pitch deck' 常指「一整份投影片」。
sentence: The tourism department encourages visitors to view the city skyline from the 80th-floor observation deck.
sentenceZh: 觀光局鼓勵遊客從 80 樓的觀景台眺望城市天際線。

tip: 機場入出境及進出口貿易中，'customs declaration form'（海關申報單）是出題頻率最高的複合名詞之一。
sentence: Failure to complete the customs declaration form accurately may lead to substantial fines or confiscation.
sentenceZh: 未如實填寫海關申報單可能導致巨額罰款或物品被沒收。

collocations: declare goods at customs (在海關申報貨物)
tip: 兩大多益常考用法：1. 申報海關（'Do you have anything to declare?'）；2. 法律財務宣稱（declare bankruptcy 宣布破產）。
sentence: Passengers carrying goods exceeding duty-free allowances are legally required to declare them upon arrival.
sentenceZh: 攜帶超過免稅額度商品的旅客，在抵達時依法必須進行申報。

tip: 雙核心考點：1. 及物動詞表「婉拒」（decline the offer/invitation）；2. 不及物或名詞表「下降」（profits decline / a decline in sales）。
sentence: Mr. Garcia had to decline the speaking invitation due to an unavoidable scheduling conflict.
sentenceZh: 加西亞先生因不可避免的行程衝突，不得不婉拒了這項演講邀請。

collocations: decode an encrypted file (解讀加密檔案)
decode consumer trends (解讀消費者趨勢)
tip: 資訊科技核心字，反義詞為 encode（編碼）。商務中亦可比喻解讀複雜的市場情報。
sentence: The security system is programmed to decode encrypted messages sent from authorized overseas servers.
sentenceZh: 該安全系統被設定用來解碼由授權的海外伺服器發送的加密訊息。

tip: 介系詞陷阱：decrease by + 幅度（減少了…幅度）；decrease to + 最終數字（減少到…）。名詞通常接 in。
sentence: Through optimized supply chain routes, the company managed to decrease freight expenses by fifteen percent.
sentenceZh: 透過優化供應鏈路線，該公司成功將貨運費用降低了 15%。

collocations: dedicate time and resources (投入時間與資源)
tip: 極高頻文法考點！'be dedicated to + V-ing/N' 中的 to 是「介系詞」，後面必須接動名詞或名詞，同義片語 be devoted/committed to。
sentence: Our customer support team is dedicated to providing prompt and dependable service around the clock.
sentenceZh: 我們的客服團隊致力於全天候提供即時且可靠的服務。

collocations: show great dedication (展現極大的熱忱奉獻)
in recognition of one's dedication (表彰某人的貢獻)
tip: 常出現在員工退休晚會、頒獎典禮（Awards Ceremony）演講中：'In recognition of your exceptional dedication...'。
sentence: The employee was presented with a commemorative plaque in recognition of her thirty years of dedication.
sentenceZh: 該名員工獲頒紀念獎牌，以表彰她三十年來盡忠職守的奉獻精神。

tip: 句型 deduce A from B（從 B 推斷出 A）。名詞為 deduction（推論；扣除額）。常與 infer 互相置換。
sentence: From the preliminary sales figures, management was able to deduce that the promotional campaign was a triumph.
sentenceZh: 從初步的銷售數據中，管理層得以推斷這場促銷宣傳大獲成功。

tip: 常考薪資單（pay slip）或報稅文章。注意形容詞 tax-deductible（可扣除的/可抵稅的）為商務報稅必備詞。
sentence: Social security contributions and health insurance premiums are automatically deducted from your monthly gross pay.
sentenceZh: 社會保險費用與健保費將自動從您的每月總薪資中扣除。

tip: 財務情境中百分之百指「扣除金額」（尤其是 tax deduction 抵稅項目）；邏輯學中指「演繹推理」。
sentence: Charitable donations made to registered nonprofit organizations qualify for an income tax deduction.
sentenceZh: 向登記有案的非營利機構所進行的慈善捐贈，符合個人所得稅扣除額資格。

collocations: deem sth necessary (認為某事有必要)
tip: 正式商務與法律用語，同義詞 consider, regard。常見被動結構或後接形容詞：'if deemed necessary'（若認為有必要）。
sentence: The proposal will be revised immediately if the safety oversight board deems it necessary.
sentenceZh: 若安全監督委員會認為有必要，該提案將立即予以修改。

zh: 深的；深切的；深奧的；深處
tip: 在促銷文案中常考 'deep discounts'（超低折扣；大幅度降價）。
sentence: The department store offered deep discounts of up to 70% during the annual inventory clearance sale.
sentenceZh: 該百貨公司在年度庫存出清特賣期間，提供了高達三折的大幅折扣優惠。

tip: 常考搭配詞：deepen relationships / partnerships（深化合作關係）或危機加深。
sentence: The bilateral trade summit was organized to deepen economic partnerships between the two neighboring nations.
sentenceZh: 舉辦這場雙邊貿易峰會旨在深化這兩個鄰國之間的經濟夥伴關係。

zh: 違約；不履行債務；預設值
collocations: default on a loan (債務違約)
by default (預設地；默認情況下)
tip: 雙重考點：1. 財務金融指「債務違約」（default on a mortgage/loan）；2. 科技電腦情境指「系統預設值」（default options）。
sentence: If the borrower defaults on the loan repayment schedule, the bank possesses the legal right to seize the collateral.
sentenceZh: 若借款人未履行還款時程，銀行擁有扣押抵押品的法定權利。

collocations: defeat a competitor (擊敗競爭對手)
tip: 商務市場競爭新聞中常用於指市佔率爭奪勝過對手，或提案遭到否決（the motion was defeated）。
sentence: Our newly launched marketing strategy helped us defeat our major competitors and gain market dominance.
sentenceZh: 我們新推出的行銷策略協助我們擊敗主要競爭對手，取得市場主導地位。

tip: 名詞發音 /ˈdiː.fekt/，動詞發音 /dɪˈfekt/。品管檢驗（QC）核心名詞，形容詞 defective（有瑕疵的）更是必背！
sentence: The automated camera inspects each finished item on the assembly line to identify any structural defect.
sentenceZh: 自動化攝影機檢查組裝線上的每一件成品，以發現任何結構瑕疵。

tip: 法務訴訟常客，指委任律師為被告訴訟進行抗辯；或商業公關中為企業商譽辯護。
sentence: The corporation retained a top-tier law firm to defend against allegations of patent infringement.
sentenceZh: 該企業聘請了一家頂級律師事務所，以對專利侵權指控進行辯護。

tip: 法庭情境中 'defense attorney' 代表被告律師（相對於 prosecutor 檢察官）。英式拼法為 defence。
sentence: The defense attorney presented documentary evidence proving that his client was elsewhere at the time.
sentenceZh: 辯護律師提出了書面證據，證明他的當事人當時身在別處。

collocations: become defensive (變得有戒心/防衛心重)
tip: 商業競爭策略中可表示 'defensive measures/strategy'（防守性策略，對抗新進入者的競爭）。
sentence: The company adopted a defensive pricing strategy to safeguard its market share against emerging low-cost rivals.
sentenceZh: 該公司採取了防守型定價策略，以捍衛其市佔率並抵擋新興低成本競爭對手的威脅。

collocations: defy expectations (出乎意料；顛覆預期)
tip: 商務新聞極高頻片語：'defy market expectations / defy the odds'（顛覆市場預期；創造奇蹟逆勢成長）。
sentence: Despite the severe economic slowdown, the tech retailer managed to defy expectations with record quarterly profits.
sentenceZh: 儘管面臨嚴重的經濟趨緩，該科技零售商仍創下創紀錄的季度利潤，顛覆了市場預期。

collocations: to a certain degree (在某種程度上)
tip: 多益徵人廣告（Job Ad）履歷必備要求：'A bachelor's degree in Finance or related field is required.'。
sentence: Applicants must possess a bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent practical industry experience.
sentenceZh: 應徵者必須具備電腦科學學士學位或同等之業界實務經驗。

tip: 文法陷阱：動詞 delay 後面若接動詞，必須使用動名詞 'delay V-ing'！聽力機場廣播最常出現 flight delay。
sentence: Unanticipated shipping port congestion has caused an unexpected delay in delivering the electronic components.
sentenceZh: 未預期到的貨運港口擁塞導致電子零組件的交付發生了意外延誤。

tip: 發音與詞性考點：動詞 /ˈdel.ə.ɡeɪt/（分派；授權）；名詞 /ˈdel.ə.ɡət/（與會代表，同義 attendee/representative）。
sentence: An effective manager must know how to delegate tasks appropriately to avoid burnout and empower the team.
sentenceZh: 一位高成效的管理者必須懂得適當分派任務，以避免過度疲勞並賦能團隊。

zh: 深思熟慮的；故意的；商議
collocations: deliberate decision (深思熟慮後的決定)
tip: 形容詞發音 /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət/，動詞發音 /dɪˈlɪb.ə.reɪt/。形容詞可表「故意的」（intentional）或「審慎周詳的」。
sentence: The executive committee will deliberate on the proposed corporate restructuring before taking a vote.
sentenceZh: 執行委員會將在投票前就提議的公司重組計畫進行審議。

tip: 同義詞 on purpose, intentionally。在合約違規或稽核調查報告中，經常用來形容「故意違規」。
sentence: The investigation revealed that the financial figures had been deliberately altered to mislead tax authorities.
sentenceZh: 調查顯示，該財務數據遭到故意篡改以誤導稅務機關。

collocations: handle with delicacy (小心翼翼處理)
tip: 在商務宴請、招待觀光或餐飲指南文章中，指珍貴罕見的地方美食特產。
sentence: During the official state banquet, visiting diplomats were treated to an assortment of exquisite local delicacies.
sentenceZh: 在官方國宴期間，來訪的外交官員享用了各式精緻的地方特色佳餚。

zh: 易碎的；精細的；微妙敏感的
tip: 物流包裹標籤常印有 'Handle with care: delicate items'（小心輕放：易碎精密物品）。商務談判中指棘手微妙的局勢。
sentence: The logistics team wrapped the delicate optical sensors in extra layers of protective bubble wrap.
sentenceZh: 物流團隊用額外的防護氣泡布將精密的各類光學感測器嚴密包裝起來。

collocations: serve delicious dishes (供應美味菜餚)
tip: 不可與 very 連用做修飾（因為 delicious 本身就是極限形容詞，宜搭配 absolutely delicious 或 simply delicious）。
sentence: The catering service hired for the annual gala served an absolutely delicious three-course meal.
sentenceZh: 為年度晚會聘請的餐飲外燴服務團隊供應了極其美味的三道式餐點。

collocations: to our great delight (令我們萬分高興的是)
tip: 形容詞 delighted（感到高興的，修飾人）與 delightful（令人愉悅的，修飾事物）是 Part 5 詞性辨析的大熱門題。
sentence: The premier resort strives to delight its guests by offering customized concierge services around the clock.
sentenceZh: 這家頂級度假村致力於藉由提供全天候客製化禮賓服務，讓房客深感愉悅。

zh: 遞送；發表(演說)；履行承諾
collocations: deliver on a promise (履行承諾)
tip: 一字多義核心：1. 運送貨物；2. 發表演講/簡報（deliver a keynote speech）；3. 履行目標承諾（deliver results）。
sentence: The supplier guaranteed that the replacement parts would be delivered within forty-eight hours.
sentenceZh: 供應商保證更換零件將在四十八小時之內送達。

collocations: take delivery of (驗收/接收貨物)
tip: 訂單與出貨信件必考：'estimated delivery date'（預計送達日）及 'on-time delivery rate'（準時交貨率）。
sentence: Customers will receive an automated tracking link once their delivery has left our regional distribution center.
sentenceZh: 一旦顧客的貨物離開我們的區域配送中心，系統便會發送自動追蹤連結給顧客。

tip: 常見文法搭配片語：under the delusion that...（誤以為…；心存幻想以為…）。
sentence: The startup founder was under the delusion that strong technology alone would guarantee commercial success.
sentenceZh: 該新創公司創辦人誤以為單憑強大的技術就能保證商業上的成功。

tip: 閱讀必考片語：'meet / satisfy growing customer demand'（滿足日益增長的客戶需求）。形容詞 demanding（要求嚴苛的）。
sentence: To meet rising consumer demand for renewable energy, the company expanded its solar panel production capacity.
sentenceZh: 為了滿足消費者對再生能源不斷增長的需求，該公司擴大了太陽能板的產能。

collocations: lead to the demise of (導致…的滅亡/倒閉)
tip: 在商業個案分析閱讀測驗中，常指一家曾經強大的公司走向「衰亡或倒閉」，同義詞 failure, downfall。
sentence: The sudden demise of the prominent travel agency left thousands of holiday travelers stranded abroad.
sentenceZh: 這家知名旅行社的突然倒閉，導致成千上萬名度假旅客滯留海外。

zh: 人口統計數據；目標客群
collocations: target demographics (目標客群人口特徵)
changing demographics (變遷中的人口統計)
tip: 常以複數名詞 demographics 出現。行銷企劃閱讀中常指依年齡、性別、收入所劃分的「目標族群」。
sentence: The marketing survey helped the brand adjust its advertising strategy to appeal to younger customer demographics.
sentenceZh: 該行銷調查協助品牌調整其廣告策略，以吸引較年輕的客層族群。

collocations: schedule to be demolished (預定拆除)
tip: 多益不動產開發或市政新聞高頻詞。名詞是 demolition。同義詞 tear down, knock down。
sentence: The outdated warehouse will be demolished next month to make way for a contemporary office complex.
