sentence: Sponsoring the international tennis tournament provided our brand with unprecedented global television exposure.
sentenceZh: 贊助這場國際網球賽事為我們的品牌帶來了前所未有的全球電視曝光度。

collocations: express check-in (快捷登機/快速退房)
tip: 作形容詞表「特快的」（express delivery）；作動詞表「表達」（express gratitude/concern）；作名詞表快遞或快車。多益常考快速辦理服務。
sentence: Business passengers requiring express delivery of urgent contractual documents can utilize our overnight courier service.
sentenceZh: 需要對緊急合約文件進行特快配送的商務旅客，可以使用我們的隔夜快遞服務。

collocations: an expression of gratitude (表達謝意)
tip: 商務書信常見格式片語「as an expression of our appreciation / gratitude（為表達我們的感謝之意，特附上…）」，通常伴隨贈品或折扣代碼。
sentence: Please accept this personalized gift voucher as a small expression of our appreciation for your continued patronage.
sentenceZh: 請收下這張個人專屬禮券，以略表我們對您持續光顧的由衷謝意。

zh: 延長（期限）；提供（邀請/謝意）
collocations: extend the deadline (延長截止日期)
tip: 【多益雙核心考點】1. 展期（extend the warranty/deadline 延長保固/交期）；2. 給予（extend an offer/invitation 給予錄取通知/邀請，等同於 give/offer）。
sentence: In light of the technical malfunction on the application portal, the committee agreed to extend the submission deadline by three days.
sentenceZh: 鑑於申請入口網站發生技術故障，委員會同意將提交截止日期延長三天。

tip: 聽力 Part 1/2/3 辦公室電話溝通必考「extension number（分機號碼，常簡寫為 ext. 1234）」；書信中常考「grant an extension（核准延期）」。
sentence: If you wish to speak directly with the project coordinator, please dial the main office number followed by extension 402.
sentenceZh: 如果您希望直接與專案協調員通話，請撥打辦公室總機並轉接分機 402。

tip: 極常搭配 experience, research, renovations, knowledge。在履歷題中修飾求職者的資歷廣泛；在飯店整修題中指「大規模全盤裝修」。
sentence: The lead consultant brings extensive experience in corporate tax compliance and regulatory restructuring.
sentenceZh: 該首席顧問在企業稅務合規及監管重組方面帶來了極為豐富廣泛的經驗。

collocations: to a certain extent (在某種程度上)
to the extent that (到達…的程度)
determine the extent of the damage (確定受損程度)
tip: 常考介系詞搭配「to ... extent（在…程度）」。事故評估題中常出現「assess the full extent of the damage（評估全面的損害程度）」。
sentence: Insurance assessors were deployed immediately to the flooded warehouse to evaluate the full extent of the structural damage.
sentenceZh: 保險公估人立即被派往淹水的倉庫，以評估建築結構受損的全面程度。

collocations: at no extra cost (無需額外付費)
tip: 促銷及飯店題極高頻片語：「at no extra charge / at no extra cost（不加收額外費用/免費）」，等同於 free of charge 或 complimentary。
sentence: Guests booking the deluxe suite will receive access to the executive lounge at no extra cost.
sentenceZh: 預訂豪華套房的賓客可免費使用行政貴賓室，無需支付額外費用。

collocations: extract from a report (報告摘要/節錄)
tip: 名詞重音在第一音節 /ˈɛkstrækt/；動詞在第二音節 /ɪkˈstrækt/（提取；抽出）。Part 7 文章常在開頭註明「The following is an extract from the annual report.」
sentence: The following document is an extract taken directly from the company's officially audited annual performance review.
sentenceZh: 以下文件是直接截取自該公司官方審計之年度績效評審報告的摘要。

zh: 非凡的；出色的；非同尋常的
collocations: extraordinary shareholder meeting (臨時股東大會)
tip: 1. 讚揚員工表現卓越（extraordinary dedication）；2. 法律與公司治理中，「extraordinary general meeting (EGM)」指為重大突發事件召開的「臨時股東大會」。
sentence: The board called an extraordinary shareholder meeting to vote on the proposed multi-billion-dollar merger.
sentenceZh: 董事會召開了臨時股東大會，就這項擬議中耗資數十億美元的併購案進行表決。

tip: 紡織服裝業或製造業採購題高頻字。常考材質特點如 breathable fabric（透氣布料）、durable fabric（耐磨布料）。亦可抽象指「結構」（the fabric of society）。
sentence: The sportswear company signed a contract with an innovative supplier that produces breathable and eco-friendly fabric.
sentenceZh: 這家運動服飾公司與一家生產透氣環保布料的創新供應商簽訂了合約。

tip: 多益聽力與閱讀常考雙重涵義：工廠製造零件（同義於 manufacture / assemble）或商業道德中捏造數據（同義於 falsify / forge）。
sentence: The industrial plant fabricates lightweight metal components for the aerospace sector.
sentenceZh: 該工業廠房為航太領域製造輕量化金屬零組件。

collocations: face intense competition (面臨激烈競爭)
be faced with a challenge (面臨挑戰)
face budget cuts (面臨預算削減)
tip: 常考主動與被動態替換：'face a problem' 等同於 'be faced with a problem'，Part 5 填空常考介系詞 with 的搭配。
sentence: Our overseas division currently faces unprecedented regulatory obstacles.
sentenceZh: 我們的海外部門目前面臨前所未有的法規阻礙。

collocations: facial recognition technology (臉部辨識技術)
wear facial coverings (配戴口罩/面罩)
tip: 在 Office Technology 或安全監控情境中，'facial recognition'（臉部辨識）是近年多益考門禁系統的超高頻科技題型。
sentence: The updated security protocol requires employees to pass through a facial recognition scanner.
sentenceZh: 最新的安全防護規定要求員工必須通過臉部辨識掃描儀。

collocations: facilitate economic growth (促進經濟成長)
facilitate a smooth transition (促成順利轉型)
tip: 多益核心及物動詞，主詞通常是政策、工具或系統，受詞為流程或事件，不可誤接人（不能寫 facilitate someone to do）。
sentence: The introduction of the new ERP software is intended to facilitate cross-departmental collaboration.
sentenceZh: 引進新型企業資源規劃軟體旨在促進跨部門合作。

zh: 引導者，協調人，會議主持人
collocations: act as a facilitator (擔任協調者)
tip: 指不直接主導決策、而是幫助團體達成共識或引導流程的人，常在商務工作坊或培訓通知的閱讀測驗中出現。
sentence: Ms. Lin served as the primary facilitator during the strategic planning retreat.
sentenceZh: 林女士在策略規劃研討會期間擔任主要引導協調人。

tip: 單數常指特定用途的建築物或廠房（如 research facility），複數 facilities 則泛指整套硬體設備（如 recreational facilities）。
sentence: The logistics firm invested fifty million dollars to expand its distribution facility in Dallas.
sentenceZh: 這家物流公司投資了五千萬美元以擴建其位於達拉斯的配送中心設施。

zh: 事實上的（常作 de facto）
collocations: de facto standard (實質上的產業標準)
tip: 多益偶爾出現在商務合約或市場分析文章中，幾乎固定以拉丁片語 'de facto' 出現，修飾名詞或作副詞，表示法律上未正式確認但事實上已存在。
sentence: Through widespread adoption, their proprietary format has become the de facto industry benchmark.
sentenceZh: 透過廣泛的普及使用，他們的專利格式已成為產業實質上的標竿。

collocations: factory outlet (工廠直營暢貨中心)
tip: 常與 plant, mill, warehouse 等製造業場所名詞在閱讀測驗中作為同義字替換考出。
sentence: The assembly factory will temporarily suspend operations for routine machinery maintenance next Monday.
sentenceZh: 這間組裝工廠將於下週一暫停營運以進行例行機械維護。

collocations: fail to comply with (未能遵守)
fail to meet expectations (未達預期)
tip: 極常考固定句型 'fail to + 原形動詞'，表示未能履行職責或遵守規範。片語 'without fail' 常在備忘錄中表示「務必、準時」。
sentence: Suppliers who fail to meet quality benchmarks will be disqualified from future bidding cycles.
sentenceZh: 未能達到品質標準的供應商將被取消未來投標週期的資格。

tip: 除了指抽象的失敗，在工廠製造與維修情境中，'mechanical/equipment failure'（機械故障）是聽力 Part 3/4 解釋延誤原因的標準答案。
sentence: The sudden delay in delivery was caused by an unexpected mechanical failure on the production line.
sentenceZh: 交貨的突然延遲是由生產線上突發的機械故障所導致的。

zh: 展覽會，市集；(adj.) 公平的
tip: 當名詞時高頻考 'job fair' 或 'trade fair'；當形容詞時常考商務定價 'fair price' 或合約誠信 'fair deal'。
sentence: Representatives from Human Resources will host an informational booth at the regional career fair.
sentenceZh: 人力資源部代表將在區域就業博覽會上設置資訊展位。

collocations: treat all applicants fairly (公正對待所有申請人)
tip: 修飾形容詞或副詞時程度等同於 'quite / reasonably'；若修飾動詞（如 treat, judge）則表示依照公平原則。
sentence: The audit committee confirmed that all tender proposals were evaluated fairly and transparently.
sentenceZh: 審計委員會確認所有投標提案均受到公正且透明的評估。

collocations: restore consumer faith (恢復消費者信心)
tip: 合約法規中極常出現 'in good faith'（本著善意/誠信原則），在商業危機公關中常考 'restore faith'。
sentence: Both parties agreed to negotiate in good faith to resolve the licensing dispute out of court.
sentenceZh: 雙方同意本著誠信原則進行協商，以在庭外解決授權爭端。

zh: 忠實的，守信的；忠於原著的
collocations: a faithful reproduction (逼真的複製品)
remain faithful to the brand (保持對該品牌的忠誠)
tip: 在顧客關係管理題型中可與 'loyal' 互換；描述翻譯或複製時則指準確無誤（accurate）。
sentence: The retailer launched a premium rewards program to show appreciation to its most faithful patrons.
sentenceZh: 該零售商推出高階酬賓計畫，以向其最忠誠的顧客表達感謝。

collocations: demand begins to falter (需求開始衰減)
falter in negotiations (在談判中動搖)
tip: 常用現在分詞 'faltering' 當形容詞修飾 economic growth、sales 或 stock price，表示增長乏力或不穩定。
sentence: Consumer confidence began to falter following the announcement of central bank interest rate hikes.
sentenceZh: 在央行宣布升息之後，消費者信心開始動搖。

tip: 文法必考主被動介系詞：人 be familiar WITH 事（熟悉某事）；事 be familiar TO 人（對某人而言是熟悉的）。
sentence: All new hires must become thoroughly familiar with the internal data security protocols.
sentenceZh: 所有新進員工必須徹底熟悉內部數據安全規範。

collocations: familiarity with local regulations (熟悉當地法規)
gain familiarity with (獲得對...的了解)
a working familiarity (實務操作的熟練度)
tip: 名詞搭配介系詞固定為 'with'，招聘啟事（Job Posting）中常列為應徵資格條件之一。
sentence: Extensive familiarity with spreadsheet modeling and pivot tables is highly desirable for this analyst position.
sentenceZh: 具備對試算表建模與樞紐分析表的深入熟練度，是此分析師職位非常看重的條件。

collocations: familiarize staff with procedures (使員工熟悉流程)
tip: 極高頻出現在員工培訓手冊中，90% 考法為反身代名詞結構：'familiarize oneself with + N'。
sentence: Before starting your first shift, please familiarize yourself with the emergency evacuation blueprint.
sentenceZh: 在開始第一次輪班前，請先讓自己熟悉緊急疏散動線圖。

collocations: airfare / train fare (機票費/火車票價)
tip: 多益常考易混淆費用辨析：fare 專指交通工具搭乘費用；fee 指專業服務費/入場費；tuition 指學費；fine 指罰款。
sentence: The regional transit authority announced a modest increase in bus fares effective next month.
sentenceZh: 區域交通管理局宣布，公車票價自下個月起將微幅調漲。

tip: 常用作名詞修飾另一個名詞（如 farewell luncheon 歡送午宴），常出現在內部電郵邀請函中，涉及員工退休或離職。
sentence: Management invites the entire department to join the farewell luncheon honoring Mr. Davis this Friday.
sentenceZh: 管理層邀請全體部門同仁參加本週五為戴維斯先生舉辦的榮退歡送午宴。

tip: 除指傳統農業農場外，綠能題型常考 'wind farm / solar farm'；商業片語 'farm out' 意同於 outsource（外包）。
sentence: The catering company procures all fresh dairy and seasonal vegetables directly from a certified organic farm.
sentenceZh: 該外燴公司直接從經過認證的有機農場採購所有新鮮乳製品與當季蔬菜。

collocations: fascinate the audience (深深吸引觀眾)
tip: 感情動詞考點：形容人用過去分詞 'be fascinated by'；形容事物用現在分詞 'fascinating'（令人著迷的）。
sentence: The keynote speaker managed to fascinate the audience with pioneering insights into renewable technology.
sentenceZh: 主講人憑藉對可再生科技的前瞻見解，深深吸引了在場所有聽眾。

collocations: hold a fascination for (對...極具吸引力)
tip: 名詞後面習慣接介系詞 'with'（表示某人對某事熱衷）或 'for'（表示某事對某人有吸引力）。
sentence: The growing consumer fascination with wearable wellness devices has driven double-digit sales growth.
sentenceZh: 消費者對穿戴式健康監測設備日益濃厚的興趣，推動了兩位數的銷售成長。

tip: 商務英語極常考片語 'in a ... fashion'，相當於 'in a ... manner / way'（如 in a professional fashion 專業地）。
sentence: Customer support inquiries must be handled in a polite and timely fashion by all representatives.
sentenceZh: 所有客服專員必須以禮貌且及時的方式處理顧客諮詢。

tip: 常出現在零售廣告或商務旅行住宿周邊環境介紹中，與 stylish 或 trendy 為同義字。
sentence: The brand flagship store is strategically situated in the city's most fashionable shopping district.
sentenceZh: 該品牌的旗艦店策略性地坐落於全城最時髦繁華的購物商圈。

tip: fast 本身既是形容詞也是副詞，英文中絕無 'fastly' 這個字，Part 5 詞性填空題請特別注意避免選錯。
sentence: Job candidates must demonstrate the capability to adapt to our fast-paced corporate environment.
sentenceZh: 求職者必須展現出適應我們快節奏企業環境的能力。

collocations: fasten the tags to (將標籤固定於...)
tip: 聽力 Part 1/2 機上廣播與安全須知必考詞彙，字母 't' 不發音（/ˈfæs.ən/），同義替換常為 secure 或 attach。
sentence: All passengers are advised to keep their seatbelts fastened whenever the cabin sign is illuminated.
sentenceZh: 建議所有乘客只要客艙指示燈亮起，便應保持安全帶繫緊狀態。

zh: 致命的，毀滅性的，災難性的
collocations: fatal error (毀滅性錯誤，致命失誤)
tip: 商務文章中常用於引申義，如 'a fatal mistake in financial modeling'（財務建模中的重大毀滅性錯誤）。
sentence: A failure to conduct adequate market research proved to be a fatal flaw in the product launch strategy.
sentenceZh: 未能進行充分的市場調研，被證明是本次產品發表策略中的致命缺陷。

collocations: decide the fate of (決定...的命運)
share the same fate (面臨同樣命運)
tip: 常出現在公司併購、瀕臨破產或大型專案審批的閱讀測驗中，表示最終結果。
sentence: The fate of the proposed merger hinges upon the antitrust regulator's formal ruling next month.
sentenceZh: 這起擬議合併案的命運取決於反壟斷監管機構下個月的正式裁決。

collocations: visit one's father-in-law (探望公公/岳父)
family emergency involving a father-in-law (涉及公公/岳父的家庭緊急突發事件)
tip: 注意複數形式是在名詞主體加 s，為 fathers-in-law，多益偶爾在人事請假（Bereavement Leave 喪假或 Family Medical Leave）情境中出現。
sentence: Under company benefits, employees may take compassionate leave upon the death of an immediate relative or father-in-law.
sentenceZh: 根據公司福利政策，直系親屬或岳父/公公過世時，員工可申請喪假。

tip: 在工安規範與員工身心健康題材中極常考，如工廠排班限制旨在避免 'worker fatigue' 引發工傷。
sentence: Safety inspectors concluded that prolonged employee fatigue contributed substantially to the operational breakdown.
sentenceZh: 工安檢查員認定，員工長時間的過度疲勞是導致此次操作事故的主因。

tip: 常考片語 'be at fault'（某人/某方應承擔責任）；與 default（違約/預設）拼法相似但意義完全不同，切勿混淆。
sentence: Neither the shipping provider nor the vendor admitted to being at fault for the damaged consignment.
sentenceZh: 貨運承包商和供應商均未承認對該批受損貨物負有過失責任。

zh: 有缺點的，有故障的，瑕疵的
collocations: replace a faulty item (更換瑕疵商品)
tip: 客訴信函（Complaint Letter）中表示瑕疵品的最高頻單字，同義詞為 defective 或 damaged。
sentence: Customers are entitled to a full refund or a free replacement if the purchased electronics prove faulty upon arrival.
sentenceZh: 顧客若發現收到的電子產品有瑕疵，有權要求全額退款或免費更換。

zh: 恩惠，好意；(v.) 偏愛，支持
collocations: favor one proposal over another (偏好某提案甚於另一提案)
tip: 多益 Part 5 片語大熱門：'in favor of'（支持、贊同），常考介系詞 of 的填空或與 approve of 互換。
sentence: The majority of the shareholders voted in favor of the board's proposed restructuring scheme.
sentenceZh: 大多數股東投票贊成董事會提出的重組方案。

collocations: favorable market conditions (有利的市場環境)
tip: 常見雙重語境：在顧客評價中指「正面的、稱讚的」（positive）；在財務合約中指「划算的、優惠的」（advantageous）。
sentence: The flagship smartphone garnered exceptionally favorable reviews from industry tech analysts.
sentenceZh: 這款旗艦智慧型手機獲得了業界科技分析師極為正面的評價。

zh: 最喜愛的；(n.) 最受歡迎的人事物
collocations: customer favorite (顧客最喜愛的產品)
local favorite (當地人最喜愛的名店)
tip: 形容詞前常與名詞直接連用，在廣告宣傳品中常作為名詞片語（如 crowd favorite 大眾最愛）。
sentence: Due to its reliability and low operating costs, the hybrid sedan has remained an enduring customer favorite.
sentenceZh: 由於其可靠性及低營運成本，這款油電混合房車一直是深受顧客青睞的首選。

collocations: send via fax (透過傳真發送)
tip: 雖然科技日新月異，但在醫療或法律專利合約中，多益仍偶爾出現用 fax 傳遞簽署文件的老派情境題。
sentence: Please sign the attached non-disclosure agreement and fax it back to our legal department by noon.
sentenceZh: 請簽署所附的保密合約，並於中午前將其傳真回我們的法務部門。

zh: 恐懼，擔憂；(v.) 畏懼，擔心
collocations: fear a recession (擔心經濟衰退)
tip: 片語 'for fear of + N/Ving' 或 'for fear that + S + V' 常考在原因狀語從屬子句中，表示「擔心/生怕發生某事」。
sentence: Investors hesitated to commit capital for fear of impending interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve.
sentenceZh: 由於擔心聯準會即將升息，投資人對於挹注資金猶豫不決。

tip: 固定複合名詞 'feasibility study' 是多益長篇閱讀（專案企劃案、建廠評估）的核心考點。
sentence: The engineering team conducted a comprehensive feasibility study before commencing drilling operations.
sentenceZh: 工程團隊在開始鑽探作業之前，先進行了一項全面的可行性研究。

collocations: a feasible alternative (可行的替代方案)
tip: 常與 viable 或 practical 作為同義字互換。常被副詞如 economically, technically, financially 修飾。
sentence: Given the strict budgetary constraints, outsourcing the software development seems the most feasible option.
sentenceZh: 考量到嚴格的預算限制，將軟體開發外包似乎是目前最可行的選擇。

zh: 盛宴，筵席；(v.) 盡情享用
collocations: a lavish feast (豐盛奢華的筵席)
feast on gourmet cuisine (盡情享用美食)
tip: 在多益年終晚會（Gala dinner / Annual banquet）或餐飲邀請函中，常作為 banquet 的文雅替換詞。
sentence: Attendees at the annual charity banquet enjoyed a four-course feast prepared by a Michelin-starred chef.
sentenceZh: 參加年度慈善晚宴的嘉賓盡情享用了由米其林星級主廚操刀的四道式盛宴。

collocations: no mean feat (絕非易事，了不起的成就)
an impressive feat (令人印象深刻的壯舉)
tip: 雙重否定片語 'no mean feat'（很不簡單、極大成就）在聽力 Part 4 公司簡介或得獎感言中經常出現。
sentence: Completing the skyscraper three months ahead of schedule was regarded as an unprecedented engineering feat.
sentenceZh: 比預定工期提前三個月完工該摩天大樓，被視為一項前所未有的工程壯舉。

zh: 特色，特徵；(v.) 以...為特色，由...主演/主講
collocations: feature a special guest (邀請特別來賓)
tip: 高頻雙詞性：作動詞時表示「以...為特色/主打」（如 The conference features keynote speakers...）；作名詞常指產品的機能或規格。
sentence: The upcoming corporate summit will feature distinguished keynote addresses by leading economic strategists.
sentenceZh: 即將召開的企業高峰會將以頂尖經濟策略專家的精彩專題演講為主要亮點。

collocations: federal funding (聯邦撥款/政府補助金)
tip: 閱讀題涉及政府招標、法律稅務或政府停擺時極常見，常與 local（地方的）或 municipal（市級的）形成層級對比。
sentence: All manufacturing facilities must adhere strictly to revised federal emission and environmental guidelines.
sentenceZh: 所有生產設施均必須嚴格遵守修訂後的聯邦碳排與環境指導方針。

tip: 專門指專業服務、機構或手續所收取的費用（如 membership fee, processing fee, legal fee），切勿與 fare（車資）混淆。
sentence: Clients will incur an additional processing fee if payments are submitted past the designated due date.
sentenceZh: 若款項在指定的截止日期之後才繳納，客戶將被收取額外的手續費。

zh: 餵養；輸入，提供；(n.) 動態消息，資訊摘要
collocations: feed data into the system (將數據輸入系統)
live video feed (現場即時視訊轉播)
tip: 在 Office Technology 中，'feed ... into' 意為把數據或紙張饋入設備中；作名詞常指社交媒體或監視器的即時串流。
sentence: Technicians must ensure that paper feeds smoothly through the high-volume industrial printing unit.
sentenceZh: 技術人員必須確保紙張能順暢地通過這部高容量工業列印設備。

tip: 不可數名詞！多益絕對不考 feedbacks，修飾它時要用 some, much, valuable，不能加不定冠詞 a，此為文法除錯必考題。
sentence: The marketing team actively solicited customer feedback through an online post-purchase survey.
sentenceZh: 行銷團隊透過線上購買後滿意度調查，積極徵集顧客的回饋意見。

zh: 同儕的，同類的；(n.) 同事，研究員
tip: 當形容詞用來修飾同屬一團體的人，如 fellow workers，強調同一陣營或階層。
sentence: Please coordinate with your fellow colleagues to ensure adequate office coverage during the holidays.
sentenceZh: 請與您的同仁相互協調，以確保連續假期期間辦公室有足夠的留守人力。

zh: 團體關係；研究員職位，獎學金
collocations: research fellowship (研究獎學金/研究員職位)
postdoctoral fellowship (博士後研究獎學金)
tip: 多益常出現在學術機構、非營利組織或研發部門的履歷徵才中，指資助特定研究專案的職位或獎金。
sentence: Dr. Zhao was awarded a prestigious research fellowship to study sustainable urban architecture in Zurich.
sentenceZh: 趙博士榮獲一項享有盛譽的研究獎學金，將前往蘇黎世從事永續城市建築研究。

tip: 多益常出現在多元共融（Diversity, Equity & Inclusion, DEI）或人口統計分析的文章中，修飾職業通常用 female（如 female entrepreneur）。
sentence: The corporation is committed to increasing female representation across its senior executive leadership.
sentenceZh: 該企業致力於提高女性在高階執行主管階層中的代表比例。

collocations: feminine hygiene products (女性衛生用品)
tip: 與 female（生物學/性別分類）不同，feminine 多側重於文化、風格、審美或傳統女性氣質特徵。
sentence: The boutique's latest spring collection emphasizes soft pastel colors and distinctly feminine silhouettes.
sentenceZh: 這間精品店最新的春季系列強調柔和的粉彩色系以及線條分明的柔美剪裁。

collocations: ferry commuters across the bay (擺渡通勤者過海灣)
tip: 在商務差旅或大眾運輸閱讀題中常考時刻表（schedule）與轉乘接駁，ferry terminal 常是行程的中轉節點。
sentence: A complimentary shuttle bus operates between the downtown hotel and the commuter ferry terminal.
sentenceZh: 市中心飯店與通勤渡輪碼頭之間提供免費的接駁接送服務。

collocations: enhance soil fertility (提高土壤肥沃度)
tip: 農業科技（Agri-tech）或總體經濟人口統計題型常考詞彙，注意常考名詞搭配 'fertility rate'（生育率）。
sentence: Sustainable crop rotation methods have been demonstrated to restore soil fertility without chemical additives.
sentenceZh: 實踐永續的輪作方式已被證實能在不使用化學添加劑的情況下恢復土壤肥力。

tip: 及物動詞，主詞為農場管理者或機器，受詞通常為土地、農作物。常出現在農業或園藝景觀保養題材。
sentence: Groundskeepers fertilize the corporate campus gardens twice every spring to promote vigorous foliage growth.
sentenceZh: 園藝管理人員每年春季會為企業園區花園施肥兩次，以促進枝葉茂盛生長。

tip: 常搭配動詞 'apply fertilizer'（施用肥料），在環境採購政策與農業供應鏈題材中頻繁露臉。
sentence: The eco-resort has entirely phased out chemical fertilizers in favor of natural composting alternatives.
sentenceZh: 這間生態度假村已全面淘汰化學肥料，改採天然堆肥替代方案。

collocations: food and wine festival (美食美酒節)
tip: 常出現在當地社區活動公告、旅遊指南或員工福利公告中，通常伴隨贊助（sponsorship）議題考出。
sentence: Our corporate foundation proudly serves as the headline sponsor for this year’s international jazz festival.
sentenceZh: 我們的企業基金會自豪地擔任今年國際爵士音樂節的首席冠名贊助商。

collocations: fetch a high price (售得高價)
fetch a handsome profit (帶來豐厚利潤)
tip: 商務拍賣或資產處分情境中，'fetch + 價格' 意思是「賣得……價錢」（同義於 sell for），為高分閱讀必備字。
sentence: The rare vintage posters fetched far more at auction than initial valuations had anticipated.
sentenceZh: 這批稀有的復古海報在拍賣會上售出的價格，遠高於最初估價的預期。

collocations: cabin fever (閉門太久引發的焦躁不安)
gold fever / buying fever (淘金狂熱/搶購熱潮)
tip: 在員工病假（Sick Leave）郵件中極常見，如 'I am running a fever and will be unable to report to work.'
sentence: Employees experiencing symptoms such as a persistent cough or high fever are urged to work remotely.
sentenceZh: 凡出現持續咳嗽或發高燒等症狀的員工，強烈建議在家遠距辦公。

zh: 聚焦，專注；(n.) 焦點，重點
collocations: focus on core competencies (專注於核心競爭力)
focus group (焦點小組/訪談群組)
tip: 不及物動詞固定接介系詞 on，與 concentrate on 同義；市場研究中的 'focus group'（焦點座談會）是行銷題常考概念。
sentence: The revised marketing initiative will focus primarily on expanding our digital footprint among younger consumers.
sentenceZh: 修訂後的行銷企劃將主要聚焦於擴大我們在年輕消費族群中的數位影響力。

collocations: fold the brochure (折疊宣傳手冊)
tip: 多益 Part 1 常考圖片題描述（如 He is folding a document），商業語境中若指公司 'fold' 則表示倒閉停業。
sentence: Before inserting the newsletters into the envelopes, please fold them neatly along the marked dotted line.
sentenceZh: 將通訊簡報裝入信封前，請沿著標記的虛線將其整齊對折。

tip: 既可指辦公室實體文具（如 manila folder），也可指電腦作業系統中的雲端共享資料夾（shared network folder）。
sentence: All workshop attendees will receive a complimentary informational folder containing speaker biographies and agenda sheets.
sentenceZh: 所有研討會出席者都將收到一份裝有講者簡介和議程表的免費資訊文件夾。

zh: 預測，預報；(v.) 預測，預報
collocations: forecast future earnings (預測未來獲利)
tip: 三態同形（forecast-forecast-forecast，亦可作 forecasted）。在財務預算情境中，'sales/revenue forecast' 極常被考出。
sentence: Financial analysts forecast a steady recovery in international passenger traffic over the coming quarters.
sentenceZh: 財務分析師預測未來幾季國際客運流量將會穩定復甦。

zh: 外國的，外來的；不熟悉的
tip: 外匯高頻詞為 'foreign exchange'（常縮寫為 Forex 或 FX）；與 domestic（國內的）經常在營收來源分析中作為對比。
sentence: Volatility in foreign currency exchange rates impacted the manufacturer's overseas quarterly revenue.
sentenceZh: 外幣匯率的劇烈波動影響了該製造商海外季度的營收表現。

zh: 最首要的，最重要的，最頂尖的
collocations: first and foremost (首先，首要的是)
world's foremost provider (全球首屈一指的供應商)
tip: 多益聽力與閱讀常見轉折片語 'first and foremost'（首要之務）；修飾學者專家時意同 leading 或 prominent。
sentence: First and foremost, workplace safety measures must take absolute precedence over hitting production quotas.
sentenceZh: 首要之務，工作場所的安全防護措施必須絕對優先於達到生產配額。

collocations: foresee any difficulties (預見任何困難)
in the foreseeable future (在可預見的未來內)
tip: 動詞三態為 foresee, foresaw, foreseen。形容詞衍生片語 'in the foreseeable future' 是閱讀測驗的大熱門句型。
sentence: The chief financial officer does not foresee any liquidity shortages during the ongoing factory expansion.
sentenceZh: 財務長並未預見在目前的建廠擴建期間會出現任何流動資金短缺情況。

zh: 表格；形式；(v.) 形成，成立
collocations: fill out / complete a form (填寫表格)
tip: 填寫表格的動詞搭配極愛考：fill out, complete, fill in；動詞用法表示組建委員會（form a committee）或夥伴關係。
sentence: Please ensure that every section of the vendor registration form is completed in legible black ink.
sentenceZh: 請確保廠商登記表格的每一欄位均以清晰易讀的黑色墨水填寫完整。

zh: 正式的，禮儀上的，正規的
tip: 服裝規定（dress code）中，'formal attire' 意指正裝西服，與 casual（休閒）或 business casual（商務休閒）相對。
sentence: The executive committee will issue a formal announcement regarding the merger early tomorrow morning.
sentenceZh: 執行委員會將於明晨就此合併案正式發布公告。

zh: 格式，版式；(v.) 編排格式
tip: 常出現在 IT 指示或電子郵件寄送附件的說明中，如要求將簡報轉為 PDF 格式儲存。
sentence: All quarterly expenditure spreadsheets must strictly adhere to the revised departmental template format.
sentenceZh: 所有季度支出試算表均必須嚴格遵循修訂後的部門公版格式。

zh: 格式化過的，編排好格式的
collocations: properly formatted document (排版得當的文件)
formatted drive (已格式化的磁碟機)
tip: 多益 Part 5 常考由過去分詞轉作形容詞的題型，修飾報告、表格或檔案結構。
sentence: Resumes submitted as correctly formatted PDF documents are processed much faster by our applicant tracking system.
sentenceZh: 以正確排版之 PDF 格式提交的履歷表，由我們的人才應徵追蹤系統處理的速度會快得多。

tip: 複數形可為 formulas 或 formulae。在製造業多指原料配方（proprietary formula），商管文章中多引申為成功之道。
sentence: Dedication to customer satisfaction and agile delivery models have proven to be the firm's winning formula.
sentenceZh: 致力於顧客滿意度與敏捷交付模式，已被證明是該公司克敵致勝的成功法則。

collocations: formulate a contingency plan (擬定應變計畫)
formulate a policy (制定方針政策)
tip: 多益高頻商務及物動詞，比 make 或 plan 更正式，受詞極常搭配 plan, strategy, policy 或 proposal。
sentence: The strategic task force met over the weekend to formulate an aggressive counter-marketing strategy.
sentenceZh: 策略專案小組利用週末開會，以制定積極的市場反制策略。

collocations: be fortunate to have (慶幸擁有)
tip: 句型常考 'be fortunate to do sth'，在演講感謝詞或年報總裁信件中常用於表達謙遜與感激。
sentence: We are extremely fortunate to secure such an experienced project lead for our international rollout.
sentenceZh: 我們非常幸運能為這次的跨國推廣計畫爭取到如此經驗豐富的專案領導人。

collocations: fortunately, no one was injured (所幸無人受傷)
arrived fortunately on time (幸運地及時抵達)
tip: 常用作句首副詞（Sentence Adverb），後面用逗號隔開整句，引導危機化解的好消息（與 Luckily 同義）。
sentence: Fortunately, the backup servers kicked in immediately, preventing any catastrophic data loss during the blackout.
sentenceZh: 幸運的是，備份伺服器立即啟動運作，避免了停電期間發生災難性的數據遺失。

collocations: amass a fortune (累積巨額財富)
cost a fortune (花費鉅資/代價不菲)
tip: 片語 'cost a fortune' 表示極其昂貴；'Fortune 500' 是多益商務文章中最常提及的全球大企業指稱詞。
sentence: Upgrading the entire company fleet to electric vehicles will undoubtedly cost a fortune in upfront capital.
sentenceZh: 將公司整個車隊全面升級為電動車，無疑在前期資本上將耗費鉅資。

collocations: open forum (公開座談/開放討論時段)
online discussion forum (線上討論論壇)
tip: 在議程表（Agenda）中，'open forum' 專指開放與會者自由提問發言的 Q&A 互動環節。
sentence: The international trade forum provides an invaluable venue for networking among industry pioneers.
sentenceZh: 這場國際貿易論壇為業界先驅之間的交流與人脈建立提供了極為珍貴的平台。

zh: 轉寄，轉交；(adv.) 向前；(adj.) 前進的
collocations: forward an email to (將電子郵件轉寄給...)
move forward with the plan (推進計畫)
tip: 雙重必考重點：1. 電郵中 'forward A to B'（轉寄）；2. 片語 'look forward to' 的 'to' 為介系詞，後面必須接動名詞 V-ing 或名詞！
sentence: I have forwarded the audited balance sheets to our external tax consultants for immediate verification.
sentenceZh: 我已將經審計的資產負債表轉寄給我們的外部稅務顧問，以便立即進行查證。

collocations: lay the foundation for (為...奠定基礎)
tip: 常考比喻用法 'lay a solid foundation for'（為未來的成功打下堅實基礎），亦常指企業附設的非營利慈善基金會。
sentence: The grant provided by the corporate foundation will sponsor technical vocational training for local youths.
sentenceZh: 該企業基金會提供的補助金將用來贊助當地青年的技術職訓計畫。

zh: 創辦人，創始人；(v.) 沉沒，失敗
tip: 多益商業背景介紹（Company Profile）核心詞彙，常與 CEO、President 等現任主管職位做時間軸對比題。
sentence: The late founder’s guiding principles of integrity and craftsmanship remain the bedrock of our company culture.
sentenceZh: 已故創辦人所秉持的誠信與精湛工藝準則，至今仍是我們企業文化的基石。

collocations: at a fraction of the cost (僅需原本費用的一小部分)
a small fraction of (極小部分的)
tip: 行銷促銷廣告極愛考搭配片語：'at a fraction of the original price/cost'（以極低廉的小部分代價）。
sentence: The cloud-based software enables small enterprises to achieve enterprise efficiency at a fraction of the typical setup cost.
sentenceZh: 該雲端軟體使小型企業能以傳統建置成本的一小部分代價，實現企業級的營運效率。

zh: 框架，架構；(v.) 制定，擬定，框住
tip: 在專案管理中，'time frame'（時程期限）是高頻複合名詞；動詞常考 'frame an argument/question'（構思/提出論點）。
sentence: We must complete the software migration within the agreed two-week time frame to avoid disrupting operations.
sentenceZh: 我們必須在雙方約定的兩週時間期限內完成軟體轉移，以避免干擾營運。

collocations: regulatory framework (法規架構/監管體系)
within the framework of (在...的框架體系內)
tip: 常出現在法規遵循（Compliance）或策略規劃篇章中，如 'regulatory/legal framework' 指一整套完整的法令機制。
sentence: The cross-border partnership was established strictly within the legal framework governing multinational commerce.
sentenceZh: 該跨國合作夥伴關係嚴格在規範跨國貿易的法律框架之內建立。

zh: 特許經營權，加盟店；(v.) 賦予特許經銷權
tip: 連鎖零售餐飲常考字。留意衍生詞 franchisee（加盟店主/受特許人）與 franchisor（特許加盟總部）。
sentence: The fast-casual restaurant chain plans to grant exclusive regional franchise rights to reputable operators in Asia.
sentenceZh: 這家休閒快餐連鎖品牌計劃將亞洲區的獨家區域加盟特許權授予信譽良好的營運商。

zh: 加盟授權商，特許經營總部
collocations: support from the franchisor (來自總部的支援)
the franchisor's guidelines (特許總部的指導綱領)
notify the franchisor (通知加盟授權總部)
tip: 字尾 -or 表示給予權利者（主動方），與字尾 -ee 表示接受者（被動方 franchisee 加盟主）在合約題中是必考的角色辨析。
sentence: Under the contract terms, the franchisor must provide comprehensive employee training and supply chain backing.
sentenceZh: 根據合約條款，特許加盟總部必須提供全面的員工培訓及供應鏈支援。

zh: 坦率的，坦誠的，直截了當的
collocations: frank exchange of views (開誠布公地交換意見)
tip: 在會議紀要（Minutes）或高層訪談中，常用 'frank discussion' 表示各方把問題攤開講、不避重就輕的實質協商。
sentence: During the debriefing, the department heads held a frank exchange regarding why quarterly targets were missed.
sentenceZh: 在檢討會議期間，各部門主管就為何未達成季度目標進行了坦誠的意見交換。

tip: 多益聽力 Part 3/4 對話極常作轉折語使用：'Quite frankly, our current inventory cannot meet this sudden surge in demand.'
sentence: Quite frankly, we simply do not possess the manufacturing bandwidth to accept such an expansive order right now.
sentenceZh: 坦白說，我們目前根本沒有足夠的產能頻寬來承接如此龐大的訂單。

tip: 法律與金融合規高頻字。常出現在網路安全、銀行警報或稽核報告中，是不可數的犯罪名稱，但指騙局時可數。
sentence: The bank promptly deployed advanced machine learning algorithms to detect and mitigate online credit card fraud.
sentenceZh: 該銀行迅速部署了先進的機器學習演算法，以偵測並防範線上信用卡詐欺行為。

collocations: fraudulent claims (詐領款項/虛假索賠)
tip: Part 5 詞性題中常考形容詞 fraudulent 修飾 transactions 或 activities，與 illegal, deceptive 語意相通。
sentence: The insurance investigator identified several fraudulent claims submitted with falsified medical invoices.
sentenceZh: 保險調查員識別出數起附帶偽造醫療單據進行申請的詐領理賠案。

zh: 免費的；空閒的，自由的；(v.) 釋放
tip: 多益促銷信件極常考片語 'free of charge'（完全免費）或字尾合成詞（如 interest-free 免息的、duty-free 免稅的）。
sentence: All registered seminar participants are eligible to receive a complimentary lunch voucher free of charge.
sentenceZh: 所有完成註冊的研討會參加者均有資格免費獲贈一張午餐兌換券。

collocations: greater freedom to innovate (更大的創新自由度)
freedom from interference (不受干涉的自由)
tip: 在企業管理文章中，常指賦予員工決策自由度（freedom to make decisions / autonomy）。
sentence: Remote work arrangements afford employees greater freedom to balance their personal and professional commitments.
sentenceZh: 遠距工作安排讓員工享有更大的自由度，以平衡其個人生活與工作職責。

collocations: air freight / sea freight (空運/海運)
tip: 物流專業核心單字。'freight charges'（運費）與 'freight forwarder'（貨代公司）在進出口貿易情境中幾乎每回必考。
sentence: The logistics contract explicitly states that international ocean freight charges are included in the quote.
sentenceZh: 物流合約中明確註明國際海運費已包含在報價之中。

collocations: with increasing frequency (越來越頻繁地)
frequency of flights (航班班次頻率)
tip: 片語 'with alarming/increasing frequency'（以驚人/與日俱增的頻率）常出現在市場動態或環境變化的閱讀測驗中。
sentence: The municipal railway decided to increase the frequency of express trains during morning peak commuting hours.
sentenceZh: 市營鐵路決定在晨間通勤尖峰時段增加直達特快車的發車頻率。

zh: 頻繁的，經常的；(v.) 常去，常光顧
collocations: frequent flyer program (飛行常客酬賓計畫)
tip: 航空旅宿題必考 'frequent flyer program'（常客里程計畫）；作及物動詞時表示光顧（frequent local restaurants）。
sentence: Enrollment in our airline's frequent flyer program allows passengers to redeem earned miles for ticket upgrades.
sentenceZh: 註冊加入我們航空公司的飛行常客酬賓計畫，讓旅客能使用累積的哩程兌換機票升等。

tip: 官網或客服指南中最著名的縮寫 'FAQ' 即來自 'Frequently Asked Questions'。常與現在簡單式連用表示習慣性動作。
sentence: Before submitting an email inquiry, please consult the FAQ section on our website to see if your query is covered.
sentenceZh: 在寄送電子郵件諮詢之前，請先查閱我們網站上的常見問題專區，確認您的問題是否已有說明。

collocations: frighten away potential buyers (嚇跑潛在買家)
tip: 商務中常以片語動詞 'frighten away/off'（嚇跑投資者或消費者）考出，同義詞為 deter 或 scare away。
sentence: Unexpected hidden processing fees at checkout can easily frighten away first-time online shoppers.
sentenceZh: 結帳時意外出現的隱藏手續費很容易嚇跑首次進行線上購物的買家。

zh: 燃料；(v.) 為...加燃料；助長，刺激
collocations: fuel economic growth (刺激經濟成長)
tip: 在差旅報銷中常考 'fuel surcharge'（燃油附加費）；作動詞時常考引申義（如 lower interest rates fuel spending 降息刺激消費）。
sentence: Rising international crude prices have forced airline carriers to impose a supplementary fuel surcharge.
sentenceZh: 國際原油價格的上漲迫使各家航空公司徵收額外的燃油附加費。

collocations: fueled by strong demand (受到強勁需求推動)
debt-fueled expansion (靠舉債推動的擴張)
tip: 多益 Part 5/7 常以被動分詞形式修飾名詞或作主詞補語，表達經濟現象或營收增長的驅動來源（propelled by）。
sentence: The tech firm's historic stock rally was largely fueled by stellar enterprise cloud subscription revenue.
sentenceZh: 該科技公司歷史性的股價大漲，主要是受到亮眼的企業雲端訂閱營收所推動。

zh: 功能；盛大集會；(v.) 運作，運行
collocations: attend a corporate function (參加公司正式宴會)
tip: 考點一：名詞作「公務社交盛會/宴會」（formal event/party）；考點二：作不及物動詞修飾設備運轉狀況（同義於 operate/work）。
sentence: The ballroom was reserved exclusively on Thursday evening for an official corporate networking function.
sentenceZh: 宴會廳在週四晚間被整場預訂，專門用於舉辦一場官方的企業人脈交流盛會。

collocations: smoothly functioning system (平穩運行的系統)
tip: 常與副詞 fully 或 properly 搭配修飾機器、軟體或部門機制，確認設備已修復完畢可供上線使用。
sentence: Following routine maintenance by IT, all checkout terminals are now fully functioning once again.
sentenceZh: 在資訊部門完成例行維護之後，所有的收銀機台目前均已再次完全恢復正常運作。

zh: 專款，資金；(v.) 資助，提供資金
collocations: insufficient funds (資金不足/存款不足)
tip: 作名詞常考銀行支票退票理由 'insufficient funds'（存款不足/跳票）；作動詞與 finance, subsidize 同義。
sentence: The municipal authority has pledged to fund the construction of a high-speed commuter rail link.
sentenceZh: 市政當局已承諾將撥款資助一條高速通勤鐵路線的建設工程。

zh: 基礎的，根本的，至關重要的
collocations: play a fundamental role (扮演不可或缺的角色)
tip: 商管分析中常考與 basic, crucial 互換；名詞複數 fundamentals 則指經濟或企業體質的「基本面」。
sentence: A fundamental understanding of customer demographics is indispensable for crafting persuasive advertising campaigns.
sentenceZh: 對顧客人口統計特徵有根本性的了解，是打造具說服力廣告行銷活動不可或缺的基石。

tip: 不可數名詞！多益絕對不考 a funding 或 fundings。常與動詞 secure, allocate, obtain, cut 搭配出題。
sentence: The biotech startup successfully secured five million dollars in venture capital funding to launch clinical trials.
sentenceZh: 這間生技新創公司成功籌措到五百萬美元的創投資金，以展開臨床試驗。

collocations: annual charity fundraiser (年度慈善募款餐會)
host a fundraiser (舉辦募款活動)
tip: 可數名詞，在多益題型中 90% 指募款宴會/活動（event），常與 ticket sales 或 charitable causes 相關題材結合。
sentence: Tickets for the non-profit organization's annual gala fundraiser sold out within forty-eight hours.
sentenceZh: 該非營利機構主辦的年度慈善晚宴募款活動門票，在四十八小時之內便銷售一空。

collocations: a piece / an item of furniture (一件家具)
tip: 【多益文法大陷阱】不可數名詞！絕對不能寫 a furniture 或 furnitures。表示單件時必須用 'a piece of furniture'。
sentence: The facilities team will deliver and assemble the newly ordered ergonomic office furniture over the weekend.
sentenceZh: 總務設施團隊將於週末期間運送並組裝新訂購的人體工學辦公家具。

zh: 進一步的；(adv.) 更進一步地；(v.) 促進，推動
collocations: for further information (欲知進一步詳情)
without further delay (事不宜遲/不再拖延)
further one's career (增進個人職涯發展)
tip: 信件結尾黃金考點：'If you have further questions / require further assistance...'；動詞用法表示推進（promote）。
sentence: Please do not hesitate to contact our representative should you require any further clarification regarding the estimate.
sentenceZh: 若您對這份估價單需要任何進一步的澄清說明，請隨時與我們的專員聯繫。

zh: 冒險，投機，賭博；(v.) 冒險，打賭
collocations: take a gamble on (在...上冒險一搏)
a risky gamble (高風險的冒險嘗試)
gamble with investors' capital (拿投資人的資本冒險)
tip: 商務文章中通常用於引申義，指在未經完整風險評估下投入資源的冒險行為（同義於 risky venture）。
sentence: Launching an unproven product line in a saturated market is seen by industry analysts as a perilous gamble.
sentenceZh: 在飽和的市場中推出未經證實的新產品線，被業界分析師視為一場危險的孤注一擲。

collocations: bridge / close the gap (縮小/彌補差距)
market gap (市場缺口/未被滿足的市場需求)
tip: 常考搭配動詞 'bridge/narrow the gap'（縮減差距）；面試招聘中常談到如何解釋求職者履歷上的 'gap in employment'。
sentence: The proposed technical mentoring initiative is specifically designed to close the digital skills gap within the workforce.
sentenceZh: 這項擬議的技術導師培訓計畫，專門旨在彌補現有員工隊伍中的數位技能落差。

collocations: dispose of garbage (清理/丟棄垃圾)
tip: 不可數名詞。在物業管理或工廠規範中，常與 trash, waste, refuse 作為同義字互相替換。
sentence: Tenants are requested to place all household garbage into designated dumpsters behind the complex by 8:00 P.M.
sentenceZh: 請住戶於晚間八點前將所有生活垃圾丟置於園區大樓後方的專用大型垃圾子母車中。

tip: 多益常考易混淆名詞：clothing（不可數總稱）；clothes（恆為複數）；garment（標準可數名詞，單數可加 a，複數可加 s）。
sentence: All operators entering the cleanroom facility must wear specialized sterile garments and safety goggles.
sentenceZh: 所有進入無塵室設施的操作人員均必須穿著專用無菌防護衣並配戴護目鏡。

tip: 美式英語指汽油，常簡稱為 gas；英式英語同義字為 petrol。多益出差報銷單中常列為可核銷費用之一。
sentence: Surging gasoline prices have prompted the logistics department to transition their urban delivery vans to electric fleets.
sentenceZh: 汽油價格的飆漲已促使物流部門將其市區配送廂型車改換為電動車隊。

collocations: gas mileage (耗油量/每加侖行駛哩程)
tip: 水電水費單（Utility bills）常見 'electric and gas services'；汽車情境中 'gas mileage' 表車輛油耗經濟性。
sentence: The industrial plant implemented advanced electronic sensors to detect hazardous gas leaks immediately.
sentenceZh: 該工業廠房加裝了先進的電子感應器，以便能在第一時間偵測到危險氣體外洩。

tip: 機場廣播（Airport Announcement）的核心單字！題目常考某航班因延誤而臨時發生 'gate change'（登機門變更）。
sentence: Passengers bound for Frankfurt are advised that the departure gate has been relocated from Gate 12 to Gate 18B.
sentenceZh: 前往法蘭克福的旅客請注意，該班機的登機門已由 12 號登機門改至 18B 登機門。

zh: 守門員，把關者，基層秘書/總機
collocations: act as a gatekeeper (充當把關者)
bypass the gatekeeper (繞過基層行政接待直接聯絡決策者)
tip: 商業銷售術語中，指在致電公司主管時負責過濾電話的行政助理或總機；在學術出版中指審查把關者。
sentence: The executive administrative assistant acts as a vigilant gatekeeper, screening unscheduled visitor requests.
sentenceZh: 該執行行政助理充當著嚴格的把關者，負責過濾未預約訪客的拜會請求。

zh: 聚集，集合；收集，蒐集；推測
collocations: gather data / information (收集數據/資料)
as far as I can gather (據我所知/推測)
tip: Part 1 常考人物聚集（People have gathered around the table）；商務分析常搭配 'gather market intelligence'（蒐集市場情報）。
sentence: Before finalizing the budget, the financial analyst must gather historical expense records from each division.
sentenceZh: 在敲定預算之前，財務分析師必須先向各部門蒐集歷年支出紀錄。

tip: 常出現在公司內部社交活動（networking event）、團隊建立（team-building）或節慶慶祝通知中。
sentence: The firm hosted an informal networking gathering at an upscale bistro to welcome the summer interns.
sentenceZh: 該公司在一間高檔小餐館舉辦了一場非正式的社交交流聚會，熱情歡迎暑期實習生。

zh: 裝備，用具；齒輪；(v.) 調整使適合
collocations: be geared toward / to (專為...設計/旨在適合...)
tip: 不可數名詞表裝備（protective gear）；極高頻被動片語考點：'be geared toward/to + N'（專門針對/為...量身打造）。
sentence: The upcoming executive seminar is specifically geared toward newly promoted regional sales directors.
sentenceZh: 即將舉辦的高階主管研討會，是專門為新晉升的區域業務總監量身設計的。

collocations: gender pay gap (性別薪資差距)
tip: 多益在人事平等聘僱法規（Equal Opportunity Employer）或企業永續報告（ESG）中常考的指標名詞。
sentence: The human resources task force introduced transparent salary benchmarks to eliminate the existing gender pay gap.
sentenceZh: 人資專案小組推出了透明的薪資標竿基準，以消除現存的性別薪資差距。

collocations: general meeting (股東大會/全體會議)
tip: 公司常務會議常稱為 'Annual General Meeting'（AGM 股東常會）；商務寫作中常用 'general overview' 表宏觀總覽。
sentence: Notice is hereby given that the company’s Annual General Meeting will convene virtually on October 15.
sentenceZh: 特此通知，本公司年度股東常會將於十月十五日以線上視訊形式召開。

zh: 一般而言，通常地，大體上
collocations: generally accepted accounting principles [GAAP] (公認會計準則)
be generally regarded as (被普遍認為是)
tip: 財會題型核心名詞 GAAP 即包含 'Generally Accepted'；作轉折副詞修飾全句時同義於 usually 或 on the whole。
sentence: Financial ledgers must be prepared in strict accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.
sentenceZh: 財務分類帳的編製必須嚴格遵循一般公認會計原則。

zh: 產生，創造（收入/利潤/電力等）
collocations: generate revenue / profits (產生營收/利潤)
generate sales leads (開拓潛在業務線索)
generate clean electricity (產生潔淨電力)
tip: 商業效益核心及物動詞！主詞通常是行銷企劃、新產品或投資案，受詞 90% 為 revenue, interest, profit 或 leads。
sentence: The targeted social media campaign is projected to generate over two million dollars in incremental sales.
sentenceZh: 這項精準投放的社群媒體行銷活動預計將產生超過兩百萬美元的增量銷售額。

collocations: lead generation (潛在客戶名單開發)
tip: 在產品推廣時常用 'next-generation' 作複合形容詞修飾硬體；在綠能科技中指 'wind/solar power generation'。
sentence: The technology giant recently unveiled its next-generation ultra-thin laptops at the consumer electronics expo.
sentenceZh: 這家科技巨頭最近在消費電子展上發表了其次世代超薄筆記型電腦。

collocations: thank someone for their generosity (感謝某人的慷慨解囊)
show great generosity (展現極大慷慨)
tip: 感謝信（Thank-you Letter）必備名詞，多用於非營利機構感謝贊助商或慈善捐助人的開場致謝詞中。
sentence: Thanks to the remarkable generosity of local corporate sponsors, the community library completed its expansion.
sentenceZh: 多虧當地企業贊助商的大力慷慨解囊，社區圖書館得以順利完成擴建。

collocations: generous benefits package (優渥的員工福利待遇)
tip: 招聘廣告中描述福利時常稱 'generous paid time off (PTO) and health insurance'（優渥的帶薪假與健保）。
sentence: In addition to competitive base pay, the company offers a remarkably generous annual performance bonus.
sentenceZh: 除了具競爭力的底薪之外，該公司還提供非常優渥的年度績效獎金。

collocations: a stroke of genius (神來之筆，天才之舉)
tip: 成語搭配 'a stroke of genius' 常在商業專案成功案例的報導中出現，指某個出奇制勝的絕妙策略。
sentence: The marketing director’s decision to rebrand the product via short-form video was widely hailed as a stroke of genius.
sentenceZh: 行銷總監決定透過短影音對產品進行品牌重塑，被外界廣泛讚譽為一記神來之筆。

collocations: gentle reminder (溫馨提示/禮貌提醒)
tip: 多益商務電郵最常用開頭片語：'This is a gentle reminder that...'（此信旨在禮貌提醒您……），能大幅軟化催款或催繳文件的語氣。
sentence: This email serves as a gentle reminder that your annual software membership license will expire in three business days.
sentenceZh: 本郵件旨在溫馨提醒您，您的年度軟體會員授權將於三個工作天後到期。

collocations: ladies and gentlemen (各位女士、各位先生)
a true gentleman (一位真正的紳士)
gentlemen's agreement (君子協定/非正式口頭協議)
tip: 主持演講開場必考招呼語 'Ladies and gentlemen'；合約題目偶爾出現 'gentlemen's agreement'（不具法律拘束力的口頭約定）。
sentence: Ladies and gentlemen, please join me in extending a warm welcome to our guest speaker from Tokyo.
sentenceZh: 各位女士、各位先生，請與我一同熱烈歡迎我們來自東京的特邀演講嘉賓。

zh: 真正的，真誠的，正宗的原廠產品
collocations: genuine replacement parts (正廠替換零件)
tip: 在維修與保固（Warranty）條款中，強調必須使用 'genuine parts'（原廠零件），等同於 authentic，切勿使用仿冒品（counterfeit）。
sentence: To prevent voiding your manufacturer warranty, ensure that only genuine replacement components are installed.
sentenceZh: 為避免原廠保固失效，請確保維修時僅安裝原廠正品替換零組件。

collocations: geographic segmentation (依地理區域的市場區隔)
tip: 常在市場調查（Market Demographics）文章中出現，與 demographic, socioeconomic 並列為市場細分標準。
sentence: The retailer’s ambitious geographic expansion entails inaugurating twenty new outlets throughout Southeast Asia.
sentenceZh: 該零售商雄心勃勃的地域擴張計畫，包含了在全東南亞新開設二十家門市專櫃。

collocations: the geography of the market (市場分佈格局)
tip: 在旅遊會展業指當地的地理環境；在跨國公司管理層報告中可指各個不同區域的業務佈局分佈。
sentence: Understanding the unique commercial geography of the European continent helped the distributor streamline shipping routes.
sentenceZh: 深入了解歐洲大陸獨特的商業地理佈局，協助該經銷商大幅精簡了運輸航線。

collocations: germ of an idea (創意的萌芽)
tip: 在公共衛生與辦公室防疫指南中極常見，常搭配動詞 kill, spread, eliminate；引申義指思想的雛形。
sentence: Office cleaners use hospital-grade disinfectants each evening to effectively eliminate airborne germs and surface viruses.
sentenceZh: 辦公室清潔人員每晚均使用醫療級消毒液，以有效消滅空氣中的病菌及物體表面病毒。

zh: 姿態，表示；手勢；(v.) 做手勢
collocations: as a gesture of goodwill (作為表達善意的姿態)
a welcoming gesture (表示歡迎的舉動)
make a gesture (做出手勢/姿態)
tip: 商務公關黃金搭配：'as a gesture of goodwill / appreciation'（作為表達善意/謝意的表示），多出現在贈送優惠券或退費信中。
sentence: As a gesture of goodwill for the flight cancellation, the airline provided displaced passengers with hotel vouchers.
sentenceZh: 作為對航班取消表達善意的補償姿態，航空公司為滯留乘客提供了免費住宿券。

tip: 題目常誤標為動詞，實為不可數/可數名詞，在旅遊觀光（Tourism & Hospitality）廣告文案中出現頻率極高。
sentence: Nestled in the lush hills, the lakeside resort is an idyllic destination for a quiet weekend getaway.
sentenceZh: 這座坐落於蔥鬱山丘中的湖畔度假村，是享受恬靜週末假期的理想絕佳勝地。

zh: 巨大的，龐大的；(n.) 業界巨頭，跨國大企業
tip: 新聞閱讀題極愛用 'industry giant / retail giant'（產業巨頭）來代指沃爾瑪、微軟等龍頭企業，同義於 conglomerate。
sentence: The European e-commerce giant reported stronger-than-anticipated operating profit for the closing quarter.
sentenceZh: 這家歐洲電子商務龍頭企業公佈的最後一季營業利潤強於原先預期。

collocations: gift certificate / gift card (禮券/禮品卡)
a natural gift for (在...方面的與生俱來天賦)
tip: 在零售推廣中，'gift card' 或 'gift certificate'（禮券）考點極多，注意使用期限（expiration date）與限制條款。
sentence: Customers who spend over one hundred dollars will automatically receive a ten-dollar electronic gift card.
sentenceZh: 凡消費滿一百美元的顧客，將自動獲得一張面額十美元的電子禮品卡。

collocations: a gifted engineer (天賦異稟的工程師)
gifted with strong leadership (具備卓越領導才能)
tip: 在人才招聘推薦信（Recommendation Letter）中讚譽應徵者能力時常用，等同於 talented 或 highly skilled。
sentence: The software firm recruited several exceptionally gifted computer science graduates straight from the technical university.
sentenceZh: 該軟體公司直接從理工大學招募了數名才華出眾的電腦科學系畢業生。

zh: 用禮品紙包裝；(n.) 禮品包裝紙
collocations: complimentary gift-wrap service (免費禮品包裝服務)
have an item gift-wrapped (將商品精美包裝成禮品)
tip: 零售服務常見動詞。Part 5 常考使役被動態：'have the item gift-wrapped'（請店員將商品進行禮物包裝）。
sentence: During the peak winter shopping season, the department store offers to gift-wrap customer purchases at no extra charge.
sentenceZh: 在冬季購物旺季期間，該百貨公司為顧客購買的商品提供免費的精美禮品包裝服務。

collocations: glamor industry (時尚/娛樂等光鮮亮麗的產業)
the superficial glamor (表面上的光鮮)
tip: 英式拼法為 glamour。多出現在品牌行銷公關活動或奢侈品、時尚產業的專題報導中。
sentence: The prestigious film festival brought international star power and media glamor to the quiet coastal resort.
sentenceZh: 這場享譽國際的電影節，為這座寧靜的沿海度假小鎮帶來了國際巨星魅力與媒體的光彩焦點。

zh: 瞥一眼，快速看過；(n.) 一瞥
collocations: at a glance (一目了然，看一眼就知道)
glance at the summary (快速瀏覽摘要)
take a quick glance (迅速掃視一眼)
tip: Part 7 常考片語：'at a glance'（一覽無遺、一目了然），常用於儀表板（Dashboard）或資訊圖表的推廣介紹。
sentence: The redesigned executive analytics dashboard allows managers to evaluate key metrics at a glance.
sentenceZh: 重新設計的高階主管分析儀表板，讓經理人能夠一目了然地評估各項關鍵數據指標。

collocations: system glitch (系統突發微小問題)
suffer a minor glitch (遭遇輕微技術故障)
tip: 多益聽力短對話超高頻！與 technical problem / computer bug 互換，常是線上訂票系統當機或刷卡失敗的解題原因。
sentence: Due to a temporary technical glitch on the ticketing portal, some passengers experienced duplicate transaction billings.
sentenceZh: 由於購票入口網站發生暫時性技術小故障，導致部分乘客遇到了重複扣款的情況。

zh: 全球的，全世界的；整體的
collocations: global presence (全球業務佈局/全球據點)
tip: 常考搭配 'expand its global presence'（擴大全球業務版圖），同義於 worldwide 或 international。
sentence: The enterprise aims to strengthen its global presence by establishing new operational hubs in key emerging markets.
sentenceZh: 該企業旨在透過於主要新興市場建立新的營運樞紐，進一步強化其全球業務版圖。

collocations: across the globe (在全世界/跨越全球)
around the globe (環繞世界各地)
tip: 介系詞片語 'across/around the globe' 等同於 worldwide 或 throughout the world，在 Part 5/6 介系詞題極常考出。
sentence: Our supply chain network seamlessly connects hundreds of verified suppliers and logistics carriers across the globe.
sentenceZh: 我們的供應鏈網絡天衣無縫地串聯起全球數百家通過認證的供應商與物流運輸商。

collocations: cast gloom over (給...蒙上一層陰影)
tip: 商業報導中常用 'economic gloom' 指景氣低迷或市場前景黯淡，其形容詞 gloomy（如 a gloomy forecast 悲觀的預測）更是大熱門。
sentence: Persistent inflationary pressures have cast a persistent gloom over consumer discretionary spending projections.
sentenceZh: 持續不斷的通膨壓力，為消費者非必要支出的預測蒙上了一層揮之不去的陰霾。

collocations: avoid glorifying risky investments (避免過度美化高風險投資)
tip: 在廣告道德或公關文宣題材中，指過度美化某個不成熟的技術或誇大成效，語意有時帶有輕微貶義。
sentence: Corporate advertising guidelines mandate that product benefits must be factually supported rather than glorified.
sentenceZh: 企業廣告指導方針規定，產品優點必須有事實佐證，而非進行浮誇的美化宣傳。

collocations: bask in the glory of (沉浸在...的光榮之中)
tip: 商務專題報導老牌公司轉型時，常提及重新拾回昔日輝煌（restore the company to its former glory）。
sentence: The ambitious turnaround strategy formulated by the new CEO successfully restored the historic automaker to its former glory.
sentenceZh: 新任執行長所制定的宏偉轉型策略，成功讓這家歷史悠久的汽車大廠重拾往日輝煌。

zh: 字彙表，專業術語對照表
collocations: technical glossary (專業技術名詞對照表)
tip: 員工教育手冊（Manual）或技術規章文末必備區塊，提示讀者若遇專案縮寫或行業行話，請至 appendix/glossary 查閱。
sentence: A comprehensive glossary of terms is appended at the end of the user manual to assist non-technical operators.
sentenceZh: 使用者手冊末尾附有一份詳盡的術語詞彙表，以協助非技術操作人員理解內容。

tip: 工安規範必考單字！在實驗室、生產線或食品加工廠中，多益必考個人防護設備（Personal Protective Equipment, PPE）的配戴。
sentence: Laboratory technicians are required under strict safety regulations to wear chemical-resistant gloves at all times.
sentenceZh: 依據嚴格的安全規定，實驗室技術人員在作業期間必須全程配戴防化學手套。

collocations: glow in the dark (在黑暗中發光)
tip: 常出現在緊急出口標示、夜間逃生動線指示（glow-in-the-dark emergency exit signs）的安全指南中。
sentence: All emergency egress indicators throughout the stairwells are coated with materials that glow brightly during a blackout.
sentenceZh: 樓梯間內所有的緊急逃生出口指示牌均塗有能在停電時發出明亮光芒的蓄光材質。

zh: 善意；（會計上的）商譽，商譽資產
collocations: gesture of goodwill (表達善意的姿態)
build customer goodwill (建立顧客的好感與忠誠度)
tip: 雙重專業場景：1. 公關客訴中表「善意、友好」；2. 財務報表中 'goodwill' 專指企業併購時收購價超過淨資產公允價值的「商譽無形資產」。
sentence: During the acquisition audit, accountants recorded twenty million dollars on the balance sheet as acquired goodwill.
sentenceZh: 在收購審計過程中，會計師在資產負債表上記錄了兩千萬美元作為併購所取得的商譽無形資產。

zh: 極好的，華麗燦爛的，極其美麗的
collocations: gorgeous interior (華麗講究的室內裝潢)
tip: 在旅遊酒店或餐飲活動介紹中，常與 stunning, magnificent 同義，用於形容場地裝潢或窗外自然海景。
sentence: Guests attending the rooftop reception enjoyed gourmet canapés alongside a gorgeous panoramic view of the harbor.
sentenceZh: 參加頂樓招待會的賓客在享用精緻小點的同時，盡情欣賞了港灣壯麗迷人的全景風光。

zh: 閒言閒語，八卦；(v.) 說閒話
collocations: workplace gossip (職場八卦/辦公室流言)
engage in idle gossip (參與無聊的閒言碎語)
tip: 不可數名詞。常出現在員工守則（Code of Conduct）或職場人際關係專題中，通常禁止員工散佈未經證實的內部耳語。
sentence: The employee conduct handbook explicitly warns that malicious workplace gossip will not be tolerated.
sentenceZh: 員工行為手冊明確提出警告，公司絕不姑息包庇具有惡意的職場流言蜚語。

collocations: be governed by the laws of (受...法律管轄/規範)
govern corporate conduct (規範企業行為)
regulations governing privacy (規範隱私權的法規)
tip: 商務合約結尾條款必考句型：'This agreement shall be governed by the laws of [State/Country].'（本合約受……法律管轄與約束）。
sentence: All contractual disputes arising from this partnership shall be governed and interpreted according to the laws of New York.
sentenceZh: 因本合作夥伴關係所引發的一切合約爭端，均應依據紐約州法律進行管轄與解釋。

tip: 多益常考 government regulations（政府法規）與 compliance（合規）搭配，注意其與 federal/local 構成修飾名詞片語。
sentence: All manufacturing facilities must strictly comply with the new environmental standards established by the local government.
sentenceZh: 所有製造工廠均必須嚴格遵守地方政府制定的新環保標準。

collocations: grab a bite (匆忙吃點東西)
tip: 在聽力 Part 3 常出現非正式用法 'grab a quick bite/coffee'，指商務人士趕時間時快速用餐或喝咖啡。
sentence: Let's grab a quick bite across the street before the afternoon presentation starts.
sentenceZh: 在下午的簡報開始之前，我們去街對面隨便吃點東西吧。

tip: 商務場景最核心考點是 grace period（寬限期），指延遲繳款或履約而不受罰款的緩衝時間。
sentence: The bank provides a five-day grace period for mortgage payments before late fees are incurred.
sentenceZh: 該銀行提供五天的房貸繳款寬限期，逾期才會產生滯納金。

tip: 形容人的舉止或簡報應對得體，亦可用於形容產品線條流暢優雅。形容詞字尾 -ful 常出現在 Part 5 詞性辨析中。
sentence: The spokesperson handled the harsh questioning from reporters in a remarkably graceful manner.
sentenceZh: 發言人以極其得體的態度處理了記者們尖銳的提問。

tip: 在採購與製造情境中，常與 industrial-grade、medical-grade 形成複合形容詞，指符合特定專業標準的原料或規格。
sentence: Only industrial-grade steel was utilized in the construction of the offshore oil platform.
sentenceZh: 這座離岸石油平台的建造僅使用了工業級鋼材。

tip: 常用於圖表題與市場分析中，常與 steady, progressive 互換，反義詞為 sharp, dramatic, sudden。
sentence: The marketing director anticipated a gradual recovery in retail sales over the next fiscal quarter.
sentenceZh: 行銷總監預期下一會計季度零售額將會逐步復甦。

tip: 常搭配 phase out（逐步淘汰）或 replace（取代），在 Part 5 中常考修飾動詞的副詞位置。
sentence: The older software systems will be gradually phased out as employees complete their system training.
sentenceZh: 隨著員工完成系統培訓，舊軟體系統將會被逐步淘汰。

collocations: graduate with honors (以優異成績畢業)
tip: 注意介系詞搭配：graduate from + 學校；graduate in + 專業科系。名詞表示「畢業生」，常考 recent graduates（社會新鮮人）。
sentence: Candidates who graduated from accredited business schools will be given priority during recruitment.
sentenceZh: 畢業於受認可商學院的應徵者在招聘過程中將獲得優先考慮。

tip: 多益特考 grand opening（新店/飯店盛大開幕慶典），邀請函、宣傳單（flyer）中高頻出現。
sentence: We cordially invite you to attend the grand opening of our new flagship store this Friday evening.
sentenceZh: 我們誠摯邀請您參加本週五晚間我們新旗艦店的盛大開幕典禮。

tip: 常考句型 grant sb sth 或 grant sth to sb；名詞為「補助款、撥款」。片語 take sth for granted（視為理所當然）也是考點。
sentence: The IT department has granted the contractor temporary access to the corporate network.
sentenceZh: 資訊科技部門已授予該約聘人員公司網絡的臨時存取權限。

tip: Part 7 圖表整合題常見，常與 chart, diagram, table 一起出現，測驗考生交叉比對文字與數據的能力。
sentence: As the graph illustrates, sales peaked in November due to the promotional campaign.
sentenceZh: 如圖表所示，由於促銷宣傳活動，銷售額在十一月達到頂峰。

collocations: firm grasp (牢固掌握；深入了解)
tip: 除實體握緊外，商務職場多指抽象的「徹底理解業務要點」，常與 fully, thoroughly 連用。
sentence: The incoming manager quickly grasped the complexities of the overseas supply chain.
sentenceZh: 新任經理迅速掌握了海外供應鏈的複雜之處。

collocations: grateful for your assistance (感謝您的協助)
tip: 商務書信結尾常見高頻字，同義於 appreciative, thankful。注意介系詞搭配：be grateful to sb for sth。
sentence: We are extremely grateful for your continuous cooperation throughout this restructuring period.
sentenceZh: 對於您在整個組織重組期間所給予的持續合作，我們深表感謝。

collocations: as a token of gratitude (作為感謝的心意)
tip: 極常出現在感謝函與致謝信中：as a token of our gratitude（作為我們一點微薄的心意/謝禮）。
sentence: Please accept this voucher as a token of our gratitude for your loyalty to our brand.
sentenceZh: 請收下這張禮券，以表達我們對您支持本品牌的由衷謝意。

tip: 在餐廳收據、飯店帳單或差旅報銷（expense report）常出現的正式字眼，口語中即為 tip。
sentence: For parties of six or more, an 18 percent gratuity will be automatically added to the final bill.
sentenceZh: 六人或六人以上的團體，帳單將自動加收百分之十八的服務小費。

collocations: gravity of the situation (形勢的嚴重性)
understand the gravity (理解嚴重程度)
tip: 在商務多益閱讀中，gravity 很少考重力，而是考「事態嚴重性、重大性」，同義於 seriousness, severity。
sentence: The board failed to appreciate the full gravity of the regulatory breach until hefty fines were imposed.
sentenceZh: 直到被處以巨額罰款，董事會才真正意識到違反法規事態的嚴重性。

tip: 在企業倫理與道德商業文章中出現，常形容因追逐短期暴利而忽視永續發展或合法性的負面行為。
sentence: The analyst pointed out that corporate greed was the underlying cause of the financial scandal.
sentenceZh: 分析師指出，企業的貪婪是導致這起金融醜聞的根本原因。

collocations: greenhouse gas emissions (溫室氣體排放)
tip: 在 ESG 和環保法規文章中，greenhouse gas emissions（溫室氣體排放，簡寫 GHG）是極高頻考點片語。
sentence: The conglomerate has committed to reducing its greenhouse gas emissions by forty percent over the next decade.
sentenceZh: 該企業集團已承諾在未來十年內將溫室氣體排放量減少百分之四十。

collocations: grin from ear to ear (笑得合不攏嘴)
tip: Part 1 聽力照片題有時會出現描述人物表情的動詞，也常作名詞使用（with a grin）。
sentence: The project leader grinned when she announced that the proposal had been approved by the executive committee.
sentenceZh: 當專案主管宣布提案已獲執行委員會批准時，她露出了笑容。

collocations: keep a firm grip on (牢牢掌握)
lose one's grip on (失去對...的控制)
tip: 多益常考抽象引申義，如 keep/lose a grip on operating costs（掌控/失控營運成本）。
sentence: Management must maintain a firm grip on overhead expenses during this economic downturn.
sentenceZh: 在當前經濟不景氣期間，管理層必須牢牢控制日常開支。

tip: 指「經營雜貨店的人」；而 grocery 指雜貨店（grocery store）或食品雜貨（groceries），兩者需清楚區分人與物。
sentence: The local grocer decided to source organic vegetables directly from nearby regional farms.
sentenceZh: 當地雜貨商決定直接從附近的區域農場採購有機蔬菜。

tip: 複數 groceries 常指「採購的食品雜貨」；日常對話聽力中極常出現 go grocery shopping。
sentence: Online grocery deliveries surged dramatically following the launch of the mobile app.
sentenceZh: 手機應用程式上線後，線上食品雜貨配送量急劇增長。

collocations: groom for leadership (培養擔任領導職)
tip: 人資管理文章中，常考 groom sb for / to be...，意指「重點培訓某人以接任要職」。形容詞 well-groomed 指應徵者儀態端正。
sentence: The assistant director is being actively groomed to take over as regional general manager next spring.
sentenceZh: 該助理主管正接受重點培訓，準備於明年春季接任區域總經理一職。

collocations: gross domestic product (國內生產毛額)
tip: 財務報表絕對必考字。gross（毛的，未扣除成本與稅額）vs. net（淨的，扣除所有支出後的淨額）。
sentence: The enterprise reported a ten percent rise in gross profit despite increasing raw material costs.
sentenceZh: 儘管原物料成本上升，該企業仍公布了百分之十的毛利增長。

collocations: on the grounds of (基於...的理由)
tip: 注意多益雙重考點：1. 片語 on the grounds that/of（理由）；2. 營建情境 break ground on a new facility（破土動工）。
sentence: The developers will officially break ground on the new distribution center later this month.
sentenceZh: 開發商將於本月稍晚為新的物流中心正式動工。

tip: 常形容新產品、技術或研究報告，同義於 revolutionary, pioneering, cutting-edge。另有名詞「動土典禮」之意。
sentence: The biomedical startup was honored for its groundbreaking research into cancer treatments.
sentenceZh: 該生物醫學新創公司因其在癌症治療方面的突破性研究而受到表彰。

tip: 可作不及物動詞（利潤成長）或及物動詞（擴展業務、增加營收）。注意與 rise, expand 的句構用法互換。
sentence: The firm seeks to grow its overseas customer base through strategic digital marketing initiatives.
sentenceZh: 該公司尋求透過策略性數位行銷措施來擴大其海外客戶群。

tip: 名詞搭配形容詞如 robust/steady/sluggish growth，在年度財報或市場調查簡報中為絕對核心詞彙。
sentence: The tech sector experienced phenomenal growth throughout the preceding two quarters.
sentenceZh: 科技板塊在前兩個季度經歷了驚人的增長。

tip: 既可作名詞也可作動詞。常見句型 guarantee that... 或 guarantee sb sth。注意與 warranty（產品保固書）常作同義替換。
sentence: The courier service guarantees next-day delivery for all domestic express shipments.
sentenceZh: 這家快遞服務公司保證所有國內特快貨件隔日送達。

tip: 指人物為 security guard（保全），在工廠製造情境中，常指機械上的「安全防護板/罩」（protective guard）。
sentence: Factory operators are strictly forbidden from removing the safety guard from heavy machinery.
sentenceZh: 工廠操作人員嚴禁拆卸重型機械上的安全防護罩。

collocations: parent or guardian (父母或監護人)
guardian of public trust (公眾信任的守護者)
tip: 在合約、保險或涉及未成年人活動報名表（registration form）中，必考 legal guardian 簽名確認欄位。
sentence: The workshop registration form requires the signature of a parent or legal guardian for participants under eighteen.
sentenceZh: 工作坊報名表要求十八歲以下的參加者必須有家長或法定監護人的簽名。

tip: 商務對話中常使用 an educated guess，指「基於經驗或數據所做的合理推斷」，比盲猜（wild guess）更具專業度。
sentence: Without exact quarterly numbers, the accountant could only make an educated guess regarding the deficit.
sentenceZh: 在缺乏確切季度數據的情況下，會計師只能對虧損情況做出有依據的推測。

tip: 在研討會情境為「客座講師」（guest speaker）；在觀光餐旅情境則專指「住宿房客或顧客」（hotel/registered guest）。
sentence: The keynote address at the international conference will be delivered by a distinguished guest speaker.
sentenceZh: 國際會議的主旨演講將由一位傑出的客座演講嘉賓發表。

collocations: under the guidance of (在...的指導下)
earnings guidance (企業營收預測指引)
tip: 財經多益文章中，earnings guidance（盈利預期/財測指引）是上市企業對未來業績的重要預告，屬不可數名詞。
sentence: Following strong sales, the corporation raised its annual revenue guidance for the current fiscal year.
sentenceZh: 在強勁銷售的推動下，該企業上調了本財政年度的年度營收指引。

tip: 可指人（tour guide 導遊）亦可指物（user guide 使用指南）。動詞義為「引導、帶領」，常考 guide sb through sth。
sentence: Please consult the user guide provided with the printer to troubleshoot common network errors.
sentenceZh: 請參閱印表機隨附的使用指南，以排查常見的網路錯誤。

tip: 旅遊情境常見字，常指印製成冊的導覽手冊，與 brochure, pamphlet 類似，但內容通常更詳盡。
sentence: The visitors referred to the city guidebook to locate the nearest subway station and convention center.
sentenceZh: 參觀者查閱了這本城市導覽手冊，以找到最近的地鐵站和會議中心。

tip: 通常以複數形式 guidelines 出現。常見搭配動詞為 follow, establish, issue, adhere to。
sentence: All department supervisors are instructed to strictly adhere to corporate procurement guidelines.
sentenceZh: 所有部門主管均被指示必須嚴格遵守公司採購指導方針。

tip: 在法律與商法糾紛文章中，常指刑事或民事責任上的「有罪/違法責任」，反義詞為 innocence（無罪）。
sentence: The defendant admitted guilt in the corporate fraud case and agreed to pay full restitution.
sentenceZh: 被告在企業詐欺案中認罪，並同意支付全額賠償金。

tip: 多益法務文章高頻句型：plead guilty to charges（對控罪認罪）或 be found guilty of copyright infringement（被判定犯有侵犯版權罪）。
sentence: The former CFO pled guilty to insider trading after comprehensive evidence was presented.
sentenceZh: 在提出詳盡證據後，前任財務長承認了內線交易的罪名。

collocations: fully equipped gym (設備齊全的健身房)
tip: 常出現在員工福利（employee benefits）說明中，如免費使用 company gym 或補助 gym membership。
sentence: As part of the corporate wellness initiative, all employees are eligible for a subsidized gym membership.
sentenceZh: 作為企業健康福利計畫的一部分，所有員工均有資格享有補助的健身房會員資格。

tip: gym 的正式全稱，多益考題中有時會作為社區租借活動、大型招聘會（job fair）的舉辦場地。
sentence: The annual community trade fair will take place inside the newly renovated gymnasium next Saturday.
sentenceZh: 一年一度的社區貿易博覽會將於下週六在翻新完成的體育館內舉行。

tip: 多益市場調查文章常考 consumer buying/spending habits（消費者購物/消費習慣），比個人生活習慣更常入題。
sentence: Market analysts track changes in purchasing habits to optimize product placement strategies.
sentenceZh: 市場分析師追蹤購買習慣的轉變，以優化產品陳列與定位策略。

tip: 常出現在 ESG、環評報告（environmental impact assessment）中，評估建廠或開發案是否危及動植物棲地。
sentence: The infrastructure expansion was modified to prevent damage to the protected natural habitat nearby.
sentenceZh: 基礎設施擴建方案進行了修改，以防止損害附近受保護的自然棲息地。

tip: HR 人事考核中常出現 habitual lateness/tardiness（習慣性遲到），作為績效扣分或懲處的事由。
sentence: Repeated warnings were issued to the clerk regarding his habitual tardiness during morning shifts.
sentenceZh: 因早班習慣性遲到，該職員接獲了多次警告。

tip: 資安題必考字，常以被動語態出現：be hacked by unauthorized parties（遭未經授權第三方入侵）。
sentence: Cybersecurity experts investigated allegations that confidential customer records had been hacked.
sentenceZh: 網路安全專家對客戶機密記錄遭到駭客入侵的指控展開了調查。

collocations: take a haircut (承受資產折價/損失)
tip: 一般指剪髮；但在金融英文高階題中，take a haircut 意味「資產減記、承受投資虧損扣減」。
sentence: Creditors were forced to take a twenty percent haircut on their bonds under the debt restructuring plan.
sentenceZh: 根據債務重組計畫，債權人被迫對其持有的債券承受百分之二十的本金扣減。

collocations: make an appointment with a hairdresser (預約美髮師)
tip: 在聽力預約排程對話中出現，常與 reschedule（改期）、cancel appointment（取消預約）搭配考題。
sentence: I need to call the salon to see if my regular hairdresser has an opening this Saturday afternoon.
sentenceZh: 我需要致電沙龍，看看我常找的美髮師本週六下午是否有空檔。

collocations: first half of the year (上半年)
by more than half (減少/增加一半以上)
tip: 財經報表中極常考 the first/second half of the fiscal year（上半/下半會計年度，常簡稱 H1/H2）。
sentence: Operational expenses were cut by nearly half through the implementation of automated workflows.
sentenceZh: 透過推行自動化工作流程，營運支出減少了將近一半。

collocations: meet sb halfway (與某人妥協/各讓一步)
tip: 商務談判慣用語 meet each other halfway 表示「各退一步、達成妥協折衷方案」，聽力與閱讀極高頻。
sentence: Both parties agreed to meet halfway regarding the delivery costs to finalize the contract quickly.
sentenceZh: 雙方同意在運費問題上各讓一步，以便盡快敲定合約。

tip: 常指大型建築物內的大廳或活動場地，如 conference hall（會議廳）、town hall meeting（全體員工大會）。
sentence: The CEO addressed the entire workforce during the quarterly town hall held in Hall B.
sentenceZh: 執行長在 B 展廳舉行的季度全員大會上向全體員工發表了談話。

zh: 標誌；顯著特徵；品質證明
tip: 常比喻某品牌或企業的「核心代表特徵、代名詞」，同義於 trademark, characteristic, signature feature。
sentence: Prompt customer service and reliable post-sale support are the hallmarks of our enterprise.
sentenceZh: 迅速的客戶服務與可靠的售後支援是我們企業的鮮明標誌。

tip: 聽力 Part 1 照片題或辦公室指路對話中高頻出現，同義於 corridor。注意安檢規定常要求 keep hallways clear。
sentence: Fire safety codes require that all hallways and emergency exits remain completely unobstructed.
sentenceZh: 消防安全法規要求所有走廊和緊急出口必須保持完全暢通無阻。

collocations: come to a halt (停頓；停擺)
grind to a halt (逐漸停頓)
tip: 可作動詞與名詞。製造業產線停工常考 come to a complete halt 或 halt production due to a power outage。
sentence: Production at the assembly plant came to an unexpected halt due to a severe power supply outage.
sentenceZh: 由於嚴重的供電中斷，組裝廠的生產意外陷入停擺。

tip: 在零售退換貨情境或機場行李規定（carry-on baggage limits）對話中常出現。
sentence: Passengers are allowed to bring one piece of carry-on luggage and a small handbag into the cabin.
sentenceZh: 旅客可攜帶一件隨身行李及一個小型手提包進入機艙。

tip: HR 情境必考 employee handbook（員工守則手冊），新進員工入職訓練（orientation）時必備發放物品。
sentence: All new hires must review the policies outlined in the employee handbook before signing their agreements.
sentenceZh: 所有新進員工在簽署協議前，必須詳閱員工手冊中所列出的各項規章政策。

collocations: a handful of (少數的；少量的)
only a handful of people (僅有少數人)
tip: 片語 a handful of + 複數名詞，表示「數量極少」，同義於 a small number of，在 Part 7 數據分析題中常考替換。
sentence: Only a handful of qualified applicants met the stringent criteria for the managerial position.
sentenceZh: 只有少數合格的應徵者符合該經理職位的嚴格標準。

tip: 在商務上可引申指「商業競爭上的不利條件/劣勢」，同義於 disadvantage, obstacle, drawback。
sentence: A lack of local market knowledge proved to be a considerable handicap for the expanding firm.
sentenceZh: 缺乏當地市場知識被證明是該擴張中企業的一大顯著劣勢。

tip: 商務萬用字，同義於 manage, take care of, deal with, address。在客服與人資題型中出現頻率極高。
sentence: Our experienced client relations team will efficiently handle any complaints that may arise.
sentenceZh: 我們經驗豐富的客戶關係團隊將高效處理任何可能出現的投訴。

collocations: shipping and handling (運送與手續費)
tip: 採購發票與線上購物單據極常考片語 shipping and handling (S&H，運費及手續處理費)。
sentence: The invoice includes a separate nominal charge of ten dollars for shipping and handling.
sentenceZh: 該發票包含一筆十美元的運費及手續處理單獨名義收費。

collocations: refer to the handout (參考講義資料)
tip: 研討會或公司培訓（seminar/workshop）必考字。主持人在開場常說：Please refer to the handout in front of you。
sentence: The presenter asked the attendees to refer to page four of the distributed handout.
sentenceZh: 演講者請與會者參考已分發講義的第四頁。

collocations: seal with a handshake (以握手達成協議)
tip: 除實體商務社交握手外，高階考點 golden handshake 意指企業給予離職高層主管的優渥遣散費或退休補償。
sentence: A firm handshake and confident eye contact remain essential components of successful interview etiquette.
sentenceZh: 有力堅定的握手和自信的眼神接觸依然是成功面試禮儀的核心要素。

tip: 在商務差旅活動行程表（itinerary）中常有 harbor cruise 觀光；在海運物流中指貨櫃裝卸泊位港埠。
sentence: Delegates were invited to join a scenic harbor cruise after the evening networking session.
sentenceZh: 晚間交流環節結束後，代表們受邀參加一場風景優美的港灣遊船行程。

tip: 文法高頻否定副詞！句首倒裝常考：Hardly had S + p.p. when S + 過去式。且注意其本身即為否定，不可與 not 連用。
sentence: There were hardly any complaints received regarding the recent software upgrade.
sentenceZh: 關於最近的軟體升級，幾乎沒有收到任何投訴。

tip: 不可數名詞！注意在 IT 情境與 software 對立；在營造採購中指五金工具零件，此時不可加 -s。
sentence: The corporation allocated additional capital to upgrade obsolete IT hardware across all branches.
sentenceZh: 該企業撥出了額外資金，用於升級所有分公司已過時的資訊科技硬體。

tip: 作名詞多為不可數，片語 do more harm than good（弊大於利）在論述性商務閱讀題中常見。
sentence: Spreading unverified rumors about impending layoffs can do serious harm to employee morale.
sentenceZh: 散布關於即將裁員的未經證實謠言會對員工士氣造成嚴重損害。

collocations: harmful effects (不良影響/有害後果)
harmful to the environment (對環境有害)
tip: 常考介系詞搭配 be harmful to（對...有害）。同義詞為 detrimental, hazardous, damaging。
sentence: The industrial paint was discontinued because it contained emissions harmful to human health.
sentenceZh: 該工業油漆已停產，因為它含有對人體健康有害的排放物質。

tip: 常用於團隊合作（teamwork）與企業文化描述中。片語 in harmony with 意為「與...保持一致或和諧」。
sentence: The new office policies were deliberately designed to maintain workplace harmony and productivity.
sentenceZh: 新辦公室規章的設計旨在維護職場和諧與工作生產力。

tip: 除農業收成外，資訊科技領域常借指「收集/擷取數據」（harvest customer data），動名詞同型。
sentence: Agricultural cooperatives reported an exceptionally abundant harvest despite dry summer weather.
sentenceZh: 儘管夏季氣候乾燥，農業合作社仍報告了異常豐富的收成。

collocations: make a hasty conclusion (倉促下結論)
tip: 常用於商業決策的批評或反思中，反義詞為 deliberate, considered, thoughtful。副詞形式為 hastily。
sentence: The CEO cautioned senior executives against making a hasty decision regarding the merger.
sentenceZh: 執行長告誡高階主管切勿針對該合併案做出草率的決定。

tip: 工安工廠巡檢（safety inspection）核心必考詞。常考潛在危險 eliminate/reduce potential hazards。
sentence: Discarded packing materials left in the aisle were cited as an unacceptable fire hazard.
sentenceZh: 走道上隨意丟棄的包裝材料被指為不可接受的火災隱患。

tip: 縮寫 HAZMAT（hazardous materials）常出現在物流與倉儲運輸規則中。常與 dangerous, toxic 互為同義替換。
sentence: Personnel handling hazardous chemicals must wear certified protective respirators and gloves.
sentenceZh: 處理危險化學品的人員必須配戴經認證的防護口罩與手套。

tip: 在公關新聞稿（press release）或報紙文章題型中，掌握 headline 能最快掌握整篇閱讀的主旨（main idea）。
sentence: The unexpected acquisition of the telecom provider instantly made headlines across global financial newspapers.
sentenceZh: 這家通訊業者出人意料的收購案立即登上了全球財經報紙的頭條新聞。

tip: 名詞通常加 -s 為 headquarters（單複數同形，作主詞時可視為單數或複數）；動詞常以被動 be headquartered in 出現。
sentence: The multinational technology conglomerate is currently headquartered in Singapore.
sentenceZh: 這家跨國科技集團目前總部設於新加坡。

collocations: heal from injuries (從傷害中康復)
tip: 醫療保險請假情境中，常指工傷康復，注意與 cure, treat 的差異（heal 多指傷口自然癒合或心理平復）。
sentence: The warehouse technician was granted three weeks of medical leave to allow his injured shoulder to heal properly.
sentenceZh: 該倉庫技術員獲准三週病假，以便讓受傷的肩膀妥善癒合。

tip: 名詞，除了生理健康外，商務閱讀常用於比喻「企業或經濟的體質與健全度」（the health of the economy/company）。
sentence: The comprehensive employee benefits package includes extensive health insurance coverage.
sentenceZh: 這份優渥的員工福利方案包含廣泛的健康保險保障。

collocations: healthy profit margin (可觀的利潤率)
healthy balance sheet (穩健的資產負債表)
tip: 在財經文章中常引申為「可觀的、大量的、穩健的」，如 a healthy increase in profits（利潤的可觀增長）。
sentence: The retail division maintained a healthy profit margin despite rising supply chain expenses.
sentenceZh: 儘管供應鏈費用上漲，該零售部門仍維持著可觀的利潤率。

collocations: hear from (收到...的來信或消息)
look forward to hearing from you (期待收到您的回覆)
tip: 書信結尾句高頻模板：I look forward to hearing from you soon.（注意 hearing 必須用動名詞，to 為介系詞）。
sentence: We look forward to hearing from your representatives regarding contract renegotiations.
sentenceZh: 我們期待收到您方代表關於合約重新談判的回覆。

collocations: turn up the heat (加強供暖/加強施壓)
tip: 物料規格中常見 heat-resistant materials（耐熱材料）。引申為競爭或壓力加劇（face the heat）。
sentence: The factory installed insulated panels to protect assembly workers from the intense heat generated by furnaces.
sentenceZh: 工廠安裝了隔熱板，以保護組裝工人免受熔爐產生的強烈熱能影響。

tip: 辦公室設施維修（facility maintenance）對話中常考，例如辦公室空調過冷時請求派人檢修暖氣系統。
sentence: The facility manager promised to replace the faulty space heater in the reception area by noon.
sentenceZh: 設備經理承諾在中午前更換接待區那台故障的室內暖爐。

collocations: on the heels of (緊接著...之後)
tip: 商務片語高頻考點：on the heels of something（緊隨某事之後發生），常出現在商業動態報導中。
sentence: On the heels of the successful merger, the banking firm announced a major global branding campaign.
sentenceZh: 在併購案大獲成功之後，該銀行機構緊接著宣布了一項重大的全球品牌推廣計畫。

collocations: at the height of (在...的高峰/頂點)
tip: 常用於比喻巔峰期：at the height of the tourist season（在旅遊旺季的高峰期），同義於 peak。
sentence: At the height of the summer travel season, all coastal hotel rooms were completely booked.
sentenceZh: 在夏季旅遊旺季的高峰期，所有沿海飯店的房間都被預訂一空。

collocations: hard hat / helmet required (規定必須配戴安全帽)
tip: 工廠、工地參訪（construction site tour）前置通知必備提示語，同義詞常為 hard hat。
sentence: All site visitors are mandated to wear a protective helmet and high-visibility vest at all times.
sentenceZh: 所有現場訪客均被強制要求全程配戴防護安全帽及高能見度反光背心。

collocations: help desk (技術支援台/客服台)
with the help of (在...幫助下)
tip: 名詞常考 IT help desk（資訊技術客服台）；作動詞時可接原形動詞或 to V：help (to) do sth。
sentence: Please contact the internal IT help desk if you experience issues configuring your work laptop.
sentenceZh: 如果您在設定公務筆記型電腦時遇到問題，請聯繫內部資訊支援服務台。

collocations: helpful customer support (樂於助人的客服)
tip: 顧客滿意度調查（customer satisfaction survey）高頻形容詞，用以讚美客服人員態度熱心積極。
sentence: The customer review highlighted that the store associate was exceptionally polite and helpful.
sentenceZh: 該顧客評價特別強調，該門市店員態度極其禮貌且樂於助人。

tip: 跨國公司季節性銷售報告或農產品進出口運輸中常見，常指不同半球之間的淡旺季反轉。
sentence: The retail distributor offsets seasonal slumps in domestic sales by marketing apparel in the Southern Hemisphere.
sentenceZh: 這家零售經銷商透過在南半球銷售服裝，來彌補國內銷售的季節性低迷。

collocations: hence the need for (因此才需要...)
tip: 副詞，同義於 therefore, consequently。注意其連接句子時前面常有分號或逗點加 and，不能單獨作對等連接詞。
sentence: The initial cost of solar installations is high; hence, government subsidies are vital for market adoption.
sentenceZh: 太陽能安裝的初始成本很高，因此，政府補助對於推動市場採用至關重要。

collocations: herd mentality (從眾心態/羊群效應)
tip: 商業投資市場分析中常出現 herd mentality（羊群效應），指投資者盲目跟風市場潮流追高殺跌。
sentence: Financial analysts warned novice investors against succumbing to herd mentality during the stock market surge.
sentenceZh: 金融分析師警告新手投資者，在股市飆漲期間切勿盲從羊群效應。

tip: 旅遊宣傳冊（brochure）極高頻詞；另外企業成立周年常宣傳其 proud corporate heritage（引以為傲的企業傳統底蘊）。
sentence: The historical hotel was carefully restored to celebrate its architectural heritage while offering modern luxury.
sentenceZh: 這家歷史悠久的飯店經過悉心修復，在提供現代奢華享受的同時，也展現了其建築文化遺產。

collocations: do not hesitate to contact (請儘管聯繫...)
hesitate to invest (對投資猶豫不決)
tip: 商業信函終極高頻結尾金句：Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.
sentence: Do not hesitate to reach out to our client relations manager should you require any modifications.
sentenceZh: 若您需要任何修改，請隨時聯繫我們的客戶關係經理，切勿猶豫。

collocations: after some hesitation (經過一番猶豫後)
tip: 常見介系詞片語 without hesitation（毫不猶豫地），常在推薦信或商務合作評價中表示堅決認可。
sentence: I would recommend Ms. Jensen for the senior project manager role without the slightest hesitation.
sentenceZh: 我將毫不猶豫地推薦詹森女士擔任高級專案經理一職。

collocations: hidden agenda (隱秘動機/隱蔽議程)
tip: 商務合約、銀行條款或租車合約中，多益高頻考 no hidden fees/charges（無任何隱藏手續費）。
sentence: Our car rental policy is completely transparent, with absolutely no hidden fees added at checkout.
sentenceZh: 我們的租車政策完全透明，結帳時絕不額外增加任何隱藏費用。

collocations: hide financial records (隱匿財務記錄)
tip: 三態為 hide, hid, hidden。在企業審計與法務文章中，常指非法隱匿財務事實（conceal, hide）。
sentence: The audited accounts revealed that the rogue branch manager attempted to hide operating losses.
sentenceZh: 查核後的帳目顯示，該違規分行經理曾企圖隱匿營業虧損。

tip: 片語 reach an all-time high（達到歷史新高）是聽力 Part 4 與閱讀圖表題的絕對核心片語。
sentence: Due to surging global semiconductor demand, the company's stock price touched an all-time high yesterday.
sentenceZh: 由於全球半導體需求激增，該公司的股價昨日創下了歷史新高。

collocations: adjacent to the highway (緊鄰高速公路)
tip: 多益聽力路況報導（traffic report）極高頻詞，常搭配 lane closure（車道封閉）、congestion（塞車）。
sentence: Commuters should expect delays on Interstate Highway 95 due to ongoing emergency resurfacing work.
sentenceZh: 由於正在進行緊急路面重鋪作業，行經 95 號州際公路的通勤者應有心理準備會遇到延誤。

zh: 健行；(價格/利率)大幅提高
tip: 作名詞與動詞時，財經多益必考「大幅加息或提價」，如 interest rate hike（央行升息），遠比遠足健行更常考。
sentence: The central bank decided to hike interest rates by fifty basis points to curb persistent inflation.
sentenceZh: 央行決定加息五十個基點以遏制持續居高不下的通膨。

collocations: find it hilarious (覺得極為可笑)
tip: 在娛樂展演活動評論、社交對話中出現，形容表演或電影極度幽默好笑，同義於 extremely funny。
sentence: The comedy show sponsored by the advertising firm received rave reviews for its hilarious script.
sentenceZh: 由該廣告公司贊助的喜劇表演因其極其風趣幽默的劇本而獲得熱烈好評。

tip: 動詞，同義於 impede, obstruct, hamper。常考句型 hinder sb/sth from doing sth。
sentence: Supply shortages and logistical delays continue to hinder the progress of the construction project.
sentenceZh: 供應短缺和物流延誤繼續阻礙著該營建專案的進展。

collocations: hint of optimism (一絲樂觀跡象)
tip: 除作暗示外，在員工教育訓練手冊中，helpful hints 常表示「實用小貼士/實用技巧」（tips）。
sentence: The presenter shared several helpful hints on negotiating effectively with overseas suppliers.
sentenceZh: 主講人分享了幾個與海外供應商進行有效談判的實用小技巧。

tip: 名詞 new hire（新員工）在人事題必考。名詞 hiring freeze 指公司遇到財務緊縮時實施的「人事凍結」。
sentence: Due to budgetary constraints, the corporation implemented a temporary hiring freeze across all departments.
sentenceZh: 由於預算限制，該企業在所有部門實施了暫時性的人事聘僱凍結。

tip: 常出現在員工個人簡介（employee profile）或工作與生活平衡（work-life balance）專題報導中。
sentence: During the onboarding mixer, staff members were encouraged to share their favorite hobbies outside of work.
sentenceZh: 在迎新交流會上，員工們被鼓勵分享工作之餘各自最喜愛的業餘嗜好。

collocations: put on hold (暫時擱置/在電話中等待)
tip: 多益雙重超高頻點：1. hold a conference/seminar（召開會議）；2. 電話用語 Please hold the line / put sb on hold。
sentence: The annual shareholders' meeting will be held in the auditorium on the ground floor.
sentenceZh: 年度股東大會將於一樓大禮堂舉行。

collocations: loophole in the law (法律漏洞)
pothole in the road (路面坑洞)
tip: 在合約與法規中，常衍生考 loophole（漏洞）；在財經新聞中常比喻赤字缺口（financial hole）。
sentence: Corporate attorneys scrutinized the agreement carefully to ensure there were no tax loopholes.
sentenceZh: 公司律師仔細審查了該協議，以確保不存在任何稅務漏洞。

collocations: holiday season (假期季節/年底消費旺季)
tip: 在零售業文章中，holiday season 特指感恩節至新年期間的「年底購物銷售旺季」。
sentence: Retailers usually recruit additional seasonal staff to prepare for the surge in holiday sales.
sentenceZh: 零售商通常會招募額外的季節性臨時工，以應對假期銷售旺季的訂單激增。

tip: WFH（work from home）已成為多益辦公室管理極高頻主題；另外 home market 常指國內本國市場。
sentence: The organization established clear productivity metrics for staff participating in the work-from-home program.
sentenceZh: 該機構為參與居家辦公計畫的員工制定了明確的生產力評量指標。

tip: 常出現在外派員工（expatriate assignment）關懷、海外留學或海外實習的心得訪談文章中。
sentence: The HR manager established support groups to assist expatriate employees who feel homesick during overseas assignments.
sentenceZh: 人資經理成立了支援小組，以協助在海外派駐期間感到想家的外派員工。

tip: 在員工專題人物介紹或地方企業家成功歷程文章中經常出現。
sentence: After gaining international experience, the executive returned to his hometown to establish an entrepreneurial incubator.
sentenceZh: 在累積了國際經驗後，這位高階主管回到家鄉創立了一個創業孵化器。

tip: 在員工評鑑（performance appraisal）中常見 honest feedback；注意以母音發音開頭，冠詞要用 an honest...
sentence: Constructive management relies on providing honest and constructive feedback during biannual reviews.
sentenceZh: 具建設性的管理依賴於在半年一次的考核中提供坦率且具建設性的反饋。

collocations: question someone's honesty (質疑某人的誠信)
tip: 在企業道德守則（code of conduct）中，honesty and integrity（誠實正直）是經典不敗的成對高頻片語。
sentence: The company's code of conduct stresses that honesty and professional integrity must guide all business transactions.
sentenceZh: 該公司的行為準則強調，誠實與職業操守必須指導所有的商業交易行為。

collocations: in honor of (為紀念/向...表示敬意)
tip: 片語 in honor of 在頒獎晚宴（awards banquet）或退休告別派對邀請函中絕對必考。
sentence: A special reception will be held this evening in honor of the retiring vice president.
sentenceZh: 今晚將舉行一場特別招待會，向即將退休的副總裁致敬。

tip: 指職位不領薪俸或象徵性的榮銜，如 honorary president（名譽會長/名譽董事長）。
sentence: The founding executive was named honorary chairperson following her official retirement from active management.
sentenceZh: 該創始主管在正式退居二線退休後，被任命為名譽董事長。

collocations: hopeful about the future (對未來抱持希望)
hopeful candidate (有希望獲選的候選人)
tip: 常搭配介系詞 about 或 that 子句。反義詞為 hopeless 或 pessimistic；同義詞為 optimistic。
sentence: The marketing team remains hopeful that the newly launched campaign will reverse declining retail sales.
sentenceZh: 行銷團隊對新推出的宣傳活動能扭轉零售額下滑趨勢仍抱持樂觀希望。

tip: 形容事情毫無挽救可能或局面極其糟糕，同義於 futile, desperate。注意字尾 -less 表示否定。
sentence: The restructuring proposal was abandoned when board members deemed the budget deficit hopeless.
sentenceZh: 當董事會成員認為預算赤字已無可挽救時，重組方案被徹底放棄。

collocations: on the horizon (即將發生/在望)
tip: 商務經典片語 on the horizon（即將來臨/迫在眉睫的事物）；金融領域指 investment horizon（投資週期/期限）。
sentence: Analysts predict that significant regulatory changes in the fintech industry are currently on the horizon.
sentenceZh: 分析師預測，金融科技產業重大的法規變革目前已露端倪、即將到來。

tip: 企管高頻術語 horizontal integration（水平整合，指收購同行競爭對手）；反義為 vertical integration（垂直整合）。
sentence: The acquisition represents a strategic move toward horizontal integration within the telecommunications sector.
sentenceZh: 該收購案代表了該電信產業朝向水平整合邁出的策略性一步。

tip: 常出現在客戶抱怨信函（complaint letter）中，描寫極端惡劣的服務體驗，同義於 terrible, dreadful。
sentence: The passenger submitted a complaint letter detailing the horrible customer service encountered at the check-in desk.
sentenceZh: 該名旅客提交了一封投訴信，詳細描述了在報到櫃檯遭遇的極其糟糕的客戶服務。

collocations: be horrified by (被...嚇壞/對...感到震驚)
horrified to learn (驚悉...感到震驚)
tip: 動詞，多益閱讀中更常以過去分詞作形容詞用：be horrified to find/hear...（驚悉某負面事件）。
sentence: Shareholders were horrified to learn that the firm had been systematically falsifying its accounting books.
sentenceZh: 股東們驚悉該公司長期以來一直在系統性地偽造會計帳簿，感到無比震驚。

tip: 常出現在人資請假（medical leave）檢附醫生診斷證明（doctor's note / hospital statement）的情境中。
sentence: Employees requiring inpatient care at a hospital must notify human resources within twenty-four hours.
sentenceZh: 需要在醫院接受住院治療的員工必須在二十四小時內通知人力資源部門。

collocations: thank you for your hospitality (感謝您的熱情款待)
tip: 產業專有名詞 the hospitality industry 專指飯店與餐飲觀光業。出差拜訪結束信函中必寫 thank you for your warm hospitality。
sentence: The regional economy relies heavily on the hospitality industry, particularly during peak summer months.
sentenceZh: 該區域經濟高度依賴餐旅觀光業，尤其是在夏季旅遊旺季期間。

collocations: a host of (大量的；許多的)
tip: 既可作名詞（主辦者）也可作動詞（主辦、主持）。片語 a host of + 複數名詞，表示「許多、大量的」，常考詞義替換。
sentence: Our corporate headquarters will host the upcoming annual international technology summit.
sentenceZh: 我們的企業總部將主辦即將到來的年度國際科技高峰會。

zh: 敵對的；不友善的；惡意收購的
tip: 商務收購合約極高頻術語 hostile takeover（未經目標公司董事會同意的惡意敵意收購）。
sentence: The board adopted a shareholder rights plan to fend off an unsolicited hostile takeover bid.
sentenceZh: 董事會採納了一項股東權益計畫（毒藥丸策略），以抵禦未經請求的惡意收購要約。

collocations: hotel amenities (飯店休閒便利設施)
tip: 商務差旅考題常搭配 amenities（設施，如健身房、泳池）、book in advance（提前預訂）、cancellation policy（取消政策）。
sentence: Please confirm your hotel reservation at least forty-eight hours prior to your scheduled arrival.
sentenceZh: 請在預定抵達時間前至少四十八小時確認您的飯店預訂。

collocations: after hours (下班後；非營業時間)
tip: 複數 hours 常指出勤或營業時間：office/business/operating hours；flexible working hours（彈性工作時間）。
sentence: The branch announced extended operating hours on Thursdays to accommodate retail shoppers.
sentenceZh: 該分行宣布每逢週四延長營業時間，以方便零售消費者。

zh: 按小時計算的；每小時的
tip: 薪資模式區分：hourly wage（時薪）vs. monthly salary（月薪）vs. annual compensation（年薪）。也可作副詞「每小時地」。
sentence: Temporary warehouse contractors are paid an hourly rate of twenty-five dollars plus overtime.
sentenceZh: 臨時倉庫約聘工的時薪為二十五美元，外加加班費。

zh: 房屋；機構；動詞：容納/收藏
collocations: house the collection (收藏/容納藏品)
tip: 片語 in-house（在公司內部進行、不假外求的）是多益超級熱門字。作動詞時表示「安置、容納、收藏」。
sentence: The firm decided to handle all graphic design in-house rather than contracting an outside agency.
sentenceZh: 該公司決定所有平面設計均在公司內部自行處理，而不是委外給外部設計公司。

collocations: household name (家喻戶曉的名字/名牌)
tip: 片語 a household name 指「家喻戶曉的名牌或名人」；市場調查常統計 average household income（平均家庭收入）。
sentence: Through decades of innovative consumer products, the electronics brand has become a household name.
sentenceZh: 透過數十年來不斷推陳出新的消費性電子產品，該品牌已成為家喻戶曉的名字。

collocations: hotel housekeeper (飯店客房清潔人員)
head housekeeper (客房部主管/總管家)
housekeeper request (客房清潔服務需求)
tip: 飯店情境名詞 housekeeping 指「客房清潔部」，而 housekeeper 則指執行客房清潔保養的人員。
sentence: If you require extra towels or bedding, please inform the hotel housekeeper on your floor.
sentenceZh: 如果您需要額外的毛巾或寢具，請告知您所在樓層的飯店客房清潔人員。

tip: 外派福利合約中常見 housing allowance（租屋津貼/房補）；不動產經濟新聞常探討 housing development（住宅開發案）。
sentence: Expatriate managers stationed in Tokyo receive a generous monthly housing allowance.
sentenceZh: 常駐東京的外派主管每月皆可領取優渥的租屋津貼。

tip: 在航空與物流情境中極常考 airline hub（航空樞紐/轉運機場），引申為區域經貿中心（tech hub）。
sentence: The metropolitan airport serves as a primary international hub for transpacific flights.
sentenceZh: 該大都會機場是跨太平洋航線的主要國際航空樞紐。

tip: 常用來修飾成功、利潤、市場規模等，同義於 massive, tremendous, immense, substantial。
sentence: The promotional campaign was a huge success, boosting third-quarter sales by thirty percent.
sentenceZh: 該宣傳推廣活動取得了巨大的成功，將第三季度的銷售額推升了百分之三十。

collocations: humane working conditions (人道的工作條件)
humane approach (合乎人情常理的做法)
tip: 注意拼寫與發音：human（人類的，重音在第一音節）vs. humane（人道的，字尾有 -e，重音在第二音節）。企業社會責任常考詞。
sentence: Corporate audit standards mandate safe, clean, and thoroughly humane working conditions in all partner factories.
sentenceZh: 企業稽核標準強制要求所有合作工廠均必須提供安全、清潔且完全符合人道的工作環境。

tip: 集合名詞，不可數，不用加 -s。現代商業演說多偏好使用包容性詞彙 humankind 來替代帶性別意涵的 mankind。
sentence: The foundation funds medical research intended to benefit humankind across developing nations.
sentenceZh: 該基金會資助旨在造福發展中國家全人類的醫學研究。

collocations: Human Resources Department (人力資源部門)
human resource management (人力資源管理)
tip: 多益十三大情境的核心詞彙，常用複數 Human Resources（HR）。負責招募（recruitment）、福利（benefits）、受訓（training）。
sentence: Please submit your completed vacation request form to the Human Resources department by Friday.
sentenceZh: 請於本週五前將填妥的休假申請表提交給人力資源部門。

zh: 謙遜的；謙虛的；不起眼的
collocations: humble beginnings (白手起家/微末的起點)
tip: 在企業家成功傳記或公司簡史中，常用 started from humble beginnings（從不起眼的微小起步發展壯大）。
sentence: From its humble beginnings in a small garage, the firm has grown into an international retail empire.
sentenceZh: 從一家小型車庫的不起眼起點開始，這家公司現已成長為一個跨國零售帝國。

tip: 在品管與庫存（inventory storage）情境中，常規定某些電子零件或藥品不能存放在 humid conditions 下。
sentence: Pharmaceutical components must be stored in cool, climate-controlled environments rather than humid warehouses.
