sentenceZh: 醫藥原料必須存放在陰涼且具溫濕度控制的環境中，而非潮濕的倉庫內。

tip: 不可數名詞。在製造廠房、精密無塵室或機房管理中，監控 temperature and humidity（溫度與濕度）是標準安全程序。
sentence: Precision machinery inside the production facility requires strict regulation of room humidity levels.
sentenceZh: 生產設施內部的精密機械需要對室內濕度水準進行嚴格調控。

tip: 演講口才介紹中常見：use humor to engage the audience（利用幽默感抓住聽眾注意力）。注意英美拼寫（humor / humour）。
sentence: The keynote speaker effectively used humor to ease tension and engage the international audience.
sentenceZh: 主旨演講人巧妙地運用幽默感化解了緊張氣氛，並吸引了全場國際聽眾的注意力。

collocations: no need to hurry (不需著急)
tip: 片語 in a hurry（急匆匆地）是聽力短對話高頻考點。作及物動詞時表示「催促某人做某事」（hurry someone along）。
sentence: Although we are running behind schedule, we should not hurry through the final quality safety checks.
sentenceZh: 雖然我們的進度落後，但我們不應為了趕時間而草率進行最終的品質安全檢查。

collocations: hurt the brand reputation (傷害品牌商譽)
tip: 在工傷情境指身體受傷；在商務財務分析中，常用於及物動詞指「衝擊/重創營收、利潤或形象」（hurt profits/reputation）。
sentence: Unexpected regulatory tariff increases could severely hurt the automotive manufacturer's export revenues.
sentenceZh: 出人意料的監管關稅調高可能會嚴重損害這家汽車製造商的出口營收。

collocations: a hush fell over (一片寂靜籠罩)
tip: 名詞常考 a hush fell over the room（全場鴉雀無聲）；非正式商業醜聞報導中有時會出現 hush money（封口費）。
sentence: A sudden hush fell over the conference auditorium as the executive director walked up to the podium.
sentenceZh: 當執行董事走上講台時，整個會議禮堂頓時鴉雀無聲。

collocations: break the ice (破冰；打破僵局)
on thin ice (如履薄冰；處境危險)
tip: 破冰活動（icebreaker）是團隊建設（team building）與新進員工培訓的超常考名詞；社交片語 break the ice 意指化解初次見面的尷尬。
sentence: The facilitator introduced a collaborative game to break the ice among new team members.
sentenceZh: 引導師引進了一款協同合作遊戲，以打破新團隊成員之間的生疏與尷尬。

tip: 在餐飲招待情境中形容消暑冷飲；在人際溝通中則可比喻極度冷漠、無動於衷的態度。
sentence: Complimentary ice-cold beverages were offered to all trade show attendees during the hot afternoon.
sentenceZh: 在炎熱的午後，所有商展參觀者均獲贈免費的冰涼飲料。

collocations: click on the icon (點擊圖示)
industry icon (行業巨擘/標竿人物)
tip: 在電腦軟體操作指引中必考「點擊某圖示」（click the shortcut icon）；在商界指「指標性標竿人物」（cultural/business icon）。
sentence: To launch the video conference software, simply double-click the designated icon on your desktop.
sentenceZh: 要啟動視訊會議軟體，只需雙擊桌面上指定的圖示即可。

zh: 結冰的；結霜的；冷冰冰的
tip: 交通路況或天候警報常見 icy roads / icy conditions，提醒駕駛小心打滑延誤，或公司因天候關閉。
sentence: Morning commuters were warned to drive cautiously due to icy conditions on municipal overpasses.
sentenceZh: 由於市立高架橋路面結冰，早晨通勤族接獲提醒應謹慎駕駛。

collocations: brainstorm ideas (腦力激盪發想創意)
tip: 常見於腦力激盪（brainstorming session）會議紀錄，常搭配動詞 come up with ideas, pitch an idea（推銷提案）。
sentence: The marketing team scheduled a brainstorming workshop to generate fresh promotion ideas for the product launch.
sentenceZh: 行銷團隊安排了一場腦力激盪工作坊，為新品發布構思新穎的推廣點子。

tip: 招聘廣告（job posting）常考 the ideal candidate should possess...；房產租賃常考 an ideal location for retail。
sentence: With its proximity to public transit, the renovated warehouse is an ideal location for our distribution center.
sentenceZh: 由於鄰近大眾運輸系統，這座翻新後的倉庫是我們設立物流中心的理想地點。

collocations: idealize the past (將過去過度理想化)
idealize a concept (將概念理想化)
tip: 動詞字尾 -ize。多益商業策略分析中，常警告主管不要 idealize projections（過度理想化財務預估而低估風險）。
sentence: Project planners should assess tangible market risks rather than idealize prospective consumer demand.
sentenceZh: 專案企劃人員應評估切實的市場風險，而非過度理想化未來的消費需求。

zh: 完全相同的；一模一樣的
collocations: produce identical parts (生產完全相同的零件)
tip: 常考介系詞搭配 identical to（或 with）。同義於 exactly the same，製造品管情境中要求規格完全一致。
sentence: Quality inspectors confirmed that the replacement components were completely identical to the original specifications.
sentenceZh: 品檢人員確認，這些替換零件與原廠規格完全一模一樣。

collocations: identify potential risks (辨識潛在風險)
tip: 在諮詢顧問與專案管理中極高頻，常考 identify areas for improvement（找出待改善之處）。名詞為 identification（身分證明）。
sentence: The external operational audit successfully identified several areas where production costs could be streamlined.
sentenceZh: 外部營運稽核成功指出了數個可以精簡生產成本的關鍵環節。

tip: 既可作形容詞也可作動詞。工廠產線停擺時機台閒置（machines sit/stand idle）；財務上指未做投資運用的閒置資金。
sentence: During the microchip shortage, several automobile assembly lines were left completely idle for weeks.
sentenceZh: 在微晶片短缺期間，數條汽車組裝產線完全停工閒置了數週之久。

tip: 在廣告與贊助（endorsement/sponsorship）主題中，常考利用知名偶像代言以擴展年輕消費客群的市場策略。
sentence: The cosmetics brand signed an endorsement contract with a famous pop idol to attract younger consumers.
sentenceZh: 該化妝品品牌與一位知名流行偶像簽署了代言合約，以吸引更多年輕消費者。

collocations: idolize successful entrepreneurs (崇拜成功企業家)
be idolized by peers (受到同儕崇拜)
tip: 在多益商業傳記或職場軟性閱讀中出現，常用於描述年輕創業家崇拜業界先驅；注意名詞為 idol，形容詞為 idolatrous。
sentence: Many junior executives idolize the founder for transforming a modest startup into a multinational conglomerate.
sentenceZh: 許多基層主管都極為崇拜該創辦人，因其將一家普通初創公司轉型為跨國企業集團。

collocations: ignite public interest (點燃大眾興趣)
tip: 多益雙重考點：在工廠安全手冊中指物理上的「點燃易燃物」；在市場行銷或商業新聞中多引申為「激起、觸發市場熱潮」。
sentence: Strict safety protocols prohibit open flames near the chemical storage tanks to prevent accidental ignition.
sentenceZh: 嚴格的安全規範禁止在化學儲罐附近使用明火，以防止意外引燃。

collocations: spark an ignition (產生火花點火)
tip: 常出現在汽車租賃協議（Corporate Travel）或工廠設備維護手冊中。turn off the ignition（關閉引擎開關）是高頻生活片語。
sentence: Inspectors found that a defect in the ignition switch was responsible for the machinery malfunction.
sentenceZh: 檢查人員發現點火開關的瑕疵是導致機械故障的主因。

collocations: in complete ignorance of (對…一無所知)
display ignorance of regulations (表現出對法規的不了解)
tip: 多益常考合約或法務情境："Ignorance of the law is no excuse"（不知法不可作為藉口）。注意常接介系詞 of。
sentence: The supplier claimed ignorance of the revised environmental guidelines, but they were still held accountable.
sentenceZh: 供應商聲稱對修訂後的環保方針不知情，但仍被追究責任。

collocations: be ignorant of market trends (對市場趨勢一無所知)
tip: 用法固定為 be ignorant of sth，不可與 rude（無禮的）混為一談，多益著重其「未掌握情報或事實」的客觀語意。
sentence: Management was not ignorant of the rising production costs, yet they hesitated to increase consumer prices.
sentenceZh: 管理層並非不知道生產成本上升，但他們對提高消費端售價猶豫不決。

collocations: ignore automated warnings (忽視系統自動警告)
ignore customer feedback (忽視客戶反饋)
tip: 在多益電腦系統通知、軟體安裝指示中極為高頻，如 "If you have already paid, please ignore this notice."（若已付款，請忽略本通知）。
sentence: Employees should not ignore system upgrade notifications, as delaying them could jeopardize network security.
sentenceZh: 員工不應忽視系統升級通知，因為延遲更新可能會危害網路安全。

tip: 當形容詞修飾名詞時多表示「不良的、惡意的」（如 ill will, ill effects）；表示「生病」時常作表語（fall ill, be ill）。
sentence: Prolonged exposure to factory noise can have ill effects on the hearing capacity of assembly line workers.
sentenceZh: 長期暴露在工廠噪音中會對裝配線工人的聽力產生不良影響。

collocations: an ill-advised investment (不明智的投資)
an ill-advised strategy (欠考慮的策略)
tip: 形容決策或商業收購未經深思熟慮，同義字為 imprudent、unwise。常見於多益商業分析報導或專家評論。
sentence: Financial analysts warned that an overseas expansion would be ill-advised during an economic downturn.
sentenceZh: 金融分析師警告，在經濟衰退期間進行海外擴張是不明智的舉動。

tip: 法律主題常客，反義字為 legal / lawful；常與 strictly（嚴格地）或 deemed（被認為）連用。
sentence: Sharing proprietary client data with unauthorized third parties is strictly illegal under international privacy laws.
sentenceZh: 根據國際隱私法規，將專屬客戶資料分享給未經授權的第三方是絕對違法的。

zh: 非法的；違禁的；不正當的
tip: 比 illegal 更強調「違反社會規範、道德或偷偷摸摸進行的違法行徑」，常出現在公司內部稽核或反洗錢情境中。
sentence: Internal auditors uncovered illicit transfers of funds to offshore shell corporations.
sentenceZh: 內部稽核人員發現了向離岸空殼公司非法轉移資金的行徑。

tip: 多益常以複合概念出現，如 financial illiteracy（理財盲）或 digital illiteracy（數位素養缺乏），非單純指不識字。
sentence: The bank launched a community workshop aimed at overcoming financial illiteracy among young adults.
sentenceZh: 該銀行推出了一項社區工作坊，旨在消除年輕族群對金融理財知識的缺乏。

collocations: sick leave due to illness (因病請病假)
prevent workplace illness (預防職場疾病)
tip: 在 HR 請假政策（Leave Policy）中高頻出現。辨析：disease 多指特定病理疾病，而 illness 偏向身體不舒服的「狀態」。
sentence: Employees who are absent due to illness for more than three consecutive days must submit a doctor's certificate.
sentenceZh: 因病連續缺勤超過三天的員工，必須繳交醫師證明書。

tip: 字首 il- 表否定，接 logical。常出現在檢討商業報告或提案評估時，指出預算或推論欠缺合理性。
sentence: Proceeding with the marketing campaign without prior market research would be entirely illogical.
sentenceZh: 在未事先進行市場調查的情況下推進行銷活動，是完全不合邏輯的。

collocations: illuminate the workspace (照亮工作空間)
illuminate key issues (闡明關鍵問題)
tip: 多益雙重含意：物理上的照明（常用 passive: be illuminated by LED bulbs）以及比喻性的「釐清、闡釋複雜數據或問題」。
sentence: The guest speaker's presentation helped illuminate the complex tax implications of corporate mergers.
sentenceZh: 客座講者的簡報有助於闡明企業合併中複雜的稅務影響。

collocations: create the illusion of (營造…的假象)
tip: 易混淆字：delusion（精神偏執妄想）、allusion（暗指）。多益常考 under the illusion that 子句（誤以為某事為真）。
sentence: The company was under the illusion that customer loyalty alone would sustain revenue during the crisis.
sentenceZh: 該公司誤以為光憑顧客忠誠度就能在危機期間維持營收。

collocations: as illustrated in the chart (如圖表所示)
tip: 多益閱讀與聽力圖表題（Part 3, 4, 7）極高頻詞。常以被動結構 "As illustrated in Table 1..." 出現。
sentence: The quarterly sales report includes several graphs that illustrate regional revenue distribution.
sentenceZh: 該季銷售報告包含數張圖表，用以說明各區域的營收分布狀況。

collocations: by way of illustration (作為例證)
tip: 指產品手冊（User Manual）中的操作圖示或簡報中的範例。注意常考片語 by way of illustration（舉例來說）。
sentence: The user manual provides step-by-step illustrations to assist customers with assembling the office desk.
sentenceZh: 該使用手冊提供逐步圖解，以協助顧客組裝辦公桌。

collocations: project a professional image (樹立專業形象)
tip: 行銷領域核心詞彙，常與 project（投射、展現）、enhance（提升）、tarnish/damage（損害）連用。
sentence: Upgrading our customer service department is crucial to improving the overall brand image.
sentenceZh: 升級我們的客戶服務部門對於提升整體品牌形象至關重要。

tip: 易混淆字三兄弟：imaginary（虛構不真實的）、imaginative（富有想像力/創意的）、imaginable（想像得到的，修飾最高級）。
sentence: The crisis management simulation presented an imaginary supply chain disruption for managers to resolve.
sentenceZh: 該危機管理模擬提供了一個虛構的供應鏈中斷情境，供經理們進行演練應對。

collocations: capture the imagination of (吸引…的想像力/引起廣大興趣)
require great imagination (需要豐富想像力)
tip: 片語 capture the public imagination 常指新科技或創新行銷方案引起大眾轟動與強烈興趣。
sentence: The design team's imagination led to a revolutionary product packaging that won multiple design awards.
sentenceZh: 設計團隊的想像力促成了革命性的產品包裝，並榮獲多項設計大獎。

tip: imagine 後面若接動詞，必須使用動名詞 V-ing（imagine expanding abroad），不可接不定詞 to V。
sentence: It is hard to imagine how the department operated efficiently before the introduction of cloud storage.
sentenceZh: 很難想像在導入雲端儲存之前，該部門是如何維持高效率運作的。

collocations: imitate a competitor's strategy (模仿競爭對手的策略)
tip: 多益常見名詞形態 imitation（仿製品）；在專利或智財侵權糾紛中，imitate 帶有未經授權抄襲的負面意味。
sentence: Rival firms quickly attempted to imitate our software's user interface, but patent protections blocked them.
sentenceZh: 競爭對手迅速試圖模仿我們軟體的使用者介面，但專利保護阻擋了他們。

zh: 不成熟的；尚未發展完善的
tip: 在多益商業分析中，多用於修飾 market、technology、industry，表示發展初期、存在較大風險與不確定性。
sentence: Investing heavily in the sector carries substantial risks because the underlying technology is still immature.
sentenceZh: 大舉投資該領域具備相當風險，因為底層技術仍未成熟。

collocations: require immediate attention (需要立即處理)
in the immediate vicinity (在緊鄰周遭)
tip: 多益黃金考點：immediate supervisor / immediate manager（直屬主管）是聽力與閱讀請假、審核流程中的必考詞組！
sentence: All leave requests must be approved by your immediate supervisor at least two weeks in advance.
sentenceZh: 所有請假申請必須至少提前兩週獲得直屬主管的核准。

collocations: immediately following the meeting (會議結束後緊接著)
tip: 神級考點："effective immediately"（即刻生效）在公司人事異動、政策公告的 memo 中出現頻率極高。
sentence: The updated corporate travel policy is effective immediately, limiting business class flights to journeys over six hours.
sentenceZh: 修訂後的企業出差政策即刻生效，商務艙飛行僅限於超過六小時的航程。

collocations: under immense pressure (承受巨大壓力)
tip: 形容規模、影響或壓力極大，同義字為 huge, enormous, tremendous。多修飾抽象名詞如 potential, value, pressure。
sentence: The launch of the electric vehicle was an immense success, generating thousands of pre-orders within hours.
sentenceZh: 該電動車的發布取得了巨大的成功，在數小時內就產生了數千份預購訂單。

tip: 辨析：immigrant（移入者）、emigrant（移出者）、migrant（移工/遷徙者）。多益常探討全球招募與技術簽證議題。
sentence: The tech sector relies heavily on highly skilled immigrants to fill specialized engineering positions.
sentenceZh: 科技產業高度依賴高技術移民來填補專業工程職缺。

zh: 不能移動的；靜止不動的；固定的
tip: 字首 im- (not) + mobile（可動的）。在房地產或物流設備中常指出於安全考量而固定不可移動的狀態。
sentence: Heavy machinery must be anchored securely to remain immobile during transport across rough terrain.
sentenceZh: 重型機械必須牢固固定，以確保在崎嶇地形運輸過程中保持不動。

zh: 免受影響的；免除的；有免疫力的
collocations: immune to inflation (免受通膨影響)
be not immune to (無法免於…)
tip: 商業多益少考生理免疫，多考「不受市場蕭條影響」或「免除法律責任」。接 to 或 from（immune to market shifts）。
sentence: Even the largest multinational retailers are not completely immune to economic recessions.
sentenceZh: 即使是規模最大的跨國零售商，也無法完全免受經濟衰退的影響。

collocations: have an impact on (對…產生影響)
tip: 文法重點：impact 當動詞時為「及物動詞」，直接加受詞（impact sales）；當名詞時才搭配 on（have an impact on sales）。
sentence: The sudden rise in fuel prices is expected to impact shipping costs across the logistics network.
sentenceZh: 燃料價格的突然上漲預計將衝擊整個物流網絡的運輸成本。

tip: 同義字為 damage, weaken。在多益無障礙設施公告中常見 visually/hearing impaired（視障/聽障人士）。
sentence: Fatigue from excessive overtime can seriously impair an employee's concentration and performance.
sentenceZh: 因過度加班帶來的疲勞會嚴重損害員工的專注力與工作表現。

zh: 公正的；無偏見的；中立的
collocations: an impartial observer (客觀的觀察員)
tip: 反義字為 biased, partial。常用於調解仲裁（arbitration）或外部獨立稽核的背景中，同義字為 unbiased, neutral。
sentence: An impartial third-party consultant was hired to evaluate complaints between management and the union.
sentenceZh: 管理層聘請了一位客觀公正的第三方顧問，以評估資方與工會之間的爭議投訴。

collocations: grow impatient with delays (對延誤漸感不耐)
tip: 常見於客服應對訓練（Customer Service Training）題目，強調如何安撫不耐煩的客戶。搭配介系詞 with。
sentence: Customer service representatives are trained to remain calm and courteous even when dealing with impatient callers.
sentenceZh: 客服代表接受過專業訓練，即使面對不耐煩的來電者也能保持冷靜與禮貌。

zh: 無懈可擊的；完美無瑕的
collocations: impeccable credentials (無可挑剔的資歷證書)
impeccable track record (完美無瑕的過往紀錄)
tip: 多益形容候選人背景（HR）或高級酒店/餐廳服務（Dining/Travel）的頂級高分讚美詞。同義字為 flawless, spotless。
sentence: Thanks to her impeccable leadership and strategic vision, the branch exceeded its annual revenue targets.
sentenceZh: 歸功於她無懈可擊的領導才能與策略眼光，該分行超額完成了年度營收目標。

collocations: impede economic growth (妨礙經濟成長)
tip: 同義字為 hinder, obstruct, hamper。名詞型態為 impediment（障礙）。多出現在供應鏈瓶頸或工程延宕報告中。
sentence: Severe supply chain disruptions have continued to impede the timely assembly of electronic components.
sentenceZh: 嚴重的供應鏈中斷持續阻礙著電子零件的及時組裝。

zh: 迫切的；極重要的；必要的
collocations: it is imperative that S (should) V (極為迫切…)
a business imperative (商業上的當務之急)
tip: 【必考文法陷阱】假定法（Subjunctive）：It is imperative that S + (should) + 原形V。考試常把 should 省略，故意考原形動詞！
sentence: It is imperative that all regional managers submit their final quarterly forecasts by Friday afternoon.
sentenceZh: 所有區域經理務必於週五下午前提交最終季度預測報告，此乃當務之急。

tip: 多益核心詞彙！動詞為實施（carry out, execute）；名詞為工具（agricultural implements）。重音不同但考動詞居多（95%）。
sentence: The executive board agreed to implement the restructuring plan gradually over the next two fiscal quarters.
sentenceZh: 執行董事會同意在接下來的兩個會計季度內逐步落實重組計劃。

tip: 常搭配 of（implementation of new software / policy）。在專案管理（Project Management）閱讀題型中最常見。
sentence: The implementation of the cloud-based CRM software was completed two weeks ahead of schedule.
sentenceZh: 基於雲端的顧客關係管理軟體導入工作，比預定時程提前了兩週完成。

zh: 牽連；暗示；可能引發的後果/影響
collocations: financial implications (財務上的潛在影響)
implications for future growth (對未來成長的影響)
tip: 在多益商業分析中，複數形 implications 常指一項決策所帶來的「潛在長遠影響/後果」，同義字為 consequence / effect。
sentence: The board met to consider the financial implications of acquiring a European logistics provider.
sentenceZh: 董事會召開會議，評估收購一家歐洲物流供應商在財務層面的潛在影響。

tip: 多益 Part 7 題目高頻問法："What is implied about Mr. Miller?"（關於米勒先生暗示了什麼？）考驗讀者由線索推論的能力。
sentence: The memo did not explicitly announce budget cuts, but it strongly implied that layoffs were unavoidable.
sentenceZh: 該備忘錄並未明確宣布削減預算，但強烈暗示裁員勢在必行。

collocations: considered impolite (被認為是不禮貌的)
tip: 反義字為 polite / courteous。在職場禮儀公告或跨文化交流培訓中提及，提醒員工商務溝通不可帶有生硬或粗魯字眼。
sentence: Interrupting a client during a formal business presentation is generally considered unprofessional and impolite.
sentenceZh: 在正式商業簡報中打斷客戶發言，通常被認為是不專業且不禮貌的。

tip: 當名詞重音在第一音節 /ˈɪm.pɔːt/，當動詞重音在第二音節 /ɪmˈpɔːt/。常與 tariff, customs clearance（清關）搭配。
sentence: The newly signed trade agreement reduces import tariffs on electronic parts originating from Southeast Asia.
sentenceZh: 新簽署的貿易協定降低了原產自東南亞電子零件的進口關稅。

collocations: stress the importance of (強調…的重要性)
tip: "of paramount importance" 或 "of utmost importance" 是多益閱讀信函中的固定高頻金句，相當於 extremely important。
sentence: The CEO stressed the importance of data privacy during the annual company-wide address.
sentenceZh: 執行長在年度全體員工大會上演說時，著重強調了數據隱私的重要性。

collocations: play an important role (扮演重要角色)
it is important to note that (值得注意的是…)
tip: 在聽力 Part 3/4 中，講者一旦說出 "It is important to remember/note that..."，後面通常緊跟著考題的關鍵答案！
sentence: Completing the software integration before the end of the fiscal year is an important objective for our team.
sentenceZh: 在會計年度結束前完成軟體整合，是我們團隊的一項重要目標。

zh: 強制實施；徵收（稅/罰款）；強加於
tip: 【高頻文法】必搭配介系詞 on：impose sth on sb/sth。常考徵稅（tax）、罰款（fine）或法規限制（restrictions）。
sentence: The municipal authority decided to impose strict emission limits on manufacturing plants located near residential areas.
sentenceZh: 市政當局決定對位於住宅區附近的製造廠強制實施嚴格的排碳限制。

collocations: render sth impossible (使某事變得不可能)
tip: 常與 render 連用形成句型：render sth impossible（使…成為不可能）。不可修飾人表示「人沒有可能」。
sentence: Severe blizzard conditions rendered it impossible for delivery trucks to dispatch orders on schedule.
sentenceZh: 嚴重的暴風雪使貨運卡車幾乎不可能按時派送訂單。

collocations: an impractical proposal (不切實際的提案)
tip: 反義字為 practical, feasible。常出現於專案預算評估信件中，用來委婉拒絕可行性低或開銷過大的計畫。
sentence: While the proposed office layout is modern and attractive, management found it impractical for daily collaboration.
sentenceZh: 雖然擬議的辦公室格局現代且美觀，但管理層發現它在日常協作上並不切實際。

zh: 使欽佩；給…留下深刻印象
collocations: impress potential investors (給潛在投資人留下深刻印象)
be impressed with/by (對…感到佩服/印象深刻)
tip: 常以被動語態出現在面試或產品發表後反饋：be impressed with / by sb's expertise（對某人的專業印象深刻）。
sentence: The startup founder managed to impress the venture capitalists with an articulate business plan.
sentenceZh: 該初創公司創辦人憑藉條理清晰的商業計畫書，成功給創投家留下了深刻的印象。

collocations: make a favorable impression (留下良好印象)
give the impression that (給人…的印象)
tip: 常考搭配動詞：make / leave / create a good impression on sb。注意介系詞用 on。
sentence: Dressing professionally for a job interview helps candidates make a favorable first impression on interviewers.
sentenceZh: 面試時穿著專業得體有助於求職者給面試官留下良好的第一印象。

zh: 令人印象深刻的；卓越的
collocations: impressive sales growth (令人矚目的銷售增長)
an impressive portfolio (出色的作品集)
tip: 商業推廣、業績成果公佈、個人履歷評論的高頻讚賞詞。不可與 impressionable（易受影響的/無主見的）混淆。
sentence: The marketing agency delivered an impressive presentation that convinced the client to renew the multi-year contract.
sentenceZh: 行銷機構發表了一場令人印象深刻的簡報，說服客戶續簽了這份多年合約。

zh: 不合適的；不當的；違規的
collocations: improper disposal of waste (不當廢棄物處理)
improper use of funds (不當挪用資金)
tip: 常出現在員工守則或法律違規通知中。反義字為 proper。副詞 improperly 常考修飾維護或操作不當。
sentence: The warranty does not cover damage resulting from improper installation or maintenance of the appliance.
sentenceZh: 本保固範圍不涵蓋因該家電安裝或維護不當所造成的損害。

collocations: improve customer satisfaction (提升客戶滿意度)
tip: 既可當及物動詞（improve performance），也可當不及物動詞（Conditions improved.）。同義字 enhance, upgrade。
sentence: The factory introduced automation to speed up production and improve overall product consistency.
sentenceZh: 工廠導入自動化以加快生產速度並提高整體產品的一致性。

tip: 多益職場評估（Performance Review）固定片語："There is still room for improvement."（仍有改進空間）。
sentence: Recent figures show a significant improvement in on-time delivery rates across all international branches.
sentenceZh: 近期數據顯示，所有國際分公司的準時交貨率皆有顯著改善。

tip: 零售與行銷考題常客：impulse buying / impulse purchase（衝動消費），指收銀台旁零食陳列區引發的即興購買。
sentence: Supermarkets place confectionery and magazines near checkouts to encourage impulse buying among shoppers.
sentenceZh: 超市在結帳櫃檯旁擺放糖果與雜誌，以促使顧客進行衝動購物。

collocations: inability to meet deadlines (無法如期完成)
inability to pay debts (無力償還債務)
tip: 固定用法為 inability + to V。常用於解釋無法履約、無法按時交件的通知書中。反義字 ability。
sentence: The contractor cited an inability to source essential building materials as the primary cause of the delay.
sentenceZh: 承包商表示無法取得關鍵建材是導致工程延宕的主要原因。

zh: 不準確的；有誤差的；錯誤的
tip: 反義字 accurate。常考於客戶投訴信（Complaint Letters）中，抱怨收據金額有誤或規格資料與實物不符。
sentence: The invoice was rejected by accounting because of inaccurate calculations regarding shipping fees and sales tax.
sentenceZh: 該發票因運費和營業稅計算不準確而遭到會計部門退回。

zh: 不活躍的；停用的；閒置的
tip: 在銀行金融（Finance）與會員系統（IT）中常考：inactive accounts 指超過規定期間未有交易活動的休眠帳戶。
sentence: The bank charges a monthly maintenance fee on accounts that have remained inactive for more than a year.
sentenceZh: 銀行對閒置超過一年以上的帳戶每月收取維護管理費。

zh: 不充足的；不充分的；不適任的
tip: 反義字 adequate（足夠的、合適的）。注意詞性為形容詞。常出現在檢討預算或工廠資源短缺的報告中。
sentence: The project stalled because inadequate funding prevented the engineering team from purchasing necessary equipment.
sentenceZh: 該專案陷入停滯，因為資金不足導致工程團隊無法採購必要的設備。

zh: 到達的；入境的；回程的；打進來的
collocations: inbound logistics (入庫物流/進貨物流)
tip: 反義字 outbound。物流中 inbound logistics 指原材料進廠供應鏈；客服中心中 inbound call 指客戶打進來的諮詢電話。
sentence: The distribution center handles thousands of inbound shipments of retail merchandise each week.
sentenceZh: 該物流配送中心每週處理數千件入庫的零售商品貨件。

zh: 股份有限公司（Incorporated 縮寫）
collocations: Apex Solutions, Inc. (Apex解決方案股份有限公司)
tip: 多益商業信函、信頭（Letterhead）、合約簽署必備縮寫。注意句尾常帶縮寫點號。表示已完成法人組織登記的公司。
sentence: Harrison Logistics, Inc. announced a merger with a European competitor to expand its shipping footprint.
sentenceZh: 哈里森物流股份有限公司宣布與一家歐洲競爭對手合併，以擴展其貨運版圖。

collocations: offer an incentive to (向…提供誘因)
tip: 多益神級單字！常指公司給予員工的績效獎勵（bonus, commission）或政府給予企業的稅務優惠（tax incentive）。
sentence: The company introduced a cash incentive for sales representatives who exceed their quarterly sales quotas.
sentenceZh: 公司為超越季銷售配額的業務代表推出了現金獎勵方案。

zh: 緩慢移動；漸進；(n) 英吋
tip: 當動詞時常考財經趨勢新聞："Stock prices inched up."（股價小幅緩步上揚）。比 creep 或 crawl 更具漸進穩定的意涵。
sentence: Market analysts observed that interest rates have continued to inch higher over the last three months.
sentenceZh: 市場分析師觀察到，利率在過去三個月內持續緩步走高。

collocations: security incident (安全事件/資安事件)
tip: 在工安手冊或IT資安防護中常見。與 accident 的差異在於 incident 可大可小，涵蓋一般異常衝突或意外。
sentence: The factory supervisor filed a comprehensive incident report detailing the machinery breakdown and injuries.
sentenceZh: 工廠主管填寫了一份詳盡的意外事件報告，詳細說明機械故障與受傷情形。

zh: 附帶的；伴隨的；(n.pl) 雜費
collocations: incidental expenses (雜項開銷/附帶費用)
tip: 【差旅必考】出差報帳（Expense Report）中，incidentals 指除機票住宿以外的小額雜費（如小費、市區短程交通費）。
sentence: Employees are provided a per diem allowance to cover meals and other incidental travel expenses.
sentenceZh: 員工享有每日津貼，用以支應出差期間的餐飲與其他雜項開銷。

collocations: incinerate hazardous waste (焚化危險廢棄物)
tip: 常出現在製造廠環保合規（Environmental Compliance）或機密文件銷毀政策中。名詞為 incineration。
sentence: Hospital protocols require medical waste to be properly incinerated to prevent contamination.
sentenceZh: 醫院處置規範要求醫療廢棄物必須妥善焚化，以防止污染。

tip: 工廠設施、城市廢棄物管理相關字彙，注意字尾 -or 表設備器具或人員。
sentence: The industrial plant installed a state-of-the-art incinerator that minimizes toxic air emissions.
sentenceZh: 該工業廠房安裝了最先進的焚化爐，能將有毒廢氣排放降至最低。

collocations: have an inclination to/towards (有…的傾向)
tip: 指人的偏好或意向，搭配介系詞 toward(s) 或接不定詞 to V。在商業討論中常表示某人偏好某項方案。
sentence: The CEO expressed an inclination to hire an external candidate rather than promote internally.
sentenceZh: 執行長表達了傾向聘用外部候選人、而非由內部晉升的意向。

collocations: be inclined to agree (傾向於同意)
incline toward a decision (偏向於某項決定)
tip: 最常考片語：be inclined to V（傾向做某事 / 贊同某事），在商務會議協商中屬於高度客氣委婉的表態方式。
sentence: Given the favorable market conditions, we are inclined to expand our manufacturing capacity next quarter.
sentenceZh: 鑑於有利的市場情勢，我們傾向於在下一季擴大製造產能。

collocations: include a copy of (附上一份…的複本)
tip: 及物動詞，主詞與受詞常為整體與部分的關係。商務信函常考附檔通知："I have included the invoice in the attachment."
sentence: The quoted price does not include installation fees or additional delivery charges.
sentenceZh: 報價中不包含安裝費用或額外的運送費用。

collocations: including but not limited to (包括但不限於)
all staff, including contractors (所有人員，包括約聘人員)
tip: 【文法必考】介系詞，後面直接加名詞或代名詞。在合約與規章中最經典的法律術語即為：including but not limited to。
sentence: The conference registration covers all meals, including the networking banquet on Friday evening.
sentenceZh: 大會註冊費用涵蓋所有餐飲，包括週五晚上的商務交流晚宴。

zh: 包含全部的；包容的；全包的
collocations: an inclusive workplace (具包容性的職場環境)
inclusive of all taxes (含所有稅金)
from June 1 to June 5 inclusive (自6月1日至6月5日包含首尾兩天)
tip: 常見用法：inclusive of sth（包含…的）；另在日期範圍後加 inclusive 表示「前後天皆包含在內」。
sentence: The company strives to build a diverse and inclusive corporate culture where every voice is respected.
sentenceZh: 該公司致力於建立多元且包容的企業文化，讓每位員工的聲音都能受到尊重。

zh: 條理不清的；不連貫的；語無倫次的
collocations: an incoherent presentation (雜亂無章的簡報)
tip: 字首 in- (not) + coherent（條理連貫的）。常在商業簡報、公關危機評論中出現，指表達邏輯混亂令人費解。
sentence: The spokesperson's statement was criticized for being incoherent and failing to address the defect issue.
sentenceZh: 發言人的聲明遭到批評，因其語無倫次且未能正面回應產品瑕疵問題。

collocations: steady source of income (穩定的收入來源)
tip: 【財會必考】income statement（損益表）與 balance sheet（資產負債表）並列多益 Part 7 財報表格雙璧！
sentence: The company's net income rose by 12% this year due to strong overseas digital sales.
sentenceZh: 由於強勁的海外數位銷售，該公司今年的淨收入增長了 12%。

zh: 剛收到的；新任的；進來的
collocations: incoming CEO / president (新任執行長/總裁)
tip: 多益雙高頻：修飾職位時指「即將上任/新任的」（反義為 outgoing 現任即將離任的）；修飾訊息郵件指「進來的」。
sentence: The incoming managing director announced plans to streamline internal operational workflows.
sentenceZh: 新任總經理宣布了簡化內部營運工作流程的計劃。

zh: 無能的；不稱職的；不具資格的
tip: 反義字 competent（有能力的/稱職的）。名詞為 incompetence。常出現在績效調查報告或人事糾紛申訴中。
sentence: The audit revealed that incompetent supervision led to significant accounting discrepancies.
sentenceZh: 稽核揭露了監管不力是導致重大會計帳目差錯的原因。

tip: 在線上表單填寫或工作申請審核中高頻出現。常見提示語："Incomplete applications will not be processed."
sentence: Any job application that is submitted with incomplete documentation will be automatically disqualified.
sentenceZh: 任何隨附文件不齊全的求職申請將被自動取消資格。

zh: 不一致的；矛盾的；反覆無常的
tip: 【文法必背】介系詞固定接 with：be inconsistent with previous statements / data。反義字 consistent。
sentence: The findings in the regional audit were inconsistent with the financial statements submitted by headquarters.
sentenceZh: 區域稽核的調查結果與總部提交的財務報表並不一致。

collocations: apologize for the inconvenience (為造成的不便致歉)
regret any inconvenience (對造成的不便深感遺憾)
tip: 【多益客訴回信第一金句】"We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause." 聽力閱讀滿分必背短語！
sentence: The airline offered passengers meal vouchers to apologize for the inconvenience caused by the flight cancellation.
sentenceZh: 航空公司向旅客提供餐券，以表達對航班取消造成不便的歉意。

collocations: at an inconvenient time (在不方便的時間)
find it inconvenient to (覺得做某事很不方便)
tip: 常用於商務約會時間更改："If this time is inconvenient for you, please let me know." 注意人不可做主詞說 I am inconvenient。
sentence: If the rescheduled meeting time is inconvenient for your schedule, please suggest an alternative date.
sentenceZh: 如果重新安排的會議時間對您的行程不便，請另行建議其他合適日期。

zh: 包含；將…併入；成立法人公司
collocations: be incorporated under state law (依州法成立公司)
tip: 常考片語：incorporate A into B（將 A 融合/納入 B 之中）。另在法務組織中指「註冊登記成立法人公司」。
sentence: The software developers decided to incorporate user feedback into the latest application update.
sentenceZh: 軟體開發人員決定將使用者回饋納入最新的應用程式更新中。

collocations: certificate of incorporation (公司執照/法人設立證書)
tip: articles of incorporation 指「公司組織章程」，在法務與企業成立文件中屬於專業必考詞。
sentence: The lawyers filed the articles of incorporation with the state commerce department yesterday.
sentenceZh: 律師們昨天向州商業廳提交了公司組織章程。

collocations: incorrect billing address (錯誤的帳單地址)
tip: 多益常出現在密碼輸入錯誤提示或帳單寄送地址校對情境。同義字 wrong, inaccurate。
sentence: Due to an incorrect shipping address provided by the customer, the package was returned to the warehouse.
sentenceZh: 由於顧客提供了錯誤的送貨地址，包裹已被退回倉庫。

collocations: an increase in demand (需求增長)
tip: 【介系詞考點】當名詞時，增加的幅度用 of（an increase of 10%），增加的領域/標的用 in（an increase in sales）。
sentence: The retail chain saw a substantial increase in online sales during the end-of-year holiday season.
sentenceZh: 該零售連鎖店在年底假期期間見證了線上銷售額的大幅增長。

tip: 名詞較少單獨作為考點，多作為干擾選項；其形容詞 incredible 極度高頻。
sentence: The incredibility of the rapid turnaround surprised even the most seasoned market observers.
sentenceZh: 如此迅速的轉虧為盈令人難以置信，連最經驗豐富的市場觀察家都感到驚訝。

zh: 難以置信的；極佳的；出色的
collocations: an incredible achievement (了不起的成就)
tip: 口語及商務演說中常當作讚美詞，同義於 amazing, extraordinary；在財經閱讀中指數據超乎想像。
sentence: The engineering team achieved incredible milestones despite severe budget constraints and tight deadlines.
sentenceZh: 儘管面臨嚴格的預算限制和緊迫的截止日期，工程團隊仍達成了令人難以置信的里程碑。

zh: 招致；蒙受；產生（費用/損失）
collocations: incur additional expenses (產生額外費用)
tip: 【財經必考】多益核心詞彙！專指非自願但必須承擔的費用、虧損或處罰。常出現在租車協議或逾期付款罰則中。
sentence: Clients will incur an additional late fee if payments are not settled within thirty days of invoicing.
sentenceZh: 若客戶未在開立發票後三十天內結清款項，將產生額外的滯納金。

collocations: be deeply indebted to (對…深表感激/欠…人情)
tip: 最常以被動過去分詞 be indebted to 出現，商業信函中表達「非常感激某人的協助或支持」（= grateful）。
sentence: We are deeply indebted to our legal advisory team for guiding us through the merger process.
sentenceZh: 我們非常感激法律顧問團隊在此次併購過程中給予我們的指導。

zh: 優柔寡斷的；無決斷力的
collocations: indecisive leadership (優柔寡斷的領導方式)
tip: 反義字 decisive（果斷的）。在職場主管考核中出現，多帶有負面含意，指難以在關鍵時刻拍板定案。
sentence: An indecisive manager can delay project schedules and cause frustration among team members.
sentenceZh: 優柔寡斷的管理者會延誤專案時程，並在團隊成員之間造成挫折感。

tip: 副詞，用於加強語氣或贊同先前的陳述。在文章承轉句型中常見於段首或句末。
sentence: The proposed marketing budget is steep; indeed, it is the largest allocation we have ever considered.
sentenceZh: 擬議的行銷預算非常龐大；確實，這是我們所考慮過金額最高的一次提撥。

zh: 獨立的；自主的；客觀中立的
collocations: independent contractor (獨立約聘人員/外包商)
tip: 【HR常考詞】independent contractor 指不受公司一般勞動法全職約束的外部承攬人。搭配介系詞 of。
sentence: Headquarters commissioned an independent audit firm to examine the regional subsidiary's financial health.
sentenceZh: 總部委託了一家獨立審計機構，以檢視該區域子公司的財務狀況。

tip: 複合形容詞，中間帶連字號修飾名詞。常見於市場研究、諮詢報告或培訓課程的宣傳單中。同義字 comprehensive, thorough。
sentence: The consulting report provides an in-depth analysis of emerging competitors in the telecommunications sector.
sentenceZh: 該諮詢報告針對電信領域新興的競爭對手提供了深入透徹的分析。

zh: 指數；指標；索引；(v) 編入索引
collocations: consumer price index (消費者物價指數 - CPI)
index wages to inflation (將工資與通膨掛鉤)
tip: CPI（Consumer Price Index）是多益財經聽力與閱讀常見縮寫。當動詞時常考 index A to B（使A隨B連動調整）。
sentence: The consumer price index rose sharply last quarter, signaling persistent inflationary pressures.
sentenceZh: 上季度消費者物價指數大幅上揚，顯示持續存在的通膨壓力。

collocations: indicate a preference for (表明偏好…)
survey results indicate that (調查結果顯示…)
tip: 【閱讀題型天王詞】Part 7 題目常問："What does the passage indicate about...?" 表達客觀事實或數據顯示的趨勢。
sentence: Preliminary survey results indicate that consumers prefer eco-friendly packaging over traditional plastic containers.
sentenceZh: 初步調查結果顯示，相較於傳統塑膠容器，消費者更青睞環保包裝。

collocations: every indication that (種種跡象表明…)
give an indication of (顯示出…的跡象)
tip: 常見句型："There is every indication that..."（種種跡象表明…）。同義字 sign, hint。
sentence: Early ticket sales give a strong indication that the upcoming international expo will break attendance records.
sentenceZh: 初期的售票情況強烈顯示，即將舉辦的國際博覽會將打破參觀人數紀錄。

collocations: key performance indicator (關鍵績效指標 - KPI)
tip: 商業名詞核心：KPI（Key Performance Indicator）已是多益HR與企管題型必備常識詞。
sentence: Customer satisfaction is regarded by the board as a key indicator of long-term corporate viability.
sentenceZh: 董事會將客戶滿意度視為企業長期生存能力的關鍵指標。

collocations: indifference to complaints (對客訴漠不關心)
tip: 在客服考核中常被指為服務缺失的罪魁禍首。搭配介系詞 to（indifference to customer needs）。
sentence: Management reprimanded the branch staff for showing indifference to repeated client complaints.
sentenceZh: 管理層對分行員工多次對客戶投訴表現出冷漠態度的行為予以申誡。

collocations: indifferent to feedback (對回饋漠不關心)
tip: 搭配介系詞 to：be indifferent to。切勿誤解為「無差別的」；在多益中 100% 測驗「不在乎、冷漠」之意。
sentence: A successful business cannot afford to be indifferent to changes in consumer preferences.
sentenceZh: 一家成功的企業絕不能對消費者偏好的變化抱持漠不關心的態度。

collocations: an indispensable member (不可或缺的成員)
play an indispensable role (扮演不可或缺的角色)
tip: 同義字 essential, vital。反義字 dispensable（可有可無的）。介系詞搭配 to 或 for。
sentence: Her extensive knowledge of European trade regulations makes her an indispensable asset to the legal division.
sentenceZh: 她對歐洲貿易法規的淵博知識使她成為法務部門不可或缺的寶貴人才。

zh: 個別的；個人的；(n) 個人
collocations: meet individual needs (滿足個別需求)
a talented individual (才華洋溢的人才)
tip: 作名詞時多益常用指「某特定專業人士或求職者」（We are seeking an experienced individual...）。
sentence: Bonuses will be awarded based on both corporate profitability and individual employee performance.
sentenceZh: 獎金將依據企業整體獲利狀況以及員工個人績效共同進行發放。

collocations: indoor air quality (室內空氣品質)
tip: 【詞性陷阱】indoor 是「形容詞」，只能放在名詞前面修飾（indoor pool）；副詞是加 s 的 indoors。
sentence: The hotel features modern conference rooms and a heated indoor swimming pool for business guests.
sentenceZh: 該飯店設有現代化會議室及專為商務旅客提供的室內溫水游泳池。

tip: 【詞性陷阱】indoors 是「副詞」，修飾動詞，其後不可再接名詞（如 move the event indoors 因下雨把活動移至室內）。
sentence: In case of heavy rain, the annual company picnic will be held indoors at the corporate gymnasium.
sentenceZh: 倘若遇上下大雨，年度員工野餐日將改在公司體育館室內舉行。

tip: 常考商用不動產租售（Real Estate）：industrial park / industrial zone。注意與 industrious（勤奮的）嚴格區分！
sentence: The logistics firm plans to lease a new warehouse facility located within the municipal industrial park.
sentenceZh: 該物流公司計畫在市營工業園區內租賃一座新的倉庫設施。

tip: 常以過去分詞 industrialized 作形容詞修飾 nations / economies（工業化已開發國家）。
sentence: As developing regions rapidly industrialize, demand for advanced manufacturing machinery continues to surge.
sentenceZh: 隨著開發中地區迅速邁向工業化，對先進製造機械的需求持續激增。

tip: 多益常考各大行業專有名詞，如 retail industry、automotive industry、hospitality industry。作勤奮解時為不可數。
sentence: Our newly launched analytics software has rapidly established itself as the new industry standard.
sentenceZh: 我們新推出的分析軟體迅速確立了其作為業界新標準的地位。

zh: 不可避免的；必然發生的
collocations: an inevitable outcome (不可避免的結果)
make delays inevitable (使得延誤無可避免)
tip: 同義字 unavoidable。多益多在敘述市場整併、重組裁員或供應短缺時的客觀必然結果。
sentence: Due to soaring raw material expenses, price adjustments for consumer goods became inevitable.
sentenceZh: 由於原料費用飆升，消費性商品調整價格已變得無可避免。

collocations: inevitably result in (不可避免地造成)
tip: 常考副詞修飾動詞片語：inevitably lead to / result in（不可避免地導致…後果）。
sentence: Postponing system maintenance will inevitably lead to more costly network failures in the future.
sentenceZh: 延遲系統維護日後必然會導致更為昂貴的網路癱瘓損失。

zh: 聲名狼藉的；臭名昭彰的
collocations: an infamous scandal (惡名昭彰的醜聞)
tip: 【發音考點】注意音標重音在第一音節 /ˈɪn.fə.məs/，而非 famous 的發音。同義字 notorious。
sentence: The defunct corporation became infamous for deceptive accounting practices that deceived global investors.
sentenceZh: 這家倒閉的公司因欺騙全球投資人的假帳造假行徑而聲名狼藉。

collocations: in its infancy (處於初期階段)
technology in its infancy (處於萌芽期的技術)
tip: 【商務黃金成語】"in its infancy"（仍在萌芽/起步階段）。多指新興科技如 AI、量子計算或新創市場。
sentence: Although renewable energy technology is still in its infancy in some markets, it holds enormous potential.
sentenceZh: 儘管再生能源技術在某些市場仍處於萌芽階段，但它蘊藏著巨大的潛力。

collocations: infant industry (新興產業/幼稚產業)
tip: 除了指嬰兒用品外，經濟學名詞 infant industry 指剛起步需要政策扶持保護的新興幼稚產業。
sentence: Government subsidies were established to protect the nation's infant renewable energy sector from foreign rivals.
sentenceZh: 政府設立補助金以保護本國尚處於起步階段的再生能源產業免受外國對手競爭。

zh: 感染；侵害；使受不良影響
collocations: infect corporate computers (感染企業電腦)
be infected with malware (感染惡意軟體)
tip: 在多益 IT 與電腦安全通告中，多指出於點擊不明連結而使系統被惡意軟體或病毒「感染」。
sentence: A sophisticated phishing email managed to infect several internal workstations with ransomware.
sentenceZh: 一封精密的網路釣魚郵件成功使數台內部工作站感染了勒索軟體。

tip: 多出現在醫療院所守則、工廠衛生安全手冊或食品加工業消毒規範中。
sentence: Food processing staff are required to sanitize their hands frequently to reduce the risk of viral infection.
sentenceZh: 食品加工人員必須頻繁消毒雙手，以降低病毒感染的風險。

collocations: infer from the text (從文中推斷)
infer market trends (推斷市場趨勢)
tip: 【閱讀題型標題】Part 7 最具挑戰性的推論題："What can be inferred about...?" 注意：答案不會字面直接寫出，需抓暗示。
sentence: From the sales manager's tone during the briefing, analysts inferred that upcoming quarterly figures would be disappointing.
sentenceZh: 從業務經理在簡報時的語氣，分析師推斷即將公佈的季度數據可能會令人失望。

tip: 常搭配動詞 draw：draw an inference from sth（從…中得出推論）。同義字 conclusion, deduction。
sentence: Based on the decline in store foot traffic, researchers drew the inference that shoppers now prefer purchasing online.
sentenceZh: 基於實體店面客流量的下滑，研究人員得出了消費者如今更偏好線上購物的推論。

tip: 【文法考點大陷阱】拉丁形容詞比較級！絕對不可寫 inferior than，**必須搭配介系詞 to**（inferior to）。
sentence: The customer complained that the replacement parts were markedly inferior in quality to the original components.
sentenceZh: 該名顧客投訴稱，替代零件的品質明顯次於原廠零件。

zh: 資訊；訊息（information 口語簡稱）
collocations: for more info, visit... (欲知更多詳情請造訪…)
tip: 雖然是 information 的簡稱，但在現代商務 email、廣告傳單、網站表格中極度普及，如 info@company.com。
sentence: Please provide your billing details and up-to-date contact info before proceeding to checkout.
sentenceZh: 在前往結帳之前，請先提供您的帳單資訊與最新聯絡方式。

collocations: inform sb of/about sth (通知某人某事)
keep sb informed (使某人持續掌握最新進展)
pleased to inform you that (很高興通知您…)
tip: 【必考句型】"Please keep me informed of any developments."（有任何進展請隨時告訴我）。受詞後接 of + 名詞或 that 子句。
sentence: We regret to inform you that the keynote lecture has been rescheduled to tomorrow morning.
sentenceZh: 我們很遺憾地通知您，專題演講已重新安排至明天上午進行。

collocations: informal dress code (便服著裝規範)
tip: 反義字 formal。在公司內部聯誼、休閒星期五（Casual Friday）或團隊內部非正式協調會中常見。
sentence: The department held an informal welcome luncheon to help the new interns get acquainted with senior staff.
sentenceZh: 該部門舉辦了一場非正式的歡迎午餐會，以幫助新實習生熟悉資深員工。

collocations: request further information (索取進一步資訊)
tip: 【多益文法大魔王】information 是**不可數名詞**！絕不可加 s，也不能加 an（不可說 an information）。表一件要用 a piece of info。
sentence: For more information regarding international shipping options, please consult our customer service department.
sentenceZh: 欲獲取有關國際海空運選項的更多資訊，請洽詢我們的客戶服務部門。

zh: 內容豐富的；提供很多有用訊息的
collocations: an informative presentation (內容充實的簡報)
an informative brochure (資料詳盡的手冊)
tip: 研討會後滿意度問卷（Evaluation Form）的最高頻讚賞詞。不可與 informed（見多識廣的/知情的）混淆。
sentence: Participants praised the workshop as both engaging and highly informative for developing financial strategies.
sentenceZh: 與會者稱讚該工作坊既引人入勝又內容豐富，對制定財務策略極具助益。

zh: 基礎建設；基礎設施；公共設施
collocations: IT infrastructure (資訊科技基礎架構)
invest in infrastructure (投資基礎建設)
tip: 在政府標案、城市規劃及企業 IT 系統升級（如伺服器、雲端硬體）中為核心字彙。
sentence: The municipal government secured federal funding to overhaul the city's aging transportation infrastructure.
sentenceZh: 市政府獲得了聯邦資金，用以全面翻新該市老化的交通基礎設施。

collocations: key ingredient (關鍵要素/關鍵成分)
tip: 多益雙考點：餐飲食品標示（Food Labels）上的原材料配方；或引申為成功的關鍵要素（a key ingredient for success）。
sentence: The bakery takes pride in sourcing fresh, locally produced ingredients for all its artisanal breads.
sentenceZh: 這家烘焙坊以其所有手工麵包皆採用新鮮的在地食材而自豪。

collocations: inhabit the region (居住在該區域)
tip: 及物動詞，直接加地方名詞，不可加 in（不可說 inhabit in a city）。同義字 populate, dwell in。
sentence: Thousands of employees inhabit the residential high-rises constructed adjacent to the business district.
sentenceZh: 成千上萬的員工居住在鄰近商業區建造的住宅大樓內。

tip: 在城市更新計畫、公聽會通知（Town Hall Meeting）中常與 resident, citizen 互相替換考同義字。
sentence: Local inhabitants expressed environmental concerns regarding the proposed construction of a chemical warehouse.
sentenceZh: 當地居民對擬議興建的化學品倉庫表達了環境方面的擔憂。

zh: 固有的；內在的；與生俱來的
collocations: inherent risk (固有風險/潛在風險)
tip: 【金融投資必背】常與 risk 連用：inherent risks（不可避免的固有風險）。接介系詞 in。
sentence: Investors should carefully weigh the inherent risks before committing capital to volatile cryptocurrency markets.
sentenceZh: 投資人在將資金投入劇烈波動的加密貨幣市場之前，應審慎權衡其固有風險。

zh: 最初的；開始的；(v) 在…上簽署姓名首字母
collocations: initial each page (在每一頁簽名縮寫)
tip: 【雙重考法】當形容詞為「最初的」（Initial Public Offering - IPO 首次公開募股）；當動詞指「在合約每頁角角落簽名縮寫確認」。
sentence: Please initial each page of the non-disclosure agreement before returning the signed contract to HR.
sentenceZh: 在將簽署好的合約送回人資部前，請在保密協議的每一頁下方簽署姓名首字母縮寫。

tip: 【出題線索詞】文章中一旦出現 initially，通常暗示「後來發生了變動」（Initially we planned... however...）。必考後面轉折！
sentence: Although the software was initially priced at $50 per user, promotional discounts lowered the rate for enterprise clients.
sentenceZh: 儘管該軟體最初定價為每位用戶 50 美元，但促銷折扣降低了企業客戶的費率。

collocations: initiate legal proceedings (提起法律訴訟)
tip: 同義字 launch, start, kick off。在正式商務或法務溝通中，偏好使用正式度更高的 initiate 來代表專案啟動。
sentence: The executive committee decided to initiate a thorough internal investigation into the accounting anomalies.
sentenceZh: 執行委員會決定針對會計異常狀況展開徹底的內部調查。

tip: 常考商務會員制俱樂部或健身中心收取的「入會費」（initiation fee / induction fee）。
sentence: New members of the executive business club are required to pay a one-time initiation fee upon registration.
sentenceZh: 高階商務俱樂部的新會員在註冊時需繳納一次性的入會費。

zh: 新倡議；新措施；主動性；主導權
collocations: take the initiative (採取主動/帶頭)
tip: 【名師極度強調】字尾是 -ive 但 100% 考「可數名詞」！常考 take the initiative（主動出擊）及各種策略措施。
sentence: The company launched an ambitious green initiative aimed at reducing greenhouse gas emissions by forty percent.
sentenceZh: 該公司推出了一項雄心勃勃的綠色環保倡議，旨在將溫室氣體排放量減少百分之四十。

tip: 在財經商業中，inject 90% 考「向企業或市場注入資金/資本」（inject capital / liquidity into the economy）。
sentence: The private equity group agreed to inject twenty million dollars into the struggling retail startup.
sentenceZh: 該私募股權集團同意向陷入困境的零售新創公司注資兩千萬美元。

tip: 多益財經高頻片語：cash injection（資金挹注），常指藉由外部注資拯救陷入現金流危機的公司。
sentence: Without a prompt cash injection from investors, the manufacturing firm would have faced bankruptcy.
sentenceZh: 若沒有投資者迅速挹注現金，該製造商原本將面臨破產命運。

tip: 工安報告主題詞彙。常用被動語態：Three workers were injured in the equipment failure.
sentence: The technician was injured while servicing the assembly robot without disabling the master power switch.
sentenceZh: 該技術員在未關閉總電源開關的情況下維修組裝機器人時受傷。

collocations: the injured party (受損方/受害方)
tip: 在合約或賠償爭端中，"the injured party" 指權益受到損害的「受害方/受損方」，非單指肢體受傷。
sentence: The company promised full medical compensation and disability coverage to the injured employee.
sentenceZh: 公司承諾向受傷員工提供全額醫療補償及失能保障保險。

tip: 常考工傷賠償（Worker's Compensation）主題。片語 on-the-job injury 指執勤期間受傷。
sentence: Management introduced stricter safety drills to prevent future workplace injuries on the factory floor.
sentenceZh: 管理層推出了更嚴格的安全演練，以防止廠房內再次發生職場工傷事故。

collocations: inner city (市中心老舊貧困區/市中心)
tip: 反義字 outer。修飾城市時，inner-city 指市區中心；修飾組織時，inner circle 指掌握決策權的核心智囊層。
sentence: A comprehensive documentary revealed the complex inner workings of the international banking conglomerate.
sentenceZh: 一部詳盡的紀錄片揭露了這家跨國銀行集團內部複雜的運作機制。

tip: 法律主題常考無罪推定：presumed innocent until proven guilty。反義字 guilty。
sentence: The compliance committee found the branch manager innocent of any wrongdoing regarding financial disclosure.
sentenceZh: 合規委員會認定分行經理在財務揭露方面沒有任何不當行為，完全清白。

collocations: innovate in product design (在產品設計上創新)
tip: 既可當不及物動詞（innovate continuously），也可當及物動詞。形容公司在激烈市場中保持領先的必備動詞。
sentence: To remain competitive against agile tech startups, established firms must continuously innovate and adapt.
sentenceZh: 為了與敏捷的科技初創公司保持競爭力，老牌企業必須持續不斷地創新與適應。

tip: 多益商業年度報告、招募文宣高頻字。常與動詞 encourage, foster, spur（激發、培養）搭配。
sentence: The CEO emphasized that fostering innovation within engineering teams is essential to long-term market dominance.
sentenceZh: 執行長強調，在工程團隊內部培養創新思維對於維持長期的市場主導地位至關重要。

tip: 字尾 -or 表人。常在商務人物專訪（Profile）中出現，形容突破傳統思維引領業界革新的領袖。
sentence: Recognized as a leading innovator in sustainable architecture, Ms. Park received an international design award.
sentenceZh: 朴女士被公認為永續建築領域的領軍革新者，榮獲了一項國際設計大獎。

collocations: inquire about availability (詢問是否有空缺/現貨)
inquire into the matter (調查該事件)
tip: 【介系詞考點】inquire about sth（詢問某事資訊）；inquire into sth（深入調查某事件）。美式常拼為 inquire，英式拼 enquire。
sentence: Several potential buyers called customer support to inquire about the commercial availability of the new tablet.
sentenceZh: 數名潛在買家致電客服部門，詢問新款平板電腦何時能在市面上買到。

collocations: respond to customer inquiries (回覆客戶諮詢)
conduct an inquiry into (對…進行調查)
tip: 【客服核心名詞】信件開頭常用金句："In response to your inquiry dated October 5th..."（針對您10月5日的詢問…）。
sentence: Our support center aims to resolve all general billing inquiries within twenty-four business hours.
sentenceZh: 我們的客服中心致力於在二十四個工作小時內解決所有一般帳單諮詢。

collocations: an insane idea (瘋狂荒謬的想法)
tip: 在一般商務中多為口語或修辭用法，指某項提案代價過於高昂或荒謬不可行。反義字 sane（明智理智的）。
sentence: Investing the department's entire reserve fund into an unproven startup would be financially insane.
sentenceZh: 將該部門的全部準備金投入一家未經考驗的新創公司，在財務上簡直是瘋狂之舉。

collocations: sheer insanity (純粹是瘋了/荒唐至極)
tip: 名詞形式。商業評論有時借用愛因斯坦名言：重複做同樣的事卻期待不同結果是 insanity。
sentence: Launching an overseas subsidiary without completing compliance screening was sheer financial insanity.
sentenceZh: 在未完成合規審查的情況下就設立海外子公司，純粹是財務上的瘋狂行徑。

collocations: insecure network connection (不安全的網路連線)
feel insecure about (對…感到不自信/缺乏安全感)
tip: 多益雙考點：在 IT 資安中指系統或連線「缺乏防護、容易被攻擊」；在 HR 職場心理指員工「對職位穩定度感到不安」。
sentence: Employees are warned never to transmit sensitive corporate data over an insecure public Wi-Fi network.
sentenceZh: 員工受到告誡，切勿透過不安全的公共 Wi-Fi 網路傳輸敏感的企業資料。

zh: 不安全；不穩定；心神不定
collocations: job insecurity (工作無保障/職業不安全感)
tip: 高頻名詞片語 job insecurity（工作缺乏保障、隨時可能被解雇的焦慮感），常出現在職場員工滿意度調查中。
sentence: The rumors of an imminent corporate merger created widespread job insecurity across several departments.
sentenceZh: 關於即將進行企業併購的傳聞，在數個部門之間引發了普遍的工作不安全感。

zh: 插入；放進；嵌入；(n) 插頁；夾頁廣告
collocations: insert a coin/card (插入硬幣/晶片卡)
insert a row in the spreadsheet (在試算表插入一列)
tip: ATM 操作或刷卡機操作說明（insert your chip card）；當名詞時指報紙雜誌中的促銷插頁廣告（advertising insert）。
sentence: Please insert your credit card into the reader and keep it in place until the transaction is verified.
sentenceZh: 請將信用卡插入讀卡機中，並保持不動直到交易驗證完成。

zh: 在…裡面；(n) 內部；(a) 內部的
collocations: inside the premises (在營業處所內部)
tip: 多益合約或法規中常出現 inside the building/facility。作形容詞時常見 inside information（內部內線消息）。
sentence: All personnel must display their identification badges at all times while inside the research facility.
sentenceZh: 所有人員在研究設施內部時，必須全程配戴身分識別證件。

zh: 內部人士；知情人士；圈內人
collocations: an industry insider (業界知情人士)
tip: 【金融法務必考神詞】"insider trading"（內線交易），是指利用非公開機密資訊進行股票買賣的嚴重違法行為。
sentence: The regulatory commission launched an inquiry to determine whether the executive engaged in illegal insider trading.
sentenceZh: 監管委員會展開調查，以查明該主管是否涉及非法內線交易。

zh: 深刻見解；洞察力；深入瞭解
collocations: provide valuable insights into (對…提供寶貴見解)
actionable insights (可付諸行動的洞見)
tip: 【固定搭配介系詞 into】insight into sth。在顧問報告、市場調研（Part 7）結尾中頻繁出現。
sentence: The keynote speaker offered valuable insights into the future implications of generative artificial intelligence for retail.
sentenceZh: 專題講者針對生成式人工智慧對零售業的未來影響，提供了極為寶貴的深刻見解。

collocations: insist on doing sth (堅持要做某事)
insist that S (should) V (堅持要求某人必須做…)
tip: 【兩大文法高頻陷阱】1. 接介系詞 on: insist on paying；2. 意志動詞接 that 子句，子句動詞用原形動詞（should省略）！
sentence: The corporate client insisted that the software developer complete the security audit before final payment.
sentenceZh: 該企業客戶堅決要求軟體開發商在結清尾款之前，必須先完成資安審計。

collocations: inspect for defects (檢查有無瑕疵)
tip: 多益常考 inspect + 受詞 + for + 瑕疵/損壞 (inspect products for defects)。同義字為 examine, check。
sentence: Quality control officers will inspect the assembly line to ensure all components meet international safety standards.
sentenceZh: 品管人員將檢查組裝線，以確保所有零組件皆符合國際安全標準。

tip: 常考 on-site inspection（現場檢查）以及 undergo/conduct an inspection。常與 test, audit 作混淆辨析。
sentence: The warehouse is scheduled to undergo a rigorous routine inspection tomorrow morning.
sentenceZh: 該倉庫預計於明天上午接受嚴格的例行檢查。

collocations: health and safety inspector (工安檢查員)
tip: 常見於多益 Part 7 報告信件署名職稱。注意與 applicant（申請人）或 supervisor（主管）在職業身份題中區分。
sentence: The building inspector requested additional blueprints before issuing the occupancy permit.
sentenceZh: 建築檢驗員在核發使用執照之前，要求提供補充的建築藍圖。

zh: 靈感；鼓舞人心的人事物
tip: 多益閱讀常考 draw/take inspiration from...（自…獲得靈感）。形容詞為 inspiring，名詞為 inspiration。
sentence: The designer drew inspiration from traditional architecture when creating the new corporate headquarters.
sentenceZh: 這位設計師在設計新的企業總部時，從傳統建築中汲取了靈感。

collocations: inspire someone to do something (激勵某人做某事)
tip: 句型為 inspire + O + to V（激勵某人去…）。被動態 be inspired by 亦極常出現在演講致詞與企業人物報導中。
sentence: The CEO's keynote address inspired employees to embrace technological innovation.
sentenceZh: 執行長的主題演講激勵了員工擁抱科技創新。

zh: 鼓舞人心的；激勵人心的
collocations: inspiring leader (令人欽佩的領導者)
tip: 形容詞分詞題：修飾令人感動的「事物/演講/成就」用 inspiring；修飾「人感到備受鼓舞」用 inspired。
sentence: Her journey from an entry-level clerk to regional director was truly inspiring to all junior staff.
sentenceZh: 她從基層職員晉升為區域主管的歷程，對所有基層員工而言都極具鼓舞性。

tip: 易混淆字：installment（分期付款/連載之一集）vs. installation（安裝，名詞）。文法常考被動態 be installed in/on。
sentence: The IT department will install the updated accounting software on all workstations this weekend.
sentenceZh: 資訊科技部門本週末將在所有工作站上安裝更新後的會計軟體。

zh: 分期付款；（分期連載的）一集
collocations: pay in monthly installments (按月分期付款)
tip: 極高頻商業情境：pay in installments（分期付款）。千萬別誤以為是 install 的動作（安裝是 installation）。
sentence: Customers can purchase the enterprise package by paying in twelve equal monthly installments.
sentenceZh: 客戶可以分十二期等額月付款購買該企業套裝方案。

tip: 片語 for instance 等同於 for example。在多益 Part 6/7 轉折詞填空題中極常作為舉例指標詞出題。
sentence: There have been several instances of network downtime during peak transaction hours.
sentenceZh: 在交易尖峰時段曾發生過數次網路連線中斷的實例。

tip: 同義字為 immediate。在商業科技情境中，instant notification（即時通知）為常見組合。
sentence: The new mobile application provides users with instant access to their investment portfolios.
sentenceZh: 這款新的行動應用程式為用戶提供了即時查看其投資組合的途徑。

collocations: transmit data instantaneously (即時傳輸數據)
tip: 副詞修飾動詞，同義字為 immediately, promptly。常見於描述雲端系統或自動化資料同步。
sentence: Cloud-based synchronization ensures that documents are updated instantaneously across all devices.
sentenceZh: 雲端同步功能確保文件在所有裝置上都能即時更新。

tip: 文法陷阱：instead 為副詞，放句首需加逗號或置於句尾；instead of 為介系詞片語，後方接名詞或動名詞。
sentence: We decided not to outsource the project and developed the software in-house instead.
sentenceZh: 我們決定不將該專案外包，而是改由內部自行開發軟體。

collocations: institute legal proceedings (提起法律訴訟)
tip: 作動詞時表示「制定、設立、實施（政策、規定等）」，同義於 implement, establish。
sentence: The management decided to institute a stricter policy regarding remote work attendance.
sentenceZh: 管理階層決定針對遠距辦公出勤實施更嚴格的政策。

tip: financial institution（金融機構）在多益聽力 Part 3/4 與閱讀 Part 7 屬必備主題核心詞。
sentence: Several prominent financial institutions have approved the terms of the merger.
sentenceZh: 幾家著名金融機構已核准了該合併案的條款。

collocations: instruct somebody to do something (指示某人做某事)
tip: 常見被動句型：be instructed to + V（被指示去做…）。注意字尾 -t，名詞為 instruction，人為 instructor。
sentence: Employees were instructed to log out of their terminals before leaving the office.
sentenceZh: 員工接獲指示，在離開辦公室前必須先登出終端機。

tip: 表示「操作指引、說明書」時通常用複數形 instructions。例如：Please read the instructions carefully.
sentence: Please review the safety instructions thoroughly before operating the heavy machinery.
sentenceZh: 在操作重型機械之前，請務必詳閱安全指示說明。

tip: 多益常出現在 corporate training（企業內部培訓）的招募或通知情境中，同義字為 trainer, lecturer。
sentence: The corporate training seminar will be conducted by a certified management instructor.
sentenceZh: 這場企業培訓研討會將由一位具認證的管理講師主持。

tip: 多益常見為 precision instrument（精密儀器）或 financial instrument（金融工具/商品）。
sentence: Technicians must calibrate the measuring instruments before testing the prototype.
sentenceZh: 技術人員在測試原型產品之前，必須先校準測量儀器。

zh: 有幫助的；起重要作用的
collocations: be instrumental in doing something (在…中扮演關鍵角色)
tip: 重要高分搭配：be instrumental in + N/V-ing（在某事上發揮極大貢獻）。
sentence: Ms. Gomez was instrumental in securing the multi-million-dollar government contract.
sentenceZh: 戈梅茲女士在爭取這項數百萬美元的政府合約中發揮了關鍵作用。

collocations: intended as an insult (意圖侮辱)
tip: 發音重音陷阱：動詞重音在後 /ɪnˈsʌlt/，名詞重音在前 /ˈɪn.sʌlt/。商務上多強調 professional conduct。
sentence: Customer service representatives must remain courteous and avoid using words that could insult patrons.
sentenceZh: 客服代表必須保持彬彬有禮，避免使用可能冒犯顧客的言詞。

tip: 商務常考搭配：insurance coverage（保險承保範圍）、insurance premium（保險費）。
sentence: The company offers comprehensive health insurance to all full-time employees upon hiring.
sentenceZh: 公司在受聘時即向所有全職員工提供全面的健康保險。

collocations: insure against damage (投保…以防損壞)
tip: 易混淆字：insure（投保、買保險）vs. ensure（確保某事發生）vs. assure（向某人保證、使確信）。
sentence: The shipping company advises clients to insure valuable cargo against transit loss.
sentenceZh: 這家貨運公司建議客戶為貴重貨物投保運輸損失險。

tip: 商業倫理中常指「道德正直」；工程或資訊題型中則指「結構/資料完整性 (data integrity)」。
sentence: Our firm places the highest value on professional integrity and transparency in all dealings.
sentenceZh: 我們公司在所有的交易中均最重視專業誠信與透明度。

tip: 科技題常考 Artificial Intelligence (AI)；行銷管理題常考 competitive intelligence（競爭情報）。
sentence: Leveraging artificial intelligence has significantly improved our predictive analytics capabilities.
sentenceZh: 善用人工智慧顯著提升了我們進行預測性分析的能力。

collocations: intend to do something (打算做某事)
be intended for (專門為…而設計的)
tip: 高頻片語：be intended for + 對象（旨在給…使用/閱讀）。例如：This handbook is intended for new recruits.
sentence: The board of directors intends to announce the next quarterly dividend next Monday.
sentenceZh: 董事會打算在下週一公布下一季度的股利發放。

tip: 多益常考「市場競爭激烈」：intense competition / fierce competition。副詞為 intensely。
sentence: Due to intense competition in the smartphone market, companies are investing heavily in research.
sentenceZh: 由於智慧型手機市場競爭激烈，各公司皆大舉投資於研發。

collocations: intensify marketing efforts (加大行銷力度)
tip: 及物動詞表示「強化（努力/宣傳）」，不及物動詞表示「（衝突/壓力）加劇、升高」。
sentence: The airline plans to intensify its promotional campaign before the upcoming holiday travel season.
sentenceZh: 該航空公司計劃在即將到來的假期旅遊季前加大促銷宣傳力度。

tip: 字尾常考複合形容詞：labor-intensive（勞力密集）、time-intensive（耗時的）。常修飾 course/seminar。
sentence: New recruits are required to complete a three-week intensive training program before joining their teams.
sentenceZh: 新進員工在加入團隊前，必須完成為期三週的密集培訓計畫。

collocations: with the intent of (帶著…的目的)
tip: 商務合約高頻詞彙：Letter of Intent (LOI，意向書)。注意作形容詞時為 intent on + V-ing（專心致志於…）。
sentence: Both corporations signed a non-binding letter of intent to explore partnership opportunities.
sentenceZh: 雙方企業簽署了一份不具法律約束力的意向書，以探索合作機會。

collocations: have every intention of doing (十分打算做…)
no intention to leave (無意離開)
tip: 常見句型：have no intention of V-ing（完全沒有…的打算）。後接 of + V-ing 或 to V 皆可。
sentence: The regional sales director announced her intention to retire at the end of the fiscal year.
sentenceZh: 區域業務總監宣布她打算在本財政年度結束時退休。

tip: 工業製造情境常考 interchangeable parts（通用/可互換零件），降低維修更換成本。
sentence: The new printer models use interchangeable toner cartridges to simplify inventory management.
sentenceZh: 新型印表機機型採用可互換碳粉匣，以簡化庫存管理。

collocations: in the best interest of (符合…的最佳利益)
tip: 多義字陷阱：多益金融常考 interest rate（利率）；管理合約常考 conflict of interest（利益衝突）。
sentence: The central bank decided to lower benchmark interest rates to stimulate business investment.
sentenceZh: 中央銀行決定調降基準利率以刺激企業投資。

collocations: interfere in internal affairs (干涉內部事務)
tip: 必考介系詞：interfere with + 事物（干涉、妨礙某進程）；interfere in + 人/局勢（插手、干涉）。
sentence: Scheduled office renovations should not interfere with regular daily business operations.
sentenceZh: 預定進行的辦公室裝修工程不應妨礙日常業務運作。

tip: 常考 interior designer/decorator。反義字為 exterior（外部的；外觀）。
sentence: The commercial building's interior was completely remodeled to create an open-plan workspace.
sentenceZh: 這棟商業大樓的內部經過全面改建，以打造開放式的工作空間。

tip: 在 IT 報修與技術支援題型中極常見，如 intermittent internet access（網路時好時壞）。
sentence: Several remote workers reported experiencing intermittent network connectivity this morning.
sentenceZh: 幾位遠距工作者回報今晨遇到了網路連線斷斷續續的問題。

tip: HR 或管理題型常出 internal transfer（內部調動）或 internal audit（內部審計）。反義詞為 external。
sentence: The department circulated an internal memo detailing the revised protocol for expense reports.
sentenceZh: 該部門發出了一份內部備忘錄，詳細說明修改後的報銷單申請流程。

tip: 常見搭配 international expansion（國際擴展）、international courier（國際快遞）。
sentence: The marketing team is preparing a presentation for the upcoming international trade convention.
sentenceZh: 行銷團隊正為即將舉行的國際貿易大會準備簡報。

collocations: internationalize the brand (推動品牌國際化)
tip: 動詞字尾 -ize。多益商業策略文意中常與 expand overseas, globalize 做同義抽換。
sentence: To remain competitive, the regional retail chain decided to internationalize its operations.
sentenceZh: 為了維持競爭力，這家區域零售連鎖店決定推動其營運走向國際化。

collocations: interpret for attendees (為與會人員口譯)
tip: 在商務中兼具「翻譯口述語言」與「解讀分析（財務報表、市場調查結果）」兩種核心考點。
sentence: Financial analysts are needed to interpret the survey findings accurately for senior management.
sentenceZh: 需要財務分析師為高階管理團隊精確解讀這些調查結果。

tip: 考點辨析：interpreter 是「口譯員」；translator 是「筆譯員」。多益國際研討會題材必備字。
sentence: A simultaneous interpreter was assigned to assist the delegation during the bilateral talks.
sentenceZh: 指派了一名同步口譯員在雙邊會談期間協助代表團。

collocations: sorry to interrupt (抱歉打擾一下)
tip: 多益聽力 Part 3/4 對話常見客套語：Pardon me, but I didn't mean to interrupt you.
sentence: Severe thunderstorms threatened to interrupt the live satellite broadcast of the product launch.
sentenceZh: 強烈的雷雨差點中斷了新品發表會的現場衛星直播。

tip: 通知信必考：We apologize for any service interruption...（對於服務中斷我們深感抱歉…）。
sentence: Backup generators prevented any interruption to production during the power grid failure.
sentenceZh: 備用發電機在電網發生故障時，防止了生產作業受到任何中斷。

collocations: call for an interview (通知面試)
tip: 人資求職主題第一名詞。常見搭配 shortlist applicants for an interview（篩選應徵者進入面試）。
sentence: Candidates who pass the screening will be invited for a second round of panel interviews.
sentenceZh: 通過書面篩選的候選人將受邀參加第二輪的小組面試。

tip: 字尾辨析：-er 是主動方（interviewer 主試官），-ee 是被動方（interviewee 受試者）。同理 trainer/trainee。
sentence: The human resources manager commended each interviewee for their professional composure.
sentenceZh: 人資經理讚揚了每位受試者的專業沉著表現。

tip: 常出現在人資審核流程中。注意聽力主被動語態所對應的角色區分。
sentence: The interviewer asked detailed questions regarding the candidate's previous project management experience.
sentenceZh: 面試官針對該候選人過往的專案管理經驗提出了詳細的問題。

tip: 同義字為 complex, elaborate, sophisticated。形容手工藝品、工程機械或合約細節。
sentence: The watchmaker demonstrated how to assemble the intricate mechanical gears of the luxury timepiece.
sentenceZh: 鐘錶大師親自示範如何組裝這款奢華腕錶精細複雜的機械齒輪。

collocations: introduce a new product (推出新產品)
tip: 商業題型中 introduce a product 等同於 launch/roll out a product（推出新品）。
sentence: The tech firm plans to introduce a new line of eco-friendly monitors next quarter.
sentenceZh: 該科技公司計劃於下季度推出一系列環保顯示器。

collocations: with the introduction of (隨著…的引進)
letter of introduction (推薦信；介紹信)
tip: 常見句型：with the introduction of new technology（隨著新科技的引進）。
sentence: The introduction of automated checkout kiosks significantly reduced waiting times for patrons.
sentenceZh: 自助結帳機的引進大幅縮短了顧客的等候時間。

tip: 行銷促銷必考搭配：introductory price / offer / rate（新上市推廣優惠價）。
sentence: Subscribe now to take advantage of our limited-time introductory rate for new members.
sentenceZh: 立即訂閱，即可享受我們為新會員提供的限時入門優惠價。

tip: 強調「無中生有」的發明；不同於 discover（發現既有的事物）。專利主題常見。
sentence: Engineers worked collaboratively to invent a more energy-efficient refrigeration system.
sentenceZh: 工程師們通力合作，發明了一種更具能源效益的冷卻系統。

tip: 常出現在專利申請（patent application）與研發（R&D）報告的文章脈絡中。
sentence: The patent office recognized the researcher's breakthrough invention with an industry award.
sentenceZh: 專利局以產業獎項表揚了該研究員的突破性發明。

collocations: inventive solution (具創意的解決方案)
tip: 同義字為 creative, innovative。經常用於形容研發團隊或專案負責人。
sentence: Our software development team proposed an inventive solution to address the server latency.
sentenceZh: 我們的軟體開發團隊提出了一個具創意的解決方案，以解決伺服器延遲問題。

tip: 在專利文件情境中，名列 inventor 與 applicant（申請專利權利之公司機構）之區分常為考點。
sentence: The lead inventor will present the prototype at the international science and technology expo.
sentenceZh: 首席發明家將在國際科技博覽會上展示其原型產品。

tip: 多益聽力/閱讀高頻字。搭配動詞用 take/conduct inventory（盤點存貨）。同義字為 stock。
sentence: The store will be closed this Friday so staff can conduct the annual physical inventory count.
sentenceZh: 該門市本週五將暫停營業，以便員工進行年度實體庫存盤點。

collocations: invest in research and development (投資於研發)
tip: 固定介系詞搭配：invest in + N/V-ing。受詞可以是資金（money）、時間（time）或資源（resources）。
sentence: The venture capital group decided to invest substantially in renewable energy start-ups.
sentenceZh: 該創業投資集團決定對再生能源新創公司進行大幅投資。

collocations: return on investment (投資報酬率, ROI)
tip: 商務指標必考縮寫：ROI (Return on Investment)。形容詞搭配常見 sound / profitable investment。
sentence: Upgrading the manufacturing machinery proved to be a sound long-term investment.
sentenceZh: 升級製造設備經證實是一項穩健的長期投資。

tip: 財經新聞常考 investor confidence（投資人信心）與 annual investor meeting（年度股東投資人會議）。
sentence: The startup attracted foreign investors after demonstrating its patented AI algorithm.
sentenceZh: 該新創公司在展示其專利人工智慧演算法後，吸引了外國投資人。

collocations: invisible to the naked eye (肉眼看不見的)
tip: 反義字為 visible。隱喻用法常見 invisible costs（隱形成本）、invisible earnings（無形收益）。
sentence: Effective maintenance keeps wear and tear almost invisible to visitors touring the facility.
sentenceZh: 有效的維護使參觀該設施的訪客幾乎看不出任何磨損痕跡。

tip: 多益商業公關信件常考動詞搭配 extend an invitation to someone（向某人發出邀請）。
sentence: The executive committee extended a formal invitation to the keynote speaker for the gala.
sentenceZh: 執行委員會向晚會的主題演講者發出了正式邀請。

collocations: invite somebody to attend (邀請某人參加)
tip: 多益進階用法：invite 除了邀請人之外，常表示「徵求（意見、提案）」：invite proposals / applications。
sentence: The board invites suggestions from all staff members regarding the new benefits package.
sentenceZh: 董事會歡迎並徵求所有員工對新福利方案的建議。

zh: 發票；請款單；(v) 開立發票
tip: 多益採購與會計高頻字。國外 invoice 主要是「請款清單」，跟中文的統一發票性質不同。receipt 則是「收據」。
sentence: Payment must be received within thirty calendar days from the date of the invoice.
sentenceZh: 款項必須自發票開立日起三十個日曆天內收到。

tip: 常見文法：involve 後面接動名詞 V-ing（不可接 to V）。被動片語為 be involved in（參與…）。
sentence: The upcoming corporate restructuring will involve consolidating several regional offices.
sentenceZh: 即將進行的企業重組將涉及合併數個區域辦事處。

tip: 企業社會責任（CSR）題型必考 community involvement（參與社區回饋活動）。
sentence: Active employee involvement is essential to the successful implementation of the safety protocol.
sentenceZh: 員工的積極參與對於安全標準作業程序的成功推行至關重要。

collocations: irrelevant to the discussion (與討論無關)
tip: 固定搭配介系詞 to：be irrelevant to something。反義詞為 relevant (to)。
sentence: The committee dismissed the complaint because the evidence provided was completely irrelevant to the case.
sentenceZh: 委員會駁回了這起申訴，因為所提供的證據與該案完全無關。

zh: 發行；核發；(n) 問題；期號
tip: 多義詞必考！動詞：issue a badge/refund（發放識別證/退款）；名詞：current issue of a magazine（雜誌當期）。
sentence: The accounting department will issue a full refund to the client due to the billing discrepancy.
sentenceZh: 由於帳單金額有出入，會計部將向客戶全額退款。

collocations: item on the agenda (議程上的項目)
tip: 商業購物常見 damaged items（受損商品）、line item（明細項目）。
sentence: Please verify whether all delivered items match the quantities listed on the packing slip.
sentenceZh: 請核對所有送達品項是否與裝箱單上所列的數量相符。

tip: 極常以分詞形式出現：itemized bill / receipt / deduction（附明細的帳單/收據/扣除額）。
sentence: To receive full reimbursement, employees must submit an itemized receipt for all meal expenses.
sentenceZh: 若要獲得全額報銷，員工必須提交所有餐飲費用的明細收據。

tip: 出差旅遊題絕對必備字！常考同義字 schedule。常用搭配 provide an itinerary / finalize the itinerary。
sentence: The executive assistant finalized the travel itinerary for the CEO's overseas marketing tour.
sentenceZh: 行政助理為執行長敲定了海外行銷考察的完整旅行行程。

tip: 形容詞形式為 janitorial（清潔的），如 janitorial services（大樓保潔服務），常考於合約外包題。
sentence: The building management hired a new janitor to oversee the sanitation of the common areas.
sentenceZh: 大樓管理處聘請了一位新清潔人員來負責公共區域的環境衛生。

tip: 注意文法：job 為「可數名詞」，而 work 作為工作時為「不可數名詞」。因此可以说 a job，不可說 a work。
sentence: The HR department updated the online job description to attract more qualified candidates.
sentenceZh: 人資部門更新了線上的職務說明，以吸引更多合格的應徵者。

collocations: jobless claims (申請失業救濟人數)
tip: 商務新聞常考 jobless rate（等同 unemployment rate）以及 weekly jobless claims（每週初次申請失業金人數）。
sentence: The government reported a marginal decline in the national jobless rate for the past quarter.
sentenceZh: 政府公佈上一季度的全國失業率略有下降。

collocations: jog someone's memory (喚起某人記憶)
tip: 除了運動慢跑，多益片語偶考 jog someone's memory（喚起某人的回憶/記性）。
sentence: Looking at the archived meeting minutes helped jog his memory about the initial contract discussions.
sentenceZh: 查看留存的會議記錄有助於喚起他對最初合約討論的記憶。

collocations: join us for lunch (與我們共進午餐)
tip: 「加入公司」直接說 join the company，千萬不可加 into 或 to。歡迎新員工句型常考：Please join me in welcoming...
sentence: We are delighted that Dr. Reynolds will join our research division as senior director next month.
sentenceZh: 我們非常高興雷諾茲博士下個月將加入我們的研發部門擔任資深總監。

tip: 商務高頻詞：joint venture (JV，合資企業/合資經營)。副詞 jointly 也常考（jointly organized 共同舉辦）。
sentence: The two multinational corporations established a joint venture to build electric vehicle batteries.
sentenceZh: 這兩家跨國公司成立了一家合資企業，以生產電動車電池。

collocations: trade journal (產業雜誌/商業期刊)
tip: 在多益 Part 7 題源中，常見出處標註為 a respected medical journal 或 trade journal（同行產業期刊）。
sentence: The breakthrough findings were published in a peer-reviewed international scientific journal.
sentenceZh: 這項突破性發現發表在經同儕審查的國際科學期刊上。

collocations: interviewed by journalists (接受記者採訪)
tip: 同義字為 reporter, correspondent。常出現在公關發布會（press conference）情境。
sentence: The public relations manager handed out press kits to journalists prior to the announcement.
sentenceZh: 公共關係經理在發布會前向記者們發放了新聞資料袋。

tip: 名詞，通常指較長途的地面或陸地旅行。同義字為 trip, travel, voyage。
sentence: Commuters experienced lengthy travel delays during their morning journey due to signal failures.
sentenceZh: 由於號誌故障，通勤族在早晨通勤途中遭遇了長時間的延誤。

zh: 判斷；評定；(n) 裁判；法官
tip: 分詞片語常考 Judging from / by...（由…來判斷的話）。名詞可指競賽的「評審」。
sentence: Judging by the positive initial feedback, the product is expected to sell out quickly.
sentenceZh: 從最初正面的市場反饋來看，該產品預計很快就會售罄。

zh: 動輒批評的；妄下判斷的
collocations: avoid being judgmental (避免過於主觀批評)
tip: 字根為 judge + ment + al。商務職場中多強調客觀（objective），避免 judgmental（主觀武斷批判的態度）。
sentence: Managers are trained to offer constructive criticism during performance reviews without appearing judgmental.
sentenceZh: 經理人員接受過培訓，在進行績效評估時能提出建設性批評而不會顯得吹毛求疵。

collocations: highway junction (高速公路交流道/交叉口)
at the junction of (在…的交匯處)
tip: 交通路況報導或辦公室路線指引題型中常見，指道路交會點。同義字為 intersection。
sentence: Turn right immediately after passing the busy motorway junction to reach the logistics terminal.
sentenceZh: 通過繁忙的高速公路交匯點後立即右轉，即可抵達物流樞紐中心。

collocations: do justice to (公平對待；充分展現)
tip: 商務演說常見片語 do justice to something（充分展現某事物的優點/實力）。
sentence: The photograph on the brochure does not do justice to the spacious elegance of the hotel suites.
sentenceZh: 宣傳手冊上的照片並未能充分展現這家飯店套房的寬敞與優雅。

collocations: justify the expense (證明花費合理)
justify the decision (為決定提出合理解釋)
hard to justify (難以自圓其說)
tip: 預算審查必備字：justify costs / expenses（提出充分理由以證實開銷的必要性）。名詞為 justification。
sentence: The project manager had to justify the additional expenditures to the chief financial officer.
sentenceZh: 專案經理必須向財務長合理解釋並證明這些額外支出的必要性。

collocations: be keen on doing (熱衷於做…)
tip: 常考搭配：keen competition（同義 fierce competition）；be keen to do something（渴望做某事）。
sentence: The investment group has expressed a keen interest in acquiring the commercial real estate.
sentenceZh: 該投資集團對收購該商業地產表現出了濃厚的興趣。

collocations: keenly priced (定價極具競爭力的)
tip: 高分搭配片語：keenly aware that / of（強烈且深切地意識到…）。
sentence: The executive committee is keenly aware of the logistical challenges posed by the supply chain delay.
sentenceZh: 執行委員會深切意識到供應鏈延誤所帶來的物流挑戰。

collocations: keep someone informed (使某人隨時知悉)
tip: 商務書信高頻：Please keep me updated / informed（請隨時讓我掌握最新狀況）。keep track of 為重要片語。
sentence: Employees are required to keep detailed records of all travel expenses for accounting verification.
sentenceZh: 員工必須保存所有出差費用的詳細記錄，以供會計部門查核。

tip: 多益中最常以複合字出現，如 bookkeeper（記帳員，名詞 bookkeeping 記帳）。
sentence: The company hired an experienced bookkeeper to organize its accounts receivable.
sentenceZh: 該公司聘請了一位經驗豐富的記帳員來整理其應收帳款。

zh: 關鍵的；主要的；(n) 關鍵
collocations: key player (主要成員；關鍵角色)
tip: 作形容詞時表「關鍵的」，同義於 crucial, vital, pivotal。如 key speaker / key component。
sentence: Effective internal communication is a key element in completing projects within the deadline.
sentenceZh: 有效的內部溝通是在期限內完成專案的關鍵要素。

tip: 多益聽力 Part 1 常考辦公桌物品描述：typing on a keyboard（正在鍵盤上打字）。
sentence: The administrative staff requested ergonomic keyboards to help reduce wrist strain during long shifts.
sentenceZh: 行政人員申請了人體工學鍵盤，以減輕長時間值班時的手腕負擔。

collocations: get a kick out of (從…獲得樂趣)
tip: 多益商業常考動詞片語 kick off（正式開始、啟動活動或專案）。
sentence: The marketing team will kick off the nationwide advertising campaign next Monday morning.
sentenceZh: 行銷團隊將於下週一上午正式啟動全國廣告宣傳活動。

tip: 商務專案必備用語：kickoff meeting（專案啟動會議，指跨部門集合召開的第一場專案會議）。
sentence: All team leaders must attend the project kickoff meeting scheduled for ten o'clock.
sentenceZh: 所有團隊負責人皆必須出席排定於十點召開的專案啟動會議。

tip: 常出現在飯店服務、主題樂園宣傳或休閒旅遊活動中，如 kid-friendly amenities（適合兒童的設施）。
sentence: The resort added several kid-friendly amenities to attract more family travelers during the summer.
sentenceZh: 該度假村增設了數項適合兒童的設施，以在夏季吸引更多家庭旅客。

tip: 拼寫注意：過去式與分詞需重複 p（kidnapped, kidnapping）。名詞綁匪為 kidnapper。
sentence: Corporate travel policies include stringent security protocols for executives visiting high-risk destinations.
sentenceZh: 企業商務差旅政策中包含了嚴格的安全防範條款，以保護造訪高風險地區的企業主管。

collocations: ransom demanded by kidnappers (綁匪索求的贖金)
tip: 多益偶爾出現在海外商務差旅安全險（kidnap and ransom insurance）的合約保單條款描述中。
sentence: The security firm successfully negotiated the hostage's release from the armed kidnappers.
sentenceZh: 該安全顧問公司成功透過談判讓武裝綁匪釋放了人質。

tip: 健康保險（health insurance coverage）或健檢報告題型偶爾出現器官名稱。
sentence: Comprehensive corporate health screening packages typically include regular tests for liver and kidney function.
sentenceZh: 企業提供的全面健康檢查方案通常包含定期的肝腎功能檢測。

tip: 物流與貨運計價常考縮寫 kg。航運計費常按 weight per kilogram（每公斤重量）計算。
sentence: The air cargo service charges an additional fee for every kilogram exceeding the weight limit.
sentenceZh: 航空貨運服務會針對超出重量限制的每一公斤額外收取費用。

collocations: within a five-kilometer radius (在五公里半徑範圍內)
tip: 常縮寫為 km。注意英式拼法為 kilometre。常考於出差里程補貼（mileage/kilometer reimbursement）。
sentence: Employees can claim travel compensation of fifty cents per kilometer when using their personal vehicles.
sentenceZh: 員工在公務中使用私家車時，可按每公里五十美分申請差旅交通補助。

collocations: next of kin (最近親屬；緊急聯絡人)
tip: 最重要的人資表格片語：next of kin（直系親屬/法定最近代理人），常見於入職緊急聯絡人欄位。
sentence: New hires are requested to designate their next of kin on the emergency notification form.
sentenceZh: 新進員工需在緊急聯絡人表單上指定其最近親屬。

zh: 仁慈的；客氣的；(n) 種類
tip: 商業信件結尾落款常見 Kind regards。作名詞表示「種類」時等同 type, sort。
sentence: We appreciate your kind assistance in resolving the shipping discrepancy so promptly.
sentenceZh: 我們非常感謝您如此迅速地協助解決貨運數量不符的問題。

collocations: kindly inform us (煩請通知我們)
tip: 商務書信高頻客套副詞！等同於 please，但語氣更加正式禮貌：Kindly reply by Friday（煩請於週五前回覆）。
sentence: Attendees are kindly reminded to silence their mobile devices throughout the presentation.
sentenceZh: 敬請與會者在整個簡報過程中將行動裝置設定為靜音。

collocations: thank you for your kindness (感謝您的熱心)
tip: 多益感謝信 Part 7 常見感謝用語，如 express gratitude for your kindness during my stay。
sentence: The visiting delegates expressed their heartfelt gratitude for the warm hospitality and kindness shown by the host.
sentenceZh: 來訪代表團對主辦方展現的熱情款待與厚意表達了由衷的感謝。

tip: 常見工安設備 first-aid kit（急救箱），或新進員工培訓的 welcome kit / orientation kit。
sentence: Safety regulations mandate that an accessible first-aid kit be placed on every floor of the facility.
sentenceZh: 安全法規強制要求該設施的每個樓層都必須放置一個易於取得的急救箱。

collocations: as far as I know (據我所知)
tip: 被動片語考點：be known for + 特色（因…聞名）；be known as + 身分（作為…為人所知）。
sentence: Please let the organizing committee know if you require any specialized audiovisual equipment.
sentenceZh: 如果您需要任何特定的視聽設備，請儘早告知籌備委員會。

collocations: knowingly violate (知法犯法；明知故犯)
tip: 合約與法律情境常考：knowingly breach the agreement（明知故犯違反協議）。同義字為 deliberately。
sentence: The audit revealed that the supplier had knowingly shipped non-compliant materials to the site.
sentenceZh: 稽核結果顯示，該供應商明知故犯地將不符合規格的材料運送到工地。

collocations: working knowledge of (對…具備實務知識)
tip: 徵才廣告必考片語：a working knowledge of + 軟體/語言（具備某工具的實際操作知識）。為不可數名詞！
sentence: The ideal candidate must possess an in-depth knowledge of international trade regulations.
sentenceZh: 理想的候選人必須對國際貿易法規具備深入的專業知識。

tip: 顧客讚美信高頻形容詞：The staff was extremely helpful and knowledgeable about the products。
sentence: Our knowledgeable customer support representatives are available around the clock to assist you.
sentenceZh: 我們專業熱忱的客服代表全天候為您提供解答與協助。

tip: laboratory 的日常商務簡稱，聽力題 Part 3 常見。注意其職稱搭配 lab technician。
sentence: Technicians in the quality control lab tested several samples before releasing the shipment.
sentenceZh: 品管實驗室的技術人員在放行該批貨物前對多個樣品進行了測試。

zh: 標籤；商標；(v) 貼標籤於
tip: 倉儲物流必考：clearly labeled（清楚貼上標籤的）。例如：All hazardous chemicals must be clearly labeled.
sentence: Ensure each outgoing parcel has an accurate shipping label attached to avoid delivery mistakes.
sentenceZh: 請確保每件寄出的包裹上都貼有正確的貨運標籤，以避免投遞錯誤。

tip: 勞工成本：labor costs；勞工短缺：labor shortage。美式拼寫為 labor，英式拼寫為 labour。
sentence: Rising labor costs have prompted the factory management to automate several packaging procedures.
sentenceZh: 不斷上升的人工成本促使工廠管理階層將數個包裝程序走向自動化。

tip: 正式全名。常與研發（R&D）、藥廠檢測、醫療生技等聽力 Part 4 導覽演講主題連動考出。
sentence: The company invested ten million dollars into constructing a state-of-the-art testing laboratory.
sentenceZh: 該公司投資了一千萬美元建造一座最先進的檢測實驗室。

tip: 文法陷阱：lack 作動詞時為「及物動詞」，直接加受詞（lack experience）；作名詞時必須加 of（a lack of experience）。
sentence: The proposed product development was unfortunately canceled due to a lack of corporate funding.
sentenceZh: 令人遺憾的是，由於缺乏公司資金，擬議的產品開發專案已遭取消。

tip: 固定介系詞搭配：be lacking in + 抽象名詞（如 confidence, detail, evidence）。
sentence: The initial proposal was found lacking in concrete financial projections and was sent back for revision.
sentenceZh: 最初的提案被認為缺乏具體的財務預測，已被退回修正。

collocations: lag behind competitors (落後於競爭對手)
tip: 商務競爭常用搭配：lag behind（落後於…）。出差常見 jet lag（時差反應）。
sentence: Domestic sales continued to lag behind projections despite extensive advertising efforts.
sentenceZh: 儘管付出了大量的廣告努力，國內銷售量仍持續落後於預期。

collocations: laid-back management style (放任悠閒的管理風格)
tip: 休閒度假村、咖啡廳宣傳文宣常見詞。同義字為 relaxed, easygoing。
sentence: The boutique agency boasts a laid-back corporate culture while maintaining high productivity.
sentenceZh: 這家精品廣告代理商以輕鬆愜意的企業文化自豪，同時保持著極高的生產力。

collocations: lament the loss of (哀悼…的喪失)
tip: 多益在商業評論文章中常出現：Industry experts lamented the lack of regulatory oversight（產業界專家感嘆監管機制的不足）。
sentence: Business owners lamented the disruption caused by prolonged road construction in front of their shops.
sentenceZh: 店家老闆們對店門前長期的道路施工所帶來的營業干擾深感無奈與抱怨。

collocations: replace a lamp bulb (更換燈泡)
tip: 多益聽力 Part 1 常見圖片描述：A desk lamp has been placed next to the computer monitor.
sentence: Please turn off your desk lamp and computer equipment before leaving the office for the day.
sentenceZh: 當天下班離開辦公室前，請務必關閉您的檯燈與電腦設備。

collocations: land a major contract (成功贏得大合約)
tip: 商務隱喻：land a deal / job 表示「成功拿下交易/爭取到工作」；在航空情境指「飛機降落」。
sentence: Flight QA-302 is scheduled to land at Frankfurt International Airport at three in the afternoon.
sentenceZh: QA-302 航班預定於下午三點降落在法蘭克福國際機場。

tip: 航空廣播通知高頻詞：prepare for landing（準備降落）。
sentence: Passengers are requested to fasten their seatbelts as the aircraft begins its final landing approach.
sentenceZh: 飛機已開始進行最後降落進場，請乘客們繫妥安全帶。

collocations: rent from a landlady (向女房東租屋)
tip: 租屋合約（lease agreement）題型常見名詞。男房東為 landlord。
sentence: The prospective tenant met with the landlady to discuss the terms of the commercial lease.
sentenceZh: 準租客與女房東會面，以商討商業租約的條款。

tip: 租約（Lease Agreement）的核心雙方：Landlord (Lessor) 與 Tenant (Lessee)。必考主體辨認！
sentence: Tenants must provide sixty days of written notice to the landlord before terminating the lease.
sentenceZh: 租客在終止租約之前，必須向房東提供六十天的書面通知。

collocations: landmark decision (里程碑式的重大決定)
tip: 兼具實體「地標」與抽象「重大里程碑/重大歷史裁決」雙重考點（landmark ruling/deal）。
sentence: The corporate headquarters was constructed next to the city's most recognizable architectural landmark.
sentenceZh: 這座企業總部建於該城市最知名的建築地標旁。

zh: 景觀；風景；(v) 美化環境
tip: 商務常考比喻用法：the changing business landscape（瞬息萬變的商業格局/市場生態）。
sentence: Rapid digital transformation has dramatically reshaped the global retail landscape.
sentenceZh: 快速的數位轉型極大地重塑了全球零售業的競爭格局。

zh: 景觀園藝師；庭園設計家
tip: 辦公大樓或物業維護情境題中，常與 maintenance worker, gardener 一起出現在合約承包對象名單中。
sentence: The property management group hired an award-winning landscaper to redesign the office courtyard.
sentenceZh: 該物業管理集團聘請了一位獲獎的景觀園藝師來重新設計辦公大樓的中庭花園。

collocations: languish in obscurity (默默無聞；無人問津)
languish under debt (因債務而陷入困境)
tip: 高階閱讀單字：常用於描述未被採納的提案、停滯的股票或低迷的產品銷量。
sentence: Without adequate promotional funding, the revolutionary prototype languished in the warehouse for months.
sentenceZh: 由於缺乏足夠的宣傳資金，這款革命性的原型產品在倉庫中滯留停擺了數月之久。

zh: 小過失；失效；(v) 失效；流逝
collocations: lapse of coverage (保險中斷/失效)
let the policy lapse (任由保單失效)
tip: 保險與合約情境必考：a lapse in coverage 指「保險保障中斷/過期」。動詞 lapse 指「失效（期滿未續）」。
sentence: Policyholders are warned that non-payment of premiums will cause their life insurance to lapse.
sentenceZh: 保戶接獲警告，若未如期繳納保費將導致其人壽保單失效。

tip: 採購情境搭配：place a large order（下大筆訂單）；片語 at large 常指 as a whole（廣大群眾/整體）。
sentence: The wholesale distributor offered a five percent discount on particularly large bulk orders.
sentenceZh: 該批發經銷商針對特別大宗的大筆訂單提供了百分之五的折扣。

tip: 複合形容詞，中間帶連字號。同義字為 mass, extensive。常用於工廠量產或大型基建。
sentence: The company secured governmental approval to begin large-scale infrastructure renovations downtown.
sentenceZh: 該公司獲得了政府核准，得以在市中心展開大規模的基礎設施改造工程。

zh: 猛烈打擊；抨擊；(n) 鞭打
tip: 商務新聞偶考 lash out at...（公開嚴厲批判對手或政策）。氣象報告中常見 heavy rain lashed the city。
sentence: Shareholders lashed out at executive directors during the annual general meeting over poor dividend yields.
sentenceZh: 在年度股東大會上，股東們針對股息殖利率低劣一事對執行董事們展開了猛烈抨擊。

collocations: while supplies last (數量有限，送/售完為止)
tip: 促銷活動必備片語：While supplies last!（贈完即止/售完即止）。作動詞時不需加介系詞也可以接時間長度。
sentence: The upcoming introductory promotional sale is scheduled to last until the end of the month.
sentenceZh: 這場即將到來的新品上市促銷活動預計將持續到本月底。

tip: 出差與差旅改期常客。注意在句中當作前置修飾名詞的複合形容詞時需加連字號（last-minute adjustments）。
sentence: We apologize for the last-minute change to the seminar schedule caused by the speaker's delayed flight.
sentenceZh: 因演講者的班機延誤而導致研討會時程在最後一刻發生變動，我們深感抱歉。

zh: 遲到的；晚期的；已故的；(ad) 遲到
tip: 帳單必考：late fee / late charge（逾期罰款）。注意 late 本身可當副詞（arrive late），千萬別用 lately（最近）。
sentence: Clients who fail to submit payments on time will incur a late fee of two percent.
sentenceZh: 未如期付款的客戶將被加收百分之二的滯納金。

tip: 時態必考題！lately 通常與「現在完成式」（have/has + p.p.）連用，同義於 recently。不可修飾遲到！
sentence: The human resources division has experienced an influx of international applications lately.
sentenceZh: 人資部門最近接到了大量來自海外的求職申請。

collocations: at a later date (在日後的某個日期)
no later than (不遲於；在…之前)
tip: 多益截止日期極高頻考點：no later than + 時間（最晚在…之前，等同 by）。例如：no later than 5:00 PM。
sentence: All departmental budget proposals must be submitted no later than Friday afternoon.
sentenceZh: 所有部門預算提案最晚必須於週五下午之前提交。

zh: 後者的；後半期的；(n) 後者
collocations: the former... the latter... (前者…後者…)
the latter half of the year (下半年)
tip: 常考對比片語：the former（前者）與 the latter（後者）。發音與拼字注意：latter（雙 t）與 later（單 t）不可混淆。
sentence: Both proposals were impressive, but the committee ultimately selected the latter because of lower implementation costs.
sentenceZh: 這兩份提案都令人印象深刻，但委員會最終選擇了後者，因為其實施成本較低。

collocations: launch a campaign (展開行銷活動)
launch a new service (推出新服務)
tip: 行銷領域超級核心詞彙！product launch event（新品發表盛會）。同義字為 release, roll out, introduce。
sentence: The electronics manufacturer intends to launch its flagship smartphone during the technology summit.
sentenceZh: 該電子製造商打算在科技高峰會期間推出其旗艦智慧型手機。

zh: 待洗衣物；洗衣店；洗衣服務
tip: 飯店住宿常考題：complimentary laundry service（免費洗衣服務）或 dry-cleaning service（乾洗服務）。
sentence: Hotel guests can take advantage of our same-day laundry and dry-cleaning services.
sentenceZh: 飯店房客可充分利用我們提供的當日洗衣與乾洗服務。

tip: 航空器（飛機）與火車上洗手間的正式名稱。在機艙廣播或聽力 Part 4 機內情境常見。
sentence: Passengers must remain seated with their seatbelts fastened while the aircraft's lavatory sign indicates occupied.
sentenceZh: 當飛機洗手間顯示佔用或遇氣流顛簸時，乘客必須在座位上坐好並繫緊安全帶。

collocations: comply with the law (遵守法律)
tip: 常考搭配動詞：abide by / comply with / adhere to the law（遵守法律）。違反法律則是 violate the law。
sentence: All commercial vehicles must undergo regular safety checks as mandated by federal transportation law.
sentenceZh: 依據聯邦交通法規之強制規定，所有商用車輛都必須接受定期安全檢查。

collocations: lawful permanent resident (合法永久居民)
tip: 同義字為 legal, legitimate。反義字為 unlawful 或 illegal。
sentence: The document serves as legal confirmation that the enterprise operates under completely lawful terms.
sentenceZh: 該文件作為法律確認，證明該企業完全在合法的條款下營運。

collocations: file a lawsuit against (對…提起訴訟)
tip: 商業法律常考動詞搭配：file / bring a lawsuit against someone（對某人提告）；settle a lawsuit（庭外和解）。
sentence: The pharmaceutical company settled the patent infringement lawsuit out of court for an undisclosed sum.
sentenceZh: 這家製藥公司以未公開的金額在庭外和解了專利侵權訴訟。

tip: 同義字為 attorney, counsel, legal representative。合約審核題型常見角色。
sentence: Our corporate lawyer is currently reviewing the non-disclosure agreement to protect our proprietary assets.
sentenceZh: 我們的公司法務律師目前正在審閱保密協議，以保護我們的專有資產。

collocations: lay the foundation for (為…奠定基礎)
tip: 文法大陷阱：lay（放置，及物，三態為 lay, laid, laid）vs. lie（躺/在於，不及物，三態為 lie, lay, lain）。
sentence: The strategic alliance established this week will lay the groundwork for global expansion next year.
sentenceZh: 本週建立的策略聯盟將為明年的全球擴張奠定堅實的基礎。

tip: 組織結構中常考 layers of management（管理層級，扁平化組織會 remove layers of management）。
sentence: Eliminating unnecessary layers of middle management has accelerated executive decision-making.
sentenceZh: 消除不必要的中階管理層級，大幅加速了高階主管的決策流程。

tip: 名詞連在一起寫 layoff；動詞片語分開寫 lay off（如 lay off 200 workers）。同義字為 downsizing。
sentence: Despite corporate restructuring, the factory managed to avoid widespread staff layoffs this quarter.
sentenceZh: 儘管面臨企業重組，該工廠本季仍設法避免了大規模的員工裁員。

zh: 格局；版面配置；動線設計
tip: 出現在辦公空間翻新或雜誌廣告設計中。常見 open-plan office layout（開放式辦公格局）。
sentence: The proposed office layout aims to enhance collaboration among cross-functional project teams.
sentenceZh: 擬議中的辦公室新格局旨在加強跨部門專案團隊之間的協同合作。

zh: 帶領；導致；(n) 領先；線索
collocations: take the lead (帶頭；取得領先地位)
tip: 重要因果片語：lead to + 名詞/動名詞（等同 result in, cause）。如 Lack of preparation led to failure.
sentence: Strict adherence to quality standards will ultimately lead to higher customer satisfaction.
sentenceZh: 嚴格遵守品質標準最終將能帶來更高的客戶滿意度。

tip: 常考 industry/market leader，在企業背景介紹中表示「最具規模與影響力的公司行號」。
sentence: As a recognized industry leader in green tech, the company sets the standard for emissions reduction.
sentenceZh: 作為公認的綠色科技產業領導者，該公司樹立了減少碳排的標竿。

tip: 多益形容詞考題常客：a leading manufacturer / authority / expert（頂尖/一流的製造商/權威/專家）。
sentence: The organization invited a leading authority on international intellectual property law to speak.
sentenceZh: 該機構邀請了一位國際智慧財產權法領域的權威專家前來演講。

collocations: in a league of one's own (獨步一時；無與倫比)
tip: 偶出現在跨企業合作同盟或企業贊助體育運動競賽（sports league sponsorship）的文章中。
sentence: The telecommunications conglomerate signed a multi-year sponsorship contract with the national basketball league.
sentenceZh: 這家大型電信集團與國家籃球聯盟簽署了一份為期多年的贊助合約。

zh: 洩漏；漏水；(n) 漏油/水；漏洞
collocations: leak confidential information (洩露機密情報)
tip: 兼具實體物理「管線漏水/漏氣」與抽象資訊「商業機密外洩 (leak confidential data)」兩種考題面向。
sentence: A maintenance technician was dispatched promptly after an employee discovered a water leak in the server room.
sentenceZh: 在一名員工發現伺服器機房漏水後，維修技術人員隨即被迅速派遣前往處理。

tip: 資訊安全領域必考：data leakage prevention（防止資料外洩系統）。化學工廠情境指實體物質洩漏。
sentence: Upgraded enterprise firewall systems were implemented immediately to eliminate the threat of proprietary data leakage.
sentenceZh: 企業立即安裝了升級後的防火牆系統，以杜絕專有資料外洩的威脅。
